text: First pass 第一次读这一章 Imagine two recordings, each containing both voices. ICA asks which hidden signals could have produced both recordings together. Start with what is observed, what is unknown, and what “recovery” is allowed to mean; the matrix notation is a compact way of keeping those roles separate. 想象两段录音里都包含两个人的声音。ICA 要问的是：哪些隐藏信号能共同产生这两段录音？先弄清哪些量被观测、哪些量未知，以及“恢复”允许留下哪些不确定性；矩阵只是把这些角色分清的一种简写。 After this pass, you should be able to: 读完这一遍，你应该能： Compute two mixtures from two source values and a known mixing matrix. Explain why changing a source sign does not by itself mean separation failed. Tell apart exact reconstruction, zero correlation, and independence. 给出两个源的取值与已知混合矩阵，能算出两个混合值。 能解释为什么源的符号发生翻转不等于分离失败。 能区分精确重构、零相关和独立这三个要求。 Before you start: addition, averages and a two-equation linear system are enough for the first pass. Use the notation guide for bold letters and the glossary for “source” and “sensor.” 先备知识： 第一遍只需会加法、平均数和二元一次方程组。粗体字母见 符号指南 ，“源”和“传感器”见 术语表 。 Read first: the model and its assumptions , ambiguities , then the two-step example . Return to the covariance parameter count in PCA versus ICA after the whitening chapter; the count explains why a rotation remains, but is not needed to understand the mixing equations. 先读路线： 模型及假设 → 不确定性 → 两步示例 。读完白化章再回看 PCA 与 ICA 中的协方差参数计数；计数解释为什么还剩旋转，但理解混合方程暂时用不到它。

Imagine two people speaking at the same time in a room with two microphones. Each microphone sits at a different distance from each speaker, so each records a different blend of the two voices. From the two recordings alone, without knowing where the microphones were or what the voices sound like, can we recover each voice on its own? This is the cocktail-party problem , named after our ability to follow one conversation in a noisy room (Cherry, 1953). Independent component analysis (ICA) solves an idealized version of it, and the idealization covers a surprisingly wide range of data. 设想房间里有两个人同时说话，屋里放着两只麦克风。每只麦克风到两位说话者的距离不同，因此录到的是两个声音的不同混合。只凭这两段录音，既不知道麦克风放在哪里，也不知道声音本来的样子，能否把每个人的声音分别还原出来？这就是 鸡尾酒会问题 ，得名于人在嘈杂房间里仍能听清一段对话的能力（Cherry, 1953）。独立成分分析（independent component analysis, ICA）解决的是这个问题的理想化版本，而这个理想化模型能覆盖的数据范围出乎意料地广。 shows the idea with two synthetic signals. The sources $s_1(t)$ and $s_2(t)$ are a sinusoid and a sawtooth; the sensors observe $x_1(t)$ and $x_2(t)$, each a weighted sum of the two. Neither recording looks like a clean sinusoid or a clean sawtooth, yet together the two recordings contain everything needed to undo the mixing. 用两个合成信号说明这一想法。源信号 $s_1(t)$ 与 $s_2(t)$ 分别是正弦波和锯齿波；传感器观测到 $x_1(t)$ 与 $x_2(t)$，各自是两个源的加权和。单看任何一段录音，都既不像干净的正弦波，也不像干净的锯齿波；但两段录音合在一起，已经包含了撤销混合所需的全部信息。 Two sources (left) and two observed mixtures (right). Each mixture is a different weighted sum of the same two sources. 两个源信号（左）与两个观测到的混合信号（右）。每个混合信号都是这两个源的不同加权和。 The same structure appears whenever several sensors record superpositions of a few underlying processes: 只要若干传感器记录的是少数几个潜在过程的叠加，就会出现同样的结构： EEG and MEG. Each scalp electrode or magnetometer records a weighted sum of activity from many brain sources, together with eye blinks, muscle activity and line noise. ICA is routinely used to separate such artifacts from brain signals (Makeig et al., 1996; Jung et al., 2000). Functional MRI. Every voxel's time series mixes several spatially distributed processes. Spatial ICA decomposes fMRI data into maps of coherent networks and their time courses (McKeown et al., 1998); Part VI of this book is devoted to it. Communications and audio. Antenna arrays receive superpositions of transmitted signals; microphone arrays receive superpositions of voices. Natural images. Applied to small patches of natural images, ICA yields localized, oriented filters that resemble the receptive fields of simple cells in primary visual cortex (Bell & Sejnowski, 1997; van Hateren & van der Schaaf, 1998). EEG 与 MEG。 每个头皮电极或磁强计记录的是许多脑内源活动的加权和，再加上眨眼、肌电和工频干扰。ICA 常被用来把这些伪迹与脑信号分开（Makeig et al., 1996; Jung et al., 2000）。 功能磁共振（fMRI）。 每个体素的时间序列都混合了若干空间分布的过程。空间 ICA 把 fMRI 数据分解为一组协同网络的空间图及其时间过程（McKeown et al., 1998）；本书第六部分专门讨论这一应用。 通信与音频。 天线阵列接收的是多个发射信号的叠加；麦克风阵列接收的是多个人声的叠加。 自然图像。 把 ICA 用于自然图像的小块，得到的是局部化、有方向性的滤波器，与初级视皮层简单细胞的感受野相似（Bell & Sejnowski, 1997; van Hateren & van der Schaaf, 1998）。 In each case the sensors see mixtures, the quantities of interest are the unmixed components, and neither the mixing weights nor the components are known in advance. The task is therefore called blind source separation (BSS). ICA is the best-known approach to it, and the subject of this book. 在这些例子里，传感器看到的都是混合，我们关心的是未混合的成分，而混合权重与成分本身事先都不知道。因此这一任务被称为 盲源分离 （blind source separation, BSS）。ICA 是解决它最著名的方法，也是本书的主题。 Jutten and Hérault (1991) described an early adaptive algorithm for separating sources; Comon (1994) gave ICA a precise formulation and proved that it is identifiable; and the Infomax algorithm of Bell and Sejnowski (1995) brought it into wide use. Hyvärinen, Karhunen and Oja (2001) and Comon and Jutten (2010) give book-length treatments. Jutten 与 Hérault（1991）描述了一种早期的自适应源分离算法；Comon（1994）给出了 ICA 的严格表述，并证明了它的可辨识性；Bell 与 Sejnowski（1995）的 Infomax 算法使 ICA 得到广泛应用。Hyvärinen、Karhunen 与 Oja（2001）以及 Comon 与 Jutten（2010）是这一领域的专著。

Write the $n$ unknown source signals at time $t$ as a vector $\bs(t) = (s_1(t), \dots, s_n(t))^\top$ and the $m$ observed signals as $\bx(t) = (x_1(t), \dots, x_m(t))^\top$. The linear instantaneous mixing model states that 把时刻 $t$ 的 $n$ 个未知源信号写成向量 $\bs(t) = (s_1(t), \dots, s_n(t))^\top$，把 $m$ 个观测信号写成 $\bx(t) = (x_1(t), \dots, x_m(t))^\top$。 线性瞬时混合模型 假设 Read the symbols by role. $\bs(t)$ lists all source values at one instant; $\bx(t)$ lists all sensor readings at that instant. A row of $\bA$ tells one sensor how to combine the sources; a column tells how one source reaches every sensor. The index $t$ changes the values, not the fixed mixing weights. 按角色读符号。 $\bs(t)$ 把某一时刻所有源的值列在一起，$\bx(t)$ 把同一时刻所有传感器读数列在一起。$\bA$ 的一行说明一个传感器怎样组合各源，一列说明一个源怎样到达各传感器。下标 $t$ 改变的是信号值，而不是固定的混合权重。 $$\bx(t) = \bA\,\bs(t), \qquad t = 1, \dots, T,$$ where $\bA \in \R^{m \times n}$ is an unknown constant mixing matrix . Column $j$ of $\bA$, written $\ba_j$, describes how source $j$ reaches the sensors, so can also be read as $\bx(t) = \sum_{j=1}^n s_j(t)\,\ba_j$: every observation is a superposition of fixed patterns $\ba_j$ with time-varying amplitudes $s_j(t)$. Stacking the $T$ samples as columns gives the matrix form $\bX = \bA\bS$, with $\bX \in \R^{m \times T}$ and $\bS \in \R^{n \times T}$. 其中 $\bA \in \R^{m \times n}$ 是未知的常数 混合矩阵 。$\bA$ 的第 $j$ 列记为 $\ba_j$，描述源 $j$ 如何到达各传感器，所以 也可以写成 $\bx(t) = \sum_{j=1}^n s_j(t)\,\ba_j$：每个观测都是若干固定模式 $\ba_j$ 的叠加，叠加系数 $s_j(t)$ 随时间变化。把 $T$ 个样本按列排开，得到矩阵形式 $\bX = \bA\bS$，其中 $\bX \in \R^{m \times T}$，$\bS \in \R^{n \times T}$。 Instantaneous means that each source reaches every sensor at the same moment, without delays or echoes. This holds well for EEG, where electrical fields propagate through the head essentially instantly, while spatial ICA of fMRI uses an analogous linear factorization with spatial maps as its sources. The latter is a statistical approximation, not a statement that the haemodynamic response is instantaneous or spatially uniform. It does not hold for speech recorded in a real room, where each microphone receives filtered and delayed copies of the voices (a convolutive mixture); that harder problem lies outside this book. 瞬时 指每个源同时到达所有传感器，没有延迟或回声。对 EEG 来说这一假设相当准确，因为电场在头部的传播几乎是瞬时的；fMRI 的空间 ICA 则以空间图为源，采用类似的线性分解。这是一种统计近似，并不表示血流动力学响应是瞬时的或空间上一致的。但在真实房间里录制的语音并不满足：每只麦克风收到的是经过滤波和延迟的声音副本（卷积混合），这个更难的问题不在本书范围之内。 Throughout the book, the model comes with the following standing assumptions, unless a chapter says otherwise. 除非某章另有说明，全书都在以下基本假设下讨论这个模型。 The sources $s_1, \dots, s_n$ are mutually statistically independent. At most one source is Gaussian. The mixing matrix $\bA$ has full column rank $n$; in particular $m \ge n$. The samples $\bs(1), \dots, \bs(T)$ are independent draws from one distribution, and each source has zero mean and finite, nonzero variance. 源 $s_1, \dots, s_n$ 相互统计独立。 至多有一个源是高斯的。 混合矩阵 $\bA$ 列满秩，秩为 $n$；特别地 $m \ge n$。 样本 $\bs(1), \dots, \bs(T)$ 是来自同一分布的独立抽样；各源均值为零，方差有限且不为零。 Independence is the structural heart of the model: when densities exist, the joint density factorizes, $p_{\bs}(\bs) = \prod_{i=1}^n p_i(s_i)$. The restriction on Gaussian sources is what makes the problem solvable at all; proves that, together with the other assumptions, it is also enough. Full column rank ensures that no source is lost or confounded with another. Zero means cost nothing: subtract the sample mean of $\bx$ first, and recover the source means afterwards as $\bW\,\E[\bx]$. Finite variances make the covariance of $\bx$ well defined, and nonzero variances rule out a source that is identically zero, which could be paired with any column of $\bA$. The usual i.i.d. batch contrast ignores sample order: shuffling the samples leaves that objective unchanged. A particular online optimizer can still depend on presentation order, and temporally dependent observations require different sampling-error calculations. shows how temporal structure can be used instead. 独立性是这个模型的结构核心：当密度存在时，联合密度可以分解为 $p_{\bs}(\bs) = \prod_{i=1}^n p_i(s_i)$。对高斯源个数的限制，是问题能够求解的前提； 会证明：在其余假设成立时，这一限制也是充分的。列满秩保证没有哪个源丢失或与其他源混淆。零均值不构成任何限制：先减去 $\bx$ 的样本均值，最后再用 $\bW\,\E[\bx]$ 恢复源的均值即可。方差有限保证 $\bx$ 的协方差有定义；方差不为零则排除了恒为零的源，因为这样的源可以与 $\bA$ 的任意一列相配。通常的独立同分布批处理对比函数不使用样本顺序：打乱样本不会改变这一目标函数。但具体的在线优化器仍可能依赖输入顺序；当观测存在时间依赖时，抽样误差的计算也必须相应调整。 会说明如何转而利用时间结构。 Given samples $\bx(1), \dots, \bx(T)$ from the model , independent component analysis estimates an unmixing matrix $\bW \in \R^{n \times m}$ such that the components of the output $\by = \bW\bx$ are mutually independent and $\Cov(\by)$ is positive definite. Under the standing assumptions, this nondegeneracy condition is equivalent to $\rank(\bW\bA)=n$. The matrix $\bP = \bW\bA \in \R^{n \times n}$, which maps sources to outputs through $\by = \bP\bs$, is called the global (or gain) matrix. 给定来自模型 的样本 $\bx(1), \dots, \bx(T)$， 独立成分分析 估计一个 解混矩阵 $\bW \in \R^{n \times m}$，使输出 $\by = \bW\bx$ 的各分量相互独立，且 $\Cov(\by)$ 正定。在基本假设下，这一非退化条件等价于 $\rank(\bW\bA)=n$。矩阵 $\bP = \bW\bA \in \R^{n \times n}$ 通过 $\by = \bP\bs$ 把源映射到输出，称为 全局矩阵 （或增益矩阵）。 The nondegeneracy requirement is essential: $\bW=\bzero$ would otherwise produce constant, hence independent, outputs without recovering any source. A common normalization is $\Cov(\by)=\bI$. When $m>n$, full row rank of $\bW$ alone is insufficient; its rows must also preserve all $n$ dimensions of the signal subspace. 非退化要求不可省略：否则 $\bW=\bzero$ 产生的常数输出也相互独立，却没有恢复任何源。通常采用的归一化是 $\Cov(\by)=\bI$。当 $m>n$ 时，仅要求 $\bW$ 行满秩还不够；它的行还必须保留信号子空间中的全部 $n$ 个维度。 With finite data, exact independence cannot be verified, so in practice $\bW$ is chosen to optimize a contrast function , a statistic that measures how independent or non-Gaussian the outputs are. Chapters 5 and 6 build these contrasts; Part III turns them into algorithms. 在有限数据下无法验证严格的独立性，因此实践中 $\bW$ 是通过优化某个 对比函数 （衡量输出有多独立或多非高斯的统计量）得到的。第 5、6 章构造这些对比函数，第三部分把它们变成算法。 Micro example: mix, then undo the mixing 微型手算：先混合，再撤销混合 Take one instant with $s_1=3$, $s_2=1$, and suppose the mixing equations are known: $x_1=s_1+s_2$ and $x_2=s_1-s_2$. 取某一时刻 $s_1=3$、$s_2=1$，并暂时假设混合方程已知：$x_1=s_1+s_2$、$x_2=s_1-s_2$。 Forward: $x_1=4$ and $x_2=2$. Both sensors contain both sources. Add the equations: $x_1+x_2=2s_1$, so $s_1=(4+2)/2=3$. Subtract them: $x_1-x_2=2s_2$, so $s_2=(4-2)/2=1$. 正向计算：$x_1=4$、$x_2=2$，两个传感器都含有两个源。 两式相加：$x_1+x_2=2s_1$，所以 $s_1=(4+2)/2=3$。 两式相减：$x_1-x_2=2s_2$，所以 $s_2=(4-2)/2=1$。 This checks how a known invertible mixture is undone. It does not solve ICA: in ICA the coefficients are unknown and must be inferred from many observations. One pair of numbers cannot establish that two random sources are independent. 这检查了怎样撤销一个已知、可逆的混合，却还没有解决 ICA：ICA 的系数未知，需要从许多观测中推断。单独一对数也不能证明两个随机源独立。 Quick check 1. If we rename the second source $s_2^{\prime}=-s_2$, what must happen to its mixing column? 自测 1。 若把第二个源改记为 $s_2^{\prime}=-s_2$，它的混合矩阵列应怎样变化？ Check the answer 查看答案 Negate that column too: $(-\ba_2)(-s_2)=\ba_2s_2$. The observations are unchanged, which is the sign ambiguity. 把对应列也取反：$(-\ba_2)(-s_2)=\ba_2s_2$。观测不变，这就是符号不确定性。 Quick check 2. Would two identical recordings $x_1=x_2=s_1+s_2$ suffice to invert two unrestricted sources? 自测 2。 若两段录音完全相同，$x_1=x_2=s_1+s_2$，能否直接反解两个不受额外约束的源？ Check the answer 查看答案 No. There is only one independent equation: $(s_1,s_2)=(3,1)$ and $(2,2)$ both give $(x_1,x_2)=(4,4)$. The mixing matrix has rank one. 不能。只有一个独立方程：$(s_1,s_2)=(3,1)$ 和 $(2,2)$ 都给出 $(x_1,x_2)=(4,4)$。混合矩阵的秩只有一。

Two things are lost in principle, however much data we have. The first is scale , including sign: since $\bx = \sum_j s_j\,\ba_j = \sum_j (s_j/\alpha_j)(\alpha_j\,\ba_j)$ for any nonzero numbers $\alpha_j$, a source can be multiplied by a constant and its column divided by the same constant without changing the observations. The second is order : the sum does not depend on how its terms are numbered, so permuting the sources and the columns of $\bA$ together changes nothing either. 无论数据有多少，有两样东西原则上无法恢复。第一是 尺度 （包括符号）：对任意非零数 $\alpha_j$，都有 $\bx = \sum_j s_j\,\ba_j = \sum_j (s_j/\alpha_j)(\alpha_j\,\ba_j)$，所以把某个源乘以一个常数、同时把对应的列除以同一常数，观测不会改变。第二是 顺序 ：求和与各项的编号无关，因此把源和 $\bA$ 的列同时重新排列，观测同样不变。 Let $\bPi$ be an $n \times n$ permutation matrix and $\bD$ an invertible diagonal matrix. Then the pair $(\bA\bD^{-1}\bPi^\top,\ \bPi\bD\bs)$ generates exactly the same observations as $(\bA, \bs)$, and the components of $\bPi\bD\bs$ are again mutually independent, with as many Gaussian components as $\bs$. Consequently no method can do better than to find $\bW$ with $\bW\bA = \bPi\bD$, that is, to recover the sources up to order and scale. 设 $\bPi$ 是 $n \times n$ 置换矩阵，$\bD$ 是可逆对角矩阵。则 $(\bA\bD^{-1}\bPi^\top,\ \bPi\bD\bs)$ 与 $(\bA, \bs)$ 生成完全相同的观测，并且 $\bPi\bD\bs$ 的各分量仍相互独立，所含高斯分量的个数也与 $\bs$ 相同。因此任何方法最多只能找到满足 $\bW\bA = \bPi\bD$ 的 $\bW$，即在顺序与尺度意义下恢复源。 Since $\bPi^\top\bPi = \bI$, we have $(\bA\bD^{-1}\bPi^\top)(\bPi\bD\bs) = \bA\bD^{-1}\bD\bs = \bA\bs$. The components of $\bPi\bD\bs$ are the numbers $d_i s_i$ in a different order; functions of independent random variables taken one at a time remain independent, and a nonzero multiple of a variable is Gaussian exactly when the variable is. 由于 $\bPi^\top\bPi = \bI$，有 $(\bA\bD^{-1}\bPi^\top)(\bPi\bD\bs) = \bA\bD^{-1}\bD\bs = \bA\bs$。$\bPi\bD\bs$ 的分量就是重新排序后的 $d_i s_i$；对独立随机变量逐个作函数变换，结果仍然独立；而一个变量的非零倍数是高斯的，当且仅当该变量本身是高斯的。 Separation therefore succeeds when the global matrix $\bP = \bW\bA$ has exactly one nonzero entry in each row and each column. For instance, with $\bA = \bigl(\begin{smallmatrix} 1 & 0.6 \\ 0.4 & 1 \end{smallmatrix}\bigr)$, an algorithm that returns $\bW$ with $\bW\bA = \bigl(\begin{smallmatrix} 0 & -2 \\ 0.5 & 0 \end{smallmatrix}\bigr)$ has succeeded completely: its outputs are $y_1 = -2\,s_2$ and $y_2 = 0.5\,s_1$. 因此，当全局矩阵 $\bP = \bW\bA$ 的每行每列恰有一个非零元时，分离就成功了。例如，对 $\bA = \bigl(\begin{smallmatrix} 1 & 0.6 \\ 0.4 & 1 \end{smallmatrix}\bigr)$，若某算法给出的 $\bW$ 满足 $\bW\bA = \bigl(\begin{smallmatrix} 0 & -2 \\ 0.5 & 0 \end{smallmatrix}\bigr)$，它就完全成功了：输出为 $y_1 = -2\,s_2$，$y_2 = 0.5\,s_1$。 In practice the ambiguities are removed by convention. The scale is usually fixed by requiring unit variance, $\E[s_i^2] = 1$, which leaves only the sign. Signs and order are then fixed by whatever is natural for the application: in fMRI, for example, each spatial map is flipped so that its heavier tail is positive, and components are ordered by explained variance or by a contrast value. How close an estimated $\bP$ is to a scaled permutation, when separation is only approximate, is the subject of . 实践中，这些不确定性靠约定来消除。尺度通常通过要求单位方差 $\E[s_i^2] = 1$ 来固定，只剩下符号未定。符号与顺序再按应用中自然的方式确定：例如在 fMRI 中，把每张空间图翻转到其较重的尾部为正，并按解释方差或对比函数值给成分排序。当分离只是近似成功时，如何度量估计的 $\bP$ 离带尺度的置换矩阵有多近，是 的主题。

sectionEn: Why not PCA or factor analysis?
sectionZh: 为什么不用 PCA 或因子分析？
text: Principal component analysis (PCA) finds an orthogonal transform that makes the outputs uncorrelated and orders them by variance. If $\bA$ were orthogonal and the source variances were distinct, PCA would recover the sources up to sign and order. In general, however, $\bA$ is not orthogonal, and being uncorrelated is a much weaker requirement than being independent. makes the difference visible. Two uniform sources fill a square (a). Mixing shears the square into a parallelogram (b). Whitening, for example PCA followed by rescaling each principal component to unit variance, turns the parallelogram back into a square, but leaves it rotated by an unknown angle (c; the figure uses the symmetric whitening matrix $\bC_{\bx}^{-1/2}$, see ). Only by using information beyond the covariance does ICA find the rotation that aligns the square with the axes (d). 主成分分析（PCA）寻找一个正交变换，使输出互不相关并按方差排序。如果 $\bA$ 是正交矩阵、且各源方差互不相同，PCA 能在符号与顺序意义下恢复源。但一般情况下 $\bA$ 并不正交，而且不相关是比独立弱得多的要求。 直观地展示了两者的差别。两个均匀分布的源填满一个正方形（a）。混合把正方形剪切成平行四边形（b）。白化（例如先做 PCA、再把每个主成分缩放到单位方差）会把平行四边形变回正方形，但这个正方形转过了一个未知的角度（c；图中使用的是对称白化矩阵 $\bC_{\bx}^{-1/2}$，见 ）。只有利用协方差之外的信息，ICA 才能找到把正方形摆正的那个旋转（d）。 Two independent uniform sources (a), their mixture (b), the whitened mixture (c), and the ICA solution (d). In (c) the data are uncorrelated with unit variance, yet clearly dependent; the arrows mark the columns of the whitened mixing matrix $\bV\bA$, which are orthogonal. ICA finds the rotation $\bU$ that aligns them with the axes. 两个独立的均匀分布源（a）、它们的混合（b）、白化后的混合（c）以及 ICA 的解（d）。在（c）中数据不相关且方差为一，却显然并不独立；箭头标出白化后混合矩阵 $\bV\bA$ 的列，它们相互正交。ICA 找到把它们转到坐标轴上的旋转 $\bU$。 A count of parameters shows why the covariance cannot be enough. Take $m = n$ and unit-variance sources. The covariance $\bC_{\bx} = \E[\bx\bx^\top] = \bA\bA^\top$ is symmetric, so it supplies $n(n+1)/2$ numbers, while $\bA$ has $n^2$ unknown entries. The shortfall is $n(n-1)/2$, which is exactly the number of free parameters of an $n \times n$ orthogonal matrix: any $\bA\bQ$ with $\bQ$ orthogonal has the same covariance as $\bA$. Second-order statistics determine the mixing matrix only up to a rotation. makes this precise, and shows that higher-order statistics pin down the rotation as soon as the sources are non-Gaussian. 数一数参数，就能看出为什么协方差不够用。取 $m = n$ 且源为单位方差。协方差 $\bC_{\bx} = \E[\bx\bx^\top] = \bA\bA^\top$ 是对称矩阵，只提供 $n(n+1)/2$ 个数，而 $\bA$ 有 $n^2$ 个未知元。两者相差 $n(n-1)/2$，恰好是一个 $n \times n$ 正交矩阵的自由参数个数：对任意正交矩阵 $\bQ$，$\bA\bQ$ 与 $\bA$ 有相同的协方差。二阶统计量只能把混合矩阵确定到一个旋转。 会把这一点说清楚， 则证明：只要源是非高斯的，高阶统计量就能确定这个旋转。 Gaussian sources are the exception. If $\bs \sim \Ncal(\bzero, \bI)$, then $\bQ\bs$ has exactly the same distribution as $\bs$ for every orthogonal $\bQ$, so the data cannot distinguish $\bA$ from $\bA\bQ^\top$ by any statistic whatsoever. This is why the standard model allows at most one Gaussian source. Classical factor analysis meets the same obstruction: it models $\bx = \bA\mathbf{f} + \bn$ with Gaussian factors $\mathbf{f}$, so its loadings are determined only up to rotation, and heuristics such as varimax are needed to choose one. ICA can be read as factor analysis with non-Gaussian independent factors, the assumption that removes the rotational freedom. 高斯源是例外。若 $\bs \sim \Ncal(\bzero, \bI)$，则对任意正交矩阵 $\bQ$，$\bQ\bs$ 与 $\bs$ 的分布完全相同，因此任何统计量都无法从数据中区分 $\bA$ 与 $\bA\bQ^\top$。这就是标准模型至多允许一个高斯源的原因。经典的 因子分析 遇到的是同一障碍：它的模型是 $\bx = \bA\mathbf{f} + \bn$，因子 $\mathbf{f}$ 为高斯分布，所以载荷矩阵只能确定到一个旋转，需要 varimax 之类的启发式方法来选定一个。可以把 ICA 理解为因子相互独立且非高斯的因子分析，正是这一假设消除了旋转自由度。

sectionEn: A first look at how ICA works
sectionZh: 初窥 ICA 的工作方式
text: Most ICA methods follow the two-step logic of . First, whiten : find a matrix $\bV$ such that $\bz = \bV\bx$ has identity covariance. What remains is to find an orthogonal $\bU$ such that $\by = \bU\bz$ has independent components, a search over rotations. Second, choose the rotation with a contrast function that measures non-Gaussianity or independence. The intuition is the central limit theorem: a sum of independent variables tends to be more Gaussian than the variables themselves, so a mixture of several sources is typically more Gaussian than the most non-Gaussian of them. Making each output as non-Gaussian as possible therefore drives it toward one source; turns this intuition into a theorem. 大多数 ICA 方法都遵循 所示的两步思路。第一步是 白化 ：找一个矩阵 $\bV$，使 $\bz = \bV\bx$ 的协方差为单位阵。剩下的任务是找一个正交矩阵 $\bU$，使 $\by = \bU\bz$ 的分量相互独立，也就是在旋转中搜索。第二步是用 对比函数 来选择旋转，对比函数衡量的是非高斯性或独立性。其直觉来自中心极限定理：独立变量之和往往比各个变量本身更接近高斯，所以几个源的混合通常比其中最非高斯的那个源更接近高斯。让每个输出尽可能非高斯，就会把它推向某一个源； 会把这一直觉变成定理。 The following script carries out both steps for two sources, one uniform and one Laplacian, using kurtosis (the fourth cumulant, $\kurt(y) = \E[y^4] - 3(\E[y^2])^2$) as the contrast and a brute-force search over the rotation angle. 下面的脚本对两个源（一个均匀分布、一个拉普拉斯分布）完成这两步，用峭度（四阶累积量，$\kurt(y) = \E[y^4] - 3(\E[y^2])^2$）作为对比函数，并对旋转角做穷举搜索。 On this run the script prints $\bW\bA \approx \bigl(\begin{smallmatrix} 0.03 & 1.00 \\ -1.00 & 0.02 \end{smallmatrix}\bigr)$: the first output is the Laplacian source and the second is the uniform source with its sign flipped, exactly the ambiguity that allows. Directions $\bw$ and $-\bw$ give the same projection up to sign, so searching angles in $[0, \pi)$ covers every direction once. A brute-force search works only in two dimensions; Chapters 7 to 9 develop algorithms that scale to many sources, and asks how accurate any algorithm can possibly be. 这次运行输出 $\bW\bA \approx \bigl(\begin{smallmatrix} 0.03 & 1.00 \\ -1.00 & 0.02 \end{smallmatrix}\bigr)$：第一个输出是拉普拉斯源，第二个输出是符号翻转后的均匀源，恰好是 所允许的不确定性。方向 $\bw$ 与 $-\bw$ 给出的投影只差一个符号，所以在 $[0, \pi)$ 内搜索角度恰好覆盖每个方向一次。穷举搜索只在二维可行；第 7 至 9 章发展能处理大量源的算法， 则讨论任何算法最多能达到多高的精度。

The book has six parts and an appendix. Each chapter ends with exercises at three levels (basic, intermediate and advanced) with solutions that open on request. 本书分为六个部分和一个附录。每章末尾都有三个难度级别（基础、进阶、硬核）的习题，解答默认折叠，点开即可查看。 Part I. Foundations This chapter; the probability tools of ICA ( ); whitening and the geometry of the problem ( ). Part II. Principles Identifiability ( ); non-Gaussianity and kurtosis ( ); negentropy, mutual information and likelihood ( ). Part III. Algorithms Natural gradient and Infomax ( ); FastICA ( ); JADE and second-order methods ( ). Part IV. Statistical theory Asymptotic performance and the Cramér–Rao bound ( ); noise, model order and reliability ( ). Part V. Beyond the square linear model Overcomplete ICA ( ); nonlinear ICA ( ). Part VI. ICA for brain imaging Spatial ICA of fMRI ( ); group ICA, dual regression and IVA ( ). 第一部分：基础 本章；ICA 的概率工具（ ）；白化与问题的几何（ ）。 第二部分：原理 可辨识性（ ）；非高斯性与峭度（ ）；负熵、互信息与似然（ ）。 第三部分：算法 自然梯度与 Infomax（ ）；FastICA（ ）；JADE 与二阶方法（ ）。 第四部分：统计理论 渐近性能与 Cramér–Rao 界（ ）；噪声、模型阶数与可靠性（ ）。 第五部分：超越方阵线性模型 过完备 ICA（ ）；非线性 ICA（ ）。 第六部分：脑影像中的 ICA fMRI 的空间 ICA（ ）；组 ICA、双回归与独立向量分析（ ）。 Two reading paths work well. For practice, read Chapters 1, 3, 5 and 8 and then Part VI. For theory, read Parts I and II in order, then Chapters 7, 10, 12 and 13. collects the facts from matrix analysis, optimization and asymptotic statistics used throughout. 推荐两条阅读路线。偏重应用：读第 1、3、5、8 章，然后读第六部分。偏重理论：按顺序读第一、二部分，再读第 7、10、12、13 章。 汇集了全书用到的矩阵分析、优化与渐近统计知识。

Vectors are bold lowercase, matrices bold uppercase, scalars italic. All vectors are column vectors, and $^	op$ denotes transposition. The symbols below keep the same meaning in every chapter unless a chapter says otherwise; Part VI, for example, writes fMRI data as a matrix with $T$ time points and $V$ voxels. 向量用粗体小写字母，矩阵用粗体大写字母，标量用斜体。所有向量都是列向量，$^	op$ 表示转置。除非某章另有说明，下表中的记号在全书各章含义不变；例如第六部分把 fMRI 数据写成 $T$ 个时间点 × $V$ 个体素的矩阵。 Notation used throughout the book. 全书通用记号。 Symbol 记号 Meaning 含义 $n,\ m,\ T$ numbers of sources, sensors and samples 源、传感器与样本的个数 $ s = (s_1, \dots, s_n)^	op$ source vector, with densities $p_i$ of $s_i$ 源向量，$s_i$ 的密度为 $p_i$ $ x,\  A,\  a_j$ observations, mixing matrix, its $j$-th column 观测、混合矩阵及其第 $j$ 列 $ W,\  y =  W x$ unmixing matrix and its outputs 解混矩阵及其输出 $ P =  W A$ global (gain) matrix 全局（增益）矩阵 $ V,\  z =  V x,\ 	ilde A =  V A$ whitening matrix, whitened data, whitened mixing matrix 白化矩阵、白化数据、白化后的混合矩阵 $ U,\  Q$ orthogonal matrices (the rotation found after whitening; a generic one) 正交矩阵（白化后求出的旋转；一般的正交矩阵） $ Pi,\  D,\  I$ permutation, diagonal and identity matrices 置换矩阵、对角矩阵、单位矩阵 $\E[\cdot],\ \hat\E[\cdot],\  C_{ x}$ expectation, sample average, covariance $\E[ x x^	op]$ of zero-mean $ x$ 期望、样本平均、零均值 $ x$ 的协方差 $\E[ x x^	op]$ $ w,\ y =  w^	op z,\  q = 	ilde A^	op w$ one-unit methods: a unit vector, its projection, and the same direction in source coordinates 单单元方法：单位向量、其投影，以及同一方向在源坐标下的表示 $\psi_i = -p_i'/p_i$ score function of source $i$ 源 $i$ 的得分函数 $\mathcal{J}_i = \E[\psi_i(s_i)^2]$ Fisher information of the unit-variance source $i$ ($\ge 1$ under the regularity conditions of Chapter 10, with equality only for a Gaussian) 单位方差源 $i$ 的 Fisher 信息（在第 10 章的正则条件下 $\ge 1$，仅当源为高斯时取等号） $\varphi_i,\ g = G'$ nonlinearity of gradient algorithms; nonlinearity of FastICA 梯度算法中的非线性函数；FastICA 中的非线性函数 $\kurt(\cdot),\ \cum(\cdot)$ kurtosis, cumulant 峭度、累积量 $\kappa_i = \kurt(s_i)$ kurtosis of the unit-variance source $i$ 单位方差源 $i$ 的峭度 $
u$ a standard Gaussian variable, $
u \sim \Ncal(0, 1)$ 标准高斯变量，$
u \sim \Ncal(0, 1)$ $H,\ J,\ I,\ D(p\,\|\,q)$ differential entropy, negentropy, mutual information, Kullback–Leibler divergence 微分熵、负熵、互信息、KL 散度 $\Ncal(\mu, \sigma^2)$ Gaussian distribution 高斯分布

sectionEn: What a successful decomposition must demonstrate
sectionZh: 怎样判断一次分解是否成功
text: Reconstruction is necessary but not sufficient. In a square noiseless model, take any invertible matrix $\bB$ and set $\bW=\bB\bA^{-1}$, $\hat\bA=\bA\bB^{-1}$. Then $\hat\bA\bW\bx=\bx$ exactly, yet the outputs are $\bB\bs$, which generally remain mixtures. Even white outputs need not be separated: a 45° rotation of independent uniform sources reconstructs perfectly and has zero covariance, but its squared outputs have covariance $-3/5$ ( ). Reconstruction error therefore checks algebra and retained rank; it does not establish independence. 重构是必要检查，却不是充分证据。 在方阵无噪声模型中，任取可逆矩阵 $\bB$，令 $\bW=\bB\bA^{-1}$、$\hat\bA=\bA\bB^{-1}$，就有 $\hat\bA\bW\bx=\bx$；但输出是 $\bB\bs$，一般仍是混合。即使输出已经白化，也未必完成了分离：把独立均匀源旋转 45°，既能精确重构又互不相关，两个输出平方的协方差却为 $-3/5$（ ）。因此重构误差检查的是代数运算和保留的秩，不能证明独立性。 Define the sampling axis. Here each column of $\bX\in\R^{m\times T}$ is one observation and rows are sensors. Some software accepts observations in rows and therefore expects $\bX^\top$. Spatial ICA of fMRI instead treats voxels as observations and time points as coordinates. Independence concerns the components across that chosen sampling axis; it is different from independence between successive time points. 先明确抽样轴。 本书中 $\bX\in\R^{m\times T}$ 的每列是一个观测、每行是一个传感器。某些软件要求观测按行排列，因此应传入 $\bX^\top$。fMRI 的空间 ICA 则把体素作为观测、把时间点作为坐标。这里的独立性是各成分沿所选抽样轴的独立性，与相邻时间点之间是否独立是不同的问题。 Record centering, scaling, retained rank, algorithm, contrast, random seed and stopping criterion. Check reconstruction, the gain matrix when synthetic ground truth is available, and dependence beyond correlation. Evaluate held-out observations using the training mean and whitening matrix, rather than fitting preprocessing again. Repeat the fit across starts and resamples, aligning component signs and permutations before comparing them. Stable axes support reproducibility; they do not establish a biological or causal interpretation. 记录中心化、尺度处理、保留的秩、算法、对比函数、随机种子和停止准则。 检查重构，在合成真值可得时检查增益矩阵，并检验相关系数以外的依赖。评估留出观测时使用训练集的均值与白化矩阵，不要重新拟合预处理。 更换初值和重抽样后重复拟合，比较前先对齐符号与置换。稳定的坐标支持可重复性，却不能单独确立生物学或因果解释。 Key points 本章要点 ICA models observations as an instantaneous linear mixture $\bx = \bA\bs$ of independent sources and estimates an unmixing matrix $\bW$. The scale, sign and order of the sources can never be recovered; success means that $\bW\bA$ is a scaled permutation matrix. Second-order statistics determine $\bA$ only up to a rotation; independence and non-Gaussianity determine the rotation. Gaussian sources are the exception: among two or more Gaussian sources, no rotation can be told apart from another. ICA 把观测建模为独立源的瞬时线性混合 $\bx = \bA\bs$，并估计解混矩阵 $\bW$。 源的尺度、符号与顺序永远无法恢复；分离成功意味着 $\bW\bA$ 是带尺度的置换矩阵。 二阶统计量只能把 $\bA$ 确定到一个旋转；独立性与非高斯性确定这个旋转。 高斯源是例外：两个及以上高斯源之间，任何旋转都无法区分。 Carry these three ideas forward 带走这三点 Sensors observe mixtures; ICA learns unknown mixing structure. Recovery permits sign, scale and order changes. Reconstruction or decorrelation alone does not prove separation. 传感器看到混合，ICA 学习未知的混合结构。 恢复允许符号、尺度和顺序变化。 仅有重构成功或去相关不能证明分离。 Start with the ambiguity exercise , then uncorrelated but dependent . They test the meaning of the model before the longer rotation derivation. 先做 不确定性题 ，再做 不相关但依赖题 ；它们先检验你是否理解模型含义，再进入较长的旋转推导。

Suppose $\bW$ separates the mixture exactly, $\bW\bA = \bI$. Show that $\bW' = \bPi\bD\bW$ also produces mutually independent outputs for every permutation matrix $\bPi$ and invertible diagonal matrix $\bD$. What is $\bW'\bA$? 设 $\bW$ 恰好完成分离，即 $\bW\bA = \bI$。证明对任意置换矩阵 $\bPi$ 和可逆对角矩阵 $\bD$，$\bW' = \bPi\bD\bW$ 的输出也相互独立。$\bW'\bA$ 等于什么？ $\bW'\bA = \bPi\bD\bW\bA = \bPi\bD$, so $\by' = \bW'\bx = \bPi\bD\bs$. Its components are the numbers $d_j s_j$ in a different order: each is a function of a single source, and the sources involved are distinct, so the components are independent. $\bW'\bA = \bPi\bD\bW\bA = \bPi\bD$，所以 $\by' = \bW'\bx = \bPi\bD\bs$。它的分量就是重新排序后的 $d_j s_j$：每个分量只是某一个源的函数，且涉及的源各不相同，所以这些分量相互独立。 Let $s$ be uniform on $[-1, 1]$ and $y = s^2$. Show that $s$ and $y$ are uncorrelated but not independent. 设 $s$ 在 $[-1, 1]$ 上均匀分布，$y = s^2$。证明 $s$ 与 $y$ 不相关但不独立。 By symmetry $\E[s] = \E[s^3] = 0$, so $\Cov(s, y) = \E[s^3] - \E[s]\,\E[s^2] = 0$. But $y < 1/4$ exactly when $|s| < 1/2$, so $P(|s| > 1/2,\ y < 1/4) = 0$, whereas $P(|s| > 1/2)\,P(y < 1/4) = \tfrac12 \cdot \tfrac12 = \tfrac14$. The joint probability does not factorize, so the variables are dependent. 由对称性，$\E[s] = \E[s^3] = 0$，所以 $\Cov(s, y) = \E[s^3] - \E[s]\,\E[s^2] = 0$。但 $y < 1/4$ 当且仅当 $|s| < 1/2$，因此 $P(|s| > 1/2,\ y < 1/4) = 0$，而 $P(|s| > 1/2)\,P(y < 1/4) = \tfrac12 \cdot \tfrac12 = \tfrac14$。联合概率不能分解，所以二者不独立。 Let $\bs \sim \Ncal(\bzero, \bI)$ in $\R^2$ and let $\bQ$ be any $2 \times 2$ orthogonal matrix. Show that $\bQ\bs$ has the same distribution as $\bs$, and conclude that the observations $\bx = \bA\bs$ cannot distinguish the mixing matrix $\bA$ from $\bA\bQ^\top$. 设 $\bs \sim \Ncal(\bzero, \bI)$ 取值于 $\R^2$，$\bQ$ 是任意 $2 \times 2$ 正交矩阵。证明 $\bQ\bs$ 与 $\bs$ 同分布，并由此说明观测 $\bx = \bA\bs$ 无法区分混合矩阵 $\bA$ 与 $\bA\bQ^\top$。 A linear transform of a Gaussian vector is Gaussian, so $\bQ\bs$ is Gaussian with mean $\bzero$ and covariance $\bQ\bI\bQ^\top = \bI$; a Gaussian distribution is determined by its mean and covariance, so $\bQ\bs \sim \Ncal(\bzero, \bI)$. Now $\bx = \bA\bs = (\bA\bQ^\top)(\bQ\bs)$, and $\bQ\bs$ is again a vector of independent standard Gaussian sources. The models $(\bA, \bs)$ and $(\bA\bQ^\top, \bQ\bs)$ therefore produce identically distributed observations, and no statistic of $\bx$ can tell them apart. 高斯向量的线性变换仍是高斯的，所以 $\bQ\bs$ 是均值为 $\bzero$、协方差为 $\bQ\bI\bQ^\top = \bI$ 的高斯向量；高斯分布由均值和协方差唯一确定，因此 $\bQ\bs \sim \Ncal(\bzero, \bI)$。又 $\bx = \bA\bs = (\bA\bQ^\top)(\bQ\bs)$，而 $\bQ\bs$ 仍是由独立标准高斯源组成的向量。于是模型 $(\bA, \bs)$ 与 $(\bA\bQ^\top, \bQ\bs)$ 产生同分布的观测，任何关于 $\bx$ 的统计量都无法区分它们。 For a square model ($m = n$) with unit-variance sources, count the numbers determined by the covariance $\bC_{\bx}$ and the unknowns in $\bA$. Show that the difference equals the number of free parameters of an $n \times n$ orthogonal matrix, and that every matrix $\bA\bQ$ with $\bQ$ orthogonal has the same covariance. 对方阵模型（$m = n$）且源为单位方差的情形，数一数协方差 $\bC_{\bx}$ 确定了多少个数，$\bA$ 又有多少个未知量。证明二者之差等于 $n \times n$ 正交矩阵的自由参数个数，并且对任意正交矩阵 $\bQ$，$\bA\bQ$ 都有相同的协方差。 $\bC_{\bx} = \bA\,\E[\bs\bs^\top]\,\bA^\top = \bA\bA^\top$ is symmetric, so it has $n(n+1)/2$ distinct entries, while $\bA$ has $n^2$. The difference is $n^2 - n(n+1)/2 = n(n-1)/2$. The orthogonality constraints $\bQ^\top\bQ = \bI$ are $n(n+1)/2$ equations (again by symmetry) on $n^2$ entries, leaving $n(n-1)/2$ free parameters: one angle for $n = 2$, three for $n = 3$. Finally $(\bA\bQ)(\bA\bQ)^\top = \bA\bQ\bQ^\top\bA^\top = \bA\bA^\top$. $\bC_{\bx} = \bA\,\E[\bs\bs^\top]\,\bA^\top = \bA\bA^\top$ 是对称矩阵，只有 $n(n+1)/2$ 个不同的元素，而 $\bA$ 有 $n^2$ 个元素，两者相差 $n^2 - n(n+1)/2 = n(n-1)/2$。正交性约束 $\bQ^\top\bQ = \bI$ 同样由于对称性只给出 $n(n+1)/2$ 个方程，作用在 $n^2$ 个元素上，剩下 $n(n-1)/2$ 个自由参数：$n = 2$ 时是一个角度，$n = 3$ 时是三个。最后，$(\bA\bQ)(\bA\bQ)^\top = \bA\bQ\bQ^\top\bA^\top = \bA\bA^\top$。 Run the script of with both sources replaced by standard Gaussian noise, and plot the absolute kurtosis of the first output against the angle. ICA needs the second question; this chapter builds several ways of asking it without confusing a useful diagnostic with a proof. 相关性问两个变量是否以线性方式共同变化，独立性则问：知道其中一个后，另一个的任何概率会不会改变？ICA 需要回答后一个问题。本章提供多种检验视角，同时区分有用的诊断和严格证明。 After this pass, you should be able to: 读完这一遍，你应该能： Check independence in a finite probability table by multiplying marginals. Compute a zero covariance for a pair that is still dependent. Explain why a zero fourth cumulant does not certify a Gaussian law. 能在有限概率表中用边缘概率乘积检查独立性。 能为一对仍然依赖的变量算出零协方差。 能解释为什么四阶累积量为零不能证明分布是高斯的。 Before you start: review the source assumptions and the expectation notation . The two coordinates are uncorrelated and have unit variance, yet they are plainly not independent: the cloud is a tilted square, so the range of values open to one coordinate depends on the value of the other. The covariance cannot see this dependence. ICA therefore needs a notion stronger than correlation, together with quantities that detect dependence and non-Gaussianity beyond second order. （c）是两个均匀分布源的混合经白化后的样子。两个坐标互不相关、方差为一，却显然并不独立：点云是一个倾斜的正方形，一个坐标能取哪些值，取决于另一个坐标的值。协方差看不到这种依赖。因此 ICA 需要比相关性更强的概念，也需要能在二阶之外检测依赖性与非高斯性的量。 This chapter assembles those tools. Two random quantities are independent when knowing the value of one tells us nothing about the other. A set $B_i$ describes an event such as “variable $i$ lies between zero and one.” The product sign $\prod$ means multiply the separate probabilities. Independence requires this equality for every such choice, not merely one event or one correlation coefficient. 怎样读定义。 集合 $B_i$ 表示一个事件，例如“第 $i$ 个变量落在零与一之间”。乘积符号 $\prod$ 表示把各自的概率相乘。独立要求每一种这样的事件选择都满足等式，而不是只检查一个事件或一个相关系数。 Random vectors $ y_1, \dots,  y_k$, with $ y_i \in \R^{d_i}$, are (mutually) independent if $P( y_1 \in B_1, \dots,  y_k \in B_k) = \prod_{i=1}^k P( y_i \in B_i)$ for all Borel sets $B_i \subseteq \R^{d_i}$. Two random vectors have the same distribution if and only if they have the same characteristic function. Affine maps. We use two consequences. First, a random variable with moments of all orders whose cumulants of order three and higher all vanish is Gaussian: its moments then coincide with those of a Gaussian, and the Gaussian distribution is determined by its moments. Second, no non-Gaussian variable has only finitely many nonzero cumulants: if it had, its moment-generating function would be entire and equal to $\exp(P(t))$ for a polynomial $P$, so $\varphi(\omega) = \exp(P(i\omega))$ and the theorem would apply. Cumulants of order three and higher are therefore measures of non-Gaussianity, and the theorem is a step in the proof of the Darmois–Skitovich theorem in . The normalized third and fourth cumulants are the simplest numbers that describe the shape of a distribution beyond its location and scale. The fourth, kurtosis, is the most widely used statistic in ICA. 归一化的三阶与四阶累积量，是在位置与尺度之外描述分布形状的最简单的数。其中四阶的峭度是 ICA 中用得最多的统计量。 Let $y$ have a finite fourth moment, mean $\mu$ and variance $\sigma^2 > 0$. Its kurtosis is the fourth cumulant, $\kurt(y) = \kappa_4(y) = \E[(y - \mu)^4] - 3\sigma^4$; for zero-mean $y$, $\kurt(y) = \E[y^4] - 3(\E[y^2])^2$. Its normalized kurtosis is $\kurt(y)/\sigma^4$, and its skewness is $\kappa_3(y)/\sigma^3 = \E[(y - \mu)^3]/\sigma^3$. The variable is called sub-Gaussian if $\kurt(y) < 0$ and super-Gaussian if $\kurt(y) > 0$. 设 $y$ 的四阶矩有限，均值为 $\mu$，方差为 $\sigma^2 > 0$。它的 峭度 是四阶累积量 $\kurt(y) = \kappa_4(y) = \E[(y - \mu)^4] - 3\sigma^4$；当 $y$ 均值为零时，$\kurt(y) = \E[y^4] - 3(\E[y^2])^2$。$\kurt(y)/\sigma^4$ 称为 归一化峭度 ，$\kappa_3(y)/\sigma^3 = \E[(y - \mu)^3]/\sigma^3$ 称为 偏度 。若 $\kurt(y) < 0$，称该变量为 亚高斯 的；若 $\kurt(y) > 0$，称其为 超高斯 的。 Statisticians call the normalized kurtosis the excess kurtosis ; the moment ratio $\E[(y - \mu)^4]/\sigma^4$ (Pearson's $ eta_2$), which many statistics texts call simply the kurtosis, equals the normalized kurtosis plus 3. For unit-variance variables, $\kurt(y)$ and the normalized kurtosis coincide, and for unit-variance sources we write $\kappa_i = \kurt(s_i)$. Super-Gaussian variables usually have heavier tails than a Gaussian of the same variance, and often a sharper peak; kurtosis measures the tails rather than the peak (Westfall, 2014). The standard examples are sparse signals, which are mostly close to zero and occasionally large: speech (Gazor & Zhang, 2003), the outputs of edge filters applied to natural images (Bell & Sejnowski, 1997), and the spatial maps of fMRI networks ( ). Sub-Gaussian variables are usually flatter, with light tails, and often bounded or multimodal: a uniform variable, a sinusoid with random phase, a binary communication symbol. Cumulants summarize a distribution by a few numbers; entropy summarizes it through its whole density. For a discrete variable, Shannon's entropy (Shannon, 1948) measures the average uncertainty of an outcome. Its continuous counterpart is differential entropy (Cover & Thomas, 2006). 累积量用几个数概括一个分布，熵则通过整个密度来概括它。对离散变量，Shannon 熵（Shannon, 1948）度量一次结果的平均不确定性；它在连续情形下的对应物是微分熵（Cover & Thomas, 2006）。 Let $\by \in \R^d$ have density $p$. Its differential entropy is $H(\by) = -\int p(\bu)\log p(\bu)\,d\bu = -\E[\log p(\by)]$, whenever the integral exists. For several random vectors, $H(\by_1, \dots, \by_k)$ is the entropy of the stacked vector. 设 $\by \in \R^d$ 有密度 $p$。它的 微分熵 定义为 $H(\by) = -\int p(\bu)\log p(\bu)\,d\bu = -\E[\log p(\by)]$（只要该积分存在）。对多个随机向量，$H(\by_1, \dots, \by_k)$ 指把它们堆叠成一个向量后的熵。 Three examples follow directly from the definition. A uniform density on an interval of length $L$ has $H = \log L$; for the unit-variance uniform law, $L = 2\sqrt3$ and $H = \log(2\sqrt3) \approx 1.2425$. For $\Ncal(\mu, \sigma^2)$, $-\log p(y) = \tfrac12\log(2\pi\sigma^2) + (y - \mu)^2/(2\sigma^2)$, whose expectation gives $H = \tfrac12\log(2\pi e\sigma^2)$, or $1.4189$ at unit variance; in the same way a Gaussian vector with positive-definite covariance $\bSigma$ has $H = \tfrac12\log\bigl((2\pi e)^d\det\bSigma\bigr)$. For the Laplace density $e^{-|y|/b}/(2b)$, $-\log p(y) = \log(2b) + |y|/b$ and $\E|y| = b$, so $H = 1 + \log(2b)$, or $1 + \tfrac12\log 2 \approx 1.3466$ at unit variance. 由定义可以直接算出三个例子。长度为 $L$ 的区间上的均匀密度，$H = \log L$；单位方差的均匀分布 $L = 2\sqrt3$，$H = \log(2\sqrt3) \approx 1.2425$。对 $\Ncal(\mu, \sigma^2)$，$-\log p(y) = \tfrac12\log(2\pi\sigma^2) + (y - \mu)^2/(2\sigma^2)$，取期望得 $H = \tfrac12\log(2\pi e\sigma^2)$，单位方差时为 $1.4189$；同理，协方差 $\bSigma$ 正定的高斯向量有 $H = \tfrac12\log\bigl((2\pi e)^d\det\bSigma\bigr)$。对拉普拉斯密度 $e^{-|y|/b}/(2b)$，$-\log p(y) = \log(2b) + |y|/b$，且 $\E|y| = b$，所以 $H = 1 + \log(2b)$，单位方差时为 $1 + \tfrac12\log 2 \approx 1.3466$。 Differential entropy differs from discrete entropy in two ways. It can be negative (the uniform density on $[0, \tfrac12]$ has entropy $-\log 2$), and it depends on scale: $H(\alpha y) = H(y) + \log|\alpha|$. Both facts are special cases of the next proposition. The quantities that ICA uses, mutual information and negentropy, are combinations of entropies in which these changes cancel. 微分熵与离散熵有两点不同。它可以为负（$[0, \tfrac12]$ 上的均匀密度的熵为 $-\log 2$），而且依赖于尺度：$H(\alpha y) = H(y) + \log|\alpha|$。这两点都是下一命题的特例。ICA 所用的量，即互信息与负熵，都是若干熵的组合，在组合中这些变化恰好相互抵消。 Let $\by \in \R^d$ have a density and finite entropy, let $\bA \in \R^{d \times d}$ be invertible and $\bb \in \R^d$. Then $H(\bA\by + \bb) = H(\by) + \log|\det\bA|$. More generally, if $\mathbf{f}$ is a continuously differentiable bijection of $\R^d$ onto an open set whose Jacobian matrix $\bJ_{\mathbf{f}}$ is nonsingular everywhere, then $H(\mathbf{f}(\by)) = H(\by) + \E\bigl[\log|\det\bJ_{\mathbf{f}}(\by)|\bigr]$ whenever the right-hand side is finite. 设 $\by \in \R^d$ 有密度且熵有限，$\bA \in \R^{d \times d}$ 可逆，$\bb \in \R^d$。则 $H(\bA\by + \bb) = H(\by) + \log|\det\bA|$。更一般地，若 $\mathbf{f}$ 是从 $\R^d$ 到某个开集的连续可微双射，且其 Jacobi 矩阵 $\bJ_{\mathbf{f}}$ 处处非奇异，则只要右端有限，就有 $H(\mathbf{f}(\by)) = H(\by) + \E\bigl[\log|\det\bJ_{\mathbf{f}}(\by)|\bigr]$。 By the change-of-variables formula, $\mathbf{f}(\by)$ has the density $p_{\mathbf{f}(\by)}(\mathbf{f}(\bu)) = p_{\by}(\bu)/|\det\bJ_{\mathbf{f}}(\bu)|$. Hence $H(\mathbf{f}(\by)) = -\E\bigl[\log p_{\mathbf{f}(\by)}(\mathbf{f}(\by))\bigr] = -\E[\log p_{\by}(\by)] + \E\bigl[\log|\det\bJ_{\mathbf{f}}(\by)|\bigr]$. For $\mathbf{f}(\bu) = \bA\bu + \bb$ the Jacobian is the constant matrix $\bA$. 由变量替换公式，$\mathbf{f}(\by)$ 的密度满足 $p_{\mathbf{f}(\by)}(\mathbf{f}(\bu)) = p_{\by}(\bu)/|\det\bJ_{\mathbf{f}}(\bu)|$。因此 $H(\mathbf{f}(\by)) = -\E\bigl[\log p_{\mathbf{f}(\by)}(\mathbf{f}(\by))\bigr] = -\E[\log p_{\by}(\by)] + \E\bigl[\log|\det\bJ_{\mathbf{f}}(\by)|\bigr]$。当 $\mathbf{f}(\bu) = \bA\bu + \bb$ 时，Jacobi 矩阵就是常数矩阵 $\bA$。 Two consequences recur in later chapters. Orthogonal transformations preserve entropy, $H(\bQ\by) = H(\by)$, because $|\det\bQ| = 1$: rotating whitened data does not change their joint entropy. And for $\by = \bW\bx$ with $\bW$ invertible, $H(\by) = H(\bx) + \log|\det\bW|$; this is how the term $\log|\det\bW|$ enters the likelihood of ICA in . 有两个推论会在后面各章反复出现。正交变换保持熵不变，$H(\bQ\by) = H(\by)$，因为 $|\det\bQ| = 1$：旋转白化后的数据不改变它们的联合熵。另外，对可逆的 $\bW$ 与 $\by = \bW\bx$，有 $H(\by) = H(\bx) + \log|\det\bW|$； 中 ICA 似然里的 $\log|\det\bW|$ 项正是这样来的。

Entropy by itself measures neither independence nor non-Gaussianity, but two divergences built from it do. Both rest on one inequality. 熵本身既不度量独立性，也不度量非高斯性；但由熵构造的两个散度可以。二者都建立在同一个不等式之上。 For densities $p$ and $q$ on $\R^d$, the Kullback–Leibler divergence is $D(p\,\|\,q) = \int p(\bu)\log\bigl(p(\bu)/q(\bu)\bigr)\,d\bu$, taken to be $+\infty$ if $P(q(\by) = 0) > 0$ for $\by \sim p$. 对 $\R^d$ 上的密度 $p$ 与 $q$， KL 散度 （Kullback–Leibler 散度）定义为 $D(p\,\|\,q) = \int p(\bu)\log\bigl(p(\bu)/q(\bu)\bigr)\,d\bu$；若对 $\by \sim p$ 有 $P(q(\by) = 0) > 0$，则规定其为 $+\infty$。 $D(p\,\|\,q) \ge 0$, with equality if and only if $p = q$ almost everywhere. $D(p\,\|\,q) \ge 0$，等号成立当且仅当 $p = q$ 几乎处处成立。 We may assume $D(p\,\|\,q) < \infty$. Let $\by \sim p$. By Jensen's inequality for the concave logarithm, $-D(p\,\|\,q) = \E\bigl[\log(q(\by)/p(\by))\bigr] \le \log\E\bigl[q(\by)/p(\by)\bigr] = \log\int_{\{p > 0\}} q(\bu)\,d\bu \le \log 1 = 0$. Since the logarithm is strictly concave, equality in the first step requires $q/p$ to be constant on $\{p > 0\}$, and equality in the second requires $\int_{\{p > 0\}} q = 1$; together they give $q = p$ almost everywhere. 不妨设 $D(p\,\|\,q) < \infty$。令 $\by \sim p$。对凹函数 $\log$ 用 Jensen 不等式，$-D(p\,\|\,q) = \E\bigl[\log(q(\by)/p(\by))\bigr] \le \log\E\bigl[q(\by)/p(\by)\bigr] = \log\int_{\{p > 0\}} q(\bu)\,d\bu \le \log 1 = 0$。由于对数严格凹，第一步取等号要求 $q/p$ 在 $\{p > 0\}$ 上为常数，第二步取等号要求 $\int_{\{p > 0\}} q = 1$；二者合起来即得 $q = p$ 几乎处处成立。 The divergence was introduced by Kullback and Leibler (1951). It is not symmetric, and it is not a metric. It is invariant under reparametrization: if both densities are transformed by the same map $\mathbf{f}$ as in , the Jacobian factors cancel in the ratio $p/q$. Its first use here is a classical extremal property of the Gaussian. 这一散度由 Kullback 与 Leibler（1951）提出。它不对称，也不是度量。它在重新参数化下不变：若两个密度经过同一个映射 $\mathbf{f}$（如 中）变换，Jacobi 因子在比值 $p/q$ 中相互抵消。它在这里的第一个用途，是证明高斯分布的一个经典极值性质。 Let $\by \in \R^d$ have density $p$, finite entropy, mean $\bmu$ and nonsingular covariance $\bSigma$, and let $p_{\mathrm{G}}$ be the density of $\Ncal(\bmu, \bSigma)$. Then 设 $\by \in \R^d$ 有密度 $p$，熵有限，均值为 $\bmu$，协方差 $\bSigma$ 非奇异，并记 $p_{\mathrm{G}}$ 为 $\Ncal(\bmu, \bSigma)$ 的密度。则 $$D(p\,\|\,p_{\mathrm{G}}) = \tfrac12\log\bigl((2\pi e)^d\det\bSigma\bigr) - H(\by) \;\ge\; 0 .$$ Hence $H(\by) \le \tfrac12\log\bigl((2\pi e)^d\det\bSigma\bigr)$, the entropy of $\Ncal(\bmu, \bSigma)$, with equality if and only if $\by$ is Gaussian. 因此 $H(\by) \le \tfrac12\log\bigl((2\pi e)^d\det\bSigma\bigr)$，即 $\Ncal(\bmu, \bSigma)$ 的熵；等号成立当且仅当 $\by$ 是高斯的。 We have $-\log p_{\mathrm{G}}(\bu) = \tfrac12\log\bigl((2\pi)^d\det\bSigma\bigr) + \tfrac12(\bu - \bmu)^\top\bSigma^{-1}(\bu - \bmu)$. Its expectation under $p$ depends only on the mean and covariance of $\by$: since $\E[(\by - \bmu)^\top\bSigma^{-1}(\by - \bmu)] = \tr(\bSigma^{-1}\bSigma) = d$, it equals $\tfrac12\log\bigl((2\pi e)^d\det\bSigma\bigr)$, the same value as for a Gaussian $\by$. Therefore $D(p\,\|\,p_{\mathrm{G}}) = -H(\by) + \E[-\log p_{\mathrm{G}}(\by)] = \tfrac12\log\bigl((2\pi e)^d\det\bSigma\bigr) - H(\by)$, which is nonnegative by and zero only when $p = p_{\mathrm{G}}$ almost everywhere. 我们有 $-\log p_{\mathrm{G}}(\bu) = \tfrac12\log\bigl((2\pi)^d\det\bSigma\bigr) + \tfrac12(\bu - \bmu)^\top\bSigma^{-1}(\bu - \bmu)$。它在 $p$ 下的期望只依赖于 $\by$ 的均值与协方差：由于 $\E[(\by - \bmu)^\top\bSigma^{-1}(\by - \bmu)] = \tr(\bSigma^{-1}\bSigma) = d$，这个期望等于 $\tfrac12\log\bigl((2\pi e)^d\det\bSigma\bigr)$，与 $\by$ 为高斯时的值相同。因此 $D(p\,\|\,p_{\mathrm{G}}) = -H(\by) + \E[-\log p_{\mathrm{G}}(\by)] = \tfrac12\log\bigl((2\pi e)^d\det\bSigma\bigr) - H(\by)$；由 ，它非负，且仅当 $p = p_{\mathrm{G}}$ 几乎处处成立时为零。 Among all distributions with a given covariance, the Gaussian is the most disordered. This is the information-theoretic side of the intuition in : mixing independent signals makes them more Gaussian, so a measure of distance from the Gaussian can guide separation. 在协方差给定的所有分布中，高斯分布最“无序”。这是 中那条直觉在信息论上的一面：混合独立信号会使它们更接近高斯，所以与高斯分布之间的“距离”可以用来指导分离。 Let $\by = (\by_1, \dots, \by_k)$ have joint density $p_{\by}$ and marginal densities $p_{\by_i}$. The mutual information of $\by_1, \dots, \by_k$ is the divergence of the joint density from the product of its marginals, 设 $\by = (\by_1, \dots, \by_k)$ 的联合密度为 $p_{\by}$，边缘密度为 $p_{\by_i}$。$\by_1, \dots, \by_k$ 的 互信息 定义为联合密度相对于边缘密度之积的散度： $$I(\by_1, \dots, \by_k) = D\Bigl(p_{\by}\,\Big\|\,\prod_{i=1}^k p_{\by_i}\Bigr) = \sum_{i=1}^k H(\by_i) - H(\by),$$ where the second expression holds when all entropies are finite. For the scalar components of $\by \in \R^n$ we write $I(\by) = I(y_1, \dots, y_n)$. 其中第二个等号在各熵有限时成立。对 $\by \in \R^n$ 的标量分量，记 $I(\by) = I(y_1, \dots, y_n)$。 The second expression follows by taking the expectation of $\log p_{\by}(\by) - \sum_i \log p_{\by_i}(\by_i)$. Mutual information measures exactly what ICA wants to remove. 对 $\log p_{\by}(\by) - \sum_i \log p_{\by_i}(\by_i)$ 取期望即得第二个表达式。互信息度量的恰好是 ICA 想要消除的东西。 (a) $I(\by) \ge 0$, with equality if and only if the components of $\by$ are independent. (b) If $f_1, \dots, f_n$ are continuously differentiable bijections of $\R$ onto open intervals with nonvanishing derivatives, then $I(f_1(y_1), \dots, f_n(y_n)) = I(y_1, \dots, y_n)$. In particular, mutual information does not change when the components are rescaled, change sign or are permuted. （a）$I(\by) \ge 0$，等号成立当且仅当 $\by$ 的各分量独立。（b）若 $f_1, \dots, f_n$ 都是从 $\R$ 到某个开区间的连续可微双射，且导数处处不为零，则 $I(f_1(y_1), \dots, f_n(y_n)) = I(y_1, \dots, y_n)$。特别地，对各分量作缩放、改变符号或重新排列，互信息都不变。 (a) follows from and statement 3 of . (b) Assume the entropies are finite. The Jacobian of $\bu \mapsto (f_1(u_1), \dots, f_n(u_n))$ is diagonal, so by the joint entropy changes by $\sum_i \E[\log|f_i'(y_i)|]$, while each marginal entropy $H(f_i(y_i))$ changes by $\E[\log|f_i'(y_i)|]$. The changes cancel in $\sum_i H(y_i) - H(\by)$, and a permutation only reorders the sum. (Without finite entropies, use the invariance of the divergence under reparametrization.) （a）由 与 的陈述 3 得到。（b）设各熵有限。映射 $\bu \mapsto (f_1(u_1), \dots, f_n(u_n))$ 的 Jacobi 矩阵是对角的，所以由 ，联合熵改变 $\sum_i \E[\log|f_i'(y_i)|]$，而每个边缘熵 $H(f_i(y_i))$ 改变 $\E[\log|f_i'(y_i)|]$。这些改变在 $\sum_i H(y_i) - H(\by)$ 中相互抵消，而置换只是重新排列求和的次序。（若熵不有限，可改用散度在重新参数化下的不变性。） For $\by = \bW\bx$ with $\bW$ invertible, turns into 对可逆的 $\bW$ 与 $\by = \bW\bx$，由 ， 变为 $$I(\by) = \sum_{i=1}^n H(y_i) - H(\bx) - \log|\det\bW|,$$ the starting point of ( ). The entropy $H(\bx)$ does not depend on $\bW$, so minimizing the mutual information of the outputs involves only the marginal entropies and $\log|\det\bW|$. 这是 的出发点（ ）。熵 $H(\bx)$ 与 $\bW$ 无关，所以最小化输出的互信息只涉及各边缘熵与 $\log|\det\bW|$。 Let $\by \in \R^d$ have a density, finite entropy and nonsingular covariance $\bSigma$, and let $\by_{\mathrm{G}}$ be a Gaussian vector with the same mean and covariance. The negentropy of $\by$ is $J(\by) = H(\by_{\mathrm{G}}) - H(\by) = \tfrac12\log\bigl((2\pi e)^d\det\bSigma\bigr) - H(\by)$. For a scalar, $J(y) = \tfrac12\log\bigl(2\pi e\Var(y)\bigr) - H(y)$. 设 $\by \in \R^d$ 有密度，熵有限，协方差 $\bSigma$ 非奇异，并设 $\by_{\mathrm{G}}$ 是与 $\by$ 均值、协方差都相同的高斯向量。$\by$ 的 负熵 定义为 $J(\by) = H(\by_{\mathrm{G}}) - H(\by) = \tfrac12\log\bigl((2\pi e)^d\det\bSigma\bigr) - H(\by)$。对标量，$J(y) = \tfrac12\log\bigl(2\pi e\Var(y)\bigr) - H(y)$。 (a) $J(\by) \ge 0$, with equality if and only if $\by$ is Gaussian. (b) $J(\by) = D(p_{\by}\,\|\,p_{\mathrm{G}})$, where $p_{\mathrm{G}}$ is the Gaussian density with the same mean and covariance. (c) $J(\bA\by + \bb) = J(\by)$ for every invertible $\bA$ and every $\bb$. （a）$J(\by) \ge 0$，等号成立当且仅当 $\by$ 是高斯的。（b）$J(\by) = D(p_{\by}\,\|\,p_{\mathrm{G}})$，其中 $p_{\mathrm{G}}$ 是均值、协方差与 $\by$ 相同的高斯密度。（c）对任意可逆的 $\bA$ 与任意 $\bb$，$J(\bA\by + \bb) = J(\by)$。 (a) and (b) restate . (c) The vector $\bA\by + \bb$ has covariance $\bA\bSigma\bA^\top$, and the Gaussian vector with its mean and covariance is $\bA\by_{\mathrm{G}} + \bb$. By , $H(\bA\by + \bb)$ and $H(\bA\by_{\mathrm{G}} + \bb)$ both exceed the original entropies by $\log|\det\bA|$, so their difference is unchanged. （a）与（b）就是 。（c）向量 $\bA\by + \bb$ 的协方差为 $\bA\bSigma\bA^\top$，与它均值、协方差相同的高斯向量是 $\bA\by_{\mathrm{G}} + \bb$。由 ，$H(\bA\by + \bb)$ 与 $H(\bA\by_{\mathrm{G}} + \bb)$ 都比原来的熵大 $\log|\det\bA|$，所以二者之差不变。 Negentropy is the information-theoretic measure of non-Gaussianity: unlike entropy it does not depend on scale, and unlike kurtosis it uses the whole density. From the entropies of , $J = \tfrac12\log(\pi e/6) \approx 0.1765$ for the uniform law and $J = \tfrac12\log(\pi e) - 1 \approx 0.0724$ for the Laplace law, whatever the variance. The two measures need not agree: the Laplace law has the larger absolute kurtosis (3 against 1.2) but the smaller negentropy. 负熵是非高斯性的信息论度量：与熵不同，它不依赖于尺度；与峭度不同，它利用了整个密度。由 中的熵可得：无论方差多大，均匀分布的 $J = \tfrac12\log(\pi e/6) \approx 0.1765$，拉普拉斯分布的 $J = \tfrac12\log(\pi e) - 1 \approx 0.0724$。两种度量的结论不必一致：拉普拉斯分布的峭度绝对值更大（3 对 1.2），负熵却更小。 The two information measures are linked. For any $\by$ with nonsingular covariance $\bC$, 这两个信息论量之间有联系。对任何协方差 $\bC$ 非奇异的 $\by$， $$I(\by) = J(\by) - \sum_{i=1}^n J(y_i) + \frac12\log\frac{\prod_{i=1}^n C_{ii}}{\det\bC}$$ ( ). If $\by = \bU\bz$ with $\bz$ white and $\bU$ orthogonal, the last term vanishes and $J(\by) = J(\bz)$ does not depend on $\bU$, so minimizing the mutual information of the outputs is the same as maximizing the sum of their negentropies. develops this equivalence ( ), connects it with maximum likelihood, and replaces negentropy, which requires a density, by approximations that can be estimated from samples ( ). （ ）。若 $\by = \bU\bz$，其中 $\bz$ 是白的、$\bU$ 正交，则最后一项为零，且 $J(\by) = J(\bz)$ 与 $\bU$ 无关，所以最小化输出的互信息等价于最大化它们的负熵之和。 会展开这一等价关系（ ），把它与最大似然联系起来，并用可以从样本估计的近似来代替需要密度的负熵（ ）。

sectionEn: Check existence before using a statistic
sectionZh: 使用统计量前先检查存在条件
text:
The tools in this chapter require different assumptions. Independence and characteristic functions make sense for discrete, continuous and singular laws without any moment assumption. Covariance needs second moments, fourth cumulants need fourth moments, and the usual $T^{-1/2}$ normal approximation for an empirical fourth cumulant needs eighth moments. For a Student $t_
u$ variable, $\E|y|^r<\infty$ exactly when $r<
u$: $t_6$ has a well-defined kurtosis, but its empirical fourth moment has infinite variance. A finite statistic and a reliable standard error are different claims. 本章各工具的假设强度不同。独立性和特征函数对离散、连续及奇异分布都有意义，不要求任何矩存在。协方差需要二阶矩，四阶累积量需要四阶矩，而经验四阶累积量通常的 $T^{-1/2}$ 正态近似需要八阶矩。对 Student $t_
u$ 变量，$\E|y|^r<\infty$ 当且仅当 $r<
u$：$t_6$ 的峭度存在，但其经验四阶矩的方差为无穷大。“统计量有定义”与“标准误可靠”是两件事。 Differential entropy requires a density on the stated ambient space. A Gaussian vector supported on a line in $\R^2$ has no two-dimensional density, so substituting $\det Sigma=0$ into the Gaussian formula is not a valid calculation of an ordinary finite differential entropy. In noiseless ICA with $m>n$, use coordinates on the $n$-dimensional signal subspace before writing density-based likelihoods. Discrete binary sources, which are legitimate ICA sources, likewise require probability masses rather than a continuous density. 微分熵要求在所声明的环境空间中存在密度。一个只落在 $\R^2$ 内某条直线上的高斯向量没有二维密度，因此不能把 $\det Sigma=0$ 直接代入高斯公式，当作普通有限微分熵的计算。在 $m>n$ 的无噪声 ICA 中，写基于密度的似然之前应先转到 $n$ 维信号子空间。二值离散源也是合法的 ICA 源，但应使用概率质量而非连续密度。 For more than two components, the nonnegative quantity $D(p_{ y}\,\|\,\prod_i p_{y_i})$ used here is also called total correlation or multi-information. It is not the alternating-sum quantity sometimes called interaction information, which can be negative. Nor does zero covariance, or a few zero cross-cumulants, establish mutual independence. Exact independence requires the full factorization, whereas finite-data diagnostics can only test selected departures from it. 对两个以上的分量，本书使用的非负量 $D(p_{ y}\,\|\,\prod_i p_{y_i})$ 也称为 总相关 或多信息。它不同于有时称为交互信息的交替求和量，后者可以为负。协方差为零或若干交叉累积量为零，也不能证明相互独立。严格独立要求完整的分解性质，而有限数据诊断只能检验某些偏离这一性质的方式。 Key points 本章要点 Independence means that the joint distribution factorizes; equivalently, $\E[g( y_1)h( y_2)] = \E[g( y_1)]\,\E[h( y_2)]$ for all bounded $g$ and $h$, or the characteristic function factorizes. Uncorrelatedness is the linear special case and is much weaker, except for jointly Gaussian vectors. Cumulants are the Taylor coefficients of the logarithm of the characteristic function. They are symmetric and multilinear, add up over independent summands, vanish when their arguments split into independent groups, and vanish beyond order two for Gaussian variables. For $ x =  A s$ with independent sources, $\cum(x_i, x_j, x_k, x_l) = \sum_p a_{ip}a_{jp}a_{kp}a_{lp}\,\kappa_p$: fourth-order statistics see the individual columns of $ A$, which the covariance cannot. Kurtosis, $\kurt(y) = \E[y^4] - 3(\E[y^2])^2$ for zero-mean $y$, is the fourth cumulant. Its sign separates sub-Gaussian from super-Gaussian variables, and the normalized kurtosis is at least $-2$. Differential entropy changes by $\log|\det A|$ under $ y \mapsto  A y$, and at fixed covariance it is largest for the Gaussian. Mutual information $I( y) = \sum_i H(y_i) - H( y) \ge 0$ vanishes exactly when the components are independent; negentropy $J \ge 0$ vanishes exactly for Gaussian vectors and is invariant under invertible linear maps. 独立意味着联合分布可以分解；等价地，对一切有界的 $g$ 与 $h$ 有 $\E[g( y_1)h( y_2)] = \E[g( y_1)]\,\E[h( y_2)]$，或者特征函数可以分解。不相关只是其中的线性特例，要弱得多；联合高斯向量是例外。 累积量是特征函数对数的 Taylor 系数。它们对称、多重线性，对独立的加项可加；当自变量能分成相互独立的两组时为零；对高斯变量，二阶以上的累积量全为零。 对源独立的 $ x =  A s$，$\cum(x_i, x_j, x_k, x_l) = \sum_p a_{ip}a_{jp}a_{kp}a_{lp}\,\kappa_p$：四阶统计量能看到 $ A$ 的每一列，而协方差做不到。 峭度（对零均值的 $y$，$\kurt(y) = \E[y^4] - 3(\E[y^2])^2$）是四阶累积量。它的符号区分亚高斯与超高斯变量，归一化峭度不小于 $-2$。 在 $ y \mapsto  A y$ 下，微分熵改变 $\log|\det A|$；在协方差固定时，高斯分布的熵最大。 互信息 $I( y) = \sum_i H(y_i) - H( y) \ge 0$，当且仅当各分量独立时为零；负熵 $J \ge 0$，当且仅当向量是高斯的时为零，并在可逆线性变换下不变。 Carry these three ideas forward 带走这三点 Independence concerns the whole joint distribution. Zero covariance or kurtosis settles only a limited question. Check the required moments or densities before using a formula. 独立性针对完整的联合分布。 协方差或峭度为零只能回答有限的问题。 套公式前检查所需的矩或密度是否存在。 Start with the uniform-kurtosis calculation , then the sign-flip counterexample . Return to the exponential cumulant derivation after characteristic functions feel familiar. 先做 均匀分布峭度计算 ，再做 符号翻转反例 。熟悉特征函数后，再回到指数分布累积量的推导。

Compute the normalized kurtosis of the uniform distribution on $[-a, a]$ and of the sinusoid $y = \sqrt2\sin\theta$ with $\theta$ uniform on $[0, 2\pi)$, and check the entries of . 计算 $[-a, a]$ 上均匀分布的归一化峭度，以及 $\theta$ 在 $[0, 2\pi)$ 上均匀时正弦波 $y = \sqrt2\sin\theta$ 的归一化峭度，并核对 中的数值。 Uniform: $\E[y^2] = \frac{1}{2a}\int_{-a}^{a} u^2\,du = a^2/3$ and $\E[y^4] = a^4/5$, so $\kurt(y) = a^4/5 - 3a^4/9 = -2a^4/15$, and dividing by $(a^2/3)^2 = a^4/9$ gives $-18/15 = -6/5$. Sinusoid: $\E[\sin^2\theta] = \tfrac12$, so $\E[y^2] = 1$; since $\sin^4\theta = (3 - 4\cos 2\theta + \cos 4\theta)/8$, $\E[\sin^4\theta] = 3/8$ and $\E[y^4] = 4 \cdot 3/8 = 3/2$. Hence $\kurt(y) = 3/2 - 3 = -3/2$. Both laws are symmetric, so their skewness is zero. 均匀分布：$\E[y^2] = \frac{1}{2a}\int_{-a}^{a} u^2\,du = a^2/3$，$\E[y^4] = a^4/5$，所以 $\kurt(y) = a^4/5 - 3a^4/9 = -2a^4/15$，再除以 $(a^2/3)^2 = a^4/9$ 得 $-18/15 = -6/5$。正弦波：$\E[\sin^2\theta] = \tfrac12$，所以 $\E[y^2] = 1$；由 $\sin^4\theta = (3 - 4\cos 2\theta + \cos 4\theta)/8$ 得 $\E[\sin^4\theta] = 3/8$，于是 $\E[y^4] = 4 \cdot 3/8 = 3/2$，$\kurt(y) = 3/2 - 3 = -3/2$。两个分布都是对称的，所以偏度为零。 Let $x \sim \Ncal(0, 1)$, let $\varepsilon$ be independent of $x$ with $P(\varepsilon = 1) = P(\varepsilon = -1) = \tfrac12$, and set $y = \varepsilon x$. Show that $y \sim \Ncal(0, 1)$ and $\Cov(x, y) = 0$, but that $x$ and $y$ are dependent. Why does this not contradict ? 设 $x \sim \Ncal(0, 1)$，$\varepsilon$ 与 $x$ 独立且 $P(\varepsilon = 1) = P(\varepsilon = -1) = \tfrac12$，令 $y = \varepsilon x$。证明 $y \sim \Ncal(0, 1)$ 且 $\Cov(x, y) = 0$，但 $x$ 与 $y$ 不独立。为什么这与 不矛盾？ By symmetry of $x$, $P(y \le u) = \tfrac12 P(x \le u) + \tfrac12 P(-x \le u) = P(x \le u)$, so $y \sim \Ncal(0, 1)$. Also $\Cov(x, y) = \E[\varepsilon x^2] = \E[\varepsilon]\,\E[x^2] = 0$. But $|y| = |x|$, so $P(|x| \le 1, |y| \le 1) = P(|x| \le 1) \approx 0.683$, while $P(|x| \le 1)\,P(|y| \le 1) \approx 0.683^2 \approx 0.466$: the variables are dependent. There is no contradiction because $(x, y)$ is not jointly Gaussian: $x + y = (1 + \varepsilon)x$ equals 0 with probability $\tfrac12$ and is otherwise distributed as $2x$, which is neither Gaussian nor constant. 由 $x$ 的对称性，$P(y \le u) = \tfrac12 P(x \le u) + \tfrac12 P(-x \le u) = P(x \le u)$，所以 $y \sim \Ncal(0, 1)$。又 $\Cov(x, y) = \E[\varepsilon x^2] = \E[\varepsilon]\,\E[x^2] = 0$。但 $|y| = |x|$，所以 $P(|x| \le 1, |y| \le 1) = P(|x| \le 1) \approx 0.683$，而 $P(|x| \le 1)\,P(|y| \le 1) \approx 0.683^2 \approx 0.466$，两个变量并不独立。这与命题不矛盾，因为 $(x, y)$ 不是联合高斯的：$x + y = (1 + \varepsilon)x$ 以概率 $\tfrac12$ 等于 0，否则与 $2x$ 同分布，这样的变量既不是高斯的也不是常数。 Let $y$ be exponential with rate $\lambda$. Using $\varphi_y(\omega) = \lambda/(\lambda - i\omega)$, show that $\kappa_j(y) = (j - 1)!/\lambda^j$ for all $j \ge 1$. Deduce that the skewness is 2 and the normalized kurtosis is 6 for every $\lambda$, and check $\kappa_3$ and $\kappa_4$ against the raw-moment formulas of , using $\E[y^j] = j!/\lambda^j$. 设 $y$ 服从速率为 $\lambda$ 的指数分布。利用 $\varphi_y(\omega) = \lambda/(\lambda - i\omega)$，证明对所有 $j \ge 1$ 有 $\kappa_j(y) = (j - 1)!/\lambda^j$。由此说明对任意 $\lambda$，偏度为 2、归一化峭度为 6；并利用 $\E[y^j] = j!/\lambda^j$，用 中的原点矩公式核对 $\kappa_3$ 与 $\kappa_4$。 For $|\omega| < \lambda$, $\log\varphi_y(\omega) = -\log(1 - i\omega/\lambda) = \sum_{j \ge 1} \frac{1}{j}\bigl(\frac{i\omega}{\lambda}\bigr)^j = \sum_{j \ge 1} \frac{(j - 1)!}{\lambda^j}\,\frac{(i\omega)^j}{j!}$, so $\kappa_j = (j-1)!/\lambda^j$. Then $\Var(y) = \kappa_2 = 1/\lambda^2$, the skewness is $\kappa_3/\kappa_2^{3/2} = (2/\lambda^3)\lambda^3 = 2$, and the normalized kurtosis is $\kappa_4/\kappa_2^2 = (6/\lambda^4)\lambda^4 = 6$. With $\lambda = 1$ the raw moments are $m_j = j!$, and the formulas give $\kappa_3 = 6 - 3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1 + 2 = 2$ and $\kappa_4 = 24 - 4 \cdot 6 - 3 \cdot 4 + 12 \cdot 2 - 6 = 6$, as they should; other values of $\lambda$ only rescale $y$. 当 $|\omega| < \lambda$ 时，$\log\varphi_y(\omega) = -\log(1 - i\omega/\lambda) = \sum_{j \ge 1} \frac{1}{j}\bigl(\frac{i\omega}{\lambda}\bigr)^j = \sum_{j \ge 1} \frac{(j - 1)!}{\lambda^j}\,\frac{(i\omega)^j}{j!}$，所以 $\kappa_j = (j-1)!/\lambda^j$。于是 $\Var(y) = \kappa_2 = 1/\lambda^2$，偏度为 $\kappa_3/\kappa_2^{3/2} = (2/\lambda^3)\lambda^3 = 2$，归一化峭度为 $\kappa_4/\kappa_2^2 = (6/\lambda^4)\lambda^4 = 6$。取 $\lambda = 1$，原点矩为 $m_j = j!$，代入公式得 $\kappa_3 = 6 - 3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1 + 2 = 2$，$\kappa_4 = 24 - 4 \cdot 6 - 3 \cdot 4 + 12 \cdot 2 - 6 = 6$，与上面一致；其他 $\lambda$ 只是对 $y$ 作缩放。 Derive the negentropies $J = \tfrac12\log(\pi e/6)$ of the uniform law and $J = \tfrac12\log(\pi e) - 1$ of the Laplace law, and explain why they do not depend on the variance. Which of the two laws is “more non-Gaussian” according to kurtosis, and which according to negentropy? 推导均匀分布的负熵 $J = \tfrac12\log(\pi e/6)$ 与拉普拉斯分布的负熵 $J = \tfrac12\log(\pi e) - 1$，并说明它们为什么与方差无关。按峭度，两个分布中哪一个“更非高斯”？按负熵呢？ By (c), $J(\alpha y) = J(y)$, so we may take unit variance. Uniform on $[-\sqrt3, \sqrt3]$: $H = \log(2\sqrt3) = \tfrac12\log 12$, so $J = \tfrac12\log(2\pi e) - \tfrac12\log 12 = \tfrac12\log(\pi e/6) \approx 0.1765$. Laplace with $b = 1/\sqrt2$: $H = 1 + \log(2b) = 1 + \tfrac12\log 2$, so $J = \tfrac12\log(2\pi e) - 1 - \tfrac12\log 2 = \tfrac12\log(\pi e) - 1 \approx 0.0724$. By absolute normalized kurtosis the Laplace law is further from the Gaussian (3 against 1.2); by negentropy the uniform law is (0.1765 against 0.0724). Kurtosis is dominated by the tails, negentropy weighs the whole density, and the bounded support of the uniform law makes its density very different from a Gaussian one. 由 （c），$J(\alpha y) = J(y)$，所以可以取单位方差。$[-\sqrt3, \sqrt3]$ 上的均匀分布：$H = \log(2\sqrt3) = \tfrac12\log 12$，所以 $J = \tfrac12\log(2\pi e) - \tfrac12\log 12 = \tfrac12\log(\pi e/6) \approx 0.1765$。$b = 1/\sqrt2$ 的拉普拉斯分布：$H = 1 + \log(2b) = 1 + \tfrac12\log 2$，所以 $J = \tfrac12\log(2\pi e) - 1 - \tfrac12\log 2 = \tfrac12\log(\pi e) - 1 \approx 0.0724$。按归一化峭度的绝对值，拉普拉斯分布离高斯更远（3 对 1.2）；按负熵则是均匀分布离高斯更远（0.1765 对 0.0724）。峭度主要由尾部决定，负熵则考虑整个密度；均匀分布的支撑有界，使它的密度与高斯密度相差很大。 Derive from : for zero-mean $x_1, \dots, x_4$ with finite fourth moments, expand $\log\varphi_{\bx}(\bomega)$ to fourth order and identify the coefficient of $\omega_1\omega_2\omega_3\omega_4$. Then use the formula to check directly that $\cum(y_1, y_1, y_2, y_2) = 0$ when $y_1$ and $y_2$ are independent with zero mean. 由 推导 ：对四阶矩有限的零均值变量 $x_1, \dots, x_4$，把 $\log\varphi_{\bx}(\bomega)$ 展开到四阶，找出 $\omega_1\omega_2\omega_3\omega_4$ 的系数。再用这个公式直接验证：当 $y_1$ 与 $y_2$ 独立且均值为零时，$\cum(y_1, y_1, y_2, y_2) = 0$。 Let $c_{ab} = \E[x_ax_b]$, $m_{abc} = \E[x_ax_bx_c]$ and $m_{abcd} = \E[x_ax_bx_cx_d]$. Expanding the exponential to fourth order (no first-order term, because the means vanish), $\varphi_{\bx}(\bomega) = 1 + u$ with 记 $c_{ab} = \E[x_ax_b]$，$m_{abc} = \E[x_ax_bx_c]$，$m_{abcd} = \E[x_ax_bx_cx_d]$。把指数函数展开到四阶（由于均值为零，没有一阶项），得 $\varphi_{\bx}(\bomega) = 1 + u$，其中 $$u = -\frac12\sum_{a,b} c_{ab}\,\omega_a\omega_b - \frac{i}{6}\sum_{a,b,c} m_{abc}\,\omega_a\omega_b\omega_c + \frac{1}{24}\sum_{a,b,c,d} m_{abcd}\,\omega_a\omega_b\omega_c\omega_d + o(\|\bomega\|^4).$$ Then $\log(1 + u) = u - u^2/2 + O(|u|^3)$, where $u^3 = O(\|\bomega\|^6)$ and, up to $o(\|\bomega\|^4)$, $u^2 = \tfrac14 S^2$ with $S = \sum_{a,b} c_{ab}\omega_a\omega_b$. Since $\cum(x_1, x_2, x_3, x_4)$ is the fourth mixed derivative at $\bzero$ (the factor $(-i)^4$ equals 1), it is the coefficient of $\omega_1\omega_2\omega_3\omega_4$ in this expansion. In $u$, the 24 orderings of $(1, 2, 3, 4)$ in the quartic sum contribute $\tfrac{1}{24} \cdot 24\,m_{1234} = m_{1234}$. In $S^2$, the monomial $\omega_1\omega_2\omega_3\omega_4$ arises from products of two terms of $S$ whose index pairs split $\{1, 2, 3, 4\}$; there are three such splits, each term of $S$ with $a \ne b$ appears twice ($c_{ab} = c_{ba}$), and the two factors can be taken in either order, so the coefficient is $8(c_{12}c_{34} + c_{13}c_{24} + c_{14}c_{23})$. With the factor $-\tfrac12 \cdot \tfrac14$, the coefficient in $\log\varphi_{\bx}$ is $m_{1234} - c_{12}c_{34} - c_{13}c_{24} - c_{14}c_{23}$, which is . For independent zero-mean $y_1$ and $y_2$, the formula gives $\cum(y_1, y_1, y_2, y_2) = \E[y_1^2y_2^2] - \E[y_1^2]\,\E[y_2^2] - 2(\E[y_1y_2])^2 = \E[y_1^2]\,\E[y_2^2] - \E[y_1^2]\,\E[y_2^2] - 0 = 0$. 于是 $\log(1 + u) = u - u^2/2 + O(|u|^3)$，其中 $u^3 = O(\|\bomega\|^6)$，并且在相差 $o(\|\bomega\|^4)$ 的意义下 $u^2 = \tfrac14 S^2$，$S = \sum_{a,b} c_{ab}\omega_a\omega_b$。由于 $\cum(x_1, x_2, x_3, x_4)$ 是 $\bzero$ 处的四阶混合偏导数（因子 $(-i)^4$ 等于 1），它就是这个展开式中 $\omega_1\omega_2\omega_3\omega_4$ 的系数。在 $u$ 中，四次求和里 $(1, 2, 3, 4)$ 的 24 种排列贡献 $\tfrac{1}{24} \cdot 24\,m_{1234} = m_{1234}$。在 $S^2$ 中，单项式 $\omega_1\omega_2\omega_3\omega_4$ 来自 $S$ 的两项之积，且两项的下标对恰好把 $\{1, 2, 3, 4\}$ 分成两组；这样的分法有三种，$S$ 中每个 $a \ne b$ 的项出现两次（$c_{ab} = c_{ba}$），两个因子的先后又有两种，所以系数为 $8(c_{12}c_{34} + c_{13}c_{24} + c_{14}c_{23})$。乘上因子 $-\tfrac12 \cdot \tfrac14$，$\log\varphi_{\bx}$ 中的系数为 $m_{1234} - c_{12}c_{34} - c_{13}c_{24} - c_{14}c_{23}$，这正是 。对独立的零均值变量 $y_1$、$y_2$，公式给出 $\cum(y_1, y_1, y_2, y_2) = \E[y_1^2y_2^2] - \E[y_1^2]\,\E[y_2^2] - 2(\E[y_1y_2])^2 = \E[y_1^2]\,\E[y_2^2] - \E[y_1^2]\,\E[y_2^2] - 0 = 0$。 Prove . Deduce that if $\bz$ is white and $\by = \bU\bz$ with $\bU$ orthogonal, then $I(\by) = J(\bz) - \sum_i J(y_i)$, and that the separating rotations are exactly the maximizers of $\sum_i J(y_i)$ whenever $\bz = \tilde\bA\bs$ with $\tilde\bA$ orthogonal and independent sources, at most one of them Gaussian. 证明 。由此推出：若 $\bz$ 是白的，$\by = \bU\bz$ 且 $\bU$ 正交，则 $I(\by) = J(\bz) - \sum_i J(y_i)$；并且当 $\bz = \tilde\bA\bs$（$\tilde\bA$ 正交，源独立且至多一个是高斯的）时，使 $\sum_i J(y_i)$ 最大的旋转恰好就是能实现分离的旋转。 By the definition of negentropy, $H(y_i) = \tfrac12\log(2\pi e\,C_{ii}) - J(y_i)$ and $H(\by) = \tfrac12\log\bigl((2\pi e)^n\det\bC\bigr) - J(\by)$. Substituting into $I(\by) = \sum_i H(y_i) - H(\by)$, the terms $\tfrac12\log(2\pi e)$ cancel ($n$ of them on each side) and we obtain $I(\by) = J(\by) - \sum_i J(y_i) + \tfrac12\bigl(\sum_i\log C_{ii} - \log\det\bC\bigr)$, which is . If $\by = \bU\bz$ with $\bz$ white, then $\bC = \bU\bI\bU^\top = \bI$, so the last term is $\tfrac12\log(1/1) = 0$, and $J(\by) = J(\bz)$ by (c). Hence $I(\by) = J(\bz) - \sum_i J(y_i)$, where $J(\bz)$ does not depend on $\bU$. Since $I(\by) \ge 0$ with equality exactly for independent outputs ( ), $\sum_i J(y_i) \le J(\bz)$ for every $\bU$, with equality exactly when the outputs are independent. A separating rotation, $\bU\tilde\bA = \bPi\bD$, makes them independent and therefore attains the maximum. Conversely, any maximizer has independent outputs, and when at most one source is Gaussian, Comon's theorem ( ) shows that it separates. 由负熵的定义，$H(y_i) = \tfrac12\log(2\pi e\,C_{ii}) - J(y_i)$，$H(\by) = \tfrac12\log\bigl((2\pi e)^n\det\bC\bigr) - J(\by)$。代入 $I(\by) = \sum_i H(y_i) - H(\by)$，两边各 $n$ 个 $\tfrac12\log(2\pi e)$ 相互抵消，得到 $I(\by) = J(\by) - \sum_i J(y_i) + \tfrac12\bigl(\sum_i\log C_{ii} - \log\det\bC\bigr)$，即 。若 $\by = \bU\bz$ 且 $\bz$ 是白的，则 $\bC = \bU\bI\bU^\top = \bI$，最后一项为 $\tfrac12\log(1/1) = 0$；又由 （c），$J(\by) = J(\bz)$。因此 $I(\by) = J(\bz) - \sum_i J(y_i)$，其中 $J(\bz)$ 与 $\bU$ 无关。由于 $I(\by) \ge 0$，且仅当输出独立时取等号（ ），对每个 $\bU$ 都有 $\sum_i J(y_i) \le J(\bz)$，等号恰在输出独立时成立。能实现分离的旋转（$\bU\tilde\bA = \bPi\bD$）使输出独立，因而达到最大值。反之，任何最大值点都使输出独立；当至多一个源是高斯的时，Comon 定理（ ）表明它能实现分离。
