Reading the identity. Mutual information uses the outputs’ actual marginal densities. Likelihood inserts the densities we choose. If those choices are wrong, an extra mismatch penalty remains; maximizing one objective need not minimize the other. Keep that distinction in view while following the algebra. 怎样读下面的恒等式。 互信息使用输出真实的边缘密度；似然代入的是我们选定的密度。选择错误时，会多出模型失配的惩罚项，因此最大化一个目标未必最小化另一个。跟随代数推导时，请始终保留这个区别。 The information-theoretic route measures the dependence of the outputs by their mutual information, $I(\by) = \sum_i H(y_i) - H(\by)$ ( ). It is nonnegative and vanishes exactly when the outputs are independent. Since $\by = \bW\bx$, the joint entropy satisfies $H(\by) = H(\bx) + \log|\det\bW|$ ( ), so 信息论的路线用互信息 $I(\by) = \sum_i H(y_i) - H(\by)$ 来度量输出之间的相依性（ ）。它非负，且恰在输出独立时为零。由于 $\by = \bW\bx$，联合熵满足 $H(\by) = H(\bx) + \log|\det\bW|$（ ），所以 $$I(\by) = \sum_{i=1}^{n} H(y_i) - H(\bx) - \log|\det\bW| .$$ Only the marginal entropies and $\log|\det\bW|$ depend on $\bW$; the joint entropy of the data is a constant. Rescaling an output changes $H(y_i)$ and $\log|\det\bW|$ by the same amount, so $I(\by)$ is invariant under $\bW \mapsto \bPi\bD\bW$, as a measure of independence should be. By , if at most one source is Gaussian, the minimizers of $I(\by)$ over invertible $\bW$, where $I(\by) = 0$, are exactly the separating matrices: mutual information is a contrast function in the sense of Comon (1994). The likelihood is tied to it by an exact identity. 只有各边缘熵和 $\log|\det\bW|$ 依赖于 $\bW$，数据的联合熵是常数。对某个输出做尺度变换，$H(y_i)$ 与 $\log|\det\bW|$ 改变同样的量，所以 $I(\by)$ 在 $\bW \mapsto \bPi\bD\bW$ 下不变，这正是独立性度量应有的性质。由 ，若至多一个源是高斯的，则 $I(\by)$ 在可逆矩阵 $\bW$ 上的最小点（在那里 $I(\by) = 0$）恰好是分离矩阵：互信息是 Comon（1994）意义下的 对比函数 。似然与它之间有一个精确的恒等式。 For every invertible $\bW$ such that the entropies and divergences below are finite, 对任意可逆矩阵 $\bW$，只要下式中的熵与散度都有限，就有 $$\mathcal{L}(\bW) = -H(\bx) - D\Bigl(p_{\by} \,\Big\|\, \prod_i p_i\Bigr) = -H(\bx) - I(\by) - \sum_{i=1}^{n} D\bigl(p_{y_i} \,\|\, p_i\bigr),$$ where $p_{\by}$ and $p_{y_i}$ are the actual densities of $\by = \bW\bx$ and of its components. Maximizing the likelihood therefore minimizes the sum of the mutual information of the outputs and the mismatch between their marginal densities and the model densities. 其中 $p_{\by}$ 与 $p_{y_i}$ 分别是 $\by = \bW\bx$ 及其各分量的实际密度。因此最大化似然，就是最小化输出的互信息与“输出边缘密度和模型密度之间的失配”这两者之和。 By definition, $D(p_{\by} \| \prod_i p_i) = \E[\log p_{\by}(\by)] - \sum_i \E[\log p_i(y_i)] = -H(\by) - \sum_i \E[\log p_i(y_i)]$. Substituting $H(\by) = H(\bx) + \log|\det\bW|$ gives $-D(p_{\by}\|\prod_i p_i) = H(\bx) + \mathcal{L}(\bW)$, the first equality. For the second, insert $\prod_i p_{y_i}$: 按定义，$D(p_{\by} \| \prod_i p_i) = \E[\log p_{\by}(\by)] - \sum_i \E[\log p_i(y_i)] = -H(\by) - \sum_i \E[\log p_i(y_i)]$。代入 $H(\by) = H(\bx) + \log|\det\bW|$，得 $-D(p_{\by}\|\prod_i p_i) = H(\bx) + \mathcal{L}(\bW)$，这就是第一个等式。对第二个等式，插入 $\prod_i p_{y_i}$： $$D\Bigl(p_{\by} \,\Big\|\, \prod_i p_i\Bigr) = \E\Bigl[\log\frac{p_{\by}(\by)}{\prod_i p_{y_i}(y_i)}\Bigr] + \sum_i \E\Bigl[\log\frac{p_{y_i}(y_i)}{p_i(y_i)}\Bigr] = I(\by) + \sum_i D\bigl(p_{y_i} \,\|\, p_i\bigr),$$ because the second expectation involves $y_i$ only and is therefore a divergence between marginal densities. 这里第二个期望只涉及 $y_i$，因而是边缘密度之间的散度。 This decomposition (Cardoso, 1997; 1998) explains what maximum likelihood does. If the model densities are correct, both terms vanish at $\bW = \bA^{-1}$, which is therefore a global maximum; by every other global maximum is a separating matrix whose outputs again have the model densities. If the model is wrong, the mismatch term is positive even at separation and competes with the mutual information. ML then trades a little dependence for a better marginal fit, and the question becomes whether the trade can move the maximum away from separation ( ). 这一分解（Cardoso, 1997; 1998）说明了最大似然在做什么。若模型密度正确，两项都在 $\bW = \bA^{-1}$ 处为零，因此它是全局最大点；由 ，其他任何全局最大点也都是分离矩阵，且其输出同样具有模型密度。若模型有误，失配项即使在分离点也为正，并与互信息相互竞争。此时最大似然会用一点相依性去换取更好的边缘拟合，问题就变成：这种交换会不会把最大点从分离解处挪走（ ）。 Let the two sources be Laplacian with unit variance and $\bA = \bI$, so $\bx = \bs$ and $H(\bx) = 2(1 + \log\sqrt2) \approx 2.693$. evaluates for four unmixing matrices and two models: the correct Laplace density, and the logistic density $e^{-u}/(1+e^{-u})^2$ that Infomax uses ( ). The output densities were obtained by numerical convolution and the entropies by numerical integration; a Monte Carlo average of $\frac1T\log L(\bW)$ over $4 \times 10^6$ samples reproduces every value of $\mathcal{L}$ to within $0.0012$. 设两个源都是单位方差的拉普拉斯变量，$\bA = \bI$，于是 $\bx = \bs$，$H(\bx) = 2(1 + \log\sqrt2) \approx 2.693$。 对四个解混矩阵和两种模型计算 ：一种是正确的拉普拉斯密度，另一种是 Infomax 所用的 logistic 密度 $e^{-u}/(1+e^{-u})^2$（ ）。输出密度由数值卷积得到，熵由数值积分得到；用 $4 \times 10^6$ 个样本对 $\frac1T\log L(\bW)$ 做 Monte Carlo 平均，所得结果与表中每个 $\mathcal{L}$ 值之差都不超过 $0.0012$。 The terms of for two unit-variance Laplacian sources with $\bA = \bI$. $\bR$ is the rotation by $30^\circ$ and $\bM = \bigl(\begin{smallmatrix} 1 & 0.5 \\ -0.3 & 1.2 \end{smallmatrix}\bigr)$. In every row $\mathcal{L} = -H(\bx) - I(\by) - \sum_i D(p_{y_i}\|p_i)$ with $H(\bx) = 2.693$. 两个单位方差拉普拉斯源、$\bA = \bI$ 时 中的各项。$\bR$ 是旋转 $30^\circ$ 的矩阵，$\bM = \bigl(\begin{smallmatrix} 1 & 0.5 \\ -0.3 & 1.2 \end{smallmatrix}\bigr)$。每一行都满足 $\mathcal{L} = -H(\bx) - I(\by) - \sum_i D(p_{y_i}\|p_i)$，其中 $H(\bx) = 2.693$。 $\bW$ $I(\by)$ Laplace model: 拉普拉斯模型： $\sum_i D$ Laplace model: 拉普拉斯模型： $\mathcal{L}$ logistic model: logistic 模型： $\sum_i D$ logistic model: logistic 模型： $\mathcal{L}$ $\bI$ $0.000$ $0.000$ $-2.693$ $0.505$ $-3.198$ $\bR$ $0.081$ $0.017$ $-2.791$ $0.433$ $-3.207$ $2\bI$ $0.000$ $0.614$ $-3.307$ $0.046$ $-2.739$ $\bM$ $0.077$ $0.049$ $-2.820$ $0.277$ $-3.047$ The table shows three things. With the correct model the likelihood is largest at $\bW = \bI$, and any mixing costs mutual information ($0.081$ nats for the rotation). With the logistic model the mismatch term dominates: the logistic density has variance $\pi^2/3 \approx 3.3$, so outputs of unit variance fit it poorly, and the likelihood is higher at $\bW = 2\bI$, which enlarges the outputs; this is harmless, since the scale is not identifiable anyway. Finally, the mismatch under the logistic model is smaller at the rotation ($0.433$) than at $\bW = \bI$ ($0.505$): a wrong model can reward mixing. Here the mutual information term still wins, so separation remains the better solution, but for sub-Gaussian sources the balance can tip. 这张表说明了三点。模型正确时，似然在 $\bW = \bI$ 处最大，任何混合都要付出互信息的代价（旋转为 $0.081$ 奈特）。用 logistic 模型时，失配项占主导：logistic 密度的方差为 $\pi^2/3 \approx 3.3$，单位方差的输出与它拟合得很差，于是似然在把输出放大的 $\bW = 2\bI$ 处更高；这无伤大雅，因为尺度本来就不可辨识。最后，在 logistic 模型下，旋转处的失配（$0.433$）比 $\bW = \bI$ 处（$0.505$）更小：错误的模型可能奖励混合。这里互信息项仍然占上风，分离解依旧更优；但对亚高斯源，天平可能倒向另一边。

sectionEn: Whitened data: mutual information and negentropy
sectionZh: 白化数据：互信息与负熵
text: For whitened data the mutual information takes a transparent form. Recall that the negentropy of a random vector with covariance $\bC$ is $J(\by) = H(\by_{\mathrm{G}}) - H(\by)$, where $\by_{\mathrm{G}}$ is Gaussian with the same covariance; it is nonnegative, vanishes only for Gaussian vectors, and is invariant under invertible linear maps ( ). For a scalar with unit variance, $H(y) = \frac12\log(2\pi e) - J(y)$. 对白化数据，互信息具有一目了然的形式。回忆：协方差为 $\bC$ 的随机向量的负熵为 $J(\by) = H(\by_{\mathrm{G}}) - H(\by)$，其中 $\by_{\mathrm{G}}$ 是具有相同协方差的高斯向量；它非负，只对高斯向量为零，并且在可逆线性变换下不变（ ）。对单位方差的标量，$H(y) = \frac12\log(2\pi e) - J(y)$。 Let $\bz$ be white and $\by = \bU\bz$ with $\bU$ orthogonal. Then 设 $\bz$ 是白的，$\by = \bU\bz$，$\bU$ 为正交矩阵。则 $$I(\by) = J(\bz) - \sum_{i=1}^{n} J(y_i) .$$ If moreover $\bz = \tilde\bA\bs$ with independent unit-variance sources, then $J(\bz) = \sum_i J(s_i)$, so $\sum_i J(y_i) \le \sum_i J(s_i)$, with equality exactly when the outputs are independent. 若进一步有 $\bz = \tilde\bA\bs$，各源独立且方差为一，则 $J(\bz) = \sum_i J(s_i)$，从而 $\sum_i J(y_i) \le \sum_i J(s_i)$，且等号恰在输出相互独立时成立。 Since $|\det\bU| = 1$, $H(\by) = H(\bz)$. The vector $\by$ is again white, so each $y_i$ has unit variance and $H(y_i) = \frac12\log(2\pi e) - J(y_i)$, while $H(\bz) = \frac n2\log(2\pi e) - J(\bz)$. Substituting into $I(\by) = \sum_i H(y_i) - H(\by)$ gives . By invariance $J(\bz) = J(\bs)$, and $J(\bs) = \frac n2\log(2\pi e) - \sum_i H(s_i) = \sum_i J(s_i)$ because the sources are independent with unit variance. The inequality is $I(\by) \ge 0$. 由于 $|\det\bU| = 1$，$H(\by) = H(\bz)$。$\by$ 仍是白的，所以每个 $y_i$ 方差为一，$H(y_i) = \frac12\log(2\pi e) - J(y_i)$；同时 $H(\bz) = \frac n2\log(2\pi e) - J(\bz)$。代入 $I(\by) = \sum_i H(y_i) - H(\by)$ 即得 。由不变性 $J(\bz) = J(\bs)$；又因各源独立且方差为一，$J(\bs) = \frac n2\log(2\pi e) - \sum_i H(s_i) = \sum_i J(s_i)$。不等式就是 $I(\by) \ge 0$。 Minimizing mutual information over rotations is therefore the same as maximizing the sum of the marginal negentropies. The non-Gaussianity principle of is not a heuristic after all: it is an exact reformulation of independence, with negentropy in the role of kurtosis, and the sources are the rotation that concentrates all the available negentropy $\sum_i J(s_i)$ in the marginals. Without whitening, the same substitution gives the identity $I(\by) = J(\bx) - \sum_i J(y_i) + \frac12\log\bigl(\prod_i \Var(y_i)/\det\bC_{\by}\bigr)$ for any invertible $\bW$ (Comon, 1994). The last term is nonnegative by Hadamard's inequality and vanishes exactly for uncorrelated outputs, so restricting the search to whitened data and rotations loses nothing. 因此，在旋转上最小化互信息，等价于最大化各边缘负熵之和。 的非高斯性原理终究不是启发式：它是独立性的精确改写，只是由负熵扮演了峭度的角色；源对应的那个旋转，把全部可用的负熵 $\sum_i J(s_i)$ 都集中到了边缘上。不白化时，同样的代换对任意可逆 $\bW$ 给出恒等式 $I(\by) = J(\bx) - \sum_i J(y_i) + \frac12\log\bigl(\prod_i \Var(y_i)/\det\bC_{\by}\bigr)$（Comon, 1994）。由 Hadamard 不等式，最后一项非负，且恰在输出不相关时为零，所以把搜索限制在白化数据与旋转上不会损失什么。 One-unit methods maximize a single negentropy $J(\bw^\top\bz)$ on the sphere. The entropy power inequality implies that its global maximum is attained at the source with the largest negentropy ( ), the analogue of . Negentropy itself, however, requires the density of $y$, which is why approximates it. 单单元方法在球面上最大化单个负熵 $J(\bw^\top\bz)$。由熵幂不等式，其全局最大值在负熵最大的那个源处取得（ ），这与 相对应。然而负熵本身需要 $y$ 的密度，这正是 要对它做近似的原因。

Bell & Sejnowski (1995) approached separation from the side of neural networks. A layer of units computes $\by = \bW\bx$ and passes each output through an increasing squashing function $g_i : \R \to (0, 1)$, giving $u_i = g_i(y_i)$. Their Infomax principle maximizes the information that the outputs $\bu$ carry about the inputs $\bx$; for a deterministic invertible map of continuous variables, however, $I(\bx;\bu)$ is generally infinite and is not a finite optimization objective. With independent additive output noise $\boldsymbol{\eta}$, $I(\bx;\bu+\boldsymbol{\eta}) = H(\bu+\boldsymbol{\eta})-H(\boldsymbol{\eta})$; in a suitable small-noise limit this motivates maximizing the noiseless output entropy $H(\bu)$. The entropy-to-likelihood identity below is exact for the noiseless transform. With the logistic function $g(y) = 1/(1 + e^{-y})$, the gradient of $H(\bu)$ is $\bW^{-\top} + \E[(\mathbf{1} - 2\bu)\bx^\top]$, and the resulting algorithm separated mixtures of audio signals; it became one of the first widely used ICA methods. Bell & Sejnowski（1995）从神经网络的角度研究分离问题。一层神经元计算 $\by = \bW\bx$，再把每个输出送入一个递增的压缩函数 $g_i : \R \to (0, 1)$，得到 $u_i = g_i(y_i)$。他们的 Infomax 原理最大化输出 $\bu$ 所携带的关于输入 $\bx$ 的信息；但对于连续变量的确定性可逆映射，$I(\bx;\bu)$ 通常为无穷大，不能直接作为有限的优化目标。加入独立的输出噪声 $\boldsymbol{\eta}$ 后，$I(\bx;\bu+\boldsymbol{\eta}) = H(\bu+\boldsymbol{\eta})-H(\boldsymbol{\eta})$；在适当的小噪声极限下，这为最大化无噪声输出熵 $H(\bu)$ 提供了动机。下面的输出熵与似然恒等式对无噪声变换精确成立。取 logistic 函数 $g(y) = 1/(1 + e^{-y})$ 时，$H(\bu)$ 的梯度为 $\bW^{-\top} + \E[(\mathbf{1} - 2\bu)\bx^\top]$；由此得到的算法成功分离了音频信号的混合，成为最早被广泛使用的 ICA 方法之一。 Let each $g_i$ be differentiable and increasing with $g_i' = p_i$, that is, $g_i$ is the distribution function of the model density $p_i$. Then for every invertible $\bW$, 设每个 $g_i$ 可微且递增，并满足 $g_i' = p_i$，即 $g_i$ 是模型密度 $p_i$ 的分布函数。则对任意可逆矩阵 $\bW$， $$H(\bu) = H(\bx) + \mathcal{L}(\bW) = -D\Bigl(p_{\by} \,\Big\|\, \prod_i p_i\Bigr) \le 0 .$$ Maximizing the output entropy is therefore maximum likelihood estimation with the model densities $g_i'$. The bound $0$ is attained exactly when the outputs are independent with densities $p_i$, that is, when $\bu$ is uniform on the unit cube. 因此，最大化输出熵就是以 $g_i'$ 为模型密度的最大似然估计。上界 $0$ 恰在输出相互独立且密度为 $p_i$ 时取到，也就是 $\bu$ 在单位立方体上均匀分布时。 The map $\by \mapsto \bu$ is smooth and invertible with Jacobian $\diag(g_1'(y_1), \dots, g_n'(y_n))$, and under such a map the entropy changes by the expected log-Jacobian: $H(\bu) = H(\by) + \sum_i \E[\log g_i'(y_i)]$. With $H(\by) = H(\bx) + \log|\det\bW|$ and $g_i' = p_i$ this is $H(\bx) + \mathcal{L}(\bW)$, and gives the divergence form. A divergence vanishes only when the two densities coincide, here when $\by$ has density $\prod_i p_i$; by the probability integral transform this happens exactly when the $u_i = g_i(y_i)$ are independent and uniform on $(0, 1)$. 映射 $\by \mapsto \bu$ 光滑可逆，其 Jacobi 矩阵为 $\diag(g_1'(y_1), \dots, g_n'(y_n))$；在这样的映射下，熵的变化等于 Jacobi 行列式对数的期望：$H(\bu) = H(\by) + \sum_i \E[\log g_i'(y_i)]$。代入 $H(\by) = H(\bx) + \log|\det\bW|$ 与 $g_i' = p_i$，即得 $H(\bx) + \mathcal{L}(\bW)$，再由 得到散度形式。散度只在两个密度相同时为零，这里即 $\by$ 的密度为 $\prod_i p_i$；由概率积分变换，这恰好等价于各 $u_i = g_i(y_i)$ 相互独立且在 $(0, 1)$ 上均匀分布。 The equivalence was pointed out by Cardoso (1997) and by Pearlmutter & Parra (1997). For the logistic $g$, the model density $g' = g(1 - g)$ is the logistic density of , with score $\varphi(y) = 2g(y) - 1 = \tanh(y/2)$; since $-\varphi(y_i) = 1 - 2u_i$, the Bell–Sejnowski gradient is exactly the likelihood gradient . The logistic density has kurtosis $1.2$, a super-Gaussian model. This explains why Infomax works well for speech and many natural signals, which are super-Gaussian, and why it needs a modification for sub-Gaussian sources ( ). develops the natural-gradient form of the algorithm ( ). 这一等价关系由 Cardoso（1997）以及 Pearlmutter & Parra（1997）指出。对 logistic 函数 $g$，模型密度 $g' = g(1 - g)$ 就是 中的 logistic 密度，其得分函数为 $\varphi(y) = 2g(y) - 1 = \tanh(y/2)$；由于 $-\varphi(y_i) = 1 - 2u_i$，Bell–Sejnowski 梯度恰好就是似然梯度 。logistic 密度的峭度为 $1.2$，是一个超高斯模型。这解释了为什么 Infomax 对语音和许多自然信号（它们是超高斯的）效果很好，而对亚高斯源则需要修改（ ）。 给出该算法的自然梯度形式（ ）。

sectionEn: When the source model is wrong
text:
In practice the source densities are unknown, and maximum likelihood is run with a fixed model such as the logistic density. This is less dangerous than it sounds, because of a simple property of the estimating equations. 实践中源密度是未知的，最大似然只能用一个固定的模型（例如 logistic 密度）来运行。这并不像听起来那么危险，原因在于估计方程的一个简单性质。 Let the sources be independent with zero mean, let $\varphi_1, \dots, \varphi_n$ be arbitrary model scores, and suppose that for each $i$ the scale equation 设各源独立且均值为零，$\varphi_1, \dots, \varphi_n$ 是任意的模型得分函数，并设对每个 $i$，尺度方程 $$\E igl[\varphi_i(d_i s_i)\, d_i s_i igr] = 1$$ has a solution $d_i 
eq 0$. Then $ W =  D A^{-1}$ with $ D = \diag(d_1, \dots, d_n)$ satisfies the estimating equations $\E[\varphi_i(y_i)\, y_j] = \delta_{ij}$, so it is a stationary point of $\mathcal{L}$. The same holds for every ordering of the sources, with each model paired with the source it extracts. 有解 $d_i 
eq 0$。则 $ W =  D A^{-1}$（$ D = \diag(d_1, \dots, d_n)$）满足估计方程 $\E[\varphi_i(y_i)\, y_j] = \delta_{ij}$，因而是 $\mathcal{L}$ 的驻点。对源的任意排列也是如此，只需把每个模型与它所提取的源配对。 Here $y_i = d_i s_i$. For $i 
eq j$, independence and $\E[s_j] = 0$ give $\E[\varphi_i(d_i s_i)\, d_j s_j] = \E[\varphi_i(d_i s_i)]\, d_j \E[s_j] = 0$. For $i = j$ the equation is the scale equation. 此时 $y_i = d_i s_i$。对 $i 
eq j$，由独立性与 $\E[s_j] = 0$ 得 $\E[\varphi_i(d_i s_i)\, d_j s_j] = \E[\varphi_i(d_i s_i)]\, d_j \E[s_j] = 0$。对 $i = j$，方程就是尺度方程。 So separation is a stationary point of the likelihood whatever the model, as long as the scale equations can be solved; for a nondegenerate source with finite first absolute moment when $\varphi = 	anh$, or finite nonzero fourth moment when $\varphi(u) = u^3$, they can be solved, because $\E[\varphi(ds)\,ds]$ grows continuously from $0$ to $\infty$ as $d$ increases. This is the basis of quasi-maximum likelihood (Pham & Garat, 1997): a crude source model can yield a locally consistent estimator when the separating root is isolated and stable, the sample criterion converges appropriately, and the algorithm selects that root (see below), and a better model improves its accuracy ( ). What the model does decide is whether this stationary point is a maximum of $\mathcal{L}$, and hence a stable point of gradient ascent. gives the conditions. Apart from a condition on single sources, $1 + \E[\varphi_i'(y_i)\,y_i^2] > 0$, which holds for every model used below, they concern pairs of sources: with $\gamma_i = \E[\varphi_i'(y_i)]\,\E[y_i^2]$ evaluated at the separating point, the pair $(i, j)$ is stable when $\gamma_i > 0$, $\gamma_j > 0$ and $\gamma_i\gamma_j > 1$. Three facts make this concrete. 所以，只要尺度方程有解，无论模型如何，分离解都是似然的驻点；对非退化源，若 $\varphi = 	anh$ 且一阶绝对矩有限，或 $\varphi(u) = u^3$ 且四阶矩有限且非零，尺度方程有解，因为随着 $d$ 增大，$\E[\varphi(ds)\,ds]$ 从 $0$ 连续增长到 $\infty$。这是 拟最大似然 的基础（Pham & Garat, 1997）：若分离根孤立且稳定、样本准则适当收敛，并且算法选中了这个根（见下文），粗糙的源模型也可以给出局部相合估计，更好的模型则提高其精度（ ）。模型真正决定的，是这个驻点是否为 $\mathcal{L}$ 的极大点，从而是否为梯度上升的稳定点。 给出了相应条件。除了一个关于单个源的条件 $1 + \E[\varphi_i'(y_i)\,y_i^2] > 0$（下文用到的每个模型都满足它）之外，其余条件都涉及源对：在分离点处计算 $\gamma_i = \E[\varphi_i'(y_i)]\,\E[y_i^2]$，则当 $\gamma_i > 0$、$\gamma_j > 0$ 且 $\gamma_i\gamma_j > 1$ 时源对 $(i, j)$ 是稳定的。下面三个事实使之具体化。 The true model is stable. With the true score, $\gamma_i = \E[\psi_i'(s_i)]\,\sigma_i^2 = \mathcal{J}_i\sigma_i^2 \ge 1$, with equality only for a Gaussian source ( ). Every pair is stable as long as at most one source is Gaussian. Gaussian sources sit on the boundary. For a Gaussian source, $\gamma_i = 1$ for every model, by Stein's identity $\E[\varphi(y)\,y] = \sigma^2\E[\varphi'(y)]$ ( ). A wrong model can fail. For $\varphi = 	anh$, the score of the hyperbolic secant density, $\gamma \approx 0.76$ for a uniform source and $\gamma \approx 1.41$ for a Laplacian one. collects the contrasts of Part II and the chapters where they are turned into algorithms. They fall into two families: those built on densities (mutual information, likelihood, Infomax, negentropy), which are linked by exact identities, and their moment-based or function-based approximations (kurtosis, cumulants, $G$-functions). Hyvärinen, Karhunen & Oja (2001) give a textbook account of these contrasts and of the algorithms built on them. 汇总了第二部分的对比函数，以及把它们变成算法的章节。它们分为两大类：基于密度的（互信息、似然、Infomax、负熵），彼此由精确恒等式联系；以及它们基于矩或基于函数 $G$ 的近似（峭度、累积量、$G$ 函数）。Hyvärinen, Karhunen & Oja（2001）对这些对比函数以及由此构造的算法有系统的教科书式论述。 Contrast functions for ICA. "Rotations" means that the criterion is optimized over orthogonal $\bU$ after whitening. ICA 的对比函数。“旋转”指在白化之后对正交矩阵 $\bU$ 优化该准则。 Contrast 对比函数 Criterion 准则 Properties 性质 Chapters 章 Mutual information 互信息 $\min\ I(\by) = \sum_i H(y_i) - H(\by)$ exact measure of dependence; minima are the separating matrices (at most one Gaussian); needs marginal densities 相依性的精确度量；最小点即分离矩阵（至多一个高斯源）；需要边缘密度 $4, 6$ Likelihood 似然 $\max\ \sum_i \E\log p_i(y_i) + \log|\det\bW|$ equals $-H(\bx) - I(\by) - \sum_i D(p_{y_i}\|p_i)$; separation is stationary when the scale equations have solutions; local stability requires the score-based pair conditions 等于 $-H(\bx) - I(\by) - \sum_i D(p_{y_i}\|p_i)$；尺度方程有解时分离解是驻点；局部稳定性须满足基于得分函数的配对条件 $6, 7, 10$ Infomax Infomax $\max\ H\bigl(\mathbf{g}(\bW\bx)\bigr)$ maximum likelihood with model densities $g_i'$; logistic $g$ is a super-Gaussian model 以 $g_i'$ 为模型密度的最大似然；logistic 函数对应超高斯模型 $6, 7$ Sum of negentropies 负熵之和 $\max\ \sum_i J(y_i)$ , rotations ，旋转 equals $J(\bz) - I(\by)$; needs marginal densities 等于 $J(\bz) - I(\by)$；需要边缘密度 $6$ Negentropy approximation 负熵近似 $\max\ [\E G(\bw^\top\bz) - \E G(\nu)]^2$ one unit at a time; robust for slowly growing $G$ such as $\log\cosh$ or $-e^{-u^2/2}$ 一次提取一个单元；$G$ 增长缓慢（如 $\log\cosh$ 或 $-e^{-u^2/2}$）时稳健 $6, 8$ Absolute kurtosis 峭度绝对值 $\max\ |\kurt(\bw^\top\bz)|$ no spurious local maxima; sensitive to outliers and heavy tails; blind to zero-kurtosis sources 没有伪局部极大点；对离群值与重尾敏感；看不见峭度为零的源 $5, 8$ Sum of squared kurtoses 峭度平方和 $\max\ \sum_i \kurt(y_i)^2$ , rotations ，旋转 global maxima are the separating rotations if at most one source has zero kurtosis; equivalent to minimizing squared fourth-order cross-cumulants 若至多一个源的峭度为零，全局最大点就是分离旋转；等价于最小化四阶交叉累积量的平方和 $5, 9$

sectionZh: 如何使用似然而不作过度解读
text: Keep the statistical model explicit. A likelihood value is meaningful only with its normalized marginal densities, the change-of-variables term, and the data units. Omitting a density normalizer is harmless only when it is independent of every fitted parameter; this matters when fitting scale or shape parameters. Comparing unmixing matrices by $\sum_i\hat\E\log p_i(y_i)$ alone omits $\log|\det\bW|$ and rewards spurious scale changes. A singular $\bW$ has no square change-of-variables likelihood. 明确统计模型。 似然值必须连同归一化的边缘密度、变量变换项和数据单位一起解释。只有归一化常数与所有待拟合参数无关时才能忽略它，拟合尺度或形状参数时尤其需要注意。只用 $\sum_i\hat\E\log p_i(y_i)$ 比较解混矩阵会漏掉 $\log|\det\bW|$，从而错误奖励尺度变化。$\bW$ 奇异时，方阵变量变换的似然不成立。 Stationarity does not certify independence. Monitor $\|\bI-\hat\E[\bphi(\by)\by^\top]\|_F$, the objective, convergence across starts and residual dependence on held-out data. A small residual can occur at an unwanted stationary point; low correlation checks only second-order structure. For a fixed standard-Gaussian source model and whitened data, every orthogonal rotation has the same likelihood although most rotations still mix non-Gaussian sources. The identity explains the cancellation between dependence and marginal mismatch. 驻点不证明独立性。 同时监测 $\|\bI-\hat\E[\bphi(\by)\by^\top]\|_F$、目标函数、不同初值的收敛结果以及留出数据上的残余依赖。很小的残差也可能对应不需要的驻点；很小的相关系数只检查二阶结构。若源模型固定为标准高斯分布，数据已白化，则所有正交旋转都有相同的似然，但大多数旋转仍然混合着非高斯源。 解释了依赖项与边缘失配项如何相互抵消。 Separate fitting from assessment. Estimate the mean, whitening transform, unmixing matrix and density parameters on training observations, then apply the fixed transformations to held-out observations. Higher held-out likelihood supports predictive fit of that model, not the physical meaning of its components. For dependent observations, use time-block or subject-level splits appropriate to the sampling design. An optimized wrong model can still prefer dependent outputs. 区分拟合与评价。 用训练观测估计均值、白化变换、解混矩阵和密度参数，再将固定变换用于留出观测。较高的留出似然支持模型的预测拟合，并不证明成分具有物理意义。观测之间有依赖时，应根据抽样设计按时间块或被试划分数据。即使一个错误模型被完全优化，它仍可能偏好有依赖的输出。 Distinguish a local expansion from a density. A truncated Gram–Charlier expression or $\phi(1+\eta\tilde G)$ need not stay nonnegative in the tails. The normalization and moment calculations describe a formal local expansion; they do not make the truncated expression a valid probability density for arbitrary coefficients. Likewise, a slowly growing $G$ limits the influence on its sample average at a fixed projection, but empirical centering and covariance whitening can still be strongly affected by outliers. 区分局部展开与概率密度。 截断的 Gram–Charlier 表达式或 $\phi(1+\eta\tilde G)$ 在尾部未必非负。归一化与矩的计算描述的是形式局部展开，并不保证任意系数下的截断式都是有效概率密度。同样，增长较慢的 $G$ 可以限制固定投影下单点对样本平均的影响，但经验中心化与协方差白化仍可能受到离群值的强烈影响。 A score derivative needs regularity. For Laplace sources $\psi(s)=\sqrt2\sign(s)$ and $\mathcal J=2$, but the ordinary derivative of $\psi$ is zero away from the origin. Inserting that derivative into $\E[\psi']=\mathcal J$ would incorrectly give zero: the jump contributes a boundary term, or a delta mass in the distributional derivative. Use nonsmooth estimating-equation theory or a smooth score approximation; do not implement Laplace FastICA by taking sign and setting its derivative to zero. 得分函数的导数需要正则条件。 对拉普拉斯源，$\psi(s)=\sqrt2\sign(s)$，$\mathcal J=2$，但 $\psi$ 的普通导数在原点以外都为零。直接将该导数代入 $\E[\psi']=\mathcal J$ 会错误地得到零：跳跃带来了边界项，也可用分布导数中的 delta 质量表示。应采用非光滑估计方程理论或光滑得分近似，不能简单用 sign 并把其导数设为零来实现拉普拉斯 FastICA。 Key points 本章要点 The change of variables gives the likelihood $\log L(\bW) = \sum_t\sum_i \log p_i(\bw_i^\top\bx(t)) + T\log|\det\bW|$; its stationary points solve the estimating equations $\E[\varphi_i(y_i)y_j] = \delta_{ij}$, with $\varphi_i = -p_i'/p_i$ the model scores. Exactly, $\mathcal{L}(\bW) = -H(\bx) - I(\by) - \sum_i D(p_{y_i}\|p_i)$: maximum likelihood minimizes the dependence of the outputs plus the mismatch of their marginals with the model. For whitened data and rotations, $I(\by) = J(\bz) - \sum_i J(y_i)$: minimizing dependence is maximizing the non-Gaussianity of the outputs. Infomax with squashing functions $g_i$ is maximum likelihood with model densities $g_i'$; the logistic choice is a super-Gaussian model. When the scale equations have solutions and the expectations exist, separation solves the estimating equations after rescaling; only its stability depends on the model, through the conditions $\gamma_i > 0$ and $\gamma_i\gamma_j > 1$ for every pair. The true score is always stable when at most one source is Gaussian, while a fixed sub- or super-Gaussian model can fail, which is why models are switched per output. Negentropy can be approximated by $\frac1{12}\kappa_3^2 + \frac1{48}\kappa_4^2$, which inherits the weaknesses of kurtosis, or by $k_G[\E G(y) - \E G(\nu)]^2$ with $\log\cosh$ or $-e^{-u^2/2}$, which needs weaker moment conditions and sees beyond the fourth moment; the robustness of the full procedure also depends on centering and whitening. 变量替换给出似然 $\log L(\bW) = \sum_t\sum_i \log p_i(\bw_i^\top\bx(t)) + T\log|\det\bW|$；其驻点满足估计方程 $\E[\varphi_i(y_i)y_j] = \delta_{ij}$，其中 $\varphi_i = -p_i'/p_i$ 是模型得分函数。 精确地有 $\mathcal{L}(\bW) = -H(\bx) - I(\by) - \sum_i D(p_{y_i}\|p_i)$：最大似然最小化的是输出的相依性加上其边缘分布与模型的失配。 对白化数据与旋转，$I(\by) = J(\bz) - \sum_i J(y_i)$：最小化相依性就是最大化输出的非高斯性。 以 $g_i$ 为压缩函数的 Infomax 就是以 $g_i'$ 为模型密度的最大似然；logistic 函数对应超高斯模型。 尺度方程有解且有关期望存在时，经过尺度调整后分离解满足估计方程；只有它的稳定性依赖于模型，由条件 $\gamma_i > 0$ 以及对每一对源的 $\gamma_i\gamma_j > 1$ 决定。至多一个源是高斯时，真实得分函数总是稳定的；固定的亚高斯或超高斯模型则可能失败，这就是要为每个输出切换模型的原因。 负熵可以用 $\frac1{12}\kappa_3^2 + \frac1{48}\kappa_4^2$ 近似，它继承了峭度的弱点；也可以用 $k_G[\E G(y) - \E G(\nu)]^2$（取 $\log\cosh$ 或 $-e^{-u^2/2}$）近似，后者只需较弱的矩条件，并能看到四阶矩以外的信息；整个过程的稳健性还取决于中心化与白化。 Before the exercises 开始习题前 Keep density normalization and the determinant together. Separate model fit, stationarity and independence in your explanation. Use approximate negentropy only under its stated conditions. 把密度归一化与行列式项一起保留。 解释结果时区分模型拟合、驻点与独立性。 只在所列条件下使用负熵近似。 Start with the score-functions exercise , then the scale-invariance exercise . Leave the Gram–Charlier and entropy-power proofs for your second pass. 先做 得分函数习题 ，再做 尺度不变性习题 。Gram–Charlier 与熵幂不等式的证明可留到第二遍。

(a) Compute the score of the unit-variance Laplace density $p(u) =  rac{1}{\sqrt2}e^{-\sqrt2|u|}$, and verify $\E[\psi(s)s] = 1$ and $\mathcal{J} = 2$. (b) Show that the score of the logistic density $e^{-u}/(1+e^{-u})^2$ is $	anh(u/2)$ and that the score of $1/(\pi\cosh u)$ is $	anh u$. （a）求单位方差拉普拉斯密度 $p(u) =  rac{1}{\sqrt2}e^{-\sqrt2|u|}$ 的得分函数，并验证 $\E[\psi(s)s] = 1$ 与 $\mathcal{J} = 2$。（b）证明 logistic 密度 $e^{-u}/(1+e^{-u})^2$ 的得分函数为 $	anh(u/2)$，而 $1/(\pi\cosh u)$ 的得分函数为 $	anh u$。 (a) $\log p(u) = - rac12\log 2 - \sqrt2|u|$, so $\psi(u) = \sqrt2\,\sign(u)$ for $u 
eq 0$. The mean absolute value of a Laplace variable equals its scale, here $1/\sqrt2$, so $\E[\psi(s)s] = \sqrt2\,\E|s| = 1$, and $\mathcal{J} = \E[\psi(s)^2] = 2$, which exceeds the Gaussian value $1$. (b) For the logistic density, $\log p(u) = -u - 2\log(1 + e^{-u})$, whose derivative is $-1 + 2e^{-u}/(1 + e^{-u}) = -(1 - e^{-u})/(1 + e^{-u}) = -	anh(u/2)$; hence $\psi(u) = 	anh(u/2)$. For the hyperbolic secant density, $\log p(u) = -\log\pi - \log\cosh u$, whose derivative is $-	anh u$, so $\psi(u) = 	anh u$. Both scores saturate, as befits super-Gaussian densities. （a）$\log p(u) = - rac12\log 2 - \sqrt2|u|$，所以 $u 
eq 0$ 时 $\psi(u) = \sqrt2\,\sign(u)$。拉普拉斯变量的平均绝对值等于其尺度参数，这里为 $1/\sqrt2$，故 $\E[\psi(s)s] = \sqrt2\,\E|s| = 1$，且 $\mathcal{J} = \E[\psi(s)^2] = 2$，大于高斯分布的取值 $1$。（b）对 logistic 密度，$\log p(u) = -u - 2\log(1 + e^{-u})$，其导数为 $-1 + 2e^{-u}/(1 + e^{-u}) = -(1 - e^{-u})/(1 + e^{-u}) = -	anh(u/2)$，因此 $\psi(u) = 	anh(u/2)$。对双曲正割密度，$\log p(u) = -\log\pi - \log\cosh u$，其导数为 $-	anh u$，所以 $\psi(u) = 	anh u$。两个得分函数都是饱和的，这与超高斯密度相符。 Show that $I( D y) = I( y)$ for every invertible diagonal $ D$, whereas $\mathcal{L}( D W)$ depends on $ D$. Show that the condition $\partial\mathcal{L}( D W)/\partial d_i = 0$ at $ D =  I$ is the diagonal estimating equation $\E[\varphi_i(y_i)y_i] = 1$. 证明对任意可逆对角矩阵 $ D$ 都有 $I( D y) = I( y)$，而 $\mathcal{L}( D W)$ 依赖于 $ D$。证明在 $ D =  I$ 处 $\partial\mathcal{L}( D W)/\partial d_i = 0$ 恰好就是对角估计方程 $\E[\varphi_i(y_i)y_i] = 1$。 $H(d_i y_i) = H(y_i) + \log|d_i|$ and $H( D y) = H( y) + \sum_i\log|d_i|$, so the logarithms cancel in $I( D y) = \sum_i H(d_iy_i) - H( D y)$. On the other hand $\mathcal{L}( D W) = \sum_i \E[\log p_i(d_i y_i)] + \log|\det W| + \sum_i \log|d_i|$, which changes with $ D$ unless the $p_i$ have a special form. Its derivative with respect to $d_i$ is $-\E[\varphi_i(d_iy_i)\,y_i] + 1/d_i$, which at $d_i = 1$ vanishes exactly when $\E[\varphi_i(y_i)y_i] = 1$. The diagonal estimating equations therefore only fix the scales of the outputs, the one thing that mutual information ignores; the off-diagonal equations carry the information about independence. $H(d_i y_i) = H(y_i) + \log|d_i|$，$H( D y) = H( y) + \sum_i\log|d_i|$，所以在 $I( D y) = \sum_i H(d_iy_i) - H( D y)$ 中这些对数项相互抵消。另一方面，$\mathcal{L}( D W) = \sum_i \E[\log p_i(d_i y_i)] + \log|\det W| + \sum_i \log|d_i|$，除非 $p_i$ 具有特殊形式，否则它随 $ D$ 变化。它对 $d_i$ 的导数为 $-\E[\varphi_i(d_iy_i)\,y_i] + 1/d_i$，在 $d_i = 1$ 处为零当且仅当 $\E[\varphi_i(y_i)y_i] = 1$。因此对角估计方程只确定输出的尺度，而这恰恰是互信息所不关心的；关于独立性的信息由非对角方程承载。 Let $\gamma = \E[\varphi'(y)]\,\E[y^2]$, evaluated at the scale $y = ds$ that solves the scale equation . (a) For $\varphi(u) = u^3$ and a unit-variance source with kurtosis $\kappa$, show that $\gamma = 3/(3 + \kappa)$. (b) Show that $\gamma = 1$ for a Gaussian source and every differentiable $\varphi$ with $\E|\varphi'(y)| < \infty$, using Stein's identity $\E[\varphi(y)\,y] = \sigma^2\E[\varphi'(y)]$ for $y \sim \Ncal(0, \sigma^2)$, and prove that identity. (c) Show that with the true score, $\gamma = \mathcal{J}\sigma^2 \ge 1$. 令 $\gamma = \E[\varphi'(y)]\,\E[y^2]$，在使尺度方程 成立的尺度 $y = ds$ 处计算。（a）对 $\varphi(u) = u^3$ 与峭度为 $\kappa$ 的单位方差源，证明 $\gamma = 3/(3 + \kappa)$。（b）利用 $y \sim \Ncal(0, \sigma^2)$ 时的 Stein 恒等式 $\E[\varphi(y)\,y] = \sigma^2\E[\varphi'(y)]$，证明对高斯源以及任意满足 $\E|\varphi'(y)| < \infty$ 的可微函数 $\varphi$ 都有 $\gamma = 1$，并证明该恒等式。（c）证明用真实得分函数时 $\gamma = \mathcal{J}\sigma^2 \ge 1$。 (a) The scale equation reads $\E[(ds)^3\, ds] = d^4\E[s^4] = d^4(3 + \kappa) = 1$. Then $\gamma = \E[3(ds)^2]\cdot\E[(ds)^2] = 3d^2 \cdot d^2 = 3d^4 = 3/(3 + \kappa)$: above $1$ for sub-Gaussian and below $1$ for super-Gaussian sources. (b) The Gaussian density $\phi_\sigma$ satisfies $u\,\phi_\sigma(u) = -\sigma^2\phi_\sigma'(u)$, so integrating by parts, $\E[\varphi(y)y] = -\sigma^2\int\varphi\,\phi_\sigma' = \sigma^2\int\varphi'\,\phi_\sigma = \sigma^2\E[\varphi'(y)]$, the boundary terms vanishing because $\phi_\sigma$ decays faster than any polynomial (we also assume $\varphi\,\phi_\sigma 	o 0$ at infinity). At the separating scale $\E[\varphi(y)y] = 1$, hence $\gamma = \E[\varphi'(y)]\,\sigma^2 = \E[\varphi(y)y] = 1$. (c) With the true score $\psi$ of $s$, the scale equation holds at $d = 1$ because $\E[\psi(s)s] = 1$ ( ), and $\E[\psi'(s)] = \E[\psi(s)^2] = \mathcal{J}$. Thus $\gamma = \mathcal{J}\sigma^2$, and the Cauchy–Schwarz inequality $1 = \E[\psi(s)s]^2 \le \mathcal{J}\sigma^2$ gives $\gamma \ge 1$, with equality only for a Gaussian source. （a）尺度方程为 $\E[(ds)^3\, ds] = d^4\E[s^4] = d^4(3 + \kappa) = 1$。于是 $\gamma = \E[3(ds)^2]\cdot\E[(ds)^2] = 3d^2 \cdot d^2 = 3d^4 = 3/(3 + \kappa)$：对亚高斯源大于 $1$，对超高斯源小于 $1$。（b）高斯密度 $\phi_\sigma$ 满足 $u\,\phi_\sigma(u) = -\sigma^2\phi_\sigma'(u)$，分部积分得 $\E[\varphi(y)y] = -\sigma^2\int\varphi\,\phi_\sigma' = \sigma^2\int\varphi'\,\phi_\sigma = \sigma^2\E[\varphi'(y)]$；由于 $\phi_\sigma$ 衰减得比任何多项式都快，边界项为零（这里还假定在无穷远处 $\varphi\,\phi_\sigma 	o 0$）。在分离尺度处 $\E[\varphi(y)y] = 1$，因此 $\gamma = \E[\varphi'(y)]\,\sigma^2 = \E[\varphi(y)y] = 1$。（c）用 $s$ 的真实得分函数 $\psi$ 时，由于 $\E[\psi(s)s] = 1$（ ），尺度方程在 $d = 1$ 处成立，且 $\E[\psi'(s)] = \E[\psi(s)^2] = \mathcal{J}$。于是 $\gamma = \mathcal{J}\sigma^2$，而 Cauchy–Schwarz 不等式 $1 = \E[\psi(s)s]^2 \le \mathcal{J}\sigma^2$ 给出 $\gamma \ge 1$，等号只对高斯源成立。 For $G(u) = -e^{-u^2/2}$, compute $\E G(

u)$ 之间的微小偏差就已意味着可观的负熵。 Let $y$ have zero mean, unit variance, and third and fourth cumulants $\kappa_3, \kappa_4$, and suppose its density is $p = \phi(1 + \varepsilon)$ with $\varepsilon =  rac{\kappa_3}{6}H_3 +  rac{\kappa_4}{24}H_4$, a small correction. (a) Check that $p$ has the stated moments up to order four, using $\int \phi\, H_j H_k = k!\,\delta_{jk}$. (b) Derive from $J(y) = D(p\|\phi)$ by expanding $\log(1 + \varepsilon)$ to second order. 设 $y$ 均值为零、方差为一，三阶与四阶累积量为 $\kappa_3, \kappa_4$，并设其密度为 $p = \phi(1 + \varepsilon)$，其中 $\varepsilon =  rac{\kappa_3}{6}H_3 +  rac{\kappa_4}{24}H_4$ 是小的修正项。（a）利用 $\int \phi\, H_j H_k = k!\,\delta_{jk}$，验证 $p$ 直到四阶的矩与所述相符。（b）由 $J(y) = D(p\|\phi)$ 出发，把 $\log(1 + \varepsilon)$ 展开到二阶，推导 。 (a) The monomials $1, u, u^2$ are combinations of $H_0, H_1, H_2$, which are orthogonal to $H_3$ and $H_4$, so $p$ integrates to one and has the mean $0$ and variance $1$ of $\phi$. Since $u^3 = H_3 + 3H_1$, $\int u^3 p =  rac{\kappa_3}{6}\int\phi H_3^2 =  rac{\kappa_3}{6}\cdot 3! = \kappa_3$; the $H_4$ term contributes nothing by parity. Since $u^4 = H_4 + 6H_2 + 3H_0$, $\int u^4 p = 3 +  rac{\kappa_4}{24}\cdot 4! = 3 + \kappa_4$, so the fourth cumulant is $\kappa_4$. (b) $D(p\|\phi) = \int \phi(1+\varepsilon)\log(1+\varepsilon)$. With $\log(1+\varepsilon) = \varepsilon -  rac12\varepsilon^2 + O(\varepsilon^3)$, we get $(1+\varepsilon)\log(1+\varepsilon) = \varepsilon +  rac12\varepsilon^2 + O(\varepsilon^3)$. The first term integrates to zero against $\phi$ by orthogonality to $H_0$, and by orthogonality of $H_3$ and $H_4$, （a）单项式 $1, u, u^2$ 都是 $H_0, H_1, H_2$ 的线性组合，与 $H_3$、$H_4$ 正交，所以 $p$ 的积分为一，且具有 $\phi$ 的均值 $0$ 与方差 $1$。由 $u^3 = H_3 + 3H_1$，$\int u^3 p =  rac{\kappa_3}{6}\int\phi H_3^2 =  rac{\kappa_3}{6}\cdot 3! = \kappa_3$；由奇偶性，$H_4$ 项没有贡献。由 $u^4 = H_4 + 6H_2 + 3H_0$，$\int u^4 p = 3 +  rac{\kappa_4}{24}\cdot 4! = 3 + \kappa_4$，所以四阶累积量为 $\kappa_4$。（b）$D(p\|\phi) = \int \phi(1+\varepsilon)\log(1+\varepsilon)$。由 $\log(1+\varepsilon) = \varepsilon -  rac12\varepsilon^2 + O(\varepsilon^3)$ 得 $(1+\varepsilon)\log(1+\varepsilon) = \varepsilon +  rac12\varepsilon^2 + O(\varepsilon^3)$。第一项与 $\phi$ 相乘后积分为零（与 $H_0$ 正交）；由 $H_3$ 与 $H_4$ 的正交性， $$J(y) \approx  rac12\int\phi\,\varepsilon^2 =  rac12\Bigl( rac{\kappa_3^2}{36}\cdot 3! +  rac{\kappa_4^2}{576}\cdot 4!\Bigr) =  rac{\kappa_3^2}{12} +  rac{\kappa_4^2}{48}.$$ This is the same result as with $G = u^3$ and $G = u^4$: the normalized Hermite polynomials $H_3/\sqrt{6}$ and $H_4/\sqrt{24}$ are exactly the orthonormalized versions of $u^3$ and $u^4$, and their expectations under $y$ are $\kappa_3/\sqrt6$ and $\kappa_4/\sqrt{24}$. 这与在 中取 $G = u^3$ 与 $G = u^4$ 的结果相同：归一化的 Hermite 多项式 $H_3/\sqrt{6}$ 与 $H_4/\sqrt{24}$ 恰好是 $u^3$ 与 $u^4$ 经正交归一化后的形式，它们在 $y$ 下的期望分别为 $\kappa_3/\sqrt6$ 与 $\kappa_4/\sqrt{24}$。 The entropy power inequality states that for independent random variables $X$ and $Y$ with densities, finite variances and finite differential entropies, $e^{2H(X+Y)} \ge e^{2H(X)} + e^{2H(Y)}$, with equality only if $X$ and $Y$ are Gaussian (Cover & Thomas, 2006). Let $ s$ have independent unit-variance components with densities and finite differential entropies, and let $y =  q^	op s$ with $\| q\| = 1$. Show that $J(y) \le \max_i J(s_i)$, and that if some source is non-Gaussian, equality holds only for $ q = \pm e_i$ with $J(s_i) = \max_j J(s_j)$. 熵幂不等式断言：对具有密度、有限方差和有限微分熵的独立随机变量 $X$ 与 $Y$，$e^{2H(X+Y)} \ge e^{2H(X)} + e^{2H(Y)}$，等号仅当 $X$ 与 $Y$ 都是高斯时成立（Cover & Thomas, 2006）。设 $ s$ 的各分量独立、方差为一、有密度且微分熵有限，令 $y =  q^	op s$，$\| q\| = 1$。证明 $J(y) \le \max_i J(s_i)$；并证明若有某个源非高斯，则等号仅在 $ q = \pm e_i$ 且 $J(s_i) = \max_j J(s_j)$ 时成立。 By induction the inequality extends to finite sums of independent variables, $e^{2H(\sum_i X_i)} \ge \sum_i e^{2H(X_i)}$, with equality only if all $X_i$ are Gaussian. Apply it to $X_i = q_i s_i$ for the indices with $q_i 
eq 0$. Since $H(q_i s_i) = H(s_i) + \log|q_i|$, we have $e^{2H(X_i)} = q_i^2 e^{2H(s_i)}$. The sources $s_i$ and the final projection $y$ have unit variance (the scaled summands $X_i$ generally do not), so $H(\cdot) = h - J(\cdot)$ with $h =  rac12\log(2\pi e)$, and the inequality becomes $e^{-2J(y)} \ge \sum_i q_i^2 e^{-2J(s_i)}$. Since the weights $q_i^2$ sum to one, the right side is at least $e^{-2\max_i J(s_i)}$, hence $J(y) \le \max_i J(s_i)$. If two or more $q_i$ are nonzero, equality would require equality in the entropy power inequality, hence Gaussian $s_i$ for those indices, and then $J(y) = 0$; so if $\max_j J(s_j) > 0$, equality forces $ q = \pm e_i$, and then $J(y) = J(s_i)$ must be the maximum. In whitened coordinates, the global maximum of $J( w^	op z)$ on the sphere is therefore attained exactly at the sources of largest negentropy. The argument says nothing about other local maxima; unlike , it does not rule them out. 由归纳法，该不等式可推广到有限个独立变量之和：$e^{2H(\sum_i X_i)} \ge \sum_i e^{2H(X_i)}$，等号仅当所有 $X_i$ 都是高斯时成立。对满足 $q_i 
eq 0$ 的下标取 $X_i = q_i s_i$。由 $H(q_i s_i) = H(s_i) + \log|q_i|$ 得 $e^{2H(X_i)} = q_i^2 e^{2H(s_i)}$。各源 $s_i$ 与最终投影 $y$ 的方差为一（缩放后的加项 $X_i$ 通常不是），所以 $H(\cdot) = h - J(\cdot)$，其中 $h =  rac12\log(2\pi e)$，不等式变为 $e^{-2J(y)} \ge \sum_i q_i^2 e^{-2J(s_i)}$。由于权重 $q_i^2$ 之和为一，右边至少为 $e^{-2\max_i J(s_i)}$，因此 $J(y) \le \max_i J(s_i)$。若有两个或更多 $q_i$ 非零，取等号就要求熵幂不等式取等号，从而这些下标对应的 $s_i$ 都是高斯的，此时 $J(y) = 0$；所以当 $\max_j J(s_j) > 0$ 时，等号迫使 $ q = \pm e_i$，而此时 $J(y) = J(s_i)$ 必须是最大值。换到白化坐标下，$J( w^	op z)$ 在球面上的全局最大值恰好在负熵最大的源处取得。这一论证对其他局部极大点只字未提；与 不同，它并不排除它们的存在。

zh: 自然梯度、Infomax 与稳定性
text: First pass 第一次读这一章 One sentence. The natural-gradient update uses the current outputs to decide how to adjust the current unmixing matrix, while the step size controls how far it moves. 一句话直觉。 自然梯度根据当前输出，决定怎样调整当前分离矩阵；步长决定这次调整走多远。 By the end, you should be able to: 读完后，你应能： compute one two-channel update from a supplied sample-average matrix; distinguish a small step from a small estimating-equation residual; explain why a stable local solution is not a global convergence guarantee. 从给定的样本平均矩阵算出一次双通道更新； 区分“走了一小步”与“估计方程的残差很小”； 解释为什么局部稳定的解不代表全局收敛保证。 Route. Start with the likelihood and score and the matrix notation . Read the update , step sizes and stopping safeguards . The geometric derivation and stability proof can be second-pass reading; do retain their conditions. 路线。 先看 似然与得分函数 以及 矩阵记号 。先读 更新规则 、 步长 与 停止保护 。几何推导和 稳定性证明 可放到第二遍，但要保留它们的适用条件。 One update by hand. Suppose the current $\bW=\bI$. From a batch, the algorithm has estimated $\bM=\hat\E[\bphi(\by)\by^\top]=\bigl(\begin{smallmatrix}1&0.2\\-0.1&1\end{smallmatrix}\bigr)$. Its entry $M_{ij}$ averages the nonlinearity of output $i$ times output $j$; it is not an ordinary covariance matrix. 手算一次更新。 设当前 $\bW=\bI$。算法从一批数据估计出 $\bM=\hat\E[\bphi(\by)\by^\top]=\bigl(\begin{smallmatrix}1&0.2\\-0.1&1\end{smallmatrix}\bigr)$。其中 $M_{ij}$ 是“输出 $i$ 的非线性函数值乘输出 $j$”的平均，因此它不是普通协方差矩阵。 Compute the correction $\bH=\bI-\bM=\bigl(\begin{smallmatrix}0&-0.2\\0.1&0\end{smallmatrix}\bigr)$. Zero diagonal entries mean that these scale equations already match their targets. Choose $\mu=0.1$. Then $\bW_{\rm new}=(\bI+\mu\bH)\bW=\bigl(\begin{smallmatrix}1&-0.02\\0.01&1\end{smallmatrix}\bigr)$. For a centered observation $\bx=(2,1)^\top$, the new outputs are $(1.98,1.02)^\top$. The update subtracts a little of channel 2 from output 1 and adds a little of channel 1 to output 2. The determinant is $1.0002$, so this particular candidate is invertible. That calculation alone says nothing about independence or likelihood improvement. Recompute the outputs and residual before another update. 先算修正量 $\bH=\bI-\bM=\bigl(\begin{smallmatrix}0&-0.2\\0.1&0\end{smallmatrix}\bigr)$。对角元为零，表示这两个尺度方程已达到各自目标。 选 $\mu=0.1$，则 $\bW_{\rm new}=(\bI+\mu\bH)\bW=\bigl(\begin{smallmatrix}1&-0.02\\0.01&1\end{smallmatrix}\bigr)$。 对已中心化观测 $\bx=(2,1)^\top$，新输出为 $(1.98,1.02)^\top$：从输出 1 中减去一点通道 2，再向输出 2 加入一点通道 1。 行列式为 $1.0002$，因此这一次的候选矩阵可逆。但这个计算本身并不说明已经独立或似然已经提高。下一次更新前，要重新计算输出与残差。 Quick check 1. If $\mu=0$, has an unchanged matrix proved convergence? 自测 1。 若令 $\mu=0$，矩阵不再变化，是否就证明收敛了？ Check the answer 查看答案 No. The update is zero by choice, while $\|\bH\|_F=\sqrt{0.2^2+0.1^2}\approx0.224$ remains nonzero. A small increment must be interpreted alongside the residual. 没有。更新为零是步长选择造成的，而 $\|\bH\|_F=\sqrt{0.2^2+0.1^2}\approx0.224$ 仍不为零。必须结合残差来解释小增量。 Quick check 2. Can this same average matrix be reused indefinitely? 自测 2。 能否一直重复使用刚才这个平均矩阵？ Check the answer 查看答案 No. It was computed from the old outputs. Changing the unmixing changes the outputs, their nonlinearities and the average. Reusing it no longer implements the stated algorithm. 不能。它由旧输出计算而来。分离矩阵变化后，输出、输出的非线性函数值及其平均都会变化；一直复用它就不再是所述算法。

zh: 自然梯度、Infomax 与稳定性
sectionEn: From a contrast to an update rule
sectionZh: 从对比函数到更新规则
text: reduced ICA to an optimization problem: find the unmixing matrix $\bW$ that maximizes the log-likelihood , or to minimize the mutual information of the outputs. These objectives share separating optima under a correct source model, but a fixed misspecified likelihood also contains marginal mismatch and is not generally equivalent to mutual-information minimization. This chapter turns that problem into algorithms that adjust $\bW$ step by step. Three questions run through it. In which direction should $\bW$ move? How does the behaviour of the algorithm depend on the unknown mixing matrix $\bA$? And which solutions are attractors, so that the algorithm actually settles on them? 把 ICA 归结为一个优化问题：寻找使对数似然 最大的解混矩阵 $\bW$，或者使输出的互信息最小。源模型正确时，它们共享分离的最优解；但固定的失配似然还包含边缘失配项，通常不等价于互信息最小化。本章把这个问题变成逐步调整 $\bW$ 的算法。贯穿全章的有三个问题：$\bW$ 应当沿什么方向移动？算法的行为如何依赖于未知的混合矩阵 $\bA$？哪些解是吸引子，也就是说，算法实际会停在哪些解上？ The answers are, in order: along the relative or natural gradient, which needs no matrix inversion; not at all, a property called equivariance ; and the separating solutions attract the algorithm when a simple condition linking the nonlinearity to the source distributions holds, and not when it fails. The same condition explains why the original Infomax algorithm separates typical super-Gaussian sources such as speech but fails on some sub-Gaussian ones, and how the extended version repairs this. 三个答案依次是：沿着 相对梯度 （即 自然梯度 ）的方向移动，这一方向不需要矩阵求逆；完全不依赖，这一性质称为 等变性 ；当非线性函数与源分布之间满足一个简单的条件时，分离解吸引算法，条件不满足时则不然。同一个条件解释了为什么原始的 Infomax 算法能分离语音这类常见的超高斯源，却在某些亚高斯源上失效，以及扩展 Infomax 如何弥补这一缺陷。 Throughout the chapter the model is square ($m = n$, after the PCA reduction of if necessary), $\bA$ is invertible, and the sources are independent with zero mean. The algorithms use model densities $p_i$ that need not be the true ones. Their scores $\varphi_i = -p_i'/p_i$ are the nonlinearities of the algorithm, collected in $\bphi(\by) = (\varphi_1(y_1), \dots, \varphi_n(y_n))^\top$. When the model is right, $\varphi_i$ is the true score $\psi_i$ of . 本章始终假设模型是方阵情形（$m = n$，必要时先做 的 PCA 降维），$\bA$ 可逆，各源相互独立且均值为零。算法使用的是 模型 密度 $p_i$，它不必是真实密度。模型密度的得分函数 $\varphi_i = -p_i'/p_i$ 就是算法中的 非线性函数 ，记作向量 $\bphi(\by) = (\varphi_1(y_1), \dots, \varphi_n(y_n))^\top$。模型正确时，$\varphi_i$ 就是 中的真实得分函数 $\psi_i$。

zh: 自然梯度、Infomax 与稳定性
text:
For one observation, the log-likelihood of $ W$ is $\sum_i \log p_i( w_i^	op x) + \log|\det W|$, where $ w_i^	op$ is the $i$-th row of $ W$. Its expectation 对单个观测，$ W$ 的对数似然为 $\sum_i \log p_i( w_i^	op x) + \log|\det W|$，其中 $ w_i^	op$ 是 $ W$ 的第 $i$ 行。它的期望 $$\ell( W) = \E\Bigl[\sum_{i=1}^n \log p_i(y_i)\Bigr] + \log|\det W|, \qquad  y =  W x,$$ is the objective of this chapter. Batch algorithms replace $\E$ by the sample average $\hat\E$ over $ x(1), \dots,  x(T)$, which turns $\ell$ into $ rac1T\log L( W)$. Since $\partial\log|\det W|/\partial W =  W^{-	op}$ ( ) and $\partial\log p_i( w_i^	op x)/\partial w_i = -\varphi_i(y_i)\, x$, the gradient is 就是本章的目标函数。批量算法把 $\E$ 换成对 $ x(1), \dots,  x(T)$ 的样本平均 $\hat\E$，此时 $\ell$ 就是 $ rac1T\log L( W)$。由 $\partial\log|\det W|/\partial W =  W^{-	op}$（ ）以及 $\partial\log p_i( w_i^	op x)/\partial w_i = -\varphi_i(y_i)\, x$，梯度为 $$
abla\ell( W) =  W^{-	op} - \E igl[ phi( y)\, x^	op igr].$$ Setting the gradient to zero and multiplying on the right by $ W^	op$ gives the estimating equations $\E[ phi( y) y^	op] =  I$, that is, $\E[\varphi_i(y_i)\,y_j] = \delta_{ij}$ for all $i, j$. Every separating matrix satisfies the off-diagonal equations, whatever the nonlinearities: if $y_i$ and $y_j$ are multiples of two different sources, then $\E[\varphi_i(y_i)y_j] = \E[\varphi_i(y_i)]\,\E[y_j] = 0$ by independence and zero means. The diagonal equations only fix the scale of each output. This is the robustness to a wrong source model noted in : the model does not move the separating points. What it decides is whether an algorithm converges to them, the subject of . 令梯度为零并右乘 $ W^	op$，得到估计方程 $\E[ phi( y) y^	op] =  I$，即对所有 $i, j$ 有 $\E[\varphi_i(y_i)\,y_j] = \delta_{ij}$。无论非线性函数取什么，任何分离矩阵都满足其中的非对角方程：若 $y_i$ 与 $y_j$ 分别是两个不同源的倍数，则由独立性与零均值，$\E[\varphi_i(y_i)y_j] = \E[\varphi_i(y_i)]\,\E[y_j] = 0$。对角方程只确定各输出的尺度。这正是 中提到的对源模型设错的稳健性：模型不会移动分离点，它决定的是算法能否收敛到分离点，这是 的主题。 Plain gradient ascent, $ W \leftarrow  W + \mu
abla\ell( W)$ with a step size $\mu > 0$, has two flaws. It needs the inverse $ W^{-	op}$ at every step. More seriously, its behaviour depends on $ A$. Write the update in terms of the global matrix $ P =  W A$, using $ W^{-	op} =  P^{-	op} A^	op$, $ x^	op =  s^	op A^	op$ and $ y =  P s$: 普通的梯度上升 $ W \leftarrow  W + \mu
abla\ell( W)$（步长 $\mu > 0$）有两个缺点。第一，每一步都要计算逆矩阵 $ W^{-	op}$。第二，也是更严重的，它的行为依赖于 $ A$。利用 $ W^{-	op} =  P^{-	op} A^	op$、$ x^	op =  s^	op A^	op$ 和 $ y =  P s$，把更新改写成全局矩阵 $ P =  W A$ 的形式： $$ P \leftarrow  P + \mu igl( P^{-	op} - \E[ phi( y)\, s^	op] igr)\, A^	op A.$$ The fixed matrix $ A^	op A$ acts as a preconditioner chosen by nature. When $ A$ is ill-conditioned, the steps are long in some directions and very short in others, and no single step size suits all of them. Panel (a) of shows the effect: with a condition number of 10, plain gradient ascent hardly moves in 150 iterations. 固定矩阵 $ A^	op A$ 相当于一个由“自然”指定的预条件矩阵。$ A$ 病态时，更新在某些方向上步子很大，在另一些方向上步子极小，没有一个统一的步长能同时适合所有方向。 的（a）图显示了这一效应：条件数为 10 时，普通梯度上升在 150 次迭代中几乎原地不动。

text:
Before the geometry. Read $\Delta W=\mu H W$ as “a small correction in the present output coordinates.” The rightmost $ W$ converts that correction back to a sensor-to-output map. You can use and check this matrix multiplication before studying the right-invariant metric below. 先理解操作，再看几何。 把 $\Delta W=\mu H W$ 读成“在当前输出坐标里作一个小修正”。最右边的 $ W$ 把修正接回从传感器到输出的映射。可以先会算、会核对这个矩阵乘法，再研究下面的右不变度量。 Cardoso and Laheld (1996) perturb $ W$ multiplicatively, $ W 	o ( I +  epsilon) W$ with a small $n 	imes n$ matrix $ epsilon$, so that the outputs change by $ y 	o  y +  epsilon y$. To first order, $\log|\det(( I +  epsilon) W)| = \log|\det W| + 	r epsilon$ and $\log p_i igl(y_i + ( epsilon y)_i igr) = \log p_i(y_i) - \varphi_i(y_i)\sum_j \varepsilon_{ij}y_j$. The matrix $ I - \E[ phi( y) y^	op]$ is the relative gradient ; it depends on $ W$ only through the outputs. A uniform source paired with a Laplace source is still stable, since $0.762 	imes 1.414 \approx 1.08$, but only barely: the smallest eigenvalue of the linearization is $0.038$, against $0.414$ for two Laplace sources, so convergence near the solution is about ten times slower. For $\varphi(y) = y^3$ one finds $\gamma = 3/(3 + \kappa)$ exactly ( ), so the cubic nonlinearity favours sub-Gaussian sources. A finite-difference Jacobian of the mean flow, computed with the same quadrature, reproduces the eigenvalues predicted by to five decimal places in all these cases. 模型设错时，这些条件可能不成立。 列出了三种常用非线性函数下的 $\gamma$ 值，先解 ，再用数值积分算出；所有情形下都有 $1 + m > 1$，所以条件（i）成立。取 $\varphi = 	anh$ 时，一对拉普拉斯源是稳定的（$1.414^2 > 1$），一对均匀源则不稳定（$0.762^2 \approx 0.58$）。均匀源与拉普拉斯源配对时仍然稳定，因为 $0.762 	imes 1.414 \approx 1.08$，但只是勉强稳定：线性化的最小特征值为 $0.038$，而两个拉普拉斯源时为 $0.414$，所以在解附近的收敛要慢约十倍。对 $\varphi(y) = y^3$，可以精确算出 $\gamma = 3/(3 + \kappa)$（ ），所以三次非线性偏向亚高斯源。在上述所有情形中，用同样的数值积分计算的平均流有限差分雅可比矩阵，其特征值与 的预测在小数点后五位一致。 Values of $\gamma = k\sigma^2$ at the normalized scale for unit-variance sources ($\kappa$ is the kurtosis). A pair $i, j$ is stable when $\gamma_i, \gamma_j > 0$ and $\gamma_i\gamma_j > 1$. The Gaussian column equals 1 for every nonlinearity. 归一化尺度下的 $\gamma = k\sigma^2$ 值（源为单位方差，$\kappa$ 为峭度）。当 $\gamma_i, \gamma_j > 0$ 且 $\gamma_i\gamma_j > 1$ 时，源对 $i, j$ 稳定。对任何非线性函数，高斯一列都等于 1。 Nonlinearity 非线性函数 uniform ($\kappa = -1.2$) 均匀（$\kappa = -1.2$） Gaussian 高斯 logistic ($\kappa = 1.2$) logistic（$\kappa = 1.2$） Laplace ($\kappa = 3$) 拉普拉斯（$\kappa = 3$） $\varphi(y) = 	anh(y)$ $0.762$ $1$ $1.134$ $1.414$ $\varphi(y) = 	anh(y/2)$ $0.846$ $1$ $1.097$ $1.269$ $\varphi(y) = y^3$ $1.667$ $1$ $0.714$ $0.500$ The following script implements batch natural-gradient ICA and runs it from $ W_0 =  I$ on two uniform and on two Laplace sources, with $\varphi = 	anh$, with $\varphi(y) = y^3$, and with the extended Infomax rule of . The printed interference is the largest ratio, over the rows of $ P =  W A$, of the second-largest to the largest entry in absolute value; it is 0 for perfect separation and near 1 for an even mixture. 下面的脚本实现了批量自然梯度 ICA，并从 $ W_0 =  I$ 出发，分别在两个均匀源和两个拉普拉斯源上运行，非线性函数依次取 $\varphi = 	anh$、$\varphi(y) = y^3$ 以及 的扩展 Infomax 规则。打印的干扰值是：在 $ P =  W A$ 的各行中，绝对值第二大的元素与最大元素之比的最大值；完全分离时为 0，均匀混合时接近 1。 This controlled demonstration uses a fixed budget of 500 full-batch updates and reports residual mixing; returning a matrix is not a convergence certificate. The extended variant keeps its preceding sign when the switching statistic lies within $10^{-6}$ of zero. For deployment, apply the residual, step-size and failure checks discussed later in this chapter. 这个受控演示固定运行 500 次全批量更新，并报告残余混合；返回矩阵并不构成收敛证明。扩展算法在切换统计量与零的距离不超过 $10^{-6}$ 时保留上一次符号。实际使用时，应实施本章后述的残差、步长与失败检查。 The output is 输出为 exactly the pattern of : $	anh$ fails on the uniform pair and $y^3$ on the Laplace pair, where they converge to points whose outputs are roughly even mixtures of the two sources, while each succeeds on the other pair. The residual interference of about 0.01 for the successful runs is estimation error from the finite sample ( ). (b) shows the same dichotomy as a dynamical statement: started next to the separating point, the mismatched runs move away from it. 这恰好是 所预言的模式：$	anh$ 在均匀源对上失败，$y^3$ 在拉普拉斯源对上失败，它们收敛到的点的输出大致是两个源的均匀混合；而各自在另一对源上都成功。成功运行中约 0.01 的残余干扰是有限样本带来的估计误差（ ）。 （b）以动力学的语言展示了同一个二分现象：从分离点附近出发，不匹配的运行会离开分离点。

zh: 自然梯度、Infomax 与稳定性
text: Bell and Sejnowski (1995) arrived at the same family of algorithms from a different principle. Pass the outputs $y_i = \bw_i^\top\bx$ through the logistic function $g(y) = 1/(1 + e^{-y})$ and choose $\bW$ to maximize the joint entropy of $\bu = (g(y_1), \dots, g(y_n))^\top$, an output-entropy criterion motivated by information transmission with small output noise. For a deterministic continuous invertible map the input–output mutual information is generally infinite; the finite objective here is the output entropy, as explained in . Since $g$ is increasing and $\by = \bW\bx$, the change-of-variables formula and give Bell 与 Sejnowski（1995）从另一个原理出发得到了同一族算法。把输出 $y_i = \bw_i^\top\bx$ 通过 logistic 函数 $g(y) = 1/(1 + e^{-y})$，再选取 $\bW$ 使 $\bu = (g(y_1), \dots, g(y_n))^\top$ 的联合熵最大，这是由小输出噪声下的信息传输所启发的输出熵准则。对确定性连续可逆映射，输入与输出的互信息通常为无穷大；这里的有限目标是输出熵，详见 。由于 $g$ 单调递增且 $\by = \bW\bx$，由变量替换公式和 得 $$H(\bu) = H(\bx) + \log|\det\bW| + \sum_{i=1}^n \E\bigl[\log g'(y_i)\bigr].$$ Up to the constant $H(\bx)$ this is the objective $\ell(\bW)$ of with model densities $p_i = g'$, the logistic density: Infomax is maximum likelihood with a logistic source model (Cardoso, 1997; ). Since $g' = g(1 - g)$, the score of this model is $\varphi(y) = 2g(y) - 1 = \tanh(y/2)$ ( ). Bell and Sejnowski's gradient is $\nabla H(\bu) = \bW^{-\top} + \E[(\mathbf{1} - 2\mathbf{g}(\by))\bx^\top]$, where $\mathbf{1}$ is the vector of ones and $\mathbf{g}$ acts componentwise; this is with $\bphi = 2\mathbf{g} - \mathbf{1}$. They also adapt a bias $\bw_0$ in $\by = \bW\bx + \bw_0$, which we omit for centered data. In practice the algorithm is usually run in its natural-gradient form. 除去常数 $H(\bx)$，这正是 中的目标函数 $\ell(\bW)$，其模型密度为 $p_i = g'$，即 logistic 密度：Infomax 就是以 logistic 分布为源模型的最大似然（Cardoso, 1997； ）。由于 $g' = g(1 - g)$，这一模型的得分函数为 $\varphi(y) = 2g(y) - 1 = \tanh(y/2)$（ ）。Bell 与 Sejnowski 给出的梯度是 $\nabla H(\bu) = \bW^{-\top} + \E[(\mathbf{1} - 2\mathbf{g}(\by))\bx^\top]$，其中 $\mathbf{1}$ 是全 1 向量，$\mathbf{g}$ 逐分量作用；这就是取 $\bphi = 2\mathbf{g} - \mathbf{1}$ 时的 。他们还在 $\by = \bW\bx + \bw_0$ 中自适应调整偏置 $\bw_0$；对已中心化的数据，这里略去偏置。实践中通常使用它的自然梯度形式。 Center the data; optionally whiten them, $\bz = \bV\bx$, so that the iteration starts from an orthogonal global matrix. Set $\bW = \bI$ and choose a step size $\mu$ and a block size $B$ ($B = T$ gives the batch algorithm). For each block of $B$ samples, compute $\by = \bW\bx$ for the block and update $\bW \leftarrow \bW + \mu\bigl(\bI - \hat\E_B[\tanh(\by/2)\,\by^\top]\bigr)\bW$, where $\hat\E_B$ averages over the block. After each pass through the data, reduce $\mu$ if the change of $\bW$ has grown; stop when the change falls below a tolerance. Return $\bW$ (or $\bW\bV$ if the data were whitened). 中心化数据；可以选择先白化 $\bz = \bV\bx$，使迭代从正交的全局矩阵出发。 令 $\bW = \bI$，选取步长 $\mu$ 与块大小 $B$（$B = T$ 即批量算法）。 对每个含 $B$ 个样本的数据块，计算该块的 $\by = \bW\bx$，并更新 $\bW \leftarrow \bW + \mu\bigl(\bI - \hat\E_B[\tanh(\by/2)\,\by^\top]\bigr)\bW$，其中 $\hat\E_B$ 表示块内平均。 每遍历一次数据后，若 $\bW$ 的变化量增大，就减小 $\mu$；当变化量低于容差时停止。 返回 $\bW$（若数据已白化，返回 $\bW\bV$）。 The second row of describes this algorithm. Its separating points are stable for the usual super-Gaussian laws, such as the Laplace and logistic laws, consistent with the success of Infomax on speech and on many EEG and fMRI sources, which tend to be super-Gaussian. The exact criterion is $\gamma_i\gamma_j > 1$, not the sign of the kurtosis: a bimodal law with rare large values can have positive kurtosis and still $\gamma < 1$. A pair of uniform sources, with $0.846^2 \approx 0.72 < 1$, is unstable: Infomax cannot separate two sub-Gaussian sources of this kind, however long it runs. 的第二行描述的正是这个算法。对拉普拉斯、logistic 这类常见的超高斯分布，它的分离点是稳定的，这与 Infomax 在语音以及许多 EEG 和 fMRI 源上的成功相符，因为这些源往往是超高斯的。准确的判据是 $\gamma_i\gamma_j > 1$，而不是峭度的符号：一个带有罕见大值的双峰分布可以峭度为正，却仍有 $\gamma < 1$。一对均匀源满足 $0.846^2 \approx 0.72 < 1$，是不稳定的：无论运行多久，Infomax 都无法分离两个这类亚高斯源。

zh: 自然梯度、Infomax 与稳定性
text: Lee, Girolami and Sejnowski (1999) let each output choose between a super-Gaussian and a sub-Gaussian model. Their update is Lee、Girolami 与 Sejnowski（1999）让每个输出在超高斯模型与亚高斯模型之间自行选择。他们的更新规则是 $$\bW \leftarrow \bW + \mu\bigl(\bI - \E\bigl[\bK\tanh(\by)\,\by^\top + \by\by^\top\bigr]\bigr)\bW, \qquad \bK = \diag(\eta_1, \dots, \eta_n),\quad \eta_i \in \{-1, +1\},$$ that is, $\varphi_i(y) = y + \eta_i\tanh(y)$. With $\eta_i = -1$ this is the score of the symmetric, sub-Gaussian two-Gaussian mixture density $\tfrac12\Ncal(1, 1) + \tfrac12\Ncal(-1, 1)$; with $\eta_i = +1$ it is the score of the super-Gaussian density proportional to $e^{-y^2/2}/\cosh y$. Lee et al. motivate this branch with the density proportional to $p_G(y)\operatorname{sech}^2 y$, where $p_G$ is the standard Gaussian density; the score of that density is $y + 2\tanh y$, and the rule they use, $y + \tanh y$, is the score of the density above. The sign is chosen by the switching rule 也就是 $\varphi_i(y) = y + \eta_i\tanh(y)$。$\eta_i = -1$ 时，它是对称的亚高斯双高斯混合密度 $\tfrac12\Ncal(1, 1) + \tfrac12\Ncal(-1, 1)$ 的得分函数；$\eta_i = +1$ 时，它是与 $e^{-y^2/2}/\cosh y$ 成正比的超高斯密度的得分函数。Lee 等人用正比于 $p_G(y)\operatorname{sech}^2 y$ 的密度（$p_G$ 为标准高斯密度）来说明这一分支，但该密度的得分函数是 $y + 2\tanh y$；他们实际使用的 $y + \tanh y$ 是上述密度的得分函数。符号由 切换规则 决定： $$\eta_i = \sign\Bigl(\E\bigl[\operatorname{sech}^2(y_i)\bigr]\,\E\bigl[y_i^2\bigr] - \E\bigl[\tanh(y_i)\,y_i\bigr]\Bigr),$$ evaluated on the current outputs, in practice on each block or after each pass through the data. The rule is exactly the stability condition of in disguise. 它在当前输出上估计，实践中在每个数据块上或每遍历一次数据后更新。这条规则其实就是 中的稳定性条件换了个样子。 Consider a separating point of , with the sources scaled as in . If every $\eta_i$ is given by evaluated at the separated outputs $y_i = s_i$, and the expression inside the sign is nonzero, then $\gamma_i > 1$ and $1 + m_i > 0$ for every $i$, so the separating point is asymptotically stable. 考虑 的一个分离点，源按 取尺度。若每个 $\eta_i$ 都由在分离输出 $y_i = s_i$ 处计算的 给出，且符号函数内的表达式不为零，则对每个 $i$ 都有 $\gamma_i > 1$ 和 $1 + m_i > 0$，因此该分离点渐近稳定。 With $\varphi_i(y) = y + \eta_i\tanh y$, the normalization reads $\sigma_i^2 + \eta_i\E[\tanh(s_i)s_i] = 1$, and $k_i = 1 + \eta_i\E[\operatorname{sech}^2(s_i)]$. Hence 当 $\varphi_i(y) = y + \eta_i\tanh y$ 时，归一化条件为 $\sigma_i^2 + \eta_i\E[\tanh(s_i)s_i] = 1$，且 $k_i = 1 + \eta_i\E[\operatorname{sech}^2(s_i)]$。因此 $$\gamma_i - 1 = \sigma_i^2 + \eta_i\,\sigma_i^2\,\E[\operatorname{sech}^2(s_i)] - \sigma_i^2 - \eta_i\,\E[\tanh(s_i)s_i] = \eta_i\bigl(\E[\operatorname{sech}^2(s_i)]\,\sigma_i^2 - \E[\tanh(s_i)s_i]\bigr),$$ which is positive when $\eta_i$ is the sign of the bracket. Moreover $m_i = \sigma_i^2 + \eta_i\E[\operatorname{sech}^2(s_i)s_i^2] \ge \sigma_i^2 - \E[\operatorname{sech}^2(s_i)s_i^2] \ge 0$ because $\operatorname{sech}^2 \le 1$, so $1 + m_i \ge 1$. With $\gamma_i > 1$ for all $i$, we get $k_i = \gamma_i/\sigma_i^2 > 0$ and $\gamma_i\gamma_j > 1$, and applies. 当 $\eta_i$ 取括号内表达式的符号时，上式为正。此外，由于 $\operatorname{sech}^2 \le 1$，有 $m_i = \sigma_i^2 + \eta_i\E[\operatorname{sech}^2(s_i)s_i^2] \ge \sigma_i^2 - \E[\operatorname{sech}^2(s_i)s_i^2] \ge 0$，所以 $1 + m_i \ge 1$。所有 $i$ 都有 $\gamma_i > 1$，于是 $k_i = \gamma_i/\sigma_i^2 > 0$ 且 $\gamma_i\gamma_j > 1$，可以应用 。 For a unit-variance uniform source the bracket in equals $-0.126$ and for a unit-variance Laplace source $+0.148$, so the rule picks the sub-Gaussian model for the first and the super-Gaussian model for the second. At the normalized scales the resulting values are $\gamma = 1.273$ (uniform, $\eta = -1$) and $\gamma = 1.084$ (Laplace, $\eta = +1$), both above 1, consistent with the successful extended-Infomax runs in the script of . For a Gaussian source the bracket is zero by Stein's lemma, and the rule has nothing to choose. 对单位方差的均匀源， 中括号内的值为 $-0.126$；对单位方差的拉普拉斯源为 $+0.148$。因此规则为前者选择亚高斯模型，为后者选择超高斯模型。在归一化尺度下，相应的 $\gamma$ 值为 $1.273$（均匀源，$\eta = -1$）和 $1.084$（拉普拉斯源，$\eta = +1$），都大于 1，这与 脚本中扩展 Infomax 的成功运行相符。对高斯源，由 Stein 引理，括号内的值为零，规则无从选择。

zh: 自然梯度、Infomax 与稳定性
sectionEn: Step sizes, online learning and EASI
text: Batch iteration. With a constant step size, is a fixed-point iteration whose linearization at a separating point is $\bepsilon \leftarrow \bepsilon - \mu\,\mathcal{L}(\bepsilon)$, where $\mathcal{L}$ is the linear map of the proof of . Its eigenvalues $\vartheta$ are the numbers $1 + m_i$ and the eigenvalues of the pair matrices in , all real. The error contracts if and only if $|1 - \mu\vartheta| < 1$ for every $\vartheta$, that is, $0 < \mu < 2/\vartheta_{\max}$ when all $\vartheta > 0$. For two Laplace sources and $\varphi = \tanh$ the eigenvalues are $2.414$, $1.214$ (twice) and $0.414$: any $\mu < 0.83$ converges locally, and with $\mu = 0.5$ the slowest mode shrinks by the factor $1 - 0.5 \times 0.414 \approx 0.79$ per iteration. By equivariance these numbers do not depend on $\bA$. 批量迭代。 步长固定时， 是一个不动点迭代，它在分离点处的线性化为 $\bepsilon \leftarrow \bepsilon - \mu\,\mathcal{L}(\bepsilon)$，其中 $\mathcal{L}$ 是 证明中的线性映射。它的特征值 $\vartheta$ 是各个 $1 + m_i$ 以及 中各源对矩阵的特征值，全是实数。误差收缩当且仅当对每个 $\vartheta$ 都有 $|1 - \mu\vartheta| < 1$；当所有 $\vartheta > 0$ 时，即 $0 < \mu < 2/\vartheta_{\max}$。对两个拉普拉斯源和 $\varphi = \tanh$，特征值为 $2.414$、$1.214$（二重）和 $0.414$：任何 $\mu < 0.83$ 都局部收敛；取 $\mu = 0.5$ 时，最慢的模态每次迭代缩小为原来的 $1 - 0.5 \times 0.414 \approx 0.79$ 倍。由等变性，这些数都与 $\bA$ 无关。 Online learning. The online rule updates $\bW$ with one sample, or a small block, at a time. With a constant step size $\bW$ does not converge; it keeps fluctuating around the separating point, with a spread that shrinks as $\mu$ decreases. The mean flow describes the average motion, so the stability conditions of decide which points the online algorithm can hover around. Step sizes that decrease with $\sum_t\mu_t = \infty$ and $\sum_t\mu_t^2 < \infty$, as in stochastic approximation (Robbins & Monro, 1951), control accumulated noise under additional regularity and stability conditions. They do not alone guarantee convergence: bounded iterates, suitable noise moments and a basin of attraction are also needed, and a stable unwanted root can still be reached. Online learning suits data that arrive as a stream or do not fit in memory, and it can track a mixing matrix that drifts slowly; for a fixed data set, batch or block updates are simpler to tune. 在线学习。 在线规则每次只用一个样本（或一个小数据块）更新 $\bW$。步长固定时 $\bW$ 不会收敛，而是在分离点附近持续波动，波动幅度随 $\mu$ 减小而减小。平均流 描述的是平均运动，所以在线算法能在哪些点附近徘徊，同样由 的稳定性条件决定。像随机逼近（Robbins & Monro, 1951）那样取满足 $\sum_t\mu_t = \infty$ 且 $\sum_t\mu_t^2 < \infty$ 的递减步长，在附加的正则性与稳定性条件下可控制累积噪声；仅靠这两个级数条件并不能保证收敛，还需要迭代有界、适当的噪声矩条件与吸引域，并且算法仍可能到达稳定但不需要的根。在线学习适合以数据流形式到达或内存放不下的数据，也能跟踪缓慢漂移的混合矩阵；对于固定的数据集，批量或分块更新更容易调参。 EASI. Cardoso and Laheld (1996) proposed a serial algorithm that whitens and rotates at the same time, so that no separate whitening step is needed: EASI。 Cardoso 与 Laheld（1996）提出了一种同时完成白化与旋转的串行算法，因而不需要单独的白化步骤： $$\bW \leftarrow \bW - \mu_t\bigl[\by\by^\top - \bI + \mathbf{g}(\by)\,\by^\top - \by\,\mathbf{g}(\by)^\top\bigr]\bW, \qquad \by = \bW\bx(t).$$ The symmetric part $\by\by^\top - \bI$ pushes the output covariance toward $\bI$; the skew-symmetric part $\mathbf{g}(\by)\by^\top - \by\,\mathbf{g}(\by)^\top$ leaves the output covariance unchanged to first order when that covariance is $\bI$, and drives the rotation, with equilibrium $\E[g_i(y_i)y_j] = \E[y_ig_j(y_j)]$. The update has the relative form $\bH(\by)\bW$, so EASI is equivariant. Linearizing as in , for unit-variance sources, shows that a separating point is asymptotically stable if 对称部分 $\by\by^\top - \bI$ 把输出协方差推向 $\bI$；反对称部分 $\mathbf{g}(\by)\by^\top - \by\,\mathbf{g}(\by)^\top$ 在输出协方差等于 $\bI$ 时，一阶近似下不改变它，负责驱动旋转，其平衡条件为 $\E[g_i(y_i)y_j] = \E[y_ig_j(y_j)]$。更新具有相对形式 $\bH(\by)\bW$，所以 EASI 是等变的。对单位方差的源，像 那样作线性化可知，分离点在下述条件下渐近稳定： $$\lambda_i + \lambda_j < 0 \quad \text{for all } i \ne j, \qquad \lambda_i = \E\bigl[g_i(s_i)\,s_i - g_i'(s_i)\bigr]$$ and unstable if $\lambda_i + \lambda_j > 0$ for some pair ( ). For $g(y) = y^3$, $\lambda_i = \kappa_i$, so EASI with the cubic nonlinearity separates pairs whose kurtoses sum to a negative number; for $g = \tanh$, $\lambda = -0.148$ for a Laplace source and $+0.126$ for a uniform one. The same quantity $\E[s\,g(s) - g'(s)]$ governs FastICA in the next chapter. 若某一对满足 $\lambda_i + \lambda_j > 0$，则不稳定（ ）。对 $g(y) = y^3$，$\lambda_i = \kappa_i$，所以采用三次非线性的 EASI 能分离峭度之和为负的源对；对 $g = \tanh$，拉普拉斯源的 $\lambda = -0.148$，均匀源的 $\lambda = +0.126$。同一个量 $\E[s\,g(s) - g'(s)]$ 也支配着下一章的 FastICA。

zh: 自然梯度、Infomax 与稳定性
text: An ascent direction does not guarantee an ascent for every finite step. Set $\bH=\bI-\hat\E[\bphi(\by)\by^\top]$, so $\bW_{\rm new}=(\bI+\mu\bH)\bW$. The condition $\mu\|\bH\|_2<1$ is sufficient for invertibility, but not objective improvement. In batch learning with a fixed differentiable source model, backtracking can reduce $\mu$ until the candidate is nonsingular, all values are finite and the sample likelihood increases. Compute $\log|\det\bW|$ with slogdet and $\log\cosh u$ as $|u|+\log(1+e^{-2|u|})-\log2$. Reject a singular or nonfinite candidate. 上升方向不保证任意有限步长都使目标上升。记 $\bH=\bI-\hat\E[\bphi(\by)\by^\top]$，则 $\bW_{\rm new}=(\bI+\mu\bH)\bW$。$\mu\|\bH\|_2<1$ 是可逆性的充分条件，却不保证目标改善。对固定可微源模型的批量学习，可回溯减小 $\mu$，直到候选矩阵非奇异、所有数值有限且样本似然上升。用 slogdet 计算 $\log|\det\bW|$，用 $|u|+\log(1+e^{-2|u|})-\log2$ 计算 $\log\cosh u$。应拒绝奇异或非有限的候选值。 A small increment may indicate stationarity or merely a tiny step size. Record the relative increment $\|\Delta\bW\,\bW^{-1}\|_F=\mu\|\bH\|_F$, the residual $\|\bH\|_F$, objective changes and the iteration limit separately. An estimate returned at the limit must be labelled unconverged. In minibatch learning assess a residual on a larger fixed block because individual updates are noisy. Save the training mean: new data must be transformed as $\bW(\bx_{\rm new}-\bar\bx_{\rm train})$. 增量小可能表示已接近驻点，也可能只是步长过小。应分别记录相对增量 $\|\Delta\bW\,\bW^{-1}\|_F=\mu\|\bH\|_F$、残差 $\|\bH\|_F$、目标变化与迭代次数上限。达到上限后的结果应标明未收敛。小批量学习的单次更新含噪，应在较大的固定数据块上评价残差。还应保存训练均值：新数据的变换为 $\bW(\bx_{\rm new}-\bar\bx_{\rm train})$。 Extended Infomax changes its nonlinearity when a sign switches, so the fixed-objective monotonicity argument cannot be applied automatically. Estimate switching statistics on adequate blocks, use a tolerance near zero and record switches. A Gaussian or nearly Gaussian output gives a zero or uncertain statistic; the theorem asserts local stability for a self-consistent separating point with nonzero switching statistics, not global convergence of a switching algorithm. The sub-Gaussian mixture above is also not genuinely bimodal: its score $y-\tanh y$ is positive for $y>0$, so the density has a single, flat-topped mode at zero. 扩展 Infomax 在符号切换时改变非线性函数，不能自动套用固定目标的单调性论证。应在足够大的数据块上估计切换统计量，在零附近设置容差并记录切换。高斯或近高斯输出会给出为零或难以确定的统计量；定理保证的是切换统计量非零、符号自洽的分离点附近的局部稳定性，不是整个切换算法的全局收敛。上面的亚高斯混合密度也并非真正双峰：对 $y>0$，其得分 $y-\tanh y$ 为正，因此密度在零处只有一个平顶峰。 The right-invariant metric used in the derivation is a chosen geometry on invertible matrices. It does not mean that the full statistical Fisher information is the identity: the source-dependent Fisher blocks appear in . Also, centering and fitting a bias are distinct operations. For $\by=\bW\bx+\mathbf b$, a stationary fitted bias requires $\E[\bphi(\by)]=\bzero$; $\E[\bx]=\bzero$ alone does not imply this for skewed sources and a mismatched symmetric density. The centered, bias-free model used in this chapter is an explicit modeling choice. 推导中的右不变度量是可逆矩阵空间上的一种几何选择，并不表示完整的统计 Fisher 信息等于单位阵；依赖源分布的 Fisher 分块见 。此外，中心化与拟合偏置是两种不同操作。对 $\by=\bW\bx+\mathbf b$，偏置的驻点条件是 $\E[\bphi(\by)]=\bzero$；对偏斜源和失配的对称密度，$\E[\bx]=\bzero$ 本身不推出这一条件。本章采用已中心化、无偏置的模型，是明确的建模选择。 Key points 本章要点 The relative or natural gradient $(\bI - \E[\bphi(\by)\by^\top])\bW$ is the ordinary gradient multiplied on the right by $\bW^\top\bW$. It is the steepest-ascent direction for the metric $\|d\bW\,\bW^{-1}\|_F$ and needs no matrix inversion. Natural-gradient algorithms are equivariant: in terms of the global matrix $\bP = \bW\bA$ they do not depend on $\bA$, so their exact relative iterations agree under corresponding transformed initializations; finite-precision conditioning and the choice of initialization still matter. When the scalar scale equations are solvable and the expectations exist, separating points solve the estimating equations; whether they attract the algorithm depends on $k_i$, $m_i$ and $\sigma_i^2$ through conditions on single sources and pairs. With the true scores they always hold when at most one source is Gaussian. Infomax is maximum likelihood with a logistic source model, $\varphi(y) = \tanh(y/2)$; its separating points are stable for typical super-Gaussian sources (Laplace, logistic) but not, for example, for a pair of uniform sources. Extended Infomax switches each output between a super- and a sub-Gaussian model by a rule that is the stability condition itself. Batch iterations converge locally for $0 < \mu < 2/\vartheta_{\max}$, where $\vartheta_{\max}$ is the largest eigenvalue of the linearization; online updates need decreasing step sizes to settle. EASI whitens and separates in one equivariant serial update and is stable when $\lambda_i + \lambda_j < 0$ for all pairs. 相对梯度（自然梯度）$(\bI - \E[\bphi(\by)\by^\top])\bW$ 就是普通梯度右乘 $\bW^\top\bW$。它是度量 $\|d\bW\,\bW^{-1}\|_F$ 下的最速上升方向，不需要矩阵求逆。 自然梯度算法是等变的：用全局矩阵 $\bP = \bW\bA$ 表示时它们与 $\bA$ 无关，在相应变换的初值下，其精确相对迭代一致；有限精度下的条件数与初值选择仍然重要。 当标量尺度方程可解且期望存在时，分离点满足估计方程；它们能否吸引算法，取决于 $k_i$、$m_i$ 和 $\sigma_i^2$，条件只涉及单个源和源对。使用真实得分函数时，只要至多一个源是高斯的，这些条件总成立。 Infomax 是以 logistic 分布为源模型的最大似然，$\varphi(y) = \tanh(y/2)$；它的分离点对常见的超高斯源（拉普拉斯、logistic）是稳定的，但对一对均匀源等情形则不稳定。扩展 Infomax 按一条规则让每个输出在超高斯与亚高斯模型之间切换，而这条规则正是稳定性条件本身。 批量迭代在 $0 < \mu < 2/\vartheta_{\max}$ 时局部收敛（$\vartheta_{\max}$ 为线性化的最大特征值）；在线更新需要递减步长才能稳定下来。EASI 用一个等变的串行更新同时完成白化与分离，当所有源对满足 $\lambda_i + \lambda_j < 0$ 时稳定。 Before the exercises 开始习题前 Form the nonlinear average, subtract it from identity, then apply the relative update. Monitor the residual as well as the parameter increment. Check source-model choice and step size before trusting a stopping signal. 先计算非线性平均，再用单位阵减去它，最后作相对更新。 同时监测残差与参数增量。 相信停止信号前，先检查源模型选择与步长。 Start with the logistic-score exercise , then parts (a) and (b) of the gradient exercise . Return to the cubic stability and EASI exercises after the local-stability section. 先做 logistic 得分习题 ，再做 梯度习题的（a）（b） ；读完局部稳定性一节后，再回到三次非线性稳定性与 EASI 习题。

First pass 第一次读这一章 One sentence. FastICA repeatedly proposes a better projection direction and restores its length, using non-Gaussian structure that whitening leaves unresolved. 一句话直觉。 FastICA 反复提出一个更合适的投影方向，再把长度归一化；它利用的是白化之后仍然留下的非高斯结构。 By the end, you should be able to: 读完后，你应能： calculate one cubic update and its normalization; explain why opposite signs can represent the same recovered component; identify a zero or rank-deficient update instead of silently normalizing it. 算出一次三次非线性更新，并完成归一化； 解释为什么相反符号可以表示同一个恢复成分； 识别零更新或秩亏更新，而不是不加检查地归一化。 Route. Review the whitened model and kurtosis of a mixture . Read the update rule , multiple components and diagnostics . First understand the iteration; the approximate-Newton derivation and convergence proof can follow later. The code guide explains how to reproduce the example. 路线。 先复习 白化后的模型 与 混合的峭度 。先读 更新规则 、 多个成分 及 诊断 。先理解迭代操作，近似牛顿法推导和 收敛证明 可以稍后读。 代码指南 说明怎样复现实例。 Small calculation: a direction becomes less mixed. Consider independent unit-variance sources with kurtoses $\kappa_1=-2$ and $\kappa_2=3$, such as a symmetric binary source and a Laplace source. In source coordinates, the unit vector $\bq=(0.6,0.8)^\top$ makes $y=0.6s_1+0.8s_2$. These coordinates are for analysis: real data do not reveal the sources to the algorithm. 手算：一个方向怎样变得混合更少？ 考虑两个相互独立、单位方差的源，峭度分别为 $\kappa_1=-2$ 与 $\kappa_2=3$，例如对称二值源和拉普拉斯源。在源坐标中，单位向量 $\bq=(0.6,0.8)^\top$ 给出 $y=0.6s_1+0.8s_2$。这只是分析坐标；真实数据不会把源直接告诉算法。 For the cubic choice $g(u)=u^3$, the exact population update has coordinates $q_i^+=\kappa_i q_i^3$. Thus $\bq^+=(-2\cdot0.6^3,3\cdot0.8^3)^\top=(-0.432,1.536)^\top$. Its length is about $1.596$. Divide both entries by that length to obtain approximately $(-0.271,0.963)^\top$; normalization keeps the search on the unit sphere. The absolute unwanted-to-target coefficient ratio falls from $0.6/0.8=0.75$ to $0.432/1.536=0.28125$. The projection is closer to source 2, even though the first coefficient changed sign. This exact calculation uses independence, whitening and population moments. Replacing expectations by sample averages introduces error; the local convergence theorem is not a promise for every data set or starting direction. 取三次非线性 $g(u)=u^3$ 时，精确总体更新为 $q_i^+=\kappa_i q_i^3$，所以 $\bq^+=(-2\cdot0.6^3,3\cdot0.8^3)^\top=(-0.432,1.536)^\top$。 它的长度约为 $1.596$。两项一起除以这个长度，得到约 $(-0.271,0.963)^\top$；归一化让搜索始终留在单位球面上。 非目标与目标系数的绝对比值，从 $0.6/0.8=0.75$ 降到 $0.432/1.536=0.28125$。虽然第一项变了符号，投影仍然更接近源 2。 这个精确计算使用了独立性、白化和总体矩。用样本平均代替期望会引入误差；局部收敛定理不是对任意数据集或初始方向的保证。 Quick check 1. If a new iterate is exactly $-\bw$, is it a different component? 自测 1。 若新迭代恰好等于 $-\bw$，它是不是另一个成分？ Check the answer 查看答案 No. Its output is only the sign-reversed version of the old output. ICA cannot identify source signs, so the stopping comparison must allow this equivalence. 不是。它的输出只是原输出反号。ICA 无法辨识源的符号，所以停止比较必须允许这种等价性。 Quick check 2. If both kurtoses are zero, can this cubic update be normalized? Does that prove both sources Gaussian? 自测 2。 若两个峭度都为零，这个三次更新能否归一化？是否由此证明两个源都高斯？ Check the answer 查看答案 The raw population update is zero, so normalization is undefined. Zero kurtosis does not prove Gaussianity; a different contrast may detect non-Gaussian structure missed by this one. 总体原始更新为零，无法定义归一化。零峭度不能证明高斯性；其他对比函数可能察觉这个对比函数漏掉的非高斯结构。

The gradient algorithms of need a step size, and near a solution they converge only linearly, at a rate set by the smallest eigenvalue of their linearization. FastICA (Hyvärinen & Oja, 1997; Hyvärinen, 1999) takes another route. It works on whitened data, estimates one direction at a time on the unit sphere, and replaces the gradient step by a fixed-point iteration obtained from Newton's method. The result has no step size, has local quadratic or even cubic convergence in the population model, and can need only a few iterations on well-conditioned examples. This is not a global or finite-sample iteration guarantee. This chapter derives the iteration, proves its convergence in source coordinates, builds the versions that estimate several components, and discusses the choice of nonlinearity. 中的梯度算法需要选择步长，而且在解附近只是线性收敛，收敛速度由线性化的最小特征值决定。FastICA（Hyvärinen & Oja, 1997; Hyvärinen, 1999）走的是另一条路：它在白化数据上工作，在单位球面上一次估计一个方向，并用由牛顿法导出的不动点迭代代替梯度步。这样得到的算法没有步长，在总体模型下局部二次甚至三次收敛，在条件良好的例子中只需少数几次迭代；这不是全局或有限样本的迭代次数保证。本章推导这一迭代，在源坐标下证明其收敛性，构造同时估计多个成分的版本，并讨论非线性函数的选择。 The setting is that of : the data are whitened, $\bz = \bV\bx = \tilde\bA\bs$ with $\tilde\bA$ orthogonal ( ), and the sources have zero mean and unit variance. A one-unit method looks for a unit vector $\bw$ such that $y = \bw^\top\bz$ is one of the sources. In source coordinates, $\bq = \tilde\bA^\top\bw$ is again a unit vector and $y = \bq^\top\bs$; the direction $\bw$ recovers source $i$ exactly when $\bq = \pm\be_i$, where $\be_i$ is the $i$-th standard basis vector. 问题的设定与 相同：数据已经白化，$\bz = \bV\bx = \tilde\bA\bs$，其中 $\tilde\bA$ 是正交矩阵（ ），源均值为零、方差为一。单单元方法寻找一个单位向量 $\bw$，使 $y = \bw^\top\bz$ 恰好是某一个源。在源坐标下，$\bq = \tilde\bA^\top\bw$ 仍是单位向量，且 $y = \bq^\top\bs$；方向 $\bw$ 恢复出源 $i$，当且仅当 $\bq = \pm\be_i$，这里 $\be_i$ 是第 $i$ 个标准基向量。

sectionEn: Derivation as an approximate Newton method
sectionZh: 作为近似牛顿法的推导
text: Reading the two terms. $\E[\bz g(y)]$ points toward directions emphasized by the nonlinearity. The subtracted multiple of $\bw$ accounts for the unit-length constraint and the approximate curvature. The result is a proposed direction, not yet a unit vector; normalization is a separate essential step. 怎样读更新中的两项。 $\E[\bz g(y)]$ 指向被非线性函数强调的方向；减去 $\bw$ 的一个倍数，是为了处理单位长度约束与近似曲率。算出的只是候选方向，还不是单位向量；归一化是另一个不可省略的步骤。 The optima of $\E\,G(\bw^\top\bz)$ under $\|\bw\|^2 = 1$ satisfy the Lagrange condition $\E\,G(\bw^\top\bz)$ 在约束 $\|\bw\|^2 = 1$ 下的最优点满足 Lagrange 条件 $$F(\bw) = \E\bigl[\bz\,g(\bw^\top\bz)\bigr] - \beta\,\bw = \bzero, \qquad \beta = \E\bigl[\bw_\star^\top\bz\;g(\bw_\star^\top\bz)\bigr],$$ where $\bw_\star$ is the optimum and the value of the multiplier $\beta$ follows by multiplying the condition by $\bw_\star^\top$. Newton's method for needs the Jacobian $\E[\bz\bz^\top g'(\bw^\top\bz)] - \beta\bI$. Its first term is the expensive part, and the whiteness of $\bz$ suggests the approximation 其中 $\bw_\star$ 是最优点，乘子 $\beta$ 的值可由条件两边左乘 $\bw_\star^\top$ 得到。对 用牛顿法，需要雅可比矩阵 $\E[\bz\bz^\top g'(\bw^\top\bz)] - \beta\bI$。其中第一项计算代价最大，而 $\bz$ 是白的这一事实提示我们作近似 $$\E\bigl[\bz\bz^\top g'(\bw^\top\bz)\bigr] \approx \E\bigl[\bz\bz^\top\bigr]\,\E\bigl[g'(\bw^\top\bz)\bigr] = \E\bigl[g'(\bw^\top\bz)\bigr]\,\bI,$$ which ignores the dependence between $\bz\bz^\top$ and $g'(\bw^\top\bz)$. At a source direction it is nevertheless exact in every direction orthogonal to $\bw$ and wrong only along $\bw$ itself, which the normalization takes care of ( ). With a diagonal Jacobian the Newton step is 这一近似忽略了 $\bz\bz^\top$ 与 $g'(\bw^\top\bz)$ 之间的相依性。尽管如此，在源方向上，它在与 $\bw$ 正交的所有方向上都是精确的，只在 $\bw$ 本身的方向上有误差，而这个方向由归一化处理（ ）。雅可比矩阵变成对角阵后，牛顿步为 $$\bw^+ = \bw - \frac{\E[\bz\,g(\bw^\top\bz)] - \beta\bw}{\E[g'(\bw^\top\bz)] - \beta}.$$ Multiplying by the scalar $\beta - \E[g'(\bw^\top\bz)]$ changes only the length and possibly the sign of $\bw^+$, both of which the subsequent normalization ignores up to sign. The $\beta$ terms then cancel and we obtain the FastICA update 两边乘以标量 $\beta - \E[g'(\bw^\top\bz)]$，只改变 $\bw^+$ 的长度以及可能改变其符号，而随后的归一化在相差符号的意义下忽略这两者。这样 $\beta$ 项相互抵消，得到 FastICA 的更新规则 $$\bw^+ = \E\bigl[\bz\,g(\bw^\top\bz)\bigr] - \E\bigl[g'(\bw^\top\bz)\bigr]\,\bw, \qquad \bw \leftarrow \bw^+/\|\bw^+\|.$$ There is no step size and no $\beta$ to estimate. Deflation excludes directions already found; symmetric orthogonalization adjusts all rows together. Orthogonality prevents duplication in the whitened geometry, but by itself does not certify statistical independence. 从一个成分到多个成分。 重复一次有效的单成分搜索，可能反复找到同一个源。逐个提取会排除已找到的方向；对称正交化则同时调整所有行。白化坐标中的正交性可以避免方向重复，但它本身不证明统计独立。 Running the one-unit algorithm $n$ times from random starts would often find the same source several times. Since the columns of $\tilde\bA$ are orthonormal, the rows $\bw_i^\top$ of the orthogonal unmixing matrix $\bU$ must be orthonormal too, and FastICA enforces this in one of two ways.
