Estimate the vectors one after another. While iterating for $\bw_p$, follow each update by a Gram–Schmidt step against the vectors already found, $\bw_p \leftarrow \bw_p - \sum_{j < p}(\bw_p^\top\bw_j)\,\bw_j$, and then normalize. If $\bw_1, \dots, \bw_{p-1}$ were exact source directions, the remaining sources would span exactly the orthogonal complement, and the iteration there is again a one-unit problem with fewer sources, so applies. With estimated vectors, however, each error tilts the subspace in which all later vectors must lie, so errors accumulate along the sequence; the last vector has no freedom left at all, being the unit vector orthogonal to the others. The order in which sources come out depends on the starting points and the contrast, not on any property chosen by the user. 逐个提取（紧缩）。 依次估计各个向量。在迭代求 $\bw_p$ 时，每次更新之后都对已经求得的向量做一次 Gram–Schmidt 正交化，$\bw_p \leftarrow \bw_p - \sum_{j < p}(\bw_p^\top\bw_j)\,\bw_j$，然后归一化。如果 $\bw_1, \dots, \bw_{p-1}$ 恰好是源方向，其余的源正好张成其正交补空间，在这个子空间里的迭代又是一个源更少的单单元问题，于是 适用。但对估计得到的向量，每个误差都会使后续向量所在的子空间发生倾斜，误差沿着序列不断累积；最后一个向量则完全没有自由度，只能是与其他向量都正交的那个单位向量。源被提取出来的顺序取决于起点和对比函数，而不是由用户指定的某种性质。 Symmetric orthogonalization. Update all $n$ vectors in parallel with , stack them as the rows of $\bW$, and replace $\bW$ by the orthogonal matrix 对称正交化。 用 并行地更新全部 $n$ 个向量，把它们作为 $\bW$ 的各行，再把 $\bW$ 替换为正交矩阵 $$\bW \leftarrow (\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\,\bW.$$ Let $\bW$ be invertible with singular value decomposition $\bW = \mathbf{L}\bSigma\bR^\top$. Then $(\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\bW = \mathbf{L}\bR^\top$. This matrix is orthogonal, it is the orthogonal matrix closest to $\bW$ in Frobenius norm (the polar factor of $\bW$; , ), and it treats all rows alike: for every permutation matrix $\bPi$, the result for $\bPi\bW$ is $\bPi$ times the result for $\bW$. 设 $\bW$ 可逆，其奇异值分解为 $\bW = \mathbf{L}\bSigma\bR^\top$。则 $(\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\bW = \mathbf{L}\bR^\top$。这个矩阵是正交的，是在 Frobenius 范数下离 $\bW$ 最近的正交矩阵（即 $\bW$ 的极分解因子；见 与 ），并且对各行一视同仁：对任意置换矩阵 $\bPi$，$\bPi\bW$ 的结果等于 $\bPi$ 乘以 $\bW$ 的结果。 $\bW\bW^\top = \mathbf{L}\bSigma^2\mathbf{L}^\top$, so $(\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2} = \mathbf{L}\bSigma^{-1}\mathbf{L}^\top$ and $(\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\bW = \mathbf{L}\bSigma^{-1}\mathbf{L}^\top\mathbf{L}\bSigma\bR^\top = \mathbf{L}\bR^\top$, a product of orthogonal matrices. For the last claim, $(\bPi\bW\bW^\top\bPi^\top)^{-1/2} = \bPi(\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\bPi^\top$, since $\bPi\bM^{-1/2}\bPi^\top$ is a symmetric positive definite square root of $(\bPi\bM\bPi^\top)^{-1}$; multiplying by $\bPi\bW$ gives $\bPi(\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\bW$. $\bW\bW^\top = \mathbf{L}\bSigma^2\mathbf{L}^\top$，所以 $(\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2} = \mathbf{L}\bSigma^{-1}\mathbf{L}^\top$，从而 $(\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\bW = \mathbf{L}\bSigma^{-1}\mathbf{L}^\top\mathbf{L}\bSigma\bR^\top = \mathbf{L}\bR^\top$，它是正交矩阵的乘积。对最后一个结论，由于 $\bPi\bM^{-1/2}\bPi^\top$ 是 $(\bPi\bM\bPi^\top)^{-1}$ 的对称正定平方根，有 $(\bPi\bW\bW^\top\bPi^\top)^{-1/2} = \bPi(\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\bPi^\top$；再乘以 $\bPi\bW$ 即得 $\bPi(\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\bW$。 Gram–Schmidt, by contrast, depends on the order of the rows ( ). The symmetric version estimates all components at once, so errors are not passed along a sequence, and the cost per iteration is that of $n$ one-unit updates plus one $n \times n$ eigendecomposition. If an inverse square root is undesirable, the iteration $\bW \leftarrow \tfrac32\bW - \tfrac12\bW\bW^\top\bW$ (Hyvärinen, 1999), started after dividing $\bW$ by $\|\bW\|_F$, converges quadratically to the same matrix ( ). 与之相比，Gram–Schmidt 正交化的结果依赖于各行的顺序（ ）。对称版本同时估计所有成分，误差不会沿着一个序列向后传递，每次迭代的代价是 $n$ 次单单元更新再加一次 $n \times n$ 的特征分解。如果不想计算逆平方根，可以先把 $\bW$ 除以 $\|\bW\|_F$，再迭代 $\bW \leftarrow \tfrac32\bW - \tfrac12\bW\bW^\top\bW$（Hyvärinen, 1999），它二次收敛到同一个矩阵（ ）。 Center and whiten the data, $\bz(t) = \bV\bx(t)$. Choose $G$ and a random $n \times n$ matrix $\bW$; orthogonalize it with . For every row, $\bw_i^+ = \hat\E[\bz\,g(\bw_i^\top\bz)] - \hat\E[g'(\bw_i^\top\bz)]\,\bw_i$; let $\bW^+$ have rows $\bw_i^{+\top}$. Set $\bW_{\text{new}} = (\bW^+\bW^{+\top})^{-1/2}\bW^+$. If $1 - \min_i|\bw_{i,\text{new}}^\top\bw_i|$ is below a tolerance, stop with $\bW = \bW_{\text{new}}$; otherwise set $\bW = \bW_{\text{new}}$ and return to step 3. Output the estimated sources $\by(t) = \bW\bz(t)$ and the unmixing matrix $\bW\bV$. 中心化并白化数据，$\bz(t) = \bV\bx(t)$。 选取 $G$ 和一个随机的 $n \times n$ 矩阵 $\bW$，并用 把它正交化。 对每一行计算 $\bw_i^+ = \hat\E[\bz\,g(\bw_i^\top\bz)] - \hat\E[g'(\bw_i^\top\bz)]\,\bw_i$；令 $\bW^+$ 的各行为 $\bw_i^{+\top}$。 令 $\bW_{\text{new}} = (\bW^+\bW^{+\top})^{-1/2}\bW^+$。 若 $1 - \min_i|\bw_{i,\text{new}}^\top\bw_i|$ 小于容差则以 $\bW = \bW_{\text{new}}$ 停止；否则令 $\bW = \bW_{\text{new}}$，回到第 3 步。 输出估计的源 $\by(t) = \bW\bz(t)$ 以及解混矩阵 $\bW\bV$。 The script below is a complete implementation, applied to four sources of different types: uniform, Laplace, binary $\pm1$ and Student-$t$ with 5 degrees of freedom, all with unit variance. 下面的脚本是一个完整的实现，用于四个不同类型的源：均匀分布、拉普拉斯分布、取值 $\pm1$ 的二值分布，以及自由度为 5 的 Student-$t$ 分布，全部为单位方差。 It prints 它的输出为 Seven iterations suffice, and the global matrix, with each row scaled by its largest entry, is a signed permutation up to off-diagonal entries of about 0.01–0.02, the estimation error for $T = 10000$. The same nonlinearity $\tanh$ has found the sub-Gaussian uniform and binary sources as well as the two super-Gaussian ones. (b) shows that the other two nonlinearities converge just as fast on these data. The convergence of symmetric FastICA, in which the units are coupled through the orthogonalization, has been analysed by Oja and Yuan (2006). In a population check with exact expectations and the kurtosis nonlinearity, the distance to the nearest signed permutation fell from $0.10$ to $2.6 \times 10^{-4}$ to $4.3 \times 10^{-12}$, again a cubic pattern. 七次迭代就足够了。把全局矩阵的每一行除以该行绝对值最大的元素后，它是一个带符号的置换矩阵，非对角元只有约 0.01–0.02，这是 $T = 10000$ 时的估计误差。同一个非线性函数 $\tanh$ 既找到了亚高斯的均匀源和二值源，也找到了两个超高斯源。 （b）表明，另两种非线性函数在这组数据上收敛得同样快。对称 FastICA 中各单元通过正交化相互耦合，其收敛性已由 Oja 与 Yuan（2006）分析过。在一个用精确期望、取峭度非线性的总体检验中，到最近的带符号置换矩阵的距离从 $0.10$ 降到 $2.6 \times 10^{-4}$，再降到 $4.3 \times 10^{-12}$，同样呈现三次收敛的模式。

Robustness. Each observation enters through $\bz\,g(\bw^\top\bz)$. The cubic $g$ amplifies large projections; bounded $g$, such as $\tanh$ or $u e^{-u^2/2}$, reduces that amplification. It does not bound the whole vector contribution: an observation can have a moderate projection but arbitrarily large coordinates orthogonal to $\bw$. Moreover, ordinary sample-mean centering and covariance whitening are themselves sensitive to outliers. Hyvärinen (1999, Theorem 3) explicitly assumes robust whitening and obtains a restricted influence bound, not a globally bounded influence function. Diagnose contamination in the full observation space and in preprocessing; changing $g$ alone does not make the complete pipeline robust. 稳健性。 每个观测通过 $\bz\,g(\bw^\top\bz)$ 进入更新。三次函数 $g$ 会放大大的投影值；$\tanh$ 或 $u e^{-u^2/2}$ 这样的有界 $g$ 可以减弱这种放大，但不能限制整个向量的贡献：一个观测的投影可以适中，而与 $\bw$ 正交的坐标任意大。此外，普通样本均值中心化和协方差白化本身也对离群值敏感。Hyvärinen（1999）的定理 3 明确假定采用稳健白化，并只给出受限的影响界，而不是全局有界的影响函数。因此应在完整观测空间和预处理中诊断污染；只替换 $g$ 并不能使整条分析流程都稳健。 Accuracy. The asymptotic variance of the one-unit estimator ( ) has $\lambda_i^2 = (\E[s_i\,g(s_i) - g'(s_i)])^2$ in its denominator. A source with $\lambda_i$ close to zero for the chosen $g$ is estimated poorly and, with finite data, found slowly or not at all; a non-Gaussian source can even have $\lambda_i = 0$ for one particular $g$ (a source with zero kurtosis is invisible to $g(u) = u^3$), and then another $g$ must be used. The variance is smallest when $g$ is a linear combination of the source score and the identity function (with an arbitrary added constant if sample centering is used) ( ). Since one fixed $g$ cannot be optimal for sources of different types, the EFICA algorithm of Koldovský, Tichavský and Oja (2006) adapts the nonlinearity to each component after a symmetric FastICA run; returns to it. 精度。 单单元估计量的渐近方差（ ）的分母中含有 $\lambda_i^2 = (\E[s_i\,g(s_i) - g'(s_i)])^2$。对所选的 $g$，若某个源的 $\lambda_i$ 接近零，它的估计就很差，在有限数据下找到它也很慢，甚至找不到；一个非高斯源对某个特定的 $g$ 甚至可能恰好有 $\lambda_i = 0$（峭度为零的源对 $g(u) = u^3$ 不可见），这时必须换用别的 $g$。当 $g$ 是源得分函数与恒等函数的线性组合时（采用样本中心化时还可加任意常数），方差最小（ ）。由于一个固定的 $g$ 不可能对不同类型的源都最优，Koldovský、Tichavský 与 Oja（2006）的 EFICA 算法在对称 FastICA 运行之后为每个成分自适应地选择非线性函数； 会再回到这一点。 Speed. Kurtosis gives cubic convergence for any sources, the other two nonlinearities give cubic convergence for symmetric sources and quadratic convergence otherwise. In practice the difference amounts to at most an iteration or two ( ). Each iteration costs one pass over the data, of order $nT$ operations per unit; evaluating $\tanh$ or an exponential is slower than a cube, but rarely enough to matter. 速度。 峭度对任何源都给出三次收敛；另两种非线性函数对对称源三次收敛，否则二次收敛。实践中两者的差别至多一两次迭代（ ）。每次迭代需要遍历一次数据，每个单元的计算量为 $nT$ 量级；计算 $\tanh$ 或指数函数比计算立方慢，但很少慢到值得在意的程度。 These considerations lead to the usual practice, recommended by Hyvärinen (1999): $\log\cosh$ with $a = 1$ as the default; the Gaussian-shaped $G$ when the sources are strongly super-Gaussian or the data contain outliers; kurtosis mainly for sub-Gaussian sources in clean data, where its fourth-moment estimates are stable. Whatever the choice, the sign of $\lambda_i$ need not be known in advance. 由这些考虑得到通常的做法，这也是 Hyvärinen（1999）的建议：默认使用 $a = 1$ 的 $\log\cosh$；当源是强超高斯的或数据含有离群点时，使用高斯形的 $G$；峭度主要用于不含离群点的数据中的亚高斯源，此时四阶矩的估计是稳定的。无论选哪一种，都无须事先知道 $\lambda_i$ 的符号。

sectionZh: 秩、收敛诊断与可复现使用
text: Use one covariance convention. All sample expectations in the fixed-point update use $1/T$. Whitening with $\hat\bC=\bX_c\bX_c^\top/T$ therefore gives $\bZ\bZ^\top/T=\bI$ exactly up to round-off. NumPy's default np.cov uses $1/(T-1)$, which instead gives $(T-1)\bI/T$ under the later averaging convention. The difference is small for large $T$, but the implementation should match its own derivation. The SVD above also avoids forming a covariance matrix whose condition number is the square of that of the centered data. 统一协方差约定。 不动点更新中的样本期望全部使用 $1/T$，所以应以 $\hat\bC=\bX_c\bX_c^\top/T$ 白化，使 $\bZ\bZ^\top/T=\bI$ 在舍入误差以内成立。NumPy 默认的 np.cov 使用 $1/(T-1)$，按后续平均约定得到的会是 $(T-1)\bI/T$。大样本时差别虽小，实现仍应与推导一致。上面的 SVD 也避免了显式形成协方差矩阵；后者的条件数是中心化数据矩阵条件数的平方。 Do not hide rank failure. Repeated channels, constant channels, or retaining more dimensions than the centered data rank make whitening impossible. Reduce to a justified signal subspace; replacing every tiny eigenvalue by an arbitrary constant changes the model and can amplify noise. A zero one-unit update cannot be normalized. A rank-deficient simultaneous update has no unique invertible polar factor. In particular, an exactly Gaussian population component has a zero update; recover the identifiable non-Gaussian components and explicitly complete a remaining one-dimensional orthogonal complement instead of asserting that the inverse square root remains defined. 不要掩盖秩亏。 重复通道、常数通道，或保留维数超过中心化数据的秩，都会使白化不可能。应降到有依据的信号子空间；将所有小特征值任意截成一个常数会改变模型并可能放大噪声。单单元更新为零时无法归一化；同时更新矩阵秩亏时，也不存在唯一的可逆极分解因子。特别地，精确高斯总体成分的更新为零：应恢复可辨识的非高斯成分，再显式补全剩余的一维正交补，不能声称逆平方根在这里仍有定义。 Convergence is numerical, not scientific validation. If $c=1-|\bw_{\rm new}^\top\bw|$, the small acute angle between the iterates is approximately $\sqrt{2c}$ radians, not $c$. A tolerance of $10^{-12}$ corresponds to roughly $1.4\times10^{-6}$ radians. This only checks that an iterate has stopped changing. Compare multiple starts after one-to-one component matching, inspect the retained rank and the nonlinearity, and assess stability on resampled data. Keep failure rates as well as successful runs; never count an iteration limit as convergence. 数值收敛不是科学验证。 若 $c=1-|\bw_{\rm new}^\top\bw|$，两次迭代之间的小锐角约为 $\sqrt{2c}$ 弧度，而不是 $c$。容差 $10^{-12}$ 对应约 $1.4\times10^{-6}$ 弧度。它只表示迭代变化已经很小。应在成分一一匹配后比较多个初值，检查保留秩与非线性函数，并用重抽样评价稳定性。既要报告成功结果，也要报告失败率；达到迭代上限不能算作收敛。 Save the fitted transformation. The code returns both $\bW$ and the training mean. Apply them unchanged to new observations; refitting the mean or whitening separately on each test block changes the transform being evaluated. Because sign and order are arbitrary, store any later sign flips and permutations with the transform. These are conventions for reporting, not additional information recovered from the observations. 保存已拟合的变换。 代码同时返回 $\bW$ 与训练均值，对新观测应原样使用；在每个测试块上重新拟合均值或白化会改变正在评价的变换。符号与顺序本来就是任意的，因此后续采用的符号翻转与置换也应与变换一起保存。这些是报告约定，不是从观测中额外恢复的信息。 Key points 本章要点 On whitened data, FastICA iterates $\bw \leftarrow \E[\bz\,g(\bw^\top\bz)] - \E[g'(\bw^\top\bz)]\,\bw$ followed by normalization: an approximate Newton step for the Lagrange condition, in which whiteness makes the Jacobian diagonal. There is no step size. In source coordinates the kurtosis iteration is exactly $q_i^+ = \kappa_iq_i^3$: when the largest weighted initial coordinate is unique and positive, it converges cubically to the source that maximizes $\sqrt{|\kappa_i|}\,|q_i^{(0)}|$. For an odd smooth $g$ satisfying the theorem, every source with $\lambda_i = \E[s_i\,g(s_i) - g'(s_i)] \ne 0$ is a fixed point with at least quadratic convergence (cubic for symmetric sources). Sub- and super-Gaussian sources are found with the same $g$; Gaussian sources are never fixed points. Several components are obtained by deflation, which accumulates errors along the sequence, or by symmetric orthogonalization $\bW \leftarrow (\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\bW$, the closest orthogonal matrix, which treats all units alike. Bounded $g$ reduces sensitivity to extreme projections, but does not guarantee robustness of whitening or of the whole estimator; the accuracy for each source is governed by $\lambda_i$, and the best $g$ is the score of the source. 在白化数据上，FastICA 迭代 $\bw \leftarrow \E[\bz\,g(\bw^\top\bz)] - \E[g'(\bw^\top\bz)]\,\bw$ 并归一化：这是对 Lagrange 条件的近似牛顿步，白化使雅可比矩阵成为对角阵。算法没有步长。 在源坐标下，峭度迭代恰好是 $q_i^+ = \kappa_iq_i^3$：当加权初始坐标的最大绝对值唯一且为正时，它三次收敛到使 $\sqrt{|\kappa_i|}\,|q_i^{(0)}|$ 最大的那个源。 对满足定理条件的光滑奇函数 $g$，每个满足 $\lambda_i = \E[s_i\,g(s_i) - g'(s_i)] \ne 0$ 的源都是不动点，收敛至少是二次的（对称源时为三次）。同一个 $g$ 能找到亚高斯源和超高斯源；高斯源永远不是不动点。 多个成分可以用逐个提取（紧缩）得到，但误差会沿序列累积；也可以用对称正交化 $\bW \leftarrow (\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\bW$ 得到，它给出最近的正交矩阵，并对所有单元一视同仁。 有界 $g$ 可减弱极端投影的影响，但不保证白化或整个估计量都稳健；每个源的估计精度由 $\lambda_i$ 决定，最优的 $g$ 是该源的得分函数。 Before the exercises 开始习题前 Whiten first, update a direction, then normalize with a degeneracy check. Compare directions up to sign and distinguish local theory from finite-sample behavior. Multiple rows need a mechanism that prevents repeatedly finding one direction. 先白化，再更新方向，检查退化情况后才归一化。 在允许反号的意义下比较方向，并区分局部理论与有限样本行为。 多行估计需要防止反复找到同一方向的机制。 Start with the cubic-update exercise , then parts (a) and (b) of the orthogonalization exercise . Next try the Gaussian-source exercise ; save the Newton proof for a second pass. 先做 三次更新习题 ，再做 正交化习题的（a）（b） ，随后尝试 高斯源习题 ；牛顿法证明留到第二遍。

Show that for $G(u) = u^4/4$, whitened data and $\| w\| = 1$, the update becomes $ w^+ = \E[ z( w^	op z)^3] - 3 w$. What changes if the data are only centered, not whitened? 证明对 $G(u) = u^4/4$、白化数据和 $\| w\| = 1$，更新 变为 $ w^+ = \E[ z( w^	op z)^3] - 3 w$。如果数据只中心化而没有白化，会有什么变化？ Here $g(u) = u^3$ and $g'(u) = 3u^2$, so $\E[g'( w^	op z)] = 3\,\E[( w^	op z)^2] = 3\, w^	op\E[ z z^	op]\, w = 3\| w\|^2 = 3$. Without whitening, $\E[( w^	op x)^2] =  w^	op C_{ x} w$ is no longer 1 on the unit sphere, so the coefficient changes from point to point; worse, the derivation used $\E[ z z^	op] =  I$ to make the Jacobian diagonal, and the identity $q_i^+ = \kappa_iq_i^3$ relied on $	ilde A$ being orthogonal. On unwhitened data the iteration is no longer an approximate Newton method and its fixed points need not be the source directions. 此时 $g(u) = u^3$，$g'(u) = 3u^2$，所以 $\E[g'( w^	op z)] = 3\,\E[( w^	op z)^2] = 3\, w^	op\E[ z z^	op]\, w = 3\| w\|^2 = 3$。若不白化，单位球面上的 $\E[( w^	op x)^2] =  w^	op C_{ x} w$ 不再等于 1，系数随点而变；更严重的是，推导中正是用 $\E[ z z^	op] =  I$ 使雅可比矩阵成为对角阵，而恒等式 $q_i^+ = \kappa_iq_i^3$ 依赖于 $	ilde A$ 是正交矩阵。在未白化的数据上，这一迭代不再是近似牛顿法，其不动点也不一定是源方向。 Suppose source 1 is Gaussian and the others are not. (a) Using Stein's lemma ( ), show that $\lambda_1 = 0$ for every $g$. (b) With the kurtosis nonlinearity, what happens to the coordinate $q_1$ after one iteration? (c) Can the one-unit iteration converge to $\pm e_1$? 设源 1 是高斯的，其余的源不是。（a）利用 Stein 引理（ ）证明：对任何 $g$ 都有 $\lambda_1 = 0$。（b）使用峭度非线性时，坐标 $q_1$ 经过一次迭代后会怎样？（c）单单元迭代能否收敛到 $\pm e_1$？ (a) For $s_1 \sim \Ncal(0, 1)$, Stein's lemma gives $\E[s_1g(s_1)] = \E[g'(s_1)]$, so $\lambda_1 = 0$. (b) $\kappa_1 = 0$, so $q_1^+ = \kappa_1q_1^3 = 0$: the Gaussian coordinate is removed in a single step, and the iteration continues among the non-Gaussian sources. (c) No. At $ q =  e_1$ the unnormalized update is $\lambda_1 e_1 =  zero$, so $ e_1$ is not even a well-defined fixed point; for kurtosis, part (a) of shows that the limit is the non-Gaussian source maximizing $\sqrt{|\kappa_i|}\,|q_i^{(0)}|$. This is how FastICA copes with one Gaussian source: it finds the others, then explicitly completes the remaining one-dimensional orthogonal complement. At exact population separation the Gaussian row has a zero update, so the full symmetric inverse-square-root step is singular and needs special handling; finite-sample implementations may instead return a noise-determined row. （a）对 $s_1 \sim \Ncal(0, 1)$，Stein 引理给出 $\E[s_1g(s_1)] = \E[g'(s_1)]$，所以 $\lambda_1 = 0$。（b）$\kappa_1 = 0$，所以 $q_1^+ = \kappa_1q_1^3 = 0$：高斯坐标一步就被消去，迭代此后只在非高斯源之间进行。（c）不能。在 $ q =  e_1$ 处，未归一化的更新为 $\lambda_1 e_1 =  zero$，所以 $ e_1$ 连定义良好的不动点都不是；对峭度， 的（a）表明极限是使 $\sqrt{|\kappa_i|}\,|q_i^{(0)}|$ 最大的那个非高斯源。FastICA 就是这样处理一个高斯源的：它先找到其余的源，随后显式补全剩余的一维正交补。在精确总体分离点，高斯行的更新为零，因此完整对称逆平方根步骤奇异，需要专门处理；有限样本实现也可能返回一个由抽样噪声决定的行。 Let $ W =  igl( egin{smallmatrix}1 & 1\ 0 & 1\end{smallmatrix} igr)$. (a) Orthonormalize its rows by Gram–Schmidt, first in the order (row 1, row 2), then in the order (row 2, row 1). (b) Compute $( W W^	op)^{-1/2} W$ and verify that it is orthogonal. en: Tensor and Second-Order Methods: JADE and SOBI
zh: 张量方法与二阶方法：JADE 与 SOBI
text: First pass 第一次读这一章 One sentence. JADE and SOBI seek directions that make several informative matrices diagonal together; their difference is which features of the data generate those matrices. 一句话直觉。 JADE 与 SOBI 寻找能让多个有信息的矩阵同时对角化的方向；区别在于，它们用数据的什么特征来构造这些矩阵。 By the end, you should be able to: 读完后，你应能： show why one covariance matrix can leave an arbitrary rotation; use a second lag to distinguish two otherwise identical signatures; choose temporal covariance or fourth-order cumulants for an explicit reason. 说明为什么一个协方差矩阵可能留下任意旋转； 用第二个时滞区分原本相同的两组特征； 有明确理由地选择时滞协方差或四阶累积量。 Route. Review whitened coordinates ; consult cumulants before JADE. Read AMUSE and SOBI with the example below, then joint diagonalization and the comparison . The tensor notation and eigenmatrix proof can wait until your second pass. The glossary provides quick term reminders. 路线。 先复习 白化坐标 ；读 JADE 前再查 累积量 。结合下面的例子，先看 AMUSE 与 SOBI ，再读 联合对角化 与 方法比较 。 张量记号 及特征矩阵证明可以第二遍再读。术语不熟时可查 词汇表 。 Small calculation: a second lag resolves a tie. Take independent stationary unit-variance sources with autocorrelations $(\rho_1(1),\rho_1(2))=(0.5,0.25)$ and $(\rho_2(1),\rho_2(2))=(0.5,0)$. These occur for an AR(1) source with coefficient $0.5$ and a normalized two-term moving average, respectively. A lag is the number of time steps separating the two observations being compared. 手算：第二个时滞怎样打破平局？ 取两个相互独立、平稳、单位方差的源，自相关分别为 $(\rho_1(1),\rho_1(2))=(0.5,0.25)$ 与 $(\rho_2(1),\rho_2(2))=(0.5,0)$。它们分别可由系数为 $0.5$ 的 AR(1) 源和归一化的两项滑动平均产生。时滞就是被比较的两个观测相隔多少个时间步。 Rotate the sources by $45^\circ$: $\bz=\bB\bs$ with $\bB=\tfrac1{\sqrt2}\bigl(\begin{smallmatrix}1&-1\\1&1\end{smallmatrix}\bigr)$. This keeps the zero-lag covariance equal to identity. At lag 1, $\bC_z(1)=\bB(0.5\bI)\bB^\top=0.5\bI$. Every direction is an eigenvector: this matrix cannot reveal the rotation. At lag 2, $\bC_z(2)=\bB\diag(0.25,0)\bB^\top=\tfrac18\bigl(\begin{smallmatrix}1&1\\1&1\end{smallmatrix}\bigr)$. Its eigenvectors are $(1,1)^\top/\sqrt2$ and $(-1,1)^\top/\sqrt2$, with eigenvalues $0.25$ and 0. Those directions recover the two source axes up to signs and order. This uses exact noiseless covariances; sample estimates need enough data and appropriate temporal regularity. A second matrix helps because its values distinguish the sources, not merely because it is additional. 把源旋转 $45^\circ$：$\bz=\bB\bs$，其中 $\bB=\tfrac1{\sqrt2}\bigl(\begin{smallmatrix}1&-1\\1&1\end{smallmatrix}\bigr)$。这会保持零时滞协方差为单位阵。 在时滞 1，$\bC_z(1)=\bB(0.5\bI)\bB^\top=0.5\bI$。每个方向都是特征向量，这个矩阵无法透露旋转角度。 在时滞 2，$\bC_z(2)=\bB\diag(0.25,0)\bB^\top=\tfrac18\bigl(\begin{smallmatrix}1&1\\1&1\end{smallmatrix}\bigr)$。其特征向量为 $(1,1)^\top/\sqrt2$ 与 $(-1,1)^\top/\sqrt2$，对应特征值为 $0.25$ 与 0。 这些方向在符号和顺序意义下恢复两个源轴。这里使用无噪声的精确协方差；样本估计还需要足够数据与适当的时间正则条件。第二个矩阵有用，是因为它的数值能区分源，不只是因为数量多了一个。 Quick check 1. If both sources have identical autocorrelations at every selected lag, does adding those lags identify their axes? 自测 1。 若两个源在所有选定时滞上的自相关都相同，加入这些时滞能否确定源轴？ Check the answer 查看答案 No. Every selected matrix is still invariant to rotation within that two-source plane. More copies of the same information cannot resolve the ambiguity. 不能。每个选定矩阵在这两个源构成的平面内仍具有旋转不变性。重复同一信息无法消除歧义。 Quick check 2. Must the example fail if both sources are Gaussian? 自测 2。 若例子中的两个源都为高斯，它是否必然失败？ Check the answer 查看答案 No. SOBI uses their different temporal signatures. Ordinary Gaussian fourth-order cumulants vanish, so JADE cannot use that feature to separate them. Temporal structure changes the model’s available information. 不会。SOBI 利用的是不同的时间特征。普通高斯四阶累积量为零，所以 JADE 无法凭这一特征分离它们。时间结构改变了模型可使用的信息。

en: Tensor and Second-Order Methods: JADE and SOBI
zh: 张量方法与二阶方法：JADE 与 SOBI
text: After whitening, the remaining unknown is an orthogonal matrix $\tilde\bA$ ( ). Suppose we can compute, from the data alone, a symmetric matrix of the form $\bM = \tilde\bA\bLambda\tilde\bA^\top$ with $\bLambda$ diagonal. This is an eigendecomposition: if the diagonal entries of $\bLambda$ are distinct, the eigenvectors of $\bM$ are the columns of $\tilde\bA$, up to sign and order, and $\bU = \tilde\bA^\top$ separates the sources. No iteration, contrast function or step size is needed. The covariance of $\bz$ is useless for this purpose, since it equals $\bI$, but two other families of statistics have exactly this structure: matrices built from fourth-order cumulants, which are informative when the sources are non-Gaussian, and lagged covariance matrices, which are informative when the sources are correlated in time. 白化之后，剩下的未知量是一个正交矩阵 $\tilde\bA$（ ）。假设能单凭数据算出一个形如 $\bM = \tilde\bA\bLambda\tilde\bA^\top$ 的对称矩阵，其中 $\bLambda$ 是对角阵。这就是一个特征分解：若 $\bLambda$ 的对角元互不相同，$\bM$ 的特征向量就是 $\tilde\bA$ 的各列（相差符号和顺序），于是 $\bU = \tilde\bA^\top$ 就能分离各源。这里不需要迭代，不需要对比函数，也不需要步长。$\bz$ 的协方差对此毫无用处，因为它等于 $\bI$；但另有两族统计量恰好具有这种结构：由四阶累积量构造的矩阵（当源为非高斯时，它们携带信息），以及时滞协方差矩阵（当源在时间上相关时，它们携带信息）。 A single such matrix is fragile: two equal or nearly equal eigenvalues make its eigenvectors undetermined or badly estimated. Using many matrices at once and finding the one rotation that diagonalizes all of them, approximately, removes the fragility. This chapter develops that idea twice: with cumulant matrices it gives FOBI and JADE (Cardoso, 1989; Cardoso & Souloumiac, 1993), with lagged covariances AMUSE and SOBI (Tong et al., 1990; Belouchrani et al., 1997). The common computational tool is the Jacobi method for joint diagonalization (Cardoso & Souloumiac, 1996). 只用一个这样的矩阵是脆弱的：两个特征值相等或接近相等时，特征向量就不确定或估计得很差。同时使用许多矩阵，寻找一个能把它们全部近似对角化的旋转，就消除了这种脆弱性。本章把这一思想发展两次：用累积量矩阵得到 FOBI 和 JADE（Cardoso, 1989; Cardoso & Souloumiac, 1993），用时滞协方差得到 AMUSE 和 SOBI（Tong et al., 1990; Belouchrani et al., 1997）。两者共同的计算工具是联合对角化的 Jacobi 方法（Cardoso & Souloumiac, 1996）。

en: Tensor and Second-Order Methods: JADE and SOBI
zh: 张量方法与二阶方法：JADE 与 SOBI
sectionEn: The cumulant tensor of whitened data
sectionZh: 白化数据的累积量张量
text: Tensor without mystery. Here a fourth-order tensor is simply an array with four indices. A cumulant matrix bundles part of that array into a familiar square matrix. JADE looks for common axes across several such bundles; you can understand that goal before following every index contraction. 先把张量看成数组。 这里的四阶张量就是带四个下标的数组。累积量矩阵把数组中的一部分组织成熟悉的方阵。JADE 寻找多个这类方阵共有的轴；不必先弄懂每一次指标缩并，才能理解这个目标。 For zero-mean variables the fourth-order cumulant is $\cum(z_i, z_j, z_k, z_l) = \E[z_iz_jz_kz_l] - \E[z_iz_j]\E[z_kz_l] - \E[z_iz_k]\E[z_jz_l] - \E[z_iz_l]\E[z_jz_k]$ ( ); for whitened data the last three terms are $\delta_{ij}\delta_{kl} + \delta_{ik}\delta_{jl} + \delta_{il}\delta_{jk}$. The $n^4$ numbers $\cum(z_i, z_j, z_k, z_l)$ form a symmetric tensor, the cumulant tensor of $\bz$. Under the ICA model it has a very simple form. 对零均值变量，四阶累积量为 $\cum(z_i, z_j, z_k, z_l) = \E[z_iz_jz_kz_l] - \E[z_iz_j]\E[z_kz_l] - \E[z_iz_k]\E[z_jz_l] - \E[z_iz_l]\E[z_jz_k]$（ ）；对白化数据，后三项为 $\delta_{ij}\delta_{kl} + \delta_{ik}\delta_{jl} + \delta_{il}\delta_{jk}$。这 $n^4$ 个数 $\cum(z_i, z_j, z_k, z_l)$ 构成一个对称张量，即 $\bz$ 的 累积量张量 。在 ICA 模型下它的形式非常简单。 $$\cum(z_i, z_j, z_k, z_l) = \sum_{p=1}^n \kappa_p\,\tilde a_{ip}\,\tilde a_{jp}\,\tilde a_{kp}\,\tilde a_{lp}.$$ To see this, write $z_i = \sum_p \tilde a_{ip}s_p$ and expand by multilinearity: $\cum(z_i, z_j, z_k, z_l) = \sum_{p,q,r,u}\tilde a_{ip}\tilde a_{jq}\tilde a_{kr}\tilde a_{lu}\cum(s_p, s_q, s_r, s_u)$. A cross-cumulant of independent variables vanishes unless all four arguments are the same variable ( ), so only $p = q = r = u$ survives, with $\cum(s_p, s_p, s_p, s_p) = \kappa_p$. In tensor language, the cumulant tensor is $\sum_p\kappa_p\,\tilde\ba_p \otimes \tilde\ba_p \otimes \tilde\ba_p \otimes \tilde\ba_p$ with orthonormal vectors $\tilde\ba_p$: it is diagonal in the source basis , and ICA of whitened data amounts to an orthogonal decomposition of a symmetric fourth-order tensor ( ; the non-orthogonal case returns in ). Only $\binom{n+3}{4}$ of the entries are distinct, for example 715 for $n = 10$. 为看出这一点，写 $z_i = \sum_p \tilde a_{ip}s_p$，并利用多重线性展开：$\cum(z_i, z_j, z_k, z_l) = \sum_{p,q,r,u}\tilde a_{ip}\tilde a_{jq}\tilde a_{kr}\tilde a_{lu}\cum(s_p, s_q, s_r, s_u)$。独立变量的交叉累积量为零，除非四个自变量是同一个变量（ ），所以只剩下 $p = q = r = u$ 的项，且 $\cum(s_p, s_p, s_p, s_p) = \kappa_p$。用张量的语言说，累积量张量等于 $\sum_p\kappa_p\,\tilde\ba_p \otimes \tilde\ba_p \otimes \tilde\ba_p \otimes \tilde\ba_p$，其中各 $\tilde\ba_p$ 标准正交：它 在源基下是对角的 ，而白化数据的 ICA 就相当于对一个对称四阶张量作正交分解（ ；非正交情形将在 中再次出现）。其中只有 $\binom{n+3}{4}$ 个元素互不相同，例如 $n = 10$ 时为 715 个。 Contracting the tensor with a matrix produces matrices of the eigendecomposition form. For an $n \times n$ matrix $\bM$ define the cumulant matrix $\bQ_{\bz}(\bM)$ by 把这个张量与一个矩阵作缩并，就得到具有特征分解形式的矩阵。对 $n \times n$ 矩阵 $\bM$，定义 累积量矩阵 $\bQ_{\bz}(\bM)$ 为 $$\bigl[\bQ_{\bz}(\bM)\bigr]_{ij} = \sum_{k,l=1}^n \cum(z_i, z_j, z_k, z_l)\,m_{kl}.$$ Let $\bz = \tilde\bA\bs$ be whitened data from the ICA model, with $\tilde\bA$ orthogonal and sources of kurtosis $\kappa_p$. For every $n \times n$ matrix $\bM$: 设 $\bz = \tilde\bA\bs$ 是来自 ICA 模型的白化数据，$\tilde\bA$ 为正交矩阵，各源的峭度为 $\kappa_p$。则对每个 $n \times n$ 矩阵 $\bM$： (a) $\bQ_{\bz}(\bM) = \tilde\bA\,\diag\bigl(\kappa_p\,\tilde\ba_p^\top\bM\tilde\ba_p\bigr)\,\tilde\bA^\top$. （a）$\bQ_{\bz}(\bM) = \tilde\bA\,\diag\bigl(\kappa_p\,\tilde\ba_p^\top\bM\tilde\ba_p\bigr)\,\tilde\bA^\top$。 (b) $\bQ_{\bz}(\bM) = \E\bigl[(\bz^\top\bM\bz)\,\bz\bz^\top\bigr] - \tr(\bM)\,\bI - \bM - \bM^\top$. （b）$\bQ_{\bz}(\bM) = \E\bigl[(\bz^\top\bM\bz)\,\bz\bz^\top\bigr] - \tr(\bM)\,\bI - \bM - \bM^\top$。 (c) On the space of symmetric matrices with the inner product $\langle\bB, \bC\rangle = \tr(\bB^\top\bC)$, the linear map $\bM \mapsto \bQ_{\bz}(\bM)$ is self-adjoint, with eigenmatrices $\tilde\ba_p\tilde\ba_p^\top$ and eigenvalues $\kappa_p$, $p = 1, \dots, n$; all its other eigenvalues are zero. （c）在对称矩阵空间上取内积 $\langle\bB, \bC\rangle = \tr(\bB^\top\bC)$，线性映射 $\bM \mapsto \bQ_{\bz}(\bM)$ 是自伴的，其特征矩阵为 $\tilde\ba_p\tilde\ba_p^\top$，对应特征值为 $\kappa_p$（$p = 1, \dots, n$）；其余特征值全为零。 (a) Substituting , $[\bQ_{\bz}(\bM)]_{ij} = \sum_p\kappa_p\tilde a_{ip}\tilde a_{jp}\sum_{kl}\tilde a_{kp}m_{kl}\tilde a_{lp} = \sum_p\kappa_p\,(\tilde\ba_p^\top\bM\tilde\ba_p)\,\tilde a_{ip}\tilde a_{jp}$. (b) Contract the definition of the cumulant with $m_{kl}$: the moment term gives $\E[z_iz_j\,\bz^\top\bM\bz]$ and the three products of Kronecker deltas give $\delta_{ij}\tr\bM$, $m_{ij}$ and $m_{ji}$. (c) By (a), $\bQ_{\bz}(\bM) = \sum_p\kappa_p\langle\tilde\ba_p\tilde\ba_p^\top, \bM\rangle\,\tilde\ba_p\tilde\ba_p^\top$. The matrices $\tilde\ba_p\tilde\ba_p^\top$ are orthonormal, because $\langle\tilde\ba_p\tilde\ba_p^\top, \tilde\ba_q\tilde\ba_q^\top\rangle = (\tilde\ba_p^\top\tilde\ba_q)^2 = \delta_{pq}$, so this is a spectral decomposition, and the map vanishes on their orthogonal complement. （a）代入 ，得 $[\bQ_{\bz}(\bM)]_{ij} = \sum_p\kappa_p\tilde a_{ip}\tilde a_{jp}\sum_{kl}\tilde a_{kp}m_{kl}\tilde a_{lp} = \sum_p\kappa_p\,(\tilde\ba_p^\top\bM\tilde\ba_p)\,\tilde a_{ip}\tilde a_{jp}$。（b）把累积量的定义与 $m_{kl}$ 缩并：矩项给出 $\E[z_iz_j\,\bz^\top\bM\bz]$，三个 Kronecker δ 乘积依次给出 $\delta_{ij}\tr\bM$、$m_{ij}$ 和 $m_{ji}$。（c）由（a），$\bQ_{\bz}(\bM) = \sum_p\kappa_p\langle\tilde\ba_p\tilde\ba_p^\top, \bM\rangle\,\tilde\ba_p\tilde\ba_p^\top$。由于 $\langle\tilde\ba_p\tilde\ba_p^\top, \tilde\ba_q\tilde\ba_q^\top\rangle = (\tilde\ba_p^\top\tilde\ba_q)^2 = \delta_{pq}$，这些矩阵 $\tilde\ba_p\tilde\ba_p^\top$ 标准正交，所以这就是一个谱分解，而该映射在它们的正交补上为零。 Formula (b) is how cumulant matrices are estimated: replace $\E$ by a sample average over whitened data. We checked (a) and (b) to machine precision on discrete sources for which every expectation can be computed exactly, including a skewed one; symmetry of the sources is not needed. 公式（b）就是估计累积量矩阵的方法：在白化数据上把 $\E$ 换成样本平均。我们在可以精确计算所有期望的离散源（包括一个有偏度的源）上验证了（a）和（b），误差在机器精度以内；源的对称性不是必需的。 FOBI. The simplest choice is $\bM = \bI$. Since $\tilde\ba_p^\top\tilde\ba_p = 1$, part (a) gives $\bQ_{\bz}(\bI) = \tilde\bA\,\diag(\kappa_1, \dots, \kappa_n)\,\tilde\bA^\top$, and part (b) gives $\bQ_{\bz}(\bI) = \E[\|\bz\|^2\bz\bz^\top] - (n + 2)\bI$. The eigenvectors of the weighted covariance $\E[\|\bz\|^2\bz\bz^\top]$ therefore separate the sources whenever their kurtoses are distinct. This is FOBI, for fourth-order blind identification (Cardoso, 1989): one weighted covariance and one eigendecomposition. Its weakness is the distinctness requirement: two Laplace sources, or two sources of the same type in general, cannot be separated by FOBI ( ). FOBI。 最简单的选择是 $\bM = \bI$。由于 $\tilde\ba_p^\top\tilde\ba_p = 1$，（a）给出 $\bQ_{\bz}(\bI) = \tilde\bA\,\diag(\kappa_1, \dots, \kappa_n)\,\tilde\bA^\top$，（b）给出 $\bQ_{\bz}(\bI) = \E[\|\bz\|^2\bz\bz^\top] - (n + 2)\bI$。因此，只要各源的峭度互不相同，加权协方差 $\E[\|\bz\|^2\bz\bz^\top]$ 的特征向量就能分离各源。这就是 FOBI（fourth-order blind identification，四阶盲辨识；Cardoso, 1989）：一个加权协方差加一次特征分解。它的弱点在于要求峭度互不相同：两个拉普拉斯源，或者一般地两个同类型的源，都无法用 FOBI 分离（ ）。

en: Tensor and Second-Order Methods: JADE and SOBI

text:
What a Jacobi sweep does. Hold every direction fixed except two, rotate that pair, and choose the angle that reduces their combined off-diagonal entries. Repeat across pairs. A small final score means the matrices are nearly diagonal together; unique source recovery additionally needs distinct joint signatures. 一次 Jacobi 扫描在做什么？ 先固定其他方向，只旋转其中一对，选择能减少它们在各矩阵中非对角项总量的角度，再逐对重复。最终分数很小，只说明这些矩阵近似共同对角；唯一恢复源还要求不同的联合特征。 Let $ Q_1, \dots,  Q_K$ be symmetric matrices that, in the model, all have the form $ Q_r = 	ilde A Lambda_r	ilde A^	op$ with diagonal $ Lambda_r = \diag(\lambda_{r1}, \dots, \lambda_{rn})$. With estimated matrices no single rotation makes all of them exactly diagonal, so we minimize the off-diagonal energy 设 $ Q_1, \dots,  Q_K$ 是对称矩阵，在模型中它们都形如 $ Q_r = 	ilde A Lambda_r	ilde A^	op$，其中 $ Lambda_r = \diag(\lambda_{r1}, \dots, \lambda_{rn})$ 为对角阵。对估计得到的矩阵，没有一个旋转能把它们全部精确对角化，于是我们最小化非对角能量 $$\mathcal{C}( U) = \sum_{r=1}^K  igl\|\offdiag igl( U Q_r U^	op igr) igr\|_F^2 \qquad 	ext{over orthogonal }  U,$$ where $\offdiag( B)$ is $ B$ with its diagonal set to zero. Since $\| U Q_r U^	op\|_F = \| Q_r\|_F$, minimizing $\mathcal{C}$ is the same as maximizing the diagonal energy $\sum_r\|\diag( U Q_r U^	op)\|^2$. In the model the minimum is zero, and the next lemma says when it is attained only at the right rotation. 其中 $\offdiag( B)$ 表示把 $ B$ 的对角线置零后的矩阵。由于 $\| U Q_r U^	op\|_F = \| Q_r\|_F$，最小化 $\mathcal{C}$ 等价于最大化对角能量 $\sum_r\|\diag( U Q_r U^	op)\|^2$。在模型中最小值为零；下面的引理说明它何时只在正确的旋转处取到。 Let $ Q_r = 	ilde A Lambda_r	ilde A^	op$, $r = 1, \dots, K$, with $	ilde A$ orthogonal and $ Lambda_r$ diagonal. Suppose that for every pair $p

Then $ B Lambda_r =  D_r B$, that is, $b_{ij}\lambda_{rj} = d_{r,i}\,b_{ij}$ for all $i, j, r$. If a row $i$ of $ B$ had two nonzero entries $b_{ij}$ and $b_{il}$, then $\lambda_{rj} = d_{r,i} = \lambda_{rl}$ for all $r$, contradicting the assumption. So each row has at most one nonzero entry; as $ B$ is invertible it has exactly one, which is $\pm1$ because the rows have unit norm, and the nonzero entries lie in different columns. For the converse, let $\mathbf{G}$ be any rotation acting only on coordinates $p$ and $q$. The $(p, q)$ block of $ Lambda_r$ is a multiple of the $2 	imes 2$ identity, so $\mathbf{G} Lambda_r\mathbf{G}^	op =  Lambda_r$, and $ U = \mathbf{G}^	op	ilde A^	op$ diagonalizes every $ Q_r$. 令 $ B =  U	ilde A$（正交矩阵），$ D_r =  U Q_r U^	op =  B Lambda_r B^	op$，按假设为对角阵。于是 $ B Lambda_r =  D_r B$，即对所有 $i, j, r$ 有 $b_{ij}\lambda_{rj} = d_{r,i}\,b_{ij}$。若 $ B$ 的某一行 $i$ 有两个非零元 $b_{ij}$ 和 $b_{il}$，则对所有 $r$ 有 $\lambda_{rj} = d_{r,i} = \lambda_{rl}$，与假设矛盾。所以每一行至多有一个非零元；由于 $ B$ 可逆，恰好有一个，又因各行范数为一，它等于 $\pm1$，并且这些非零元位于不同的列。反过来，设 $\mathbf{G}$ 是只作用在坐标 $p$、$q$ 上的任意旋转。$ Lambda_r$ 的 $(p, q)$ 块是 $2 	imes 2$ 单位阵的倍数，所以 $\mathbf{G} Lambda_r\mathbf{G}^	op =  Lambda_r$，从而 $ U = \mathbf{G}^	op	ilde A^	op$ 能对角化每个 $ Q_r$。 Jacobi rotations. The Jacobi method minimizes $\mathcal{C}$ by a sequence of plane rotations. A sweep visits every pair $p < q$ once; for each pair it applies $ Q_r \leftarrow  R^	op Q_r R$ to all matrices and $ U \leftarrow  R^	op U$, where $ R =  R_{pq}(	heta)$ is the identity except for $R_{pp} = R_{qq} = \cos	heta$, $R_{pq} = -\sin	heta$ and $R_{qp} = \sin	heta$. Sweeps are repeated until all angles are negligible. The point of the method is that the best angle for a pair has a closed form. Write $\alpha_r = [ Q_r]_{pp} - [ Q_r]_{qq}$ and $ eta_r = 2[ Q_r]_{pq}$. A direct computation on the $(p, q)$ block shows that the rotation acts on these two numbers as Jacobi 旋转。 Jacobi 方法通过一系列平面旋转来最小化 $\mathcal{C}$。一次 扫描 依次访问每一对 $p < q$；对每一对，对所有矩阵作 $ Q_r \leftarrow  R^	op Q_r R$，并令 $ U \leftarrow  R^	op U$，其中 $ R =  R_{pq}(	heta)$ 除 $R_{pp} = R_{qq} = \cos	heta$、$R_{pq} = -\sin	heta$、$R_{qp} = \sin	heta$ 外都与单位阵相同。重复扫描，直到所有角度都可以忽略为止。这一方法的要点在于：每一对的最优角度有闭式解。记 $\alpha_r = [ Q_r]_{pp} - [ Q_r]_{qq}$，$ eta_r = 2[ Q_r]_{pq}$。对 $(p, q)$ 块直接计算可知，旋转对这两个数的作用为 $$ egin{pmatrix} \alpha'_r \  eta'_r \end{pmatrix} =  egin{pmatrix} \cos2	heta & \sin2	heta \ -\sin2	heta & \cos2	heta \end{pmatrix}  egin{pmatrix} \alpha_r \  eta_r \end{pmatrix},$$ where primes denote values after the rotation. The other off-diagonal entries in rows and columns $p$ and $q$ are rotated in pairs, $([ Q_r]_{pk}, [ Q_r]_{qk})$ for $k 
e p, q$, which preserves their sum of squares, and all remaining entries are unchanged. So the rotation affects $\mathcal{C}$ only through the two entries in positions $(p, q)$ and $(q, p)$, whose contribution is $	frac12\sum_r eta_r'^2$. Write $\mathbf{h}_r = (\alpha_r,  eta_r)^	op$ and $\mathbf{v} = (\cos2	heta, \sin2	heta)^	op$. Because $\|\mathbf{h}_r\|$ is invariant, $	frac12\sum_r eta_r'^2 = 	frac12\sum_r igl(\|\mathbf{h}_r\|^2 - (\mathbf{h}_r^	op\mathbf{v})^2 igr)$, and the best angle maximizes $\mathbf{v}^	op\mathbf{G}\mathbf{v}$ with $\mathbf{G} = \sum_r\mathbf{h}_r\mathbf{h}_r^	op$: $\mathbf{v}$ is the leading eigenvector of the $2 	imes 2$ matrix $\mathbf{G}$. Since $\mathbf{v}^	op\mathbf{G}\mathbf{v} = 	frac12(g_{11} + g_{22}) + 	frac12(g_{11} - g_{22})\cos4	heta + g_{12}\sin4	heta$, the optimal angle in $(-\pi/4, \pi/4]$ is 其中带撇号的量表示旋转后的值。第 $p$、$q$ 行和列中的其余非对角元 $([ Q_r]_{pk}, [ Q_r]_{qk})$（$k 
e p, q$）成对地旋转，平方和保持不变；其余元素都不变。所以旋转只通过位于 $(p, q)$ 和 $(q, p)$ 的两个元素影响 $\mathcal{C}$，它们的贡献为 $	frac12\sum_r eta_r'^2$。记 $\mathbf{h}_r = (\alpha_r,  eta_r)^	op$，$\mathbf{v} = (\cos2	heta, \sin2	heta)^	op$。由于 $\|\mathbf{h}_r\|$ 不变，有 $	frac12\sum_r eta_r'^2 = 	frac12\sum_r igl(\|\mathbf{h}_r\|^2 - (\mathbf{h}_r^	op\mathbf{v})^2 igr)$；最优角度使 $\mathbf{v}^	op\mathbf{G}\mathbf{v}$ 最大，其中 $\mathbf{G} = \sum_r\mathbf{h}_r\mathbf{h}_r^	op$，即 $\mathbf{v}$ 是 $2 	imes 2$ 矩阵 $\mathbf{G}$ 的主特征向量。由于 $\mathbf{v}^	op\mathbf{G}\mathbf{v} = 	frac12(g_{11} + g_{22}) + 	frac12(g_{11} - g_{22})\cos4	heta + g_{12}\sin4	heta$，$(-\pi/4, \pi/4]$ 内的最优角度为 $$	heta^\star = 	frac14\operatorname{atan2}\Bigl(2\sum_{r}\alpha_r eta_r,\ \ \sum_{r} igl(\alpha_r^2 -  eta_r^2 igr)\Bigr), \qquad \alpha_r = [ Q_r]_{pp} - [ Q_r]_{qq},\quad  eta_r = 2[ Q_r]_{pq},$$ the real case of the formula of Cardoso and Souloumiac (1996), whose version also covers complex matrices. For a single matrix it reduces to the classical Jacobi angle $	an2	heta =  eta/\alpha = 2[ Q]_{pq}/([ Q]_{pp} - [ Q]_{qq})$ ( ). Each rotation minimizes $\mathcal{C}$ exactly over its plane, so $\mathcal{C}$ never increases. We compared with a brute-force search over 20001 angles for 200 random sets of symmetric matrices: the closed form was never beaten, and the angles agreed to within the grid spacing. (b) shows the criterion of one pair as a function of $	heta$: a constant minus a sinusoid of period $\pi/2$, minimized at $	heta^\star$. In practice a few sweeps suffice. With exactly jointly diagonalizable matrices the decrease is very fast (in a test with $n = 6$ and $K = 5$, $\mathcal{C}$ went from 20 to $10^{-13}$ in three sweeps); with estimated matrices $\mathcal{C}$ levels off after two or three sweeps at a value set by the sampling error. 这是 Cardoso 与 Souloumiac（1996）公式的实数情形，他们的版本也适用于复矩阵。对单个矩阵，它退化为经典的 Jacobi 角 $	an2	heta =  eta/\alpha = 2[ Q]_{pq}/([ Q]_{pp} - [ Q]_{qq})$（ ）。每次旋转都在其所在平面内精确地最小化 $\mathcal{C}$，所以 $\mathcal{C}$ 从不增加。我们在 200 组随机对称矩阵上把 与对 20001 个角度的穷举搜索作了比较：闭式解从未被超越，两者给出的角度在网格间距以内一致。 （b）画出了一对坐标的准则作为 $	heta$ 的函数：它是一个常数减去一个周期为 $\pi/2$ 的正弦曲线，在 $	heta^\star$ 处取最小值。实践中几次扫描就够了。对可以精确联合对角化的矩阵，下降非常快（在 $n = 6$、$K = 5$ 的测试中，$\mathcal{C}$ 在三次扫描内从 20 降到 $10^{-13}$）；对估计得到的矩阵，$\mathcal{C}$ 在两三次扫描后就稳定在由抽样误差决定的水平上。

en: Tensor and Second-Order Methods: JADE and SOBI
zh: 张量方法与二阶方法：JADE 与 SOBI
text: JADE, for joint approximate diagonalization of eigenmatrices (Cardoso & Souloumiac, 1993), applies the Jacobi method to cumulant matrices. Let $\bQ_{kl} = \bQ_{\bz}(\be_k\be_l^\top)$, so that $[\bQ_{kl}]_{ij} = \cum(z_i, z_j, z_k, z_l)$; these $n^2$ matrices contain the whole cumulant tensor. The joint-diagonality criterion of this set is itself a function of the output cumulants. JADE（joint approximate diagonalization of eigenmatrices，特征矩阵的联合近似对角化；Cardoso & Souloumiac, 1993）把 Jacobi 方法用于累积量矩阵。令 $\bQ_{kl} = \bQ_{\bz}(\be_k\be_l^\top)$，即 $[\bQ_{kl}]_{ij} = \cum(z_i, z_j, z_k, z_l)$；这 $n^2$ 个矩阵包含了整个累积量张量。这组矩阵的联合对角化准则本身就是输出累积量的函数。 For orthogonal $\bU$ and $\by = \bU\bz$, 对正交矩阵 $\bU$ 和 $\by = \bU\bz$， $$\sum_{k,l=1}^n \bigl\|\diag\bigl(\bU\bQ_{kl}\bU^\top\bigr)\bigr\|^2 = \sum_{i,k,l=1}^n \cum(y_i, y_i, y_k, y_l)^2.$$ Under the ICA model its maximum over orthogonal $\bU$ is $\sum_p\kappa_p^2$, attained exactly by the rotations that jointly diagonalize all cumulant matrices. These include every separating rotation, and if at most one source has zero kurtosis they are the only ones. 在 ICA 模型下，它在正交矩阵上的最大值为 $\sum_p\kappa_p^2$，恰好在那些能联合对角化所有累积量矩阵的旋转处取到。这些旋转包括所有分离旋转；若至多一个源的峭度为零，则只有分离旋转能取到最大值。 By multilinearity, $[\bU\bQ_{kl}\bU^\top]_{ii} = \sum_{a,b}u_{ia}u_{ib}\cum(z_a, z_b, z_k, z_l) = \cum(y_i, y_i, z_k, z_l)$. For fixed $i$, the matrix with entries $\cum(y_i, y_i, z_k, z_l)$ becomes the matrix with entries $\cum(y_i, y_i, y_k, y_l)$ when multiplied by $\bU$ on the left and $\bU^\top$ on the right, which preserves the Frobenius norm; summing over $i$ gives . Next, $\sum_{kl}\|\bU\bQ_{kl}\bU^\top\|_F^2 = \sum_{ijkl}\cum(z_i, z_j, z_k, z_l)^2$, which by equals $\sum_{p,q}\kappa_p\kappa_q(\tilde\ba_p^\top\tilde\ba_q)^4 = \sum_p\kappa_p^2$. Hence the criterion equals $\sum_p\kappa_p^2 - \sum_{kl}\|\offdiag(\bU\bQ_{kl}\bU^\top)\|_F^2$, with maximum $\sum_p\kappa_p^2$ exactly when $\bU$ diagonalizes every $\bQ_{kl}$, or equivalently, by linearity, every $\bQ_{\bz}(\bM)$. Separating rotations do so by . For uniqueness apply to the family of all $\bQ_{\bz}(\bM)$: for $\bM = \tilde\ba_p\tilde\ba_p^\top$ the eigenvalues are $\kappa_p$ for source $p$ and $0$ for every other source, so every pair containing a source with nonzero kurtosis is distinguished. 由多重线性，$[\bU\bQ_{kl}\bU^\top]_{ii} = \sum_{a,b}u_{ia}u_{ib}\cum(z_a, z_b, z_k, z_l) = \cum(y_i, y_i, z_k, z_l)$。固定 $i$，以 $\cum(y_i, y_i, z_k, z_l)$ 为元素的矩阵左乘 $\bU$、右乘 $\bU^\top$ 后，就变成以 $\cum(y_i, y_i, y_k, y_l)$ 为元素的矩阵，而这一变换保持 Frobenius 范数；对 $i$ 求和即得 。其次，$\sum_{kl}\|\bU\bQ_{kl}\bU^\top\|_F^2 = \sum_{ijkl}\cum(z_i, z_j, z_k, z_l)^2$，由 ，它等于 $\sum_{p,q}\kappa_p\kappa_q(\tilde\ba_p^\top\tilde\ba_q)^4 = \sum_p\kappa_p^2$。因此准则等于 $\sum_p\kappa_p^2 - \sum_{kl}\|\offdiag(\bU\bQ_{kl}\bU^\top)\|_F^2$，其最大值 $\sum_p\kappa_p^2$ 恰在 $\bU$ 对角化每个 $\bQ_{kl}$ 时取到，由线性性，这等价于对角化每个 $\bQ_{\bz}(\bM)$。由 ，分离旋转做到了这一点。至于唯一性，把 用于全体 $\bQ_{\bz}(\bM)$：取 $\bM = \tilde\ba_p\tilde\ba_p^\top$ 时，源 $p$ 对应的特征值为 $\kappa_p$，其余各源都为 $0$，所以凡是包含一个峭度非零的源的源对都能被区分。 The terms with $k = l = i$ in form Comon's contrast $\sum_i\kurt(y_i)^2$ (Comon, 1994; ); JADE adds the cross-cumulants $\cum(y_i, y_i, y_k, y_l)$ with $(k, l) \ne (i, i)$. Both are maximized by the separating rotations; the extra terms are what turn the problem into joint diagonalization, with its closed-form Jacobi angles. Cardoso (1999) discusses the relations among these fourth-order contrasts. Two refinements make JADE practical. First, by part (c) of , the linear map $\bM \mapsto \bQ_{\bz}(\bM)$ has eigenpairs $(\lambda_r, \bM_r)$, and the left side of equals $\sum_r\lambda_r^2\,\|\diag(\bU\bM_r\bU^\top)\|^2$ ( ). In the model at most $n$ eigenvalues are nonzero, so JADE jointly diagonalizes the $n$ weighted eigenmatrices $\lambda_r\bM_r$ with the largest $|\lambda_r|$ instead of $n^2$ matrices; this is the "eigenmatrices" of its name. Second, the Jacobi updates touch only two rows and two columns of each matrix. 中 $k = l = i$ 的项构成 Comon 的对比函数 $\sum_i\kurt(y_i)^2$（Comon, 1994； ）；JADE 另外加上了 $(k, l) \ne (i, i)$ 的交叉累积量 $\cum(y_i, y_i, y_k, y_l)$。两者都在分离旋转处取最大值；正是这些额外的项把问题变成了联合对角化，从而可以使用闭式的 Jacobi 角。Cardoso（1999）讨论了这些四阶对比函数之间的关系。有两点改进使 JADE 实用。第一，由 的（c），线性映射 $\bM \mapsto \bQ_{\bz}(\bM)$ 有特征对 $(\lambda_r, \bM_r)$，而 的左边等于 $\sum_r\lambda_r^2\,\|\diag(\bU\bM_r\bU^\top)\|^2$（ ）。在模型中至多有 $n$ 个特征值非零，所以 JADE 只需联合对角化 $|\lambda_r|$ 最大的 $n$ 个加权 特征矩阵 $\lambda_r\bM_r$，而不是 $n^2$ 个矩阵；这就是其名称中“特征矩阵”的由来。第二，Jacobi 更新每次只涉及每个矩阵的两行两列。 Center and whiten the data, $\bz(t) = \bV\bx(t)$, reducing to $n$ dimensions by PCA if $m > n$. Estimate the cumulant matrices $\bQ_{kl}$ from part (b) of with sample averages; optionally replace them by the $n$ most significant weighted eigenmatrices $\lambda_r\bM_r$. Find the orthogonal $\bU$ that jointly diagonalizes these matrices by Jacobi sweeps with the angle , until all angles fall below a threshold. Output $\by(t) = \bU\bz(t)$ and the unmixing matrix $\bW = \bU\bV$. 中心化并白化数据，$\bz(t) = \bV\bx(t)$；若 $m > n$，用 PCA 降到 $n$ 维。 用 的（b）以样本平均估计累积量矩阵 $\bQ_{kl}$；也可以改用最显著的 $n$ 个加权特征矩阵 $\lambda_r\bM_r$。 用角度 进行 Jacobi 扫描，求出联合对角化这些矩阵的正交矩阵 $\bU$，直到所有角度都小于阈值。 输出 $\by(t) = \bU\bz(t)$ 以及解混矩阵 $\bW = \bU\bV$。 The following implementation favours clarity: it forms the full cumulant tensor with einsum , uses all $n^2$ matrices $\bQ_{kl}$, and rotates whole matrices. It is applied to a uniform, a Laplace and a binary source. 下面的实现以清晰为先：它用 einsum 构造完整的累积量张量，使用全部 $n^2$ 个矩阵 $\bQ_{kl}$，并对整个矩阵作旋转。示例中的源为一个均匀源、一个拉普拉斯源和一个二值源。 The printed global matrix, each row scaled by its largest entry, is a signed permutation up to entries of at most 0.03: 打印出的全局矩阵（每行除以该行绝对值最大的元素）在至多 0.03 的误差内是一个带符号的置换矩阵： JADE needs no initialization and no step size, and its Jacobi sweeps are deterministic and few; its weakness is cost. Storing the $n^2$ cumulant matrices takes $n^4$ numbers ($6.25 \times 10^6$ for $n = 50$, $10^8$ for $n = 100$), and estimating them takes of the order of $n^4T$ operations. This restricts JADE to moderate numbers of sources, a few tens rather than hundreds. JADE 不需要初始化，也没有步长，其 Jacobi 扫描是确定性的，次数也很少；它的弱点在于计算量。存储 $n^2$ 个累积量矩阵需要 $n^4$ 个数（$n = 50$ 时为 $6.25 \times 10^6$，$n = 100$ 时为 $10^8$），估计它们需要 $n^4T$ 量级的运算。这使 JADE 只适用于中等数目的源，即几十个而不是几百个。

en: Tensor and Second-Order Methods: JADE and SOBI
zh: 张量方法与二阶方法：JADE 与 SOBI
text:
The i.i.d. assumption of discards the order of the samples. Many signals, from EEG rhythms to fMRI time courses, are correlated in time, and this structure can replace non-Gaussianity. Assume that the sources are zero-mean, wide-sense stationary, and mutually uncorrelated at every lag: $\E[s_i(t)s_j(t + 	au)] = 0$ for $i 
e j$ and all $	au$. Write $ho_i(	au) = \E[s_i(t)s_i(t + 	au)]$ for the autocovariance of source $i$, with $ho_i(0) = 1$. The lagged covariance matrices of the data are then 中的独立同分布假设丢弃了样本的顺序。许多信号，从 EEG 节律到 fMRI 时间过程，在时间上都是相关的，这种结构可以取代非高斯性。假设各源均值为零、宽平稳，并且在任何时滞下互不相关：对 $i 
e j$ 和所有 $	au$ 有 $\E[s_i(t)s_j(t + 	au)] = 0$。记 $ho_i(	au) = \E[s_i(t)s_i(t + 	au)]$ 为源 $i$ 的自协方差，$ho_i(0) = 1$。于是数据的时滞协方差矩阵为 $$ C_{ x}(	au) = \E igl[ x(t)\, x(t + 	au)^	op igr] =  A\,\diag igl(ho_1(	au), \dots, ho_n(	au) igr)\, A^	op.$$ They are symmetric in the model, but their estimates $\hat C_{ x}(	au) =  rac{1}{T - 	au}\sum_t x(t) x(t + 	au)^	op$ are not, so one uses $ ar C(	au) = 	frac12(\hat C(	au) + \hat C(	au)^	op)$. Whitening with $ C_{ x}(0) =  A A^	op$ gives $ ar C_{ z}(	au) = 	ilde A\,\diag(ho_i(	au))\,	ilde A^	op$ for every lag: again the joint diagonalization structure. Only second-order statistics are involved, so neither non-Gaussianity nor full independence is required. 在模型中这些矩阵是对称的，但其估计 $\hat C_{ x}(	au) =  rac{1}{T - 	au}\sum_t x(t) x(t + 	au)^	op$ 并不对称，所以使用 $ ar C(	au) = 	frac12(\hat C(	au) + \hat C(	au)^	op)$。用 $ C_{ x}(0) =  A A^	op$ 白化后，对每个时滞都有 $ ar C_{ z}(	au) = 	ilde A\,\diag(ho_i(	au))\,	ilde A^	op$：又是联合对角化的结构。这里只涉及二阶统计量，所以既不需要非高斯性，也不需要完全独立。 AMUSE. The AMUSE algorithm of Tong et al. (1990) uses a single lag: whiten, then take the eigenvectors of $ ar C_{ z}(	au)$. By with $K = 1$, this separates the sources if and only if the numbers $ho_1(	au), \dots, ho_n(	au)$ are distinct; Tong et al. (1991) analyse the identifiability question in detail. Molgedey and Schuster (1994) proposed the same idea, formulated as the simultaneous diagonalization of $ C_{ x}(0)$ and $ C_{ x}(	au)$. The condition is fragile: two sources with equal or nearly equal autocorrelation at the chosen lag are mixed, or estimated poorly, however different they are at other lags. AMUSE。 Tong 等（1990）提出的 AMUSE 算法只用一个时滞：先白化，再取 $ ar C_{ z}(	au)$ 的特征向量。由 （取 $K = 1$），它能分离各源当且仅当 $ho_1(	au), \dots, ho_n(	au)$ 互不相同；Tong 等（1991）详细分析了其中的可辨识性问题。Molgedey 与 Schuster（1994）提出了同一思想，表述为 $ C_{ x}(0)$ 与 $ C_{ x}(	au)$ 的同时对角化。这个条件是脆弱的：两个源若在所选时滞处自相关相等或接近相等，就会被混在一起或估计得很差，不管它们在其他时滞上相差多大。 Center the data and whiten them with the sample covariance $\hat C_{ x}(0)$: $ z(t) =  V x(t)$. Choose lags $	au_1, \dots, 	au_K$ and compute the symmetrized lagged covariances $ ar C_{ z}(	au_k)$. Find the orthogonal $ U$ that jointly diagonalizes them by Jacobi sweeps with . Output $ y(t) =  U z(t)$ and the unmixing matrix $ W =  U V$. 中心化数据，并用样本协方差 $\hat C_{ x}(0)$ 白化：$ z(t) =  V x(t)$。 选取时滞 $	au_1, \dots, 	au_K$，计算对称化的时滞协方差 $ ar C_{ z}(	au_k)$。 用 进行 Jacobi 扫描，求出联合对角化它们的正交矩阵 $ U$。 输出 $ y(t) =  U z(t)$ 以及解混矩阵 $ W =  U V$。 This is SOBI, second-order blind identification (Belouchrani et al., 1997); TDSEP (Ziehe & Müller, 1998) is essentially the same method. Its identifiability condition follows directly from . 这就是 SOBI（second-order blind identification，二阶盲辨识；Belouchrani et al., 1997）；TDSEP（Ziehe & Müller, 1998）本质上是同一种方法。它的可辨识条件直接由 得到。 Let the sources be zero-mean, wide-sense stationary and mutually uncorrelated at all lags, with autocovariances $ho_i(	au)$, $ho_i(0) = 1$, and let $ z = 	ilde A s$ be the whitened data. If for every pair $i 
e j$ there is a lag $	au_k$ in the chosen set with $ho_i(	au_k) 
e ho_j(	au_k)$, then every orthogonal $ U$ that diagonalizes all $ C_{ z}(	au_1), \dots,  C_{ z}(	au_K)$ satisfies $ U	ilde A = $ signed permutation, so $ U z$ recovers the sources up to sign and order. If some pair has $ho_i(	au_k) = ho_j(	au_k)$ for all $k$, these matrices cannot separate sources $i$ and $j$ (Belouchrani et al., 1997). 设各源均值为零、宽平稳，在任何时滞下互不相关，自协方差为 $ho_i(	au)$，$ho_i(0) = 1$，并设 $ z = 	ilde A s$ 为白化数据。若对每一对 $i 
e j$，在所选的时滞集合中都存在某个 $	au_k$ 使 $ho_i(	au_k) 
e ho_j(	au_k)$，则任何能对角化全部 $ C_{ z}(	au_1), \dots,  C_{ z}(	au_K)$ 的正交矩阵 $ U$ 都满足 $ U	ilde A$ 为带符号的置换矩阵，从而 $ U z$ 在符号与顺序意义下恢复各源。若存在一对源，使得对所有 $k$ 都有 $ho_i(	au_k) = ho_j(	au_k)$，则这些矩阵无法分离源 $i$ 与源 $j$（Belouchrani et al., 1997）。 By and whitening, $ C_{ z}(	au_k) = 	ilde A\,\diag(ho_1(	au_k), \dots, ho_n(	au_k))\,	ilde A^	op$ with $	ilde A$ orthogonal. Apply with $\lambda_{ki} = ho_i(	au_k)$, in both directions. 由 并经白化，$ C_{ z}(	au_k) = 	ilde A\,\diag(ho_1(	au_k), \dots, ho_n(	au_k))\,	ilde A^	op$，其中 $	ilde A$ 为正交矩阵。取 $\lambda_{ki} = ho_i(	au_k)$，从两个方向应用 即可。 Two consequences stand out. Gaussian sources, any number of them, are separable as soon as their autocorrelation functions differ, which is the case whenever their normalized power spectra differ, since the spectrum and the autocovariance determine each other. And i.i.d. sources are never separable by SOBI, since $ho_i(	au) = 0$ for all $	au 
e 0$ and every $i$. Second-order methods and the methods of Chapters 7, 8 and this chapter's first half are thus complementary: one needs temporal structure, the other non-Gaussianity. 有两个推论特别值得注意。第一，任意多个高斯源，只要它们的自相关函数不同，就是可分离的；由于功率谱与自协方差相互唯一确定，只要归一化功率谱不同，这一条件就成立。第二，独立同分布的源永远无法用 SOBI 分离，因为对所有 $	au 
e 0$ 和每个 $i$ 都有 $ho_i(	au) = 0$。因此二阶方法与第 7、8 章以及本章前半部分的方法是互补的：前者需要时间结构，后者需要非高斯性。 The script below continues the previous one. It generates three Gaussian sources: an AR(1) process with coefficient 0.5, so $ho_1(	au) = 0.5^	au$; a moving average $s_2(t) = e(t) + e(t - 1)$ of white noise, so $ho_2(1) = 0.5$ and $ho_2(	au) = 0$ for $	au \ge 2$; and an AR(1) process with coefficient $-0.8$. The first two have the same autocorrelation at lag 1 and differ at lag 2 ( (a)). 下面的脚本接着上一个脚本。它生成三个高斯源：系数为 0.5 的 AR(1) 过程，故 $ho_1(	au) = 0.5^	au$；白噪声的滑动平均 $s_2(t) = e(t) + e(t - 1)$，故 $ho_2(1) = 0.5$，且 $	au \ge 2$ 时 $ho_2(	au) = 0$；以及系数为 $-0.8$ 的 AR(1) 过程。前两个源在时滞 1 处的自相关相同，在时滞 2 处不同（ （a））。 The output is 输出为 AMUSE recovers the third source but leaves the first two mixed: in their plane its rotation is decided by sampling noise, so the leakage changes from run to run (over ten random seeds, its largest entry ranged from 0.05 to 0.86). SOBI separates all three, with leakage of at most 0.04 over the same ten seeds. JADE fails, as it must: all three sources are Gaussian and every fourth-order cumulant is zero up to sampling error. AMUSE 恢复了第三个源，但前两个源仍混在一起：在它们张成的平面内，旋转由抽样噪声决定，所以泄漏量每次运行都不同（在十个随机种子下，其最大泄漏元素在 0.05 到 0.86 之间）。SOBI 把三个源全部分离，在同样十个种子下泄漏至多为 0.04。JADE 失败了，这是必然的：三个源都是高斯的，所有四阶累积量在抽样误差范围内都为零。 (a) Autocorrelation functions of the three Gaussian sources of the example: $ho_1(	au) = 0.5^	au$, $ho_2(1) = 0.5$ and $ho_2(	au) = 0$ for $	au \ge 2$, $ho_3(	au) = (-0.8)^	au$. Sources 1 and 2 agree at lag 1 (dotted line), so AMUSE with $	au = 1$ cannot separate them, but they differ at lag 2, which SOBI exploits. (b) The criterion $\mathcal{C}$ of for the five whitened lagged covariances of the example, as a function of the angle of a rotation in the $(1, 2)$ plane: a constant minus a sinusoid of period $\pi/2$, minimized at the closed-form angle $	heta^\star$ of . The minimum is not zero because this rotation does not change the off-diagonal energy outside positions $(1, 2)$ and $(2, 1)$. （a）例子中三个高斯源的自相关函数：$ho_1(	au) = 0.5^	au$；$ho_2(1) = 0.5$，$	au \ge 2$ 时 $ho_2(	au) = 0$；$ho_3(	au) = (-0.8)^	au$。源 1 与源 2 在时滞 1 处相同（点线），所以 $	au = 1$ 的 AMUSE 无法分离它们；但它们在时滞 2 处不同，SOBI 正是利用了这一点。（b）例子中五个白化时滞协方差的准则 $\mathcal{C}$（ ）作为 $(1, 2)$ 平面内旋转角的函数：它是一个常数减去周期为 $\pi/2$ 的正弦曲线，在 的闭式角 $	heta^\star$ 处取最小值。最小值不为零，是因为这一旋转不改变 $(1, 2)$、$(2, 1)$ 位置以外的非对角能量。

Fourth-order cumulants of Gaussian noise vanish, so the cumulant matrices of $ x =  A s +  n$ with Gaussian $ n$ independent of $ s$ are those of $ A s$; population lagged covariances at $	au 
e 0$ are unaffected by temporally uncorrelated noise that is also uncorrelated with the signal at every relevant lag. These population invariances do not remove finite-sample noise variance. In both cases the whitening step, which uses $ C_{ x}(0) =  A A^	op +  C_{ n}$, is biased by the noise; with more sensors than sources the bias can be reduced as described in . The methods can also be combined, for example by jointly diagonalizing cumulant matrices and lagged covariances together, when the sources are both non-Gaussian and temporally structured. 噪声对这两类方法的影响方式相似。高斯噪声的四阶累积量为零，所以当 $ n$ 为高斯且与 $ s$ 独立时，$ x =  A s +  n$ 的累积量矩阵与 $ A s$ 的相同；在时间上不相关、且在所有相关时滞处均与信号不相关的噪声，不影响 $	au 
e 0$ 处的总体时滞协方差。这些总体不变性并不消除有限样本中的噪声方差。两种情形下白化步骤都会受噪声影响而产生偏差，因为它用到 $ C_{ x}(0) =  A A^	op +  C_{ n}$；当传感器多于源时，可以按 所述减小这一偏差。当源既是非高斯的又有时间结构时，两类方法还可以结合起来，例如把累积量矩阵与时滞协方差放在一起作联合对角化。

en: Tensor and Second-Order Methods: JADE and SOBI
zh: 张量方法与二阶方法：JADE 与 SOBI
sectionZh: 从可辨识性到可靠的对角化
text: Measure the separation between joint signatures. The uniqueness theorem requires the vectors $\boldsymbol{\lambda}_i=(\lambda_{1i},\ldots,\lambda_{Ki})$ to be distinct. Distinct but nearly equal vectors still give a poorly conditioned problem. At an exactly diagonal solution, a small rotation by $\theta$ in the $(i,j)$ plane creates off-diagonal energy 量化联合特征之间的距离。 唯一性定理要求向量 $\boldsymbol{\lambda}_i=(\lambda_{1i},\ldots,\lambda_{Ki})$ 互不相同，但不同却极接近的向量仍会使问题病态。在精确对角解附近，$(i,j)$ 平面内一个小角度 $\theta$ 产生的非对角能量为 $$\mathcal C(\theta)-\mathcal C(0)=\tfrac12\sin^2(2\theta)\sum_{r=1}^K(\lambda_{ri}-\lambda_{rj})^2=2\theta^2\|\boldsymbol{\lambda}_i-\boldsymbol{\lambda}_j\|^2+O(\theta^4).$$ Thus signature gaps control local curvature: when the gap is small, small estimation errors can cause a large rotation. For SOBI inspect estimated autocorrelation signatures across the chosen lags, not just the final diagonality score. Adding lags that distinguish a difficult pair helps; adding many long lags with small correlations and few available products can instead increase estimation noise. Choosing lags on held-out or simulated data with comparable temporal structure is more informative than maximizing the number of matrices. 因此联合特征间距控制局部曲率：间距很小时，微小估计误差就可能造成大的旋转。对 SOBI，应查看所选滞后上的估计自相关特征，而不只看最终的对角化分数。加入能区分困难源对的滞后有帮助；加入大量相关性小、可用乘积样本少的长滞后，反而可能增加估计噪声。用留出数据或时间结构相近的模拟数据选择滞后，比单纯追求矩阵数量更有意义。 Keep population and sample claims separate. Wide-sense stationarity specifies the covariance model but does not alone guarantee that time averages estimate ensemble covariances. Consistency also needs an appropriate ergodicity or law-of-large-numbers condition, and uncertainty estimates need stronger dependence and moment control. The displayed sample lag matrices are only approximately jointly diagonalizable; symmetrizing an estimate does not remove its sampling error. In the code, all zero-lag moments now use $1/T$, matching the cumulant subtraction of identity covariance. 区分总体与样本结论。 宽平稳性规定协方差模型，却不单独保证时间平均能够估计总体协方差。相合性还需要适当的遍历性或大数定律条件；不确定性估计需要更强的依赖与矩条件。样本滞后矩阵只近似联合可对角化；将估计矩阵对称化并不会消除抽样误差。代码中的所有零滞后矩现在统一使用 $1/T$，与减去单位协方差的累积量公式一致。 Check what a small criterion means. It can indicate successful separation, weak or absent identifying statistics, or several indistinguishable sources. All-zero Gaussian cumulant matrices give a perfect score for every rotation. Use the signature gaps, variability across resamples and sensitivity to lag sets or cumulant choices together. The unmixing matrix returned by the examples must be applied to data centered with the fitted training mean. For weighted joint diagonalization $\sum_r\omega_r\|\offdiag(\bU\bQ_r\bU^\top)\|_F^2$ with fixed positive $\omega_r$, apply the same algorithm to $\sqrt{\omega_r}\bQ_r$; different weights change finite-sample tradeoffs and should be recorded. 解释很小的准则值。 它可能表示分离成功，也可能表示识别统计量很弱、完全不存在，或多个源不可区分。全零的高斯累积量矩阵会使每个旋转都得到完美分数。应结合联合特征间距、重抽样变异性，以及对滞后集合或累积量选择的敏感性判断。示例返回的解混矩阵须应用于减去训练均值的数据。对固定正权重 $\omega_r$ 的加权联合对角化 $\sum_r\omega_r\|\offdiag(\bU\bQ_r\bU^\top)\|_F^2$，把同一算法用于 $\sqrt{\omega_r}\bQ_r$ 即可；权重会改变有限样本的权衡，应记录其取值。 Noise invariance is not noise immunity. Independent Gaussian noise has zero fourth cumulants, and temporally white noise independent of the signal has zero nonzero-lag covariance, but noise still affects whitening and the variance of estimated matrices. Naive orthogonal joint diagonalization after noisy covariance whitening need not recover the correct signal rotation. Use a justified noise model and, when available, corrected signal covariance as in ; multiple sensors alone do not remove arbitrary colored noise. 对噪声的不变性不等于不受噪声影响。 独立高斯噪声的四阶累积量为零，与信号独立的时间白噪声在非零滞后处的协方差为零，但噪声仍影响白化和估计矩阵的方差。在含噪协方差白化之后直接做正交联合对角化，未必能恢复正确的信号旋转。应使用有依据的噪声模型，并在可行时采用 中的信号协方差校正；传感器多本身不能消除任意有色噪声。 Key points 本章要点 After whitening, any statistic of the form $\tilde\bA\bLambda\tilde\bA^\top$ with distinct diagonal entries reveals $\tilde\bA$ through its eigenvectors; jointly diagonalizing many such matrices removes the need for distinct eigenvalues in any single one. The fourth-order cumulant tensor of whitened data is $\sum_p\kappa_p\,\tilde\ba_p^{\otimes 4}$, and every cumulant matrix is $\tilde\bA\,\diag(\kappa_p\tilde\ba_p^\top\bM\tilde\ba_p)\,\tilde\bA^\top$. FOBI uses $\bM = \bI$ and needs distinct kurtoses; JADE uses all cumulant matrices and needs at most one zero kurtosis. Jacobi sweeps minimize the off-diagonal energy one plane at a time with the closed-form angle $\theta^\star = \tfrac14\operatorname{atan2}(2g_{12}, g_{11} - g_{22})$; the criterion never increases, and a few sweeps suffice. Lagged covariances satisfy $\bC_{\bx}(\tau) = \bA\,\diag(\rho_i(\tau))\,\bA^\top$. SOBI separates the sources if and only if every pair is distinguished by some lag in the set, so Gaussian sources with different spectra are separable and i.i.d. sources are not. JADE costs grow as $n^4$; SOBI is cheap. Cumulant methods and second-order methods rely on different structure and complement each other. 白化之后，任何形如 $\tilde\bA\bLambda\tilde\bA^\top$ 且对角元互不相同的统计量，都能通过其特征向量揭示 $\tilde\bA$；对许多这样的矩阵作联合对角化，就不再要求其中任何一个矩阵的特征值互不相同。 白化数据的四阶累积量张量为 $\sum_p\kappa_p\,\tilde\ba_p^{\otimes 4}$，每个累积量矩阵都等于 $\tilde\bA\,\diag(\kappa_p\tilde\ba_p^\top\bM\tilde\ba_p)\,\tilde\bA^\top$。FOBI 取 $\bM = \bI$，要求峭度互不相同；JADE 使用全部累积量矩阵，只要求至多一个峭度为零。 Jacobi 扫描逐个平面地最小化非对角能量，所用闭式角为 $\theta^\star = \tfrac14\operatorname{atan2}(2g_{12}, g_{11} - g_{22})$；准则从不增加，几次扫描就够了。 时滞协方差满足 $\bC_{\bx}(\tau) = \bA\,\diag(\rho_i(\tau))\,\bA^\top$。SOBI 能分离各源，当且仅当每一对源都能被所选集合中的某个时滞区分；因此谱不同的高斯源可以分离，而独立同分布的源不能。 JADE 的计算量按 $n^4$ 增长；SOBI 则很便宜。累积量方法与二阶方法依赖不同的结构，相互补充。 Before the exercises 开始习题前 JADE uses fourth-order structure; SOBI uses temporal covariance. Look for distinct joint signatures, not merely many matrices. Separate numerical diagonality from statistical identifiability. JADE 用四阶结构，SOBI 用时间协方差。 寻找不同的联合特征，而不只是堆积矩阵。 区分数值上的对角化与统计上的可辨识性。 Start with the AR-source exercise , then the FOBI exercise . Try the single-matrix Jacobi exercise before the eigenmatrix proof. 先做 AR 源习题 ，再做 FOBI 习题 ；读特征矩阵证明前，先尝试 单矩阵 Jacobi 习题 。

en: Tensor and Second-Order Methods: JADE and SOBI
zh: 张量方法与二阶方法：JADE 与 SOBI
text: (a) Show that for two unit-variance Laplace sources $\bQ_{\bz}(\bI) = 3\bI$, and conclude that FOBI cannot separate them. (b) Why does FOBI succeed for one uniform and one Laplace source? (c) Does JADE separate two Laplace sources? （a）证明对两个单位方差的拉普拉斯源有 $\bQ_{\bz}(\bI) = 3\bI$，并由此说明 FOBI 无法分离它们。（b）为什么 FOBI 能分离一个均匀源和一个拉普拉斯源？（c）JADE 能否分离两个拉普拉斯源？ (a) $\bQ_{\bz}(\bI) = \tilde\bA\,\diag(3, 3)\,\tilde\bA^\top = 3\tilde\bA\tilde\bA^\top = 3\bI$. Every orthogonal $\bU$ gives $\bU(3\bI)\bU^\top = 3\bI$, which is diagonal, so the matrix carries no information about the rotation (this is the converse part of ). (b) Then $\bQ_{\bz}(\bI) = \tilde\bA\,\diag(-1.2, 3)\,\tilde\bA^\top$ has distinct eigenvalues, and its unit eigenvectors are $\pm$ the columns of $\tilde\bA$. (c) Yes. Both kurtoses are nonzero, so by the maximizers of the JADE criterion are exactly the separating rotations. Concretely, $\bQ_{\bz}(\tilde\ba_1\tilde\ba_1^\top) = \tilde\bA\,\diag(3, 0)\,\tilde\bA^\top$ distinguishes the two sources. （a）$\bQ_{\bz}(\bI) = \tilde\bA\,\diag(3, 3)\,\tilde\bA^\top = 3\tilde\bA\tilde\bA^\top = 3\bI$。任何正交矩阵 $\bU$ 都给出对角阵 $\bU(3\bI)\bU^\top = 3\bI$，所以这个矩阵不含有关旋转的任何信息（这正是 的逆命题部分）。（b）此时 $\bQ_{\bz}(\bI) = \tilde\bA\,\diag(-1.2, 3)\,\tilde\bA^\top$ 的特征值互不相同，其单位特征向量就是 $\tilde\bA$ 的各列（相差正负号）。（c）能。两个峭度都不为零，由 ，JADE 准则的最大值点恰好是分离旋转。具体地，$\bQ_{\bz}(\tilde\ba_1\tilde\ba_1^\top) = \tilde\bA\,\diag(3, 0)\,\tilde\bA^\top$ 就能区分这两个源。 (a) Let $s(t) = a\,s(t - 1) + e(t)$ with $|a| < 1$ and white noise $e$ independent of the past of $s$, and let $s$ be stationary. Show that $\rho(\tau) = a^\tau$ for $\tau \ge 0$ (normalizing $\rho(0) = 1$). (b) For two such sources with $a_1 = 0.5$ and $a_2 = -0.5$, for which lags does AMUSE separate them? (c) What happens to SOBI when the sources are i.i.d.? （a）设 $s(t) = a\,s(t - 1) + e(t)$，$|a| < 1$，白噪声 $e$ 与 $s$ 的过去独立，且 $s$ 平稳。证明 $\tau \ge 0$ 时 $\rho(\tau) = a^\tau$（归一化使 $\rho(0) = 1$）。（b）对两个这样的源，$a_1 = 0.5$，$a_2 = -0.5$，AMUSE 在哪些时滞下能分离它们？（c）如果源是独立同分布的，SOBI 会怎样？ (a) For $\tau \ge 1$, multiply $s(t + \tau) = a\,s(t + \tau - 1) + e(t + \tau)$ by $s(t)$ and take expectations; $e(t + \tau)$ is independent of $s(t)$ and has zero mean, so $\rho(\tau) = a\,\rho(\tau - 1)$, and with $\rho(0) = 1$ this gives $\rho(\tau) = a^\tau$. (b) $\rho_1(\tau) = 0.5^\tau$ and $\rho_2(\tau) = (-0.5)^\tau$ are equal for even $\tau$ and opposite for odd $\tau$. AMUSE separates the sources with any odd lag and fails with every even lag; SOBI with the lags $\{1, 2\}$ works because lag 1 distinguishes the pair. (c) For i.i.d. sources $\rho_i(\tau) = 0$ for every $\tau \ne 0$, so all lagged covariance matrices vanish in the model. Every rotation diagonalizes them, no pair is distinguished, and SOBI returns an arbitrary rotation of the whitened data. （a）对 $\tau \ge 1$，把 $s(t + \tau) = a\,s(t + \tau - 1) + e(t + \tau)$ 两边乘以 $s(t)$ 并取期望；$e(t + \tau)$ 与 $s(t)$ 独立且均值为零，所以 $\rho(\tau) = a\,\rho(\tau - 1)$，再由 $\rho(0) = 1$ 得 $\rho(\tau) = a^\tau$。（b）$\rho_1(\tau) = 0.5^\tau$ 与 $\rho_2(\tau) = (-0.5)^\tau$ 在 $\tau$ 为偶数时相等，为奇数时互为相反数。AMUSE 用任何奇数时滞都能分离这两个源，用任何偶数时滞都会失败；SOBI 取时滞 $\{1, 2\}$ 即可，因为时滞 1 能区分这一对。（c）对独立同分布的源，所有 $\tau \ne 0$ 都有 $\rho_i(\tau) = 0$，所以在模型中全部时滞协方差矩阵都为零。任何旋转都能对角化它们，没有一对源能被区分，SOBI 给出的只是白化数据的一个任意旋转。 Derive part (b) of from the definition of the fourth-order cumulant, and deduce that $\E[\|\bz\|^2\bz\bz^\top] = \tilde\bA\,\diag(\kappa_p + n + 2)\,\tilde\bA^\top$. Check the trace of both sides for Gaussian data. 由四阶累积量的定义推出 的（b），并推出 $\E[\|\bz\|^2\bz\bz^\top] = \tilde\bA\,\diag(\kappa_p + n + 2)\,\tilde\bA^\top$。对高斯数据检验两边的迹。 For whitened zero-mean $\bz$, $\cum(z_i, z_j, z_k, z_l) = \E[z_iz_jz_kz_l] - \delta_{ij}\delta_{kl} - \delta_{ik}\delta_{jl} - \delta_{il}\delta_{jk}$. Multiplying by $m_{kl}$ and summing over $k, l$: $\sum_{kl}m_{kl}\E[z_iz_jz_kz_l] = \E[z_iz_j\,\bz^\top\bM\bz]$, $\sum_{kl}m_{kl}\delta_{ij}\delta_{kl} = \delta_{ij}\tr\bM$, $\sum_{kl}m_{kl}\delta_{ik}\delta_{jl} = m_{ij}$ and $\sum_{kl}m_{kl}\delta_{il}\delta_{jk} = m_{ji}$, which is (b). With $\bM = \bI$, $\E[\|\bz\|^2\bz\bz^\top] = \bQ_{\bz}(\bI) + (n + 2)\bI = \tilde\bA\,\diag(\kappa_p)\,\tilde\bA^\top + (n + 2)\tilde\bA\tilde\bA^\top$, as claimed. For Gaussian $\bz \sim \Ncal(\bzero, \bI)$ all $\kappa_p = 0$; the trace of the right side is $n(n + 2)$, and the left side has trace $\E\|\bz\|^4 = \E[(\chi^2_n)^2] = \Var(\chi^2_n) + n^2 = 2n + n^2$, in agreement. 对白化的零均值 $\bz$，有 $\cum(z_i, z_j, z_k, z_l) = \E[z_iz_jz_kz_l] - \delta_{ij}\delta_{kl} - \delta_{ik}\delta_{jl} - \delta_{il}\delta_{jk}$。乘以 $m_{kl}$ 并对 $k, l$ 求和：$\sum_{kl}m_{kl}\E[z_iz_jz_kz_l] = \E[z_iz_j\,\bz^\top\bM\bz]$，$\sum_{kl}m_{kl}\delta_{ij}\delta_{kl} = \delta_{ij}\tr\bM$，$\sum_{kl}m_{kl}\delta_{ik}\delta_{jl} = m_{ij}$，$\sum_{kl}m_{kl}\delta_{il}\delta_{jk} = m_{ji}$，这就是（b）。取 $\bM = \bI$，得 $\E[\|\bz\|^2\bz\bz^\top] = \bQ_{\bz}(\bI) + (n + 2)\bI = \tilde\bA\,\diag(\kappa_p)\,\tilde\bA^\top + (n + 2)\tilde\bA\tilde\bA^\top$，即所求。对高斯数据 $\bz \sim \Ncal(\bzero, \bI)$，所有 $\kappa_p = 0$，右边的迹为 $n(n + 2)$；左边的迹为 $\E\|\bz\|^4 = \E[(\chi^2_n)^2] = \Var(\chi^2_n) + n^2 = 2n + n^2$，两者一致。 (a) Show that for a single symmetric matrix ($K = 1$) the angle makes the rotated entry $[\bQ']_{pq}$ zero and agrees with the classical rule $\tan2\theta = 2[\bQ]_{pq}/([\bQ]_{pp} - [\bQ]_{qq})$. (b) For general $K$, show that the part of $\mathcal{C}$ that depends on $\theta$ equals $c_0 - c_1\cos\bigl(4(\theta - \theta^\star)\bigr)$ with $c_1 \ge 0$, which explains the shape of (b). （a）证明对单个对称矩阵（$K = 1$），角度 使旋转后的元素 $[\bQ']_{pq}$ 为零，并且与经典规则 $\tan2\theta = 2[\bQ]_{pq}/([\bQ]_{pp} - [\bQ]_{qq})$ 一致。（b）对一般的 $K$，证明 $\mathcal{C}$ 中依赖于 $\theta$ 的部分等于 $c_0 - c_1\cos\bigl(4(\theta - \theta^\star)\bigr)$，其中 $c_1 \ge 0$，这解释了 （b）的形状。 (a) Write $\mathbf{h} = (h_1, h_2) = \varrho(\cos\phi, \sin\phi)$ with $\varrho = \|\mathbf{h}\| > 0$. Then $(h_1^2 - h_2^2,\ 2h_1h_2) = \varrho^2(\cos2\phi, \sin2\phi)$, so gives $4\theta^\star \equiv 2\phi$, that is, $2\theta^\star \equiv \phi \pmod{\pi}$ and $\mathbf{v} = (\cos2\theta^\star, \sin2\theta^\star) = \pm\mathbf{h}/\varrho$. This is $\tan2\theta^\star = h_2/h_1 = \beta/\alpha$, and $\beta' = 2[\bQ']_{pq} = \mathbf{h}^\top\mathbf{v}^\perp = 0$ because $\mathbf{v}^\perp = (-\sin2\theta^\star, \cos2\theta^\star)$ is orthogonal to $\mathbf{h}$. (b) The $\theta$-dependent part is $\tfrac12\sum_r(\|\mathbf{h}_r\|^2 - (\mathbf{h}_r^\top\mathbf{v})^2) = \tfrac12\tr\mathbf{G} - \tfrac12\mathbf{v}^\top\mathbf{G}\mathbf{v}$. Using the expansion of $\mathbf{v}^\top\mathbf{G}\mathbf{v}$ in the text, this is $\tfrac14(g_{11} + g_{22}) - \tfrac12\bigl[\tfrac12(g_{11} - g_{22})\cos4\theta + g_{12}\sin4\theta\bigr] = c_0 - c_1\cos(4\theta - 4\theta^\star)$ with $c_0 = \tfrac14(g_{11} + g_{22})$ and $c_1 = \tfrac12\sqrt{\tfrac14(g_{11} - g_{22})^2 + g_{12}^2} \ge 0$, where $4\theta^\star$ is the angle of the vector $(\tfrac12(g_{11} - g_{22}), g_{12})$, as in . The rest of $\mathcal{C}$ does not depend on $\theta$, so $\mathcal{C}(\theta)$ is a constant minus a sinusoid of period $\pi/2$ with its minimum at $\theta^\star$. （a）写 $\mathbf{h} = (h_1, h_2) = \varrho(\cos\phi, \sin\phi)$，其中 $\varrho = \|\mathbf{h}\| > 0$。则 $(h_1^2 - h_2^2,\ 2h_1h_2) = \varrho^2(\cos2\phi, \sin2\phi)$，所以由 得 $4\theta^\star \equiv 2\phi$，即 $2\theta^\star \equiv \phi \pmod{\pi}$，且 $\mathbf{v} = (\cos2\theta^\star, \sin2\theta^\star) = \pm\mathbf{h}/\varrho$。这就是 $\tan2\theta^\star = h_2/h_1 = \beta/\alpha$；又因 $\mathbf{v}^\perp = (-\sin2\theta^\star, \cos2\theta^\star)$ 与 $\mathbf{h}$ 正交，有 $\beta' = 2[\bQ']_{pq} = \mathbf{h}^\top\mathbf{v}^\perp = 0$。（b）依赖于 $\theta$ 的部分为 $\tfrac12\sum_r(\|\mathbf{h}_r\|^2 - (\mathbf{h}_r^\top\mathbf{v})^2) = \tfrac12\tr\mathbf{G} - \tfrac12\mathbf{v}^\top\mathbf{G}\mathbf{v}$。利用正文中 $\mathbf{v}^\top\mathbf{G}\mathbf{v}$ 的展开，它等于 $\tfrac14(g_{11} + g_{22}) - \tfrac12\bigl[\tfrac12(g_{11} - g_{22})\cos4\theta + g_{12}\sin4\theta\bigr] = c_0 - c_1\cos(4\theta - 4\theta^\star)$，其中 $c_0 = \tfrac14(g_{11} + g_{22})$，$c_1 = \tfrac12\sqrt{\tfrac14(g_{11} - g_{22})^2 + g_{12}^2} \ge 0$，而 $4\theta^\star$ 是向量 $(\tfrac12(g_{11} - g_{22}), g_{12})$ 的辐角，与 一致。$\mathcal{C}$ 的其余部分与 $\theta$ 无关，所以 $\mathcal{C}(\theta)$ 是一个常数减去周期为 $\pi/2$ 的正弦曲线，在 $\theta^\star$ 处取最小值。 Let $(\lambda_r, \bM_r)$, $r = 1, \dots, n(n + 1)/2$, be orthonormal eigenpairs of the self-adjoint map $\bM \mapsto \bQ_{\bz}(\bM)$ on symmetric matrices, computed from exact or from sample cumulants (both are fully symmetric in their four indices). Prove that for every orthogonal $\bU$ 设 $(\lambda_r, \bM_r)$，$r = 1, \dots, n(n + 1)/2$，是对称矩阵空间上自伴映射 $\bM \mapsto \bQ_{\bz}(\bM)$ 的标准正交特征对，可以由精确累积量或样本累积量算出（两者对四个下标都是完全对称的）。证明对每个正交矩阵 $\bU$ 有 $$\sum_{k,l}\bigl\|\diag\bigl(\bU\bQ_{kl}\bU^\top\bigr)\bigr\|^2 = \sum_r \lambda_r^2\,\bigl\|\diag\bigl(\bU\bM_r\bU^\top\bigr)\bigr\|^2,$$ and explain why, in the model, jointly diagonalizing $n$ weighted eigenmatrices is equivalent to jointly diagonalizing all $n^2$ cumulant matrices. 并解释为什么在模型中，联合对角化 $n$ 个加权特征矩阵与联合对角化全部 $n^2$ 个累积量矩阵是等价的。 Let $\bu_i$ be the $i$-th row of $\bU$, as a column vector, and $\bB_i = \bu_i\bu_i^\top$, a symmetric matrix. Then $[\bU\bQ_{kl}\bU^\top]_{ii} = \sum_{a,b}u_{ia}u_{ib}\cum(z_a, z_b, z_k, z_l) = \sum_{a,b}\cum(z_k, z_l, z_a, z_b)\,[\bB_i]_{ab} = [\bQ_{\bz}(\bB_i)]_{kl}$, using the symmetry of the cumulants in their indices. Hence $\sum_{k,l}[\bU\bQ_{kl}\bU^\top]_{ii}^2 = \|\bQ_{\bz}(\bB_i)\|_F^2$. Expanding $\bB_i = \sum_r\langle\bM_r, \bB_i\rangle\bM_r$ in the orthonormal eigenbasis gives $\bQ_{\bz}(\bB_i) = \sum_r\lambda_r\langle\bM_r, \bB_i\rangle\bM_r$, so $\|\bQ_{\bz}(\bB_i)\|_F^2 = \sum_r\lambda_r^2\langle\bM_r, \bB_i\rangle^2$. Finally $\langle\bM_r, \bB_i\rangle = \bu_i^\top\bM_r\bu_i = [\bU\bM_r\bU^\top]_{ii}$; summing over $i$ proves the identity. In the model, part (c) of says that at most $n$ eigenvalues are nonzero, with eigenmatrices $\tilde\ba_p\tilde\ba_p^\top$, so the right side contains $n$ terms and the two criteria coincide as functions of $\bU$. With sample cumulants the remaining eigenvalues are of the order of the sampling error, and discarding them is a small approximation that saves a factor of $n$ in the size of the problem. 设 $\bu_i$ 为 $\bU$ 的第 $i$ 行（写成列向量），$\bB_i = \bu_i\bu_i^\top$ 为对称矩阵。利用累积量对下标的对称性，$[\bU\bQ_{kl}\bU^\top]_{ii} = \sum_{a,b}u_{ia}u_{ib}\cum(z_a, z_b, z_k, z_l) = \sum_{a,b}\cum(z_k, z_l, z_a, z_b)\,[\bB_i]_{ab} = [\bQ_{\bz}(\bB_i)]_{kl}$。因此 $\sum_{k,l}[\bU\bQ_{kl}\bU^\top]_{ii}^2 = \|\bQ_{\bz}(\bB_i)\|_F^2$。在标准正交特征基下展开 $\bB_i = \sum_r\langle\bM_r, \bB_i\rangle\bM_r$，得 $\bQ_{\bz}(\bB_i) = \sum_r\lambda_r\langle\bM_r, \bB_i\rangle\bM_r$，所以 $\|\bQ_{\bz}(\bB_i)\|_F^2 = \sum_r\lambda_r^2\langle\bM_r, \bB_i\rangle^2$。最后 $\langle\bM_r, \bB_i\rangle = \bu_i^\top\bM_r\bu_i = [\bU\bM_r\bU^\top]_{ii}$；对 $i$ 求和即证得恒等式。在模型中， 的（c）表明至多有 $n$ 个特征值非零，对应的特征矩阵为 $\tilde\ba_p\tilde\ba_p^\top$，所以右边只有 $n$ 项，两个准则作为 $\bU$ 的函数完全相同。用样本累积量时，其余特征值与抽样误差同阶，舍去它们只是一个很小的近似，却使问题规模缩小为原来的 $1/n$。

en: Asymptotic Performance and the Cramér–Rao Bound
zh: 渐近性能与 Cramér–Rao 界
text: First pass 第一次读这一章 One sentence. A separation can look right yet retain small amounts of the other sources; this chapter measures those errors and explains how sampling limits accuracy. 一句话直觉。 分离结果看起来正确，仍可能残留其他源；本章量化这些误差，并解释抽样怎样限制精度。 By the end, you should be able to: 读完后，你应能： read a gain matrix after matching output order to source order; convert a leakage coefficient into a power ratio without confusing the two; distinguish a realized error, an average error and a Monte Carlo standard error. 先匹配输出与源的顺序，再读懂增益矩阵； 把泄漏系数换成功率比，而不把两者混淆； 区分一次实现的误差、平均误差与 Monte Carlo 标准误。 Route. Revisit the first separation example and finite-sample whitening . Read gain and ISR , then the simulation and valid uncertainty . The matrix asymptotics and Fisher-information proof can follow on a second pass. Consult the glossary for unfamiliar terms. 路线。 先回看 第一次分离示例 与 有限样本白化 。先读 增益与 ISR ，再读 模拟 与 有效的不确定性 。 矩阵渐近推导 和 Fisher 信息证明 可以第二遍再读；陌生术语可查 词汇表 。 Small calculation: amplitude is not power. In a simulation we know the mixing matrix $\bA$, so we can form $\bP=\bW\bA$. Suppose source order is already matched and $\bP=\bigl(\begin{smallmatrix}1&0.10\\0.05&1\end{smallmatrix}\bigr)$. The sources are independent with zero mean and unit variance. Unlike a simulation, an ordinary real-data decomposition does not reveal its true $\bA$. 手算：幅度不等于功率。 模拟中已知混合矩阵 $\bA$，因此能形成 $\bP=\bW\bA$。假设源顺序已经匹配，且 $\bP=\bigl(\begin{smallmatrix}1&0.10\\0.05&1\end{smallmatrix}\bigr)$。各源独立、零均值、单位方差。与模拟不同，普通真实数据分解不会告诉我们真实的 $\bA$。 The first output is $y_1=s_1+0.10s_2$. Desired-signal variance is $1^2=1$; interference variance is $0.10^2=0.01$. Its realized ISR is therefore 0.01, or 1%. The second output is $y_2=0.05s_1+s_2$, giving realized ISR $0.05^2=0.0025$, or 0.25%. The two leakage directions need not be equally accurate. These are errors of one fitted matrix. Averaging them over independently generated data sets estimates expected performance; one matrix alone does not establish an asymptotic variance. For scale, a regular estimator with asymptotic constant $V_g=2$ and the required moment convergence has approximate expected ISR $2/T$: 0.002 at $T=1000$ and 0.0005 at $T=4000$. This prediction concerns repeated-sample averages, not an exact identity for every run. 第一个输出为 $y_1=s_1+0.10s_2$。目标信号方差是 $1^2=1$，干扰方差是 $0.10^2=0.01$，所以这次实现的 ISR 为 0.01，即 1%。 第二个输出为 $y_2=0.05s_1+s_2$，这次的 ISR 为 $0.05^2=0.0025$，即 0.25%。两个泄漏方向的精度不必相同。 这些是一个拟合矩阵的误差。跨独立生成的数据集平均，才是在估计期望性能；单个矩阵不能确定渐近方差。 再看数量级：若正则估计量的渐近常数 $V_g=2$，并满足所需的矩收敛条件，则近似期望 ISR 为 $2/T$，在 $T=1000$ 时是 0.002，在 $T=4000$ 时是 0.0005。它预测重复抽样的平均表现，不是每次运行都满足的精确等式。 Quick check 1. Multiply the first row of the gain matrix by 3. What happens to its ISR? 自测 1。 把增益矩阵第一行乘以 3，其 ISR 会怎样变化？ Check the answer 查看答案 It is unchanged: the row becomes $(3,0.30)$ and the squared interference-to-signal coefficient ratio is $(0.30/3)^2=0.01$. Overall output scale is not separation quality. 不变。该行成为 $(3,0.30)$，干扰与信号系数比的平方仍为 $(0.30/3)^2=0.01$。整体输出尺度不是分离质量。 Quick check 2. With four times as many independent samples, does typical leakage amplitude become four times smaller? 自测 2。 独立样本量增至四倍，典型泄漏幅度会缩小到四分之一吗？ Check the answer 查看答案 Under the stated regular asymptotic regime and moment-convergence conditions, power error scales as $1/T$, while root-mean-square amplitude scales as $1/\sqrt T$. The respective factors are one quarter and one half. Dependence, weak identifiability or failures can invalidate this approximation. 在所述正则渐近条件与矩收敛条件下，功率误差按 $1/T$ 缩小，均方根幅度按 $1/\sqrt T$ 缩小，因此分别成为四分之一和二分之一。时间依赖、弱可辨识性或运行失败可能使这个近似失效。

en: Asymptotic Performance and the Cramér–Rao Bound
zh: 渐近性能与 Cramér–Rao 界
text: An ICA algorithm computes its estimate from a finite sample, so even when the model holds exactly, each output keeps a small amount of the other sources. The script of printed $\bW\bA \approx \bigl(\begin{smallmatrix} 0.03 & 1.00 \\ -1.00 & 0.02 \end{smallmatrix}\bigr)$: separation succeeded, but the entries $0.03$ and $0.02$ are not zero, and they would change with a new sample. This chapter quantifies such residual errors. How large are they? How do they depend on the sample size $T$, on the distributions of the sources and on the algorithm? Is there a limit that no algorithm can beat? ICA 算法的估计来自有限样本，所以即使模型完全成立，每个输出里仍会残留少量其他源的成分。 的脚本输出 $\bW\bA \approx \bigl(\begin{smallmatrix} 0.03 & 1.00 \\ -1.00 & 0.02 \end{smallmatrix}\bigr)$：分离成功了，但 $0.03$ 和 $0.02$ 这两个元素并不为零，换一组样本它们还会变。本章定量刻画这种残余误差：它有多大？它如何依赖于样本量 $T$、源的分布以及所用的算法？是否存在任何算法都无法突破的极限？ The answers are asymptotic: they describe the leading behaviour of the errors as $T \to \infty$, under regularity and identifiability conditions. Finite-sample accuracy must be checked, especially near Gaussianity or with heavy tails. Three facts organize the chapter. For the usual estimators the distribution of the errors does not depend on the mixing matrix ( ). The errors shrink like $1/\sqrt{T}$, with constants that can be computed in closed form; for one-unit FastICA the constant is the asymptotic variance $V_g$ of Hyvärinen (1997; 1999), and the best nonlinearity is the score function of the source ( ). Finally, the Cramér–Rao bound (Tichavský, Koldovský & Oja, 2006) gives a lower bound on the variance of regular unbiased estimators; it is governed by the Fisher information of the sources and the inverse-information formula breaks down when two sources are Gaussian ( ). 这些答案都是渐近的：它们描述 $T \to \infty$ 时误差的主导行为，并要求相应的正则性与可辨识性条件。有限样本精度需要检验，尤其是在接近高斯或尾部较重时。本章围绕三个事实展开。对常用的估计量，误差的分布与混合矩阵无关（ ）。误差以 $1/\sqrt{T}$ 的速度缩小，其常数可以写成闭式：对单单元 FastICA，这个常数就是 Hyvärinen（1997; 1999）给出的渐近方差 $V_g$，而最优的非线性函数是源的得分函数（ ）。最后，Cramér–Rao 界（Tichavský, Koldovský & Oja, 2006）给出正则无偏估计量方差的下界；它由源的 Fisher 信息决定，两个源都是高斯时信息矩阵变为奇异（ ）。 Throughout the chapter the model is square ($m = n$, $\bA$ invertible), the sources satisfy with zero mean and unit variance, and their densities $p_i$ are smooth enough for every expectation below to exist and for differentiation under the integral sign. The score function is $\psi_i = -p_i'/p_i$ and the Fisher information is $\mathcal{J}_i = \E[\psi_i^2(s_i)]$ ( ). One identity is used repeatedly. If $f$ is differentiable and $f(s)p(s) \to 0$ as $|s| \to \infty$, integration by parts gives $\int f'p\,ds = -\int fp'\,ds = \int f\psi p\,ds$, that is, 本章始终假设模型为方阵（$m = n$，$\bA$ 可逆），源满足 ，均值为零、方差为一，并且密度 $p_i$ 足够光滑，使下文出现的期望都存在，积分号下也可以求导。得分函数记为 $\psi_i = -p_i'/p_i$，Fisher 信息记为 $\mathcal{J}_i = \E[\psi_i^2(s_i)]$（ ）。有一个恒等式会反复用到：若 $f$ 可微，且 $|s| \to \infty$ 时 $f(s)p(s) \to 0$，则分部积分给出 $\int f'p\,ds = -\int fp'\,ds = \int f\psi p\,ds$，即 $$\E[f'(s)] = \E[\psi(s)\,f(s)].$$ With $f = 1$, $f(s) = s$ and $f = \psi$ it yields $\E[\psi(s)] = 0$, $\E[s\,\psi(s)] = 1$ and $\E[\psi'(s)] = \mathcal{J}$. For a standard Gaussian $\psi(s) = s$, so $\mathcal{J} = 1$; every other unit-variance law has $\mathcal{J} > 1$, because $\E[(\psi(s) - s)^2] = \mathcal{J} - 2 + 1 = \mathcal{J} - 1$ vanishes only when $\psi(s) = s$. 取 $f = 1$、$f(s) = s$ 和 $f = \psi$，依次得到 $\E[\psi(s)] = 0$、$\E[s\,\psi(s)] = 1$ 和 $\E[\psi'(s)] = \mathcal{J}$。标准高斯分布的 $\psi(s) = s$，因此 $\mathcal{J} = 1$；其他任何方差为一的分布都有 $\mathcal{J} > 1$，因为 $\E[(\psi(s) - s)^2] = \mathcal{J} - 2 + 1 = \mathcal{J} - 1$ 只在 $\psi(s) = s$ 时为零。

Order the outputs so that output $i$ estimates source $i$, and let $\hat D = \diag(\hat P_{11}, \dots, \hat P_{nn})$. The gain error is the matrix $ epsilon$ with zero diagonal defined by $\hat W$ 的 增益矩阵 是 $\hat P = \hat W A$，于是输出为 $\hat y = \hat P s$。把输出排好顺序，使第 $i$ 个输出估计第 $i$ 个源，并记 $\hat D = \diag(\hat P_{11}, \dots, \hat P_{nn})$。 增益误差 是对角元为零的矩阵 $ epsilon$，定义为 $$\hat D^{-1}\hat P =  I +  epsilon, \qquad \varepsilon_{ij} =  rac{\hat P_{ij}}{\hat P_{ii}} \quad (i
