e i}\varepsilon_{ij}s_j igr)$：除掉无法恢复的尺度 $\hat P_{ii}$ 之后，$\varepsilon_{ij}$ 就是源 $j$ 漏进源 $i$ 的估计中的分量。完全分离意味着 $ epsilon =  zero$。 The interference-to-signal ratio of source $j$ in output $i$ is $\mathrm{ISR}_{ij} = \E[\varepsilon_{ij}^2]$, $i 
e j$, where the expectation is over the random sample. The total ISR of output $i$ is $\sum_{j 
e i}\mathrm{ISR}_{ij}$. 源 $j$ 在输出 $i$ 中的 干扰信号比 （ISR）定义为 $\mathrm{ISR}_{ij} = \E[\varepsilon_{ij}^2]$（$i 
e j$），期望对随机样本求取。输出 $i$ 的总 ISR 为 $\sum_{j 
e i}\mathrm{ISR}_{ij}$。 Because the sources have unit variance, $\varepsilon_{ij}^2$ is the ratio of the power that source $j$ contributes to output $i$ to the power of the wanted source in that output. ISRs are often quoted in decibels, $10\log_{10}\mathrm{ISR}$; the reciprocal is the signal-to-interference ratio (SIR). In a simulation $ A$ is known, so $ epsilon$ can be computed in every run and the ISR estimated by averaging $\varepsilon_{ij}^2$ over runs. For the estimators of this chapter, $\sqrt{T}\,\varepsilon_{ij}$ converges in distribution to a normal law with mean zero and some variance $v_{ij}$, the asymptotic variance . As is customary, we then use $\mathrm{ISR}_{ij} \approx v_{ij}/T$, replacing the exact mean square by its asymptotic value; checks this approximation numerically. The constant $v_{ij}$ measures the statistical efficiency of a method independently of $T$. 由于源的方差为一，$\varepsilon_{ij}^2$ 就是源 $j$ 在输出 $i$ 中贡献的功率与目标源功率之比。ISR 常以分贝表示，即 $10\log_{10}\mathrm{ISR}$；其倒数是信干比（SIR）。做模拟时 $ A$ 已知，因此每次运行都能算出 $ epsilon$，再对多次运行的 $\varepsilon_{ij}^2$ 求平均即可估计 ISR。对本章讨论的估计量，$\sqrt{T}\,\varepsilon_{ij}$ 依分布收敛到均值为零、方差为某个 $v_{ij}$ 的正态分布，$v_{ij}$ 称为 渐近方差 。按惯例，我们用 $\mathrm{ISR}_{ij} \approx v_{ij}/T$，即以渐近值代替精确的均方； 用数值方法检验这一近似。常数 $v_{ij}$ 衡量的是方法本身的统计效率，与 $T$ 无关。 Why the mixing matrix does not matter 为什么混合矩阵无关紧要 Most ICA estimators are defined by equations that involve the data only through the outputs. Maximum likelihood and Infomax solve $\hat\E[ phi( y) y^	op] =  I$; the fixed points of FastICA satisfy whitening and fixed-point conditions on $ y$; JADE optimizes cumulants of $ y$. Such estimators are equivariant (Cardoso & Laheld, 1996; see also ), and equivariance has a strong consequence for performance. 大多数 ICA 估计量由一组只通过输出依赖数据的方程定义。最大似然与 Infomax 求解 $\hat\E[ phi( y) y^	op] =  I$；FastICA 的不动点满足关于 $ y$ 的白化条件和不动点条件；JADE 优化的是 $ y$ 的累积量。这样的估计量具有 等变性 （Cardoso & Laheld, 1996；另见 ），而等变性对性能有一个很强的推论。 Suppose $\hat W$ solves equations $\mathbf{H}(\hat W X) =  zero$ that depend on the data matrix $ X$ only through the outputs $\hat W X$, and that when several solutions exist, the one returned is chosen by a rule that also depends only on the outputs. Then the gain matrix $\hat P = \hat W A$ obtained from $ X =  A S$ equals the estimate obtained from the sources $ S$ themselves. In particular, the distributions of $\hat P$, $ epsilon$ and every ISR are the same for all invertible $ A$. 设 $\hat W$ 是方程 $\mathbf{H}(\hat W X) =  zero$ 的解，这组方程只通过输出 $\hat W X$ 依赖数据矩阵 $ X$；若有多个解，则返回哪一个也只由输出决定。那么由 $ X =  A S$ 得到的增益矩阵 $\hat P = \hat W A$，等于直接用源 $ S$ 算出的估计。特别地，对所有可逆的 $ A$，$\hat P$、$ epsilon$ 以及每个 ISR 的分布都相同。 Let $ W_{ S}$ be the solution returned for the data $ S$. The matrix $ W_{ S} A^{-1}$ produces from $ X =  A S$ exactly the same outputs, $( W_{ S} A^{-1})( A S) =  W_{ S} S$, so it solves the equations for $ X$ and is the one returned. Hence $\hat W( A S) = \hat W( S)\, A^{-1}$ and $\hat P = \hat W( S)$, which does not involve $ A$. 记 $ W_{ S}$ 为对数据 $ S$ 返回的解。矩阵 $ W_{ S} A^{-1}$ 作用于 $ X =  A S$ 时给出完全相同的输出，$( W_{ S} A^{-1})( A S) =  W_{ S} S$，因此它是关于 $ X$ 的方程的解，而且就是被返回的那一个。于是 $\hat W( A S) = \hat W( S)\, A^{-1}$，从而 $\hat P = \hat W( S)$，与 $ A$ 无关。 Simulation studies can therefore take $ A =  I$ without loss of generality, and an ill-conditioned mixing matrix does not by itself make an equivariant estimator less accurate. What can depend on $ A$ is the path of an iterative algorithm that is not itself equivariant, such as plain gradient ascent with a fixed step size, and the numerical round-off when $ A$ is nearly singular. 因此，模拟研究可以不失一般性地取 $ A =  I$；混合矩阵病态本身也不会降低等变估计量的精度。可能依赖于 $ A$ 的，是本身不具等变性的迭代算法的收敛路径（例如固定步长的普通梯度上升），以及 $ A$ 接近奇异时的数值舍入误差。

en: Asymptotic Performance and the Cramér–Rao Bound
zh: 渐近性能与 Cramér–Rao 界
text:
The ISR requires the outputs to be matched to the sources and the scales to be removed. Amari, Cichocki and Yang (1996) proposed a single number that needs no matching of outputs to sources. It does depend on the scales of the outputs, which are therefore normalized first (see the invariance property below). For an $n 	imes n$ gain matrix $ P = (p_{ij})$, 计算 ISR 需要先把输出与源配对，并除去尺度。Amari、Cichocki 和 Yang（1996）提出了一个无需把输出与源配对的单一指标。不过它依赖于输出的尺度，因此要先把输出归一化（见下面的不变性）。对 $n 	imes n$ 的增益矩阵 $ P = (p_{ij})$，定义 $$E( P) = \sum_{i=1}^n\Bigl(\sum_{j=1}^n rac{|p_{ij}|}{\max_k|p_{ik}|} - 1\Bigr) + \sum_{j=1}^n\Bigl(\sum_{i=1}^n rac{|p_{ij}|}{\max_k|p_{kj}|} - 1\Bigr).$$ Its main properties follow directly from the definition. 它的主要性质可以直接从定义得出。 Zero exactly at separation. Each bracket is a sum of ratios in $[0, 1]$, one of which equals $1$, so it is nonnegative and vanishes exactly when its row (or column) has a single nonzero entry. Hence $E( P) \ge 0$, with equality if and only if $ P =  Pi D$ as in . Range. Each bracket is at most $n - 1$, so $0 \le E( P) \le 2n(n-1)$; the normalized index $E/(2n(n-1))$ lies in $[0, 1]$. Invariance. $E$ is unchanged by permutations of the rows or of the columns. A row bracket is unchanged when its row is rescaled and a column bracket when its column is rescaled, but rescaling a row changes the column brackets. In practice $E$ is computed after normalizing every output to unit variance, that is, every row of $\hat P$ to unit Euclidean norm (the sources having unit variance). Relation to the ISR. With the rows normalized and the outputs matched to the sources, $|\hat P_{ii}| = 1 + O(\| epsilon\|^2)$ and $E(\hat P) = 2\sum_{i 
e j}|\varepsilon_{ij}| + O(\| epsilon\|^2)$. If $\sqrt{T}\,\varepsilon_{ij}$ is approximately normal, $\E|\varepsilon_{ij}| \approx \sqrt{2\,\mathrm{ISR}_{ij}/\pi}$, so $\E[E(\hat P)] \approx 2\sqrt{2/\pi}\,\sum_{i 
e j}\sqrt{\mathrm{ISR}_{ij}}$. The Amari index decreases like $1/\sqrt{T}$, the ISR like $1/T$: halving the index takes four times as many samples. 恰在分离时为零。 每个括号都是若干个 $[0, 1]$ 中的比值之和，其中恰有一个等于 $1$，所以它非负，并且当且仅当该行（或该列）只有一个非零元时为零。因此 $E( P) \ge 0$，等号成立当且仅当 $ P =  Pi D$，与 一致。 取值范围。 每个括号至多为 $n - 1$，所以 $0 \le E( P) \le 2n(n-1)$；归一化指标 $E/(2n(n-1))$ 落在 $[0, 1]$ 中。 不变性。 对行或列作置换，$E$ 不变。某一行乘以常数时，该行的括号不变；某一列乘以常数时，该列的括号不变；但对行作缩放会改变各列的括号。实践中先把每个输出归一化为单位方差，即把 $\hat P$ 的每一行归一化为单位欧氏范数（源的方差为一），再计算 $E$。 与 ISR 的关系。 行归一化且输出与源配好对之后，$|\hat P_{ii}| = 1 + O(\| epsilon\|^2)$，并且 $E(\hat P) = 2\sum_{i 
e j}|\varepsilon_{ij}| + O(\| epsilon\|^2)$。若 $\sqrt{T}\,\varepsilon_{ij}$ 近似服从正态分布，则 $\E|\varepsilon_{ij}| \approx \sqrt{2\,\mathrm{ISR}_{ij}/\pi}$，于是 $\E[E(\hat P)] \approx 2\sqrt{2/\pi}\,\sum_{i 
e j}\sqrt{\mathrm{ISR}_{ij}}$。Amari 指标以 $1/\sqrt{T}$ 的速度下降，ISR 则以 $1/T$ 的速度下降：要把指标减半，需要四倍的样本。 Take the gain matrix printed in , $\hat P =  igl( egin{smallmatrix} 0.03 & 1.00 \ -1.00 & 0.02 \end{smallmatrix} igr)$, whose rows already have norm $1.00$ to two decimals. The row brackets are $0.03$ and $0.02$, the column brackets $0.03$ and $0.02$, so $E(\hat P) = 0.10$ and the normalized index is $0.025$. Output 1 estimates $s_2$ and output 2 estimates $s_1$. Reordering the outputs accordingly gives $\varepsilon_{12} = 0.02/(-1.00)$ (source 2 in the estimate of source 1) and $\varepsilon_{21} = 0.03/1.00$ (source 1 in the estimate of source 2). The realized interference-to-signal ratios are $\varepsilon_{12}^2 = 4 	imes 10^{-4}$ ($-34.0$ dB) and $\varepsilon_{21}^2 = 9 	imes 10^{-4}$ ($-30.5$ dB), and indeed $2(|\varepsilon_{12}| + |\varepsilon_{21}|) = 0.10 = E(\hat P)$. 取 中输出的增益矩阵 $\hat P =  igl( egin{smallmatrix} 0.03 & 1.00 \ -1.00 & 0.02 \end{smallmatrix} igr)$，保留两位小数时它的各行范数已经是 $1.00$。两个行括号分别是 $0.03$ 和 $0.02$，两个列括号也是 $0.03$ 和 $0.02$，所以 $E(\hat P) = 0.10$，归一化指标为 $0.025$。输出 1 估计的是 $s_2$，输出 2 估计的是 $s_1$。相应地重排输出，得到 $\varepsilon_{12} = 0.02/(-1.00)$（源 2 漏进源 1 的估计中）和 $\varepsilon_{21} = 0.03/1.00$（源 1 漏进源 2 的估计中）。这次实现的干扰信号比为 $\varepsilon_{12}^2 = 4 	imes 10^{-4}$（$-34.0$ dB）和 $\varepsilon_{21}^2 = 9 	imes 10^{-4}$（$-30.5$ dB），并且确有 $2(|\varepsilon_{12}| + |\varepsilon_{21}|) = 0.10 = E(\hat P)$。

Random sampling perturbs the residual; a small slope magnifies that perturbation. The theory of such M-estimators ( ; van der Vaart, 1998) states that if $ theta_0$ is an isolated root, $\mathbf{F}$ is smooth enough and $ M = \E[\partial\mathbf{F}/\partial theta^	op]$ is invertible at $ theta_0$, then the root $\hat theta$ near $ theta_0$ is consistent and 大多数 ICA 估计量都是 估计方程 $ rac{1}{T}\sum_{t=1}^T \mathbf{F}( x(t);  theta) =  zero$ 的解，其总体形式 $\E[\mathbf{F}( x;  theta)] =  zero$ 在真实参数 $ theta_0$ 处成立；这里 $ theta$ 由 $ W$ 的元素组成，$ theta_0$ 是一个分离矩阵。这类 M 估计量的理论（ ；van der Vaart, 1998）指出：若 $ theta_0$ 是孤立根，$\mathbf{F}$ 足够光滑，且 $ M = \E[\partial\mathbf{F}/\partial theta^	op]$ 在 $ theta_0$ 处可逆，则 $ theta_0$ 附近的根 $\hat theta$ 是相合的，并且 $$\sqrt{T}\,(\hat theta -  theta_0) \ \xrightarrow{d}\ \Ncal igl( zero,\  M^{-1} Sigma M^{-	op} igr), \qquad  Sigma = \E igl[\mathbf{F}( x;  theta_0)\,\mathbf{F}( x;  theta_0)^	op igr].$$ The argument is a first-order expansion, $ zero = \hat\E[\mathbf{F}( x; \hat theta)] \approx \hat\E[\mathbf{F}( x;  theta_0)] +  M(\hat theta -  theta_0)$, followed by the central limit theorem for $\hat\E[\mathbf{F}( x;  theta_0)]$. The errors are therefore of order $1/\sqrt{T}$ and the ISR of order $1/T$. For ICA the expansion has a special structure: it splits into separate $2 	imes 2$ problems, one for each pair of sources. 论证就是一阶展开 $ zero = \hat\E[\mathbf{F}( x; \hat theta)] \approx \hat\E[\mathbf{F}( x;  theta_0)] +  M(\hat theta -  theta_0)$，再对 $\hat\E[\mathbf{F}( x;  theta_0)]$ 应用中心极限定理。因此误差是 $1/\sqrt{T}$ 量级，ISR 是 $1/T$ 量级。对 ICA 而言，这个展开有特殊的结构：它分解为互不相干的若干个 $2 	imes 2$ 问题，每对源一个。 Let $\varphi_1, \dots, \varphi_n$ be differentiable nonlinearities, and let $\hat W$ solve 设 $\varphi_1, \dots, \varphi_n$ 是可微的非线性函数，$\hat W$ 满足 $$\hat\E[\varphi_i(y_i)\,y_j] = 0, \qquad i

There the error $ epsilon = \hat P -  I$ keeps its diagonal; dividing each row of $\hat P$ by its diagonal entry, as in , changes the off-diagonal entries only by $O_p(1/T)$, and centering changes $\hat C_{ s}$ only by $O_p(1/T)$. The rotation step can only reduce the antisymmetric part $\varepsilon_{ij} - \varepsilon_{ji}$; the symmetric part is set by the sampling error of the covariance. shows that the best possible estimator does better than this whenever both sources are non-Gaussian. 对“用样本协方差白化、再做旋转”的情形给出了同样的结果。那里的误差 $ epsilon = \hat P -  I$ 保留了对角元；像 那样把 $\hat P$ 的每一行除以其对角元，只在 $O_p(1/T)$ 量级上改变非对角元，而中心化也只在 $O_p(1/T)$ 量级上改变 $\hat C_{ s}$。旋转这一步只能减小反对称部分 $\varepsilon_{ij} - \varepsilon_{ji}$；对称部分由协方差的抽样误差决定。 将说明，只要两个源都非高斯，最优估计量都能做得比这更好。

One-unit FastICA ( ) centers the data, whitens them with the sample covariance, $ z = \hat V x$, and returns a unit vector $ w$ with $\hat\E[ z\,g( w^	op z)] = \lambda w$ for some scalar $\lambda$: the Lagrange condition for an extremum of $\hat\E[G( w^	op z)]$ on the sphere, which the update solves. Because the sources have zero mean, we first analyse the estimator without the centering step and then state what centering changes. Suppose the solution estimates source $i$, and write $y =  w^	op z =  q^	op s$ with $ q = (\hat V A)^	op w$, the row of the gain matrix that produces $y$. The gain errors of this output are $\varepsilon_k = q_k/q_i$, $k 
e i$. 单单元 FastICA（ ）先把数据中心化，再用样本协方差白化，$ z = \hat V x$，然后返回一个满足 $\hat\E[ z\,g( w^	op z)] = \lambda w$（$\lambda$ 为某个标量）的单位向量 $ w$：这是 $\hat\E[G( w^	op z)]$ 在球面上取极值的 Lagrange 条件，更新式 求解的正是它。由于源的均值为零，我们先分析不做中心化的估计量，再说明中心化带来的变化。设这个解估计的是源 $i$，记 $y =  w^	op z =  q^	op s$，其中 $ q = (\hat V A)^	op w$ 是增益矩阵中产生 $y$ 的那一行。这个输出的增益误差为 $\varepsilon_k = q_k/q_i$，$k 
e i$。 Assume a locally consistent root, differentiability and the usual uniform remainder control for the estimating equations, finite fourth source moments for sample whitening, and the finite second moments below. Let $\E[s_ig(s_i) - g'(s_i)] 
e 0$. For the solution $ w$ of $\hat\E[ z\,g( w^	op z)] = \lambda w$, $\| w\| = 1$, near the direction of source $i$, and for every $k 
e i$, $\sqrt{T}\,\varepsilon_k$ is asymptotically normal with mean zero and variance 假设存在局部相合根，估计方程满足可微性与通常的一致余项控制，样本白化所需的源四阶矩有限，下面的二阶矩有限，且 $\E[s_ig(s_i) - g'(s_i)] 
e 0$。对方程 $\hat\E[ z\,g( w^	op z)] = \lambda w$、$\| w\| = 1$ 在源 $i$ 方向附近的解 $ w$，以及每个 $k 
e i$，$\sqrt{T}\,\varepsilon_k$ 渐近服从均值为零的正态分布，方差为 $$V_g =  rac{\E[g^2(s_i)] -  igl(\E[s_i\,g(s_i)] igr)^2}{ igl(\E[s_i\,g(s_i) - g'(s_i)] igr)^2}.$$ The variance depends on the distribution of $s_i$ alone: not on the other sources and, by , not on $ A$ (Hyvärinen, 1997; 1999). If the data are centered with the sample mean before whitening, as in , the same holds with $\E[g^2(s_i)]$ in the numerator replaced by $\Var g(s_i) = \E[g^2(s_i)] - (\E[g(s_i)])^2$ (Wei, 2015). 这个方差只依赖于 $s_i$ 的分布：与其他源无关，并且由 ，也与 $ A$ 无关（Hyvärinen, 1997; 1999）。若像 那样在白化之前先用样本均值把数据中心化，结论不变，只需把分子中的 $\E[g^2(s_i)]$ 换成 $\Var g(s_i) = \E[g^2(s_i)] - (\E[g(s_i)])^2$（Wei, 2015）。 Source coordinates. With $ M = \hat V A$ we have $ z =  M s$ and $ M\hat C_{ s} M^	op =  I$, where $\hat C_{ s} = \hat\E[ s s^	op]$, because $\hat V$ whitens the sample. Since $ w =  M^{-	op} q$ and $ M^{-1} M^{-	op} = \hat C_{ s}$, multiplying the fixed-point condition by $ M^{-1}$ gives $\hat\E[ s\,g(y)] = \lambda\hat C_{ s} q = \lambda\hat\E[ s\,y]$, and the constraint becomes $\| w\|^2 =  q^	op\hat C_{ s} q = \hat\E[y^2] = 1$. 源坐标。 记 $ M = \hat V A$，则 $ z =  M s$，并且由于 $\hat V$ 把样本白化，$ M\hat C_{ s} M^	op =  I$，其中 $\hat C_{ s} = \hat\E[ s s^	op]$。由于 $ w =  M^{-	op} q$ 且 $ M^{-1} M^{-	op} = \hat C_{ s}$，把不动点条件左乘 $ M^{-1}$ 得 $\hat\E[ s\,g(y)] = \lambda\hat C_{ s} q = \lambda\hat\E[ s\,y]$，约束则化为 $\| w\|^2 =  q^	op\hat C_{ s} q = \hat\E[y^2] = 1$。 Expansion. Take $i = 1$ and write $ q = (1 + \delta) e_1 + \sum_{k \ge 2}\eta_k e_k$ with $\delta, \eta_k = O_p(T^{-1/2})$, so that $\varepsilon_k = \eta_k + O_p(T^{-1})$. For $k \ge 2$, expand both sides of the $k$-th equation around $y = s_1$ and replace the sample averages that multiply $\delta$ or $\eta_l$ by their expectations; since $\E[s_ks_lg'(s_1)] = \delta_{kl}\E[g'(s_1)]$ for $k, l \ge 2$ and $\E[s_ks_1g'(s_1)] = 0$, 展开。 取 $i = 1$，写 $ q = (1 + \delta) e_1 + \sum_{k \ge 2}\eta_k e_k$，其中 $\delta, \eta_k = O_p(T^{-1/2})$，于是 $\varepsilon_k = \eta_k + O_p(T^{-1})$。对 $k \ge 2$，把第 $k$ 个方程两边在 $y = s_1$ 处展开，并把乘以 $\delta$ 或 $\eta_l$ 的样本平均换成期望；由于对 $k, l \ge 2$ 有 $\E[s_ks_lg'(s_1)] = \delta_{kl}\E[g'(s_1)]$，且 $\E[s_ks_1g'(s_1)] = 0$，得到 $$ egin{aligned} \hat\E[s_k\,g(y)] &= \hat\E[s_k\,g(s_1)] + \eta_k\,\E[g'(s_1)] + o_p(T^{-1/2}), \ \hat\E[s_k\,y] &= \hat\E[s_ks_1] + \eta_k + o_p(T^{-1/2}). \end{aligned}$$ The first equation ($k = 1$) gives $\lambda 	o \mu = \E[s_1g(s_1)]$. Substituting, 第一个方程（$k = 1$）给出 $\lambda 	o \mu = \E[s_1g(s_1)]$。代入得 $$\eta_k igl(\mu - \E[g'(s_1)] igr) = \hat\E igl[s_k\, igl(g(s_1) - \mu s_1 igr) igr] + o_p(T^{-1/2}).$$ Limit. The right side is an average of i.i.d. zero-mean terms with variance $\E[s_k^2]\,\E[(g(s_1) - \mu s_1)^2] = \E[g^2(s_1)] - \mu^2$, using $\E[s_1g(s_1)] = \mu$ and $\E[s_1^2] = 1$. The central limit theorem and division by $\mu - \E[g'(s_1)]$ give the result. 取极限。 右边是独立同分布、均值为零的项的平均，其方差为 $\E[s_k^2]\,\E[(g(s_1) - \mu s_1)^2] = \E[g^2(s_1)] - \mu^2$，这里用到了 $\E[s_1g(s_1)] = \mu$ 和 $\E[s_1^2] = 1$。由中心极限定理并除以 $\mu - \E[g'(s_1)]$ 即得结论。 Centering. If the data are centered, the argument applies with $ s$ replaced by $ s -  ar s$, where $ ar s$ is the sample mean of the sources. To first order the only change is that $\hat\E[s_k\,g(s_1)]$ gains the term $- ar s_k\,\E[g(s_1)]$. Hence $g(s_1)$ is replaced by $g(s_1) - \E[g(s_1)]$ on the right side, and the variance becomes $\E[g^2(s_1)] - \mu^2 - (\E[g(s_1)])^2$. 中心化。 若先把数据中心化，只需把 $ s$ 换成 $ s -  ar s$，上述论证依然成立，其中 $ ar s$ 是源的样本均值。在一阶近似下，唯一的变化是 $\hat\E[s_k\,g(s_1)]$ 多出一项 $- ar s_k\,\E[g(s_1)]$。于是右边的 $g(s_1)$ 换成了 $g(s_1) - \E[g(s_1)]$，方差变为 $\E[g^2(s_1)] - \mu^2 - (\E[g(s_1)])^2$。 Three features of matter in practice. The denominator is the quantity $\E[s\,g(s) - g'(s)]$ that decides whether the source direction is an extremum of the FastICA contrast ( ); for a Gaussian source with $f = g$ gives $\E[s\,g(s)] = \E[g'(s)]$, so the regular variance formula is undefined and the nondegenerate fixed-point assumption fails (it can even have the indeterminate form $0/0$ for linear $g$). Second, $V_g$ does not change when $g$ is multiplied by a nonzero constant or when a multiple of $s$ is added to $g$: only the nonlinear part of $g$ matters. Third, the numerator equals $\E[(g(s) - \mu s)^2]$, the mean square of the part of $g(s)$ that a linear regression on $s$ does not explain. With centering the regression also contains a constant, so centering never increases $V_g$. The two versions agree when $\E[g(s)] = 0$, as for a symmetric source and an odd $g$; this is the case in all other examples of this chapter, including the simulations below, which center the data. For skewed sources they can differ appreciably: for the unit-variance exponential law shifted to zero mean (density $e^{-(s+1)}$ for $s \ge -1$) and $g = 	anh$, numerical quadrature gives $V_g = 3.75$ without centering and $3.14$ with it. lists $V_g$ for the three standard nonlinearities of FastICA. 有三个在实践中要紧的特点。其一，分母中的 $\E[s\,g(s) - g'(s)]$ 正是决定源方向是否为 FastICA 对比函数极值点的那个量（ ）；对高斯源，在 中取 $f = g$ 得 $\E[s\,g(s)] = \E[g'(s)]$，所以正则方差公式不适用，非退化不动点的假设失效（线性 $g$ 甚至会给出 $0/0$）。其二，把 $g$ 乘以非零常数，或给 $g$ 加上 $s$ 的倍数，$V_g$ 都不变：起作用的只是 $g$ 的非线性部分。其三，分子等于 $\E[(g(s) - \mu s)^2]$，即 $g(s)$ 中不能由 $s$ 的线性回归解释的部分的均方。做中心化时，回归中还多了一个常数项，所以中心化绝不会增大 $V_g$。当 $\E[g(s)] = 0$ 时（例如源分布对称而 $g$ 为奇函数），两种情形的结果相同；本章其余的例子都属于这种情形，包括下文先做中心化的模拟。对偏斜的源，两者可能相差不小：对平移到零均值的单位方差指数分布（$s \ge -1$ 时密度为 $e^{-(s+1)}$）并取 $g = 	anh$，数值积分给出不做中心化时 $V_g = 3.75$，做中心化时 $V_g = 3.14$。 列出了 FastICA 三个标准非线性函数的 $V_g$。 Asymptotic variance $V_g$ of one-unit FastICA for unit-variance sources, computed from by numerical quadrature, and the lower bound $1/(\mathcal{J} - 1)$ of . The hyperbolic secant density is $ rac12\operatorname{sech}(\pi s/2)$; densities of the other laws are in . The uniform density has bounded support, so $\mathcal{J}$ is not defined for it (see ). 单位方差源下单单元 FastICA 的渐近方差 $V_g$（由 经数值积分算得），以及 给出的下界 $1/(\mathcal{J} - 1)$。双曲正割分布的密度为 $ rac12\operatorname{sech}(\pi s/2)$；其余分布的密度见 。均匀分布的支撑集有界，$\mathcal{J}$ 对它无定义（见 ）。 Source law 源的分布 $\mathcal{J}$ $g(u) = 	anh u$ $g(u) = u\,e^{-u^2/2}$ $g(u) = u^3$ $1/(\mathcal{J} - 1)$ Laplace 拉普拉斯 $2$ $2.01$ $1.82$ $6.00$ $1.00$ hyperbolic secant 双曲正割 $\pi^2/8 \approx 1.234$ $4.43$ $4.37$ $9.00$ $4.28$ logistic 逻辑斯谛 $\pi^2/9 \approx 1.097$ $10.37$ $10.96$ $15.43$ $10.35$ uniform 均匀 — $0.69$ $0.71$ $0.43$ — No nonlinearity in the table is best for every law, and the cubic nonlinearity of kurtosis is the best for the uniform source but the worst for the three super-Gaussian ones. What is the best possible choice for a given source? 表中没有哪个非线性函数对所有分布都最好；峭度对应的三次函数对均匀源最好，对三个超高斯分布却最差。对给定的源，最好的选择是什么？ Let $s$ have unit variance and a density with score $\psi$ and Fisher information $1 < \mathcal{J} < \infty$, and let $g$ satisfy the conditions of together with $g(s)p(s) 	o 0$ as $|s| 	o \infty$. Then 设 $s$ 方差为一，其密度的得分函数为 $\psi$，Fisher 信息满足 $1 < \mathcal{J} < \infty$；又设 $g$ 满足 的条件，并且 $|s| 	o \infty$ 时 $g(s)p(s) 	o 0$。则 $$V_g \ \ge\  rac{1}{\mathcal{J} - 1},$$ with equality if and only if $g(s) = a\,\psi(s) + b\,s$ for constants $a 
e 0$ and $b$. In particular the score function itself is optimal, with $V_\psi = 1/(\mathcal{J} - 1)$. 等号成立当且仅当 $g(s) = a\,\psi(s) + b\,s$，其中 $a 
e 0$、$b$ 为常数。特别地，得分函数本身就是最优的，且 $V_\psi = 1/(\mathcal{J} - 1)$。 Let $\mu = \E[s\,g(s)]$ and $h(s) = g(s) - \mu s$, so that the numerator of is $\E[h^2]$. By , $\E[g'(s)] = \E[\psi(s)g(s)]$, hence $\E[s\,g(s) - g'(s)] = \E[(s - \psi(s))\,g(s)] = \E[(s - \psi(s))\,h(s)]$, where the last step uses $\E[(s - \psi(s))\,s] = 1 - 1 = 0$. By the Cauchy–Schwarz inequality, 令 $\mu = \E[s\,g(s)]$，$h(s) = g(s) - \mu s$，则 的分子为 $\E[h^2]$。由 ，$\E[g'(s)] = \E[\psi(s)g(s)]$，因此 $\E[s\,g(s) - g'(s)] = \E[(s - \psi(s))\,g(s)] = \E[(s - \psi(s))\,h(s)]$，最后一步用到了 $\E[(s - \psi(s))\,s] = 1 - 1 = 0$。由 Cauchy–Schwarz 不等式， $$ igl(\E[(s - \psi(s))\,h(s)] igr)^2 \le \E igl[(s - \psi(s))^2 igr]\,\E[h^2] = (\mathcal{J} - 1)\,\E[h^2],$$ which is . Equality holds if and only if $h$ is proportional to $s - \psi$, that is, $g = \mu s + c\,(s - \psi)$ with $c 
e 0$ ($c = 0$ makes $g$ linear and the denominator zero). For $g = \psi$: $\mu = 1$, the numerator is $\mathcal{J} - 1$ and the denominator $(1 - \mathcal{J})^2$. With centering, the numerator is $\E[h^2]$ for $h(s) = g(s) - \mu s - \E[g(s)]$; since $\E[s - \psi(s)] = 0$, the same argument gives the same bound, with equality if and only if $g(s) = a\,\psi(s) + b\,s + d$ for constants $a 
e 0$, $b$ and $d$, and $V_\psi$ is unchanged because $\E[\psi(s)] = 0$. 这就是 。等号成立当且仅当 $h$ 与 $s - \psi$ 成比例，即 $g = \mu s + c\,(s - \psi)$ 且 $c 
e 0$（$c = 0$ 时 $g$ 是线性的，分母为零）。当 $g = \psi$ 时，$\mu = 1$，分子为 $\mathcal{J} - 1$，分母为 $(1 - \mathcal{J})^2$。做中心化时，分子为 $\E[h^2]$，其中 $h(s) = g(s) - \mu s - \E[g(s)]$；由于 $\E[s - \psi(s)] = 0$，同样的论证给出同一个下界，等号成立当且仅当 $g(s) = a\,\psi(s) + b\,s + d$，其中 $a 
e 0$、$b$、$d$ 为常数；又因为 $\E[\psi(s)] = 0$，$V_\psi$ 不变。 In terms of the contrast, $g = G' = \psi$ means $G = -\log p$ up to scale and an added quadratic: the best one-unit contrast is minus the log-density of the source. The unit-variance hyperbolic secant law has score $ rac{\pi}{2}	anh(\pi s/2)$, so $	anh(au)$ with $a = \pi/2$ is optimal for it; with $a = 1$ the variance is $4.43$ instead of $4.28$. The Laplace score is $\sqrt2\,\sign(s)$; $	anh(au)$ approaches it as $a$ grows, and quadrature gives $V_g = 2.01$, $1.11$ and $1.04$ for $a = 1$, $10$ and $30$, approaching the bound $1$. For the kurtosis nonlinearity $g(u) = u^3$, becomes $(\E[s^6] - (\E[s^4])^2)/(\E[s^4] - 3)^2$, which involves the sixth moment; for the Laplace law it is six times the optimum. This is the asymptotic form of the robustness argument of . Since the density is unknown in practice, the optimum is approached either by robust general-purpose choices or by choosing for each component a nonlinearity adapted to its estimated distribution, as EFICA does ( ). 从对比函数的角度看，$g = G' = \psi$ 意味着在尺度和一个附加二次项的意义下 $G = -\log p$：最好的单单元对比函数就是源的负对数密度。单位方差双曲正割分布的得分函数为 $ rac{\pi}{2}	anh(\pi s/2)$，因此对它而言取 $a = \pi/2$ 的 $	anh(au)$ 是最优的；取 $a = 1$ 时方差为 $4.43$，而不是 $4.28$。拉普拉斯分布的得分函数为 $\sqrt2\,\sign(s)$，$a$ 增大时 $	anh(au)$ 逼近它；数值积分给出 $a = 1$、$10$、$30$ 时 $V_g$ 分别为 $2.01$、$1.11$ 和 $1.04$，逐渐趋于下界 $1$。对峭度对应的非线性函数 $g(u) = u^3$， 化为 $(\E[s^6] - (\E[s^4])^2)/(\E[s^4] - 3)^2$，其中出现了六阶矩；对拉普拉斯分布它是最优值的六倍。这正是 中稳健性论证的渐近形式。由于实践中密度未知，要接近最优，要么采用稳健的通用选择，要么像 EFICA 那样，根据每个成分估计出的分布为它选择相应的非线性函数（ ）。

en: Asymptotic Performance and the Cramér–Rao Bound
zh: 渐近性能与 Cramér–Rao 界
text: The script below estimates $T \cdot \mathrm{ISR}$ for one-unit FastICA on a Laplace source mixed with two uniform sources, for $g = \tanh$ and $g(u) = u^3$, and compares it with $V_g$ computed by Monte Carlo integration. Every run draws new sources and whitens with the sample covariance; the iteration starts at the true direction, so that the run measures the accuracy of the fixed point near source 1 rather than the chance of converging to another source. 下面的脚本对一个拉普拉斯源与两个均匀源的混合运行单单元 FastICA，分别取 $g = \tanh$ 和 $g(u) = u^3$，估计 $T \cdot \mathrm{ISR}$，并与用蒙特卡洛积分算出的 $V_g$ 比较。每次运行都重新抽取源，并用样本协方差白化；迭代从真实方向出发，因此测得的是源 1 附近那个不动点的精度，而不是收敛到其他源的概率。 The script prints 脚本输出 where $\pm$ is two standard errors of the Monte Carlo average (the exact values are $V_{\tanh} = 2.015$ and $V_{u^3} = 6$). For $\tanh$ prediction and observation agree. For $u^3$ the observed value is about $5\%$ low, just outside the Monte Carlo interval: the asymptotic formula neglects higher-order terms, and these are larger for $u^3$, whose fluctuations are driven by high moments of the source (the denominator involves the sample kurtosis, whose variance involves $\E[s^8]$, which equals $2520$ for the unit-variance Laplace law). repeats the experiment over a range of $T$ and for a uniform target. Over this finite range the curves approach their asymptotic reference values with Monte Carlo fluctuations; the Laplace/cubic combination retains a visible downward finite-sample bias at smaller $T$. The figure caption discloses two runs excluded for nonconvergence. 其中 $\pm$ 后面是蒙特卡洛平均的两倍标准误（精确值为 $V_{\tanh} = 2.015$ 和 $V_{u^3} = 6$）。对 $\tanh$，预测与观测一致。对 $u^3$，观测值约低 $5\%$，略超出蒙特卡洛区间：渐近公式忽略了高阶项，而对 $u^3$ 这些项更大，因为它的波动由源的高阶矩驱动（分母涉及样本峭度，其方差又涉及 $\E[s^8]$，对单位方差拉普拉斯分布这个值为 $2520$）。 在一系列 $T$ 上重复了这一实验，并加入以均匀源为目标的情形。在这一有限范围内，各曲线伴随 Monte Carlo 波动而接近各自的渐近参考值；样本较小时，拉普拉斯源与三次函数组合仍存在明显的向下有限样本偏差。图注披露了两次因未收敛而被排除的运行。 $T \cdot \mathrm{ISR}$ of one-unit FastICA against the sample size, for a Laplace source mixed with a uniform one (a) and a uniform source mixed with a Laplace one (b), with three nonlinearities. Each configuration attempts 1500 independent runs initialized at the true target direction, so this is a local-error experiment. Markers are conditional averages over runs that satisfy the sign-invariant tolerance $10^{-12}$ within 200 iterations and whose target has the larger absolute gain. At $T=500$ in panel (b), $\tanh$ and $u^3$ each retain 1499 runs: one run per method reached the iteration limit. Every other point retains all 1500; there are no converged wrong-target or numerical failures. Bars are $\pm 2$ Monte Carlo standard errors, computed with sample standard deviation (ddof=1); they are not formal 95% confidence intervals. The generator logs the counts for every point; dashed lines: $V_g$ from ; dotted line in (a): the optimum $1/(\mathcal{J} - 1) = 1$ for the Laplace source. 单单元 FastICA 的 $T \cdot \mathrm{ISR}$ 随样本量的变化：（a）拉普拉斯源与一个均匀源混合，（b）均匀源与一个拉普拉斯源混合，各用三种非线性函数。每种配置独立尝试 1500 次，初值设在真实目标方向，因此这是局部误差实验。标记是在 200 次迭代内达到符号不变容差 $10^{-12}$，且目标绝对增益大于另一源的运行上的条件平均。在（b）中 $T=500$ 时，$\tanh$ 与 $u^3$ 各保留 1499 次：两种方法各有一次耗尽迭代上限。其他点均保留全部 1500 次，没有已收敛却恢复错目标或数值失败的运行。误差条是按样本标准差（ddof=1）计算的 $\pm 2$ 倍 Monte Carlo 标准误，不是正式的 95% 置信区间。生成脚本逐点输出实际计数；虚线：由 算出的 $V_g$；（a）中的点线：拉普拉斯源的最优值 $1/(\mathcal{J} - 1) = 1$。

en: Asymptotic Performance and the Cramér–Rao Bound
zh: 渐近性能与 Cramér–Rao 界
text:
Read a bound as a benchmark. The inverse-information bound describes what regular estimation can achieve under its model assumptions. It is not a guarantee for a chosen implementation or every finite sample. If the information matrix is singular, ordinary inversion is not available; that signals an unidentified direction. 把下界当作比较基准。 逆信息界描述模型假设下正则估计所能达到的精度，不是对某个实现或每个有限样本的保证。信息矩阵奇异时，普通求逆并不存在；这提示某个方向无法辨识。 The variances computed so far belong to particular estimators. The Cramér–Rao bound limits all of them. Suppose the source densities are known, so that the unmixing matrix is the only unknown, and parametrize it around the truth as $ W = ( I + \mathbf{E}) A^{-1}$. The gain matrix is then $ P =  I + \mathbf{E}$: the off-diagonal entries $E_{ij}$ are the separation errors and the diagonal entries are scale parameters. text: Match components one-to-one. In simulations, align outputs to known sources before averaging gain errors. Taking the largest entry in each row independently can assign several outputs to the same source and hide a failure. Solve a one-to-one assignment, for example by maximizing absolute source correlations or an appropriate normalized gain score; then fix signs and scales. Report convergence and matching failures separately. With real data, $\bA$ and the true sources are unknown, so a gain-based ISR cannot be computed from the decomposition alone. Bootstrap agreement is reproducibility, not an observed truth-based ISR. 成分必须一一匹配。 模拟中应先把输出与已知源配对，再平均增益误差。逐行独立选择最大元素，可能把多个输出都分配给同一个源，从而掩盖失败。应求解一一对应的指派问题，例如最大化源与输出的绝对相关，或合适的归一化增益分数；再固定符号与尺度。收敛失败和匹配失败应单独报告。真实数据中的 $\bA$ 与真实源未知，不能仅凭分解就算出基于增益的 ISR。Bootstrap 一致性衡量可重复性，并不是观测到了相对于真值的 ISR。 Dependence changes the covariance, not just the sample count. The formulas above use i.i.d. observations. For a stationary dependent sequence of estimating functions $\mathbf F_t=\mathbf F(\bx(t);\btheta_0)$, an appropriate dependent-data central limit theorem instead gives 依赖会改变协方差，而不仅是样本数。 上述公式使用独立同分布观测。若估计函数 $\mathbf F_t=\mathbf F(\bx(t);\btheta_0)$ 是平稳依赖序列，则在适当的依赖数据中心极限定理条件下，应改用 $$\sqrt T(\hat\btheta-\btheta_0)\xrightarrow{d}\Ncal(\bzero,\bM^{-1}\boldsymbol\Omega\bM^{-\top}),\qquad \boldsymbol\Omega=\sum_{h=-\infty}^{\infty}\Cov(\mathbf F_0,\mathbf F_h).$$ The series must converge and the required mixing, moment and estimator-regularity conditions must hold. The i.i.d. sandwich uses only its $h=0$ term. For example, if two source processes are mutually independent, zero-mean and unit-variance, then the long-run variance of the sample cross-product is $1+2\sum_{h\ge1}\rho_i(h)\rho_j(h)$. Two independent AR(1) sources with coefficients $0.8$ give $(1+0.8^2)/(1-0.8^2)\approx4.56$, rather than 1. This factor concerns that particular statistic; nonlinear estimating functions generally have different long-run covariances. Replacing $T$ by a single generic “effective sample size” in every ICA formula is not justified. Preserve dependence with suitable block or subject resampling. 这里要求级数收敛，并满足所需的混合性、矩条件与估计量正则条件。独立同分布的三明治公式只保留 $h=0$ 项。例如，若两个源过程相互独立、均值为零且方差为一，样本交叉乘积的长期方差为 $1+2\sum_{h\ge1}\rho_i(h)\rho_j(h)$。两个系数都为 $0.8$ 的独立 AR(1) 源给出 $(1+0.8^2)/(1-0.8^2)\approx4.56$，而不是 1。该因子只针对这一统计量；非线性估计函数通常有不同的长期协方差，不能把一个通用的“有效样本数”代入所有 ICA 公式。重抽样时应通过适当的时间块或被试级抽样保留依赖。 Count independent Monte Carlo replicates. Errors for several output pairs in the same simulated data set share sources and whitening errors. First average the desired error measure within each independently generated run, then compute the standard error across runs. The simulation above now uses this run-level calculation and the sample standard deviation with ddof=1 . Its interval quantifies Monte Carlo uncertainty around a finite-$T$ experiment; it does not include uncertainty in a separately simulated theoretical constant, and it does not turn an asymptotic approximation into an exact finite-sample statement. 按独立 Monte Carlo 重复计数。 同一个模拟数据集中的多个输出对共享源样本与白化误差。应先在每次独立生成的运行内平均所需误差指标，再跨运行计算标准误。上面的模拟现已采用这种按运行聚合的算法，并以 ddof=1 计算样本标准差。所得区间只量化有限 $T$ 实验的 Monte Carlo 不确定性，不包含另一次模拟计算理论常数的误差，也不能把渐近近似变成精确的有限样本结论。 A limiting normal law is not a mean-square theorem. Convergence in distribution of $\sqrt T\varepsilon_{ij}$ does not by itself prove $T\E[\varepsilon_{ij}^2]\to v_{ij}$; moment convergence needs tail control, such as uniform integrability. Rare failures or a near-zero matched denominator can dominate the exact mean square. Likewise, two Gaussian sources make the Fisher block singular: the ordinary inverse-information bound is not defined there. Calling it “infinite” describes the divergent limit toward the non-identifiable direction, not a valid inversion of a singular matrix. These distinctions matter when reporting efficiency from simulations. 正态极限并不自动给出均方极限。 $\sqrt T\varepsilon_{ij}$ 依分布收敛，本身并不证明 $T\E[\varepsilon_{ij}^2]\to v_{ij}$；矩收敛还需要一致可积性等尾部控制。罕见失败或接近零的匹配后分母可能主导精确均方。同样，两个高斯源使 Fisher 分块奇异，普通逆信息界在该点不成立。“无穷大”描述的是向不可辨识方向逼近时发散的极限，而不是对奇异矩阵作了有效求逆。用模拟报告效率时必须区分这些概念。 Key points 本章要点 The gain error $\varepsilon_{ij} = \hat P_{ij}/\hat P_{ii}$ measures how much of source $j$ leaks into the estimate of source $i$; $\mathrm{ISR}_{ij} = \E[\varepsilon_{ij}^2]$. Once the outputs are normalized, Amari's index summarizes $\hat\bP$ without matching outputs to sources; it decreases like $1/\sqrt{T}$. For equivariant estimators the distribution of the errors does not depend on the mixing matrix, only on the sources and the method. Estimators defined by estimating equations have errors of order $1/\sqrt{T}$; for ICA the asymptotic variance decouples into pairs of sources, and exact decorrelation makes $\sqrt{T}(\varepsilon_{ij} + \varepsilon_{ji})$ asymptotically $\Ncal(0, 1)$. One-unit FastICA has asymptotic variance $V_g$, which depends only on the estimated source (and, for skewed sources, on whether the data are centered); it is minimized by the score function, with value $1/(\mathcal{J} - 1)$. The Cramér–Rao bound is $\mathcal{J}_j/(T(\mathcal{J}_i\mathcal{J}_j - 1))$: undefined for two exactly Gaussian sources, large near the non-identifiable Gaussian limit, attained by maximum likelihood with the true scores, and in general not attained by one-unit or exactly decorrelating estimators. 增益误差 $\varepsilon_{ij} = \hat P_{ij}/\hat P_{ii}$ 衡量源 $j$ 漏进源 $i$ 的估计中的多少；$\mathrm{ISR}_{ij} = \E[\varepsilon_{ij}^2]$。把输出归一化之后，Amari 指标无需把输出与源配对就能概括 $\hat\bP$，并以 $1/\sqrt{T}$ 的速度下降。 对等变估计量，误差的分布与混合矩阵无关，只取决于源和方法。 由估计方程定义的估计量误差为 $1/\sqrt{T}$ 量级；在 ICA 中渐近方差按源的两两配对解耦，而严格去相关使 $\sqrt{T}(\varepsilon_{ij} + \varepsilon_{ji})$ 渐近服从 $\Ncal(0, 1)$。 单单元 FastICA 的渐近方差为 $V_g$，它只依赖于被估计的源（对偏斜的源，还取决于数据是否做了中心化）；得分函数使它达到最小值 $1/(\mathcal{J} - 1)$。 Cramér–Rao 界为 $\mathcal{J}_j/(T(\mathcal{J}_i\mathcal{J}_j - 1))$：两个源恰好都为高斯时不成立，接近不可辨识的高斯极限时很大；用真实得分函数的最大似然可以达到它，单单元估计量和严格去相关的估计量一般达不到。 Before the exercises 开始习题前 Match source labels before interpreting off-diagonal gain entries. Square normalized leakage coefficients to obtain realized ISR. Report independent-run uncertainty and any excluded failures separately. 解释非对角增益前，先匹配源标签。 将归一化泄漏系数平方，才得到一次实现的 ISR。 分别报告跨独立运行的不确定性与被排除的失败。 Start with part (a) of the Amari-index exercise . After reading the bound, calculate the two-Laplace example ; then try the cubic-variance exercise . The symmetric-estimator proof can wait. 先做 Amari 指数习题的（a） 。读完下界后，计算 双拉普拉斯源的例子 ，再尝试 三次非线性方差习题 ；对称估计量的证明可稍后再做。

If the data are first centered with the sample mean, $ s$ is replaced by $ s -  ar s$. To first order this subtracts $ ar s_l\,\E[g_k(s_k)]$ from $u_{kl}$ and $ ar s_k\,\E[g_l(s_l)]$ from $u_{lk}$, so in the two averages $g_k(s_k)$ and $g_l(s_l)$ are replaced by their deviations from their means. The averages remain uncorrelated, $\gamma_k$ becomes $\gamma_k - (\E[g(s_k)])^2$, $\gamma_l + 	au_l^2$ becomes $\gamma_l + 	au_l^2 - (\E[g(s_l)])^2$, and the numerator loses $(\E[g(s_k)])^2 + (\E[g(s_l)])^2$. 这两个平均不相关，因为它们的协方差乘以 $T$ 等于 $\E[s_k(g_k(s_k) - \mu'_ks_k)]\,\E[s_l(g_l(s_l) - ho'_ls_l)] = 0 \cdot (\mu'_l - ho'_l) = 0$。它们的方差乘以 $T$ 分别为 $\E[(g_k(s_k) - \mu'_ks_k)^2] =  eta_k - \mu_k^2 = \gamma_k$ 和 $\E[(g_l(s_l) - ho'_ls_l)^2] =  eta_l - 2ho'_l\mu'_l + ho_l'^2 = \gamma_l + 	au_l^2$。因此 $T\Var(e_{kl}) 	o (\gamma_k + \gamma_l + 	au_l^2)/(	au_k + 	au_l)^2$，而 $\varepsilon_{kl} = e_{kl} + O_p(T^{-1})$。若先用样本均值把数据中心化，就要把 $ s$ 换成 $ s -  ar s$。在一阶近似下，这使 $u_{kl}$ 减去 $ ar s_l\,\E[g_k(s_k)]$，$u_{lk}$ 减去 $ ar s_k\,\E[g_l(s_l)]$，相当于在两个平均中把 $g_k(s_k)$ 和 $g_l(s_l)$ 换成它们与各自均值之差。两个平均仍不相关，$\gamma_k$ 变为 $\gamma_k - (\E[g(s_k)])^2$，$\gamma_l + 	au_l^2$ 变为 $\gamma_l + 	au_l^2 - (\E[g(s_l)])^2$，所以分子减少 $(\E[g(s_k)])^2 + (\E[g(s_l)])^2$。
