This appendix collects the matrix and statistical facts used throughout the book. Short and instructive proofs are given in full; for the rest we point to standard references. All matrices are real. For matrices of the same size, $\langle\bA, \bB\rangle = \tr(\bA^\top\bB) = \sum_{ij}a_{ij}b_{ij}$ is the Frobenius inner product and $\|\bA\|_F = \langle\bA, \bA\rangle^{1/2}$ the Frobenius norm; $\|\bx\|$ is the Euclidean norm of a vector. The identity $\tr(\bA\bB) = \tr(\bB\bA)$ is used constantly. For symmetric matrices, $\bA \succeq \bB$ (respectively $\bA \succ \bB$) means that $\bA - \bB$ is positive semidefinite (positive definite). 本附录汇集全书用到的矩阵与统计知识。简短而有启发的证明完整给出，其余给出标准参考文献。所有矩阵都是实矩阵。对同样大小的矩阵，$\langle\bA, \bB\rangle = \tr(\bA^\top\bB) = \sum_{ij}a_{ij}b_{ij}$ 是 Frobenius 内积，$\|\bA\|_F = \langle\bA, \bA\rangle^{1/2}$ 是 Frobenius 范数；$\|\bx\|$ 是向量的欧氏范数。恒等式 $\tr(\bA\bB) = \tr(\bB\bA)$ 会反复用到。对对称矩阵，$\bA \succeq \bB$（或 $\bA \succ \bB$）表示 $\bA - \bB$ 半正定（或正定）。 Every square matrix splits as $\bM = \operatorname{sym}(\bM) + \operatorname{skew}(\bM)$, with symmetric part $\operatorname{sym}(\bM) = (\bM + \bM^\top)/2$ and skew-symmetric part $\operatorname{skew}(\bM) = (\bM - \bM^\top)/2$. The two parts are orthogonal: if $\bS$ is symmetric and $\bK$ is skew-symmetric, then $\tr(\bS\bK) = \tr\bigl((\bS\bK)^\top\bigr) = -\tr(\bK\bS) = -\tr(\bS\bK)$, so $\langle\bS, \bK\rangle = 0$. This simple fact underlies the gradients on the orthogonal group in . 每个方阵都可以分解为 $\bM = \operatorname{sym}(\bM) + \operatorname{skew}(\bM)$，其中对称部分为 $\operatorname{sym}(\bM) = (\bM + \bM^\top)/2$，反对称部分为 $\operatorname{skew}(\bM) = (\bM - \bM^\top)/2$。两部分相互正交：若 $\bS$ 对称、$\bK$ 反对称，则 $\tr(\bS\bK) = \tr\bigl((\bS\bK)^\top\bigr) = -\tr(\bK\bS) = -\tr(\bS\bK)$，所以 $\langle\bS, \bK\rangle = 0$。 中正交群上的梯度就建立在这个简单事实之上。

A square matrix $\bQ$ is orthogonal if $\bQ^\top\bQ = \bI$, equivalently $\bQ\bQ^\top = \bI$ or $\bQ^{-1} = \bQ^\top$. Orthogonal matrices preserve inner products, $(\bQ\bu)^\top(\bQ\bv) = \bu^\top\bv$, and hence lengths, angles and Frobenius norms: $\|\bQ\bM\|_F = \|\bM\bQ\|_F = \|\bM\|_F$. They form a group, the orthogonal group $O(n)$. Since $(\det\bQ)^2 = \det(\bQ^\top\bQ) = 1$, every orthogonal matrix has determinant $\pm 1$. Those with determinant $+1$ form the group $SO(n)$ of rotations; the others include reflections such as $\diag(1, \dots, 1, -1)$. 若方阵 $\bQ$ 满足 $\bQ^\top\bQ = \bI$（等价地，$\bQ\bQ^\top = \bI$，或 $\bQ^{-1} = \bQ^\top$），则称它是 正交矩阵 。正交矩阵保持内积 $(\bQ\bu)^\top(\bQ\bv) = \bu^\top\bv$，因而保持长度、夹角与 Frobenius 范数：$\|\bQ\bM\|_F = \|\bM\bQ\|_F = \|\bM\|_F$。它们构成一个群，即 正交群 $O(n)$。由于 $(\det\bQ)^2 = \det(\bQ^\top\bQ) = 1$，正交矩阵的行列式为 $\pm 1$。行列式为 $+1$ 的正交矩阵构成旋转群 $SO(n)$；其余的包括 $\diag(1, \dots, 1, -1)$ 这样的反射。 $O(n)$ is a smooth manifold of dimension $n(n-1)/2$. Its tangent space at $\bQ$ is $\{\boldsymbol{\Omega}\bQ : \boldsymbol{\Omega}^\top = -\boldsymbol{\Omega}\}$, and for every skew-symmetric $\boldsymbol{\Omega}$ the curve $t \mapsto \exp(t\boldsymbol{\Omega})\bQ$ lies in $O(n)$ and passes through $\bQ$ with velocity $\boldsymbol{\Omega}\bQ$. $O(n)$ 是维数为 $n(n-1)/2$ 的光滑流形。它在 $\bQ$ 处的切空间为 $\{\boldsymbol{\Omega}\bQ : \boldsymbol{\Omega}^\top = -\boldsymbol{\Omega}\}$；对每个反对称矩阵 $\boldsymbol{\Omega}$，曲线 $t \mapsto \exp(t\boldsymbol{\Omega})\bQ$ 落在 $O(n)$ 中，并以速度 $\boldsymbol{\Omega}\bQ$ 经过 $\bQ$。 $O(n)$ is the level set $\{\bQ : \bQ\bQ^\top = \bI\}$ of the map $\bQ \mapsto \bQ\bQ^\top$, whose derivative $\dot\bQ \mapsto \dot\bQ\bQ^\top + \bQ\dot\bQ^\top$ maps onto the symmetric matrices (given a symmetric $\bS$, take $\dot\bQ = \tfrac12\bS\bQ$). By the regular value theorem, $O(n)$ is a smooth manifold whose tangent space at $\bQ$ is the kernel of this derivative. Writing $\dot\bQ = \boldsymbol{\Omega}\bQ$, the kernel condition becomes $\boldsymbol{\Omega} + \boldsymbol{\Omega}^\top = \bzero$. A skew-symmetric matrix is determined by its $n(n-1)/2$ entries above the diagonal, which gives the dimension. Finally, $\exp(t\boldsymbol{\Omega})^\top\exp(t\boldsymbol{\Omega}) = \exp(-t\boldsymbol{\Omega})\exp(t\boldsymbol{\Omega}) = \bI$, and the derivative at $t = 0$ is $\boldsymbol{\Omega}\bQ$. $O(n)$ 是映射 $\bQ \mapsto \bQ\bQ^\top$ 的水平集 $\{\bQ : \bQ\bQ^\top = \bI\}$，该映射的导数 $\dot\bQ \mapsto \dot\bQ\bQ^\top + \bQ\dot\bQ^\top$ 映满全体对称矩阵（对给定的对称矩阵 $\bS$，取 $\dot\bQ = \tfrac12\bS\bQ$ 即可）。由正则值定理，$O(n)$ 是光滑流形，它在 $\bQ$ 处的切空间就是这个导数的核。记 $\dot\bQ = \boldsymbol{\Omega}\bQ$，核的条件就变成 $\boldsymbol{\Omega} + \boldsymbol{\Omega}^\top = \bzero$。反对称矩阵由对角线以上的 $n(n-1)/2$ 个元素确定，由此得到维数。最后，$\exp(t\boldsymbol{\Omega})^\top\exp(t\boldsymbol{\Omega}) = \exp(-t\boldsymbol{\Omega})\exp(t\boldsymbol{\Omega}) = \bI$，且它在 $t = 0$ 处的导数为 $\boldsymbol{\Omega}\bQ$。 For $n = 2$, $\exp\bigl(\theta\bigl(\begin{smallmatrix} 0 & -1 \\ 1 & 0 \end{smallmatrix}\bigr)\bigr) = \bigl(\begin{smallmatrix} \cos\theta & -\sin\theta \\ \sin\theta & \cos\theta \end{smallmatrix}\bigr)$, the rotation by $\theta$: one parameter, as $n(n-1)/2 = 1$ predicts. In general every rotation is the exponential of a skew-symmetric matrix. An orthogonal change of basis $\bB$ brings any orthogonal $\bQ$ to a block-diagonal form with $2 \times 2$ blocks $\exp(\theta_k\bJ)$, $\bJ = \bigl(\begin{smallmatrix} 0 & -1 \\ 1 & 0 \end{smallmatrix}\bigr)$, and diagonal entries $\pm 1$ (Horn & Johnson, 2013). When $\det\bQ = 1$ the entries $-1$ come in pairs, each pair forming a block $\exp(\pi\bJ) = -\bI_2$, so $\bQ = \exp(\boldsymbol{\Omega})$ with the skew-symmetric matrix $\boldsymbol{\Omega} = \bB\,\diag(\theta_1\bJ, \dots, \theta_k\bJ, 0, \dots, 0)\,\bB^\top$. Conversely, $\det\exp(\boldsymbol{\Omega}) = e^{\tr\boldsymbol{\Omega}} = 1$. 当 $n = 2$ 时，$\exp\bigl(\theta\bigl(\begin{smallmatrix} 0 & -1 \\ 1 & 0 \end{smallmatrix}\bigr)\bigr) = \bigl(\begin{smallmatrix} \cos\theta & -\sin\theta \\ \sin\theta & \cos\theta \end{smallmatrix}\bigr)$，即旋转 $\theta$ 角：只有一个参数，与 $n(n-1)/2 = 1$ 一致。一般地，每个旋转都是某个反对称矩阵的指数。通过正交基变换 $\bB$，任何正交矩阵 $\bQ$ 都可以化为分块对角形式，其中的 $2 \times 2$ 块为 $\exp(\theta_k\bJ)$，$\bJ = \bigl(\begin{smallmatrix} 0 & -1 \\ 1 & 0 \end{smallmatrix}\bigr)$，其余对角元为 $\pm 1$（Horn & Johnson, 2013）。当 $\det\bQ = 1$ 时，对角元 $-1$ 成对出现，每一对构成一个块 $\exp(\pi\bJ) = -\bI_2$，于是 $\bQ = \exp(\boldsymbol{\Omega})$，其中 $\boldsymbol{\Omega} = \bB\,\diag(\theta_1\bJ, \dots, \theta_k\bJ, 0, \dots, 0)\,\bB^\top$ 是反对称矩阵。反之，$\det\exp(\boldsymbol{\Omega}) = e^{\tr\boldsymbol{\Omega}} = 1$。 Givens rotations. The Givens rotation $\bG(i, j, \theta)$ equals the identity except for the entries $g_{ii} = g_{jj} = \cos\theta$, $g_{ij} = -\sin\theta$ and $g_{ji} = \sin\theta$; it rotates the $(i, j)$ coordinate plane by $\theta$ and leaves the other coordinates unchanged. There are $n(n-1)/2$ such planes, matching the dimension of $O(n)$. Every orthogonal matrix is a product of at most $n(n-1)/2$ Givens rotations and a diagonal matrix of signs: applying Givens rotations to zero the entries below the diagonal of $\bQ$ column by column, as in the Givens QR factorization (Golub & Van Loan, 2013), leaves an upper triangular orthogonal matrix, which must be diagonal with entries $\pm 1$. Jacobi-type algorithms such as JADE ( ) search over $O(n)$ by sweeping through the planes and optimizing one angle at a time. Givens 旋转。 Givens 旋转 $\bG(i, j, \theta)$ 除 $g_{ii} = g_{jj} = \cos\theta$、$g_{ij} = -\sin\theta$、$g_{ji} = \sin\theta$ 之外与单位阵相同；它把 $(i, j)$ 坐标平面旋转 $\theta$ 角，而保持其余坐标不变。这样的平面共有 $n(n-1)/2$ 个，恰好等于 $O(n)$ 的维数。每个正交矩阵都是至多 $n(n-1)/2$ 个 Givens 旋转与一个符号对角矩阵的乘积：像用 Givens 旋转做 QR 分解那样（Golub & Van Loan, 2013），逐列消去 $\bQ$ 对角线以下的元素，剩下一个上三角的正交矩阵，它必然是对角元为 $\pm 1$ 的对角矩阵。JADE（ ）等 Jacobi 型算法在 $O(n)$ 中搜索的方式，就是依次扫过各个平面，每次只优化一个角度。 Permutation matrices. For a permutation $\pi$ of $\{1, \dots, n\}$, the permutation matrix $\bPi$ has entries $\pi_{ij} = 1$ if $i = \pi(j)$ and $0$ otherwise, so $(\bPi\bs)_{\pi(j)} = s_j$: it moves component $j$ to position $\pi(j)$. Permutation matrices are orthogonal, and so are the signed permutation matrices $\bPi\bD$ with $\bD = \diag(\pm 1)$. These are the only orthogonal scaled permutations. 置换矩阵。 对 $\{1, \dots, n\}$ 的置换 $\pi$，置换矩阵 $\bPi$ 的元素为：当 $i = \pi(j)$ 时 $\pi_{ij} = 1$，否则为 $0$。于是 $(\bPi\bs)_{\pi(j)} = s_j$：它把第 $j$ 个分量移到第 $\pi(j)$ 个位置。置换矩阵是正交的， 带符号的置换矩阵 $\bPi\bD$（$\bD = \diag(\pm 1)$）也是正交的，而且它们是仅有的正交的带尺度置换矩阵。 Let $\bPi$ be a permutation matrix and $\bD$ a diagonal matrix. Then $\bPi\bD$ is orthogonal if and only if $\bD = \diag(\pm 1)$. The signed permutation matrices form a subgroup of $O(n)$ with $2^n n!$ elements. 设 $\bPi$ 为置换矩阵，$\bD$ 为对角矩阵。则 $\bPi\bD$ 正交当且仅当 $\bD = \diag(\pm 1)$。带符号的置换矩阵构成 $O(n)$ 的一个子群，共有 $2^n n!$ 个元素。 $(\bPi\bD)^\top(\bPi\bD) = \bD\bPi^\top\bPi\bD = \bD^2$, which equals $\bI$ exactly when every $d_i^2 = 1$. For two signed permutations, $\bD\bPi' = \bPi'(\bPi'^\top\bD\bPi')$ and $\bPi'^\top\bD\bPi'$ is again a diagonal sign matrix, so the product $(\bPi\bD)(\bPi'\bD')$ is a signed permutation; so is the inverse $(\bPi\bD)^\top = \bPi^\top(\bPi\bD\bPi^\top)$. Distinct pairs $(\bPi, \bD)$ give distinct matrices, because the position of the nonzero entry in each column determines $\bPi$ and its sign determines $\bD$; hence there are $n!\cdot 2^n$ of them. $(\bPi\bD)^\top(\bPi\bD) = \bD\bPi^\top\bPi\bD = \bD^2$，它等于 $\bI$ 当且仅当每个 $d_i^2 = 1$。对两个带符号置换矩阵，$\bD\bPi' = \bPi'(\bPi'^\top\bD\bPi')$，而 $\bPi'^\top\bD\bPi'$ 仍是对角符号矩阵，所以乘积 $(\bPi\bD)(\bPi'\bD')$ 仍是带符号置换矩阵；逆矩阵 $(\bPi\bD)^\top = \bPi^\top(\bPi\bD\bPi^\top)$ 也是。不同的 $(\bPi, \bD)$ 给出不同的矩阵，因为每列非零元的位置确定 $\bPi$，其符号确定 $\bD$；因此共有 $n!\cdot 2^n$ 个。 In ICA, separation means that the global matrix is a scaled permutation $\bPi\bD$ ( ). After whitening the global matrix is orthogonal ( ), and the lemma shows that the scaling is then reduced to signs: the solutions form the finite group of signed permutations. 在 ICA 中，分离意味着全局矩阵是带尺度的置换矩阵 $\bPi\bD$（ ）。白化之后全局矩阵是正交的（ ），由引理可知，此时尺度只剩下符号：所有解构成带符号置换矩阵这个有限群。

Spectral theorem. Every symmetric $\bC \in \R^{n \times n}$ can be written $\bC = \mathbf{E}\bLambda\mathbf{E}^\top = \sum_i \lambda_i\be_i\be_i^\top$, with $\mathbf{E}$ orthogonal with columns $\be_i$ and $\bLambda = \diag(\lambda_1, \dots, \lambda_n)$ real (Horn & Johnson, 2013). The columns are orthonormal eigenvectors, $\bC\be_i = \lambda_i\be_i$. If the eigenvalues are distinct, each eigenvector is unique up to sign; for a repeated eigenvalue, any orthonormal basis of its eigenspace can be used. 谱定理。 每个对称矩阵 $\bC \in \R^{n \times n}$ 都可以写成 $\bC = \mathbf{E}\bLambda\mathbf{E}^\top = \sum_i \lambda_i\be_i\be_i^\top$，其中 $\mathbf{E}$ 是以 $\be_i$ 为列的正交矩阵，$\bLambda = \diag(\lambda_1, \dots, \lambda_n)$ 为实对角矩阵（Horn & Johnson, 2013）。各列是标准正交的特征向量，$\bC\be_i = \lambda_i\be_i$。若特征值互不相同，则每个特征向量在相差一个符号的意义下唯一；对重特征值，可以取其特征子空间的任意一组标准正交基。 Definiteness. $\bC$ is positive semidefinite, $\bC \succeq \bzero$, if $\bv^\top\bC\bv \ge 0$ for all $\bv$, equivalently if all $\lambda_i \ge 0$; it is positive definite, $\bC \succ \bzero$, if $\bv^\top\bC\bv > 0$ for all $\bv \ne \bzero$, equivalently if all $\lambda_i > 0$. Covariance matrices are positive semidefinite, since $\bv^\top\bC_{\bx}\bv = \Var(\bv^\top\bx)$. A positive definite matrix has a unique Cholesky factorization $\bC = \mathbf{L}\mathbf{L}^\top$ with $\mathbf{L}$ lower triangular with a positive diagonal (Golub & Van Loan, 2013). 正定性。 若对所有 $\bv$ 都有 $\bv^\top\bC\bv \ge 0$，等价地，所有 $\lambda_i \ge 0$，则称 $\bC$ 半正定，记作 $\bC \succeq \bzero$；若对所有 $\bv \ne \bzero$ 都有 $\bv^\top\bC\bv > 0$，等价地，所有 $\lambda_i > 0$，则称 $\bC$ 正定，记作 $\bC \succ \bzero$。协方差矩阵是半正定的，因为 $\bv^\top\bC_{\bx}\bv = \Var(\bv^\top\bx)$。正定矩阵有唯一的 Cholesky 分解 $\bC = \mathbf{L}\mathbf{L}^\top$，其中 $\mathbf{L}$ 是对角元为正的下三角矩阵（Golub & Van Loan, 2013）。 Rayleigh quotient. For a unit vector $\bw$, $\bw^\top\bC\bw = \sum_i \lambda_i(\be_i^\top\bw)^2$ is an average of the eigenvalues with weights $(\be_i^\top\bw)^2$ that sum to one. Hence $\max_{\|\bw\| = 1}\bw^\top\bC\bw = \lambda_{\max}$ and $\min_{\|\bw\| = 1}\bw^\top\bC\bw = \lambda_{\min}$, attained at the corresponding eigenvectors. This variational characterization is the basis of PCA, and revisits it as an optimization problem on the sphere. Rayleigh 商。 对单位向量 $\bw$，$\bw^\top\bC\bw = \sum_i \lambda_i(\be_i^\top\bw)^2$ 是各特征值以 $(\be_i^\top\bw)^2$ 为权重的加权平均，权重之和为一。因此 $\max_{\|\bw\| = 1}\bw^\top\bC\bw = \lambda_{\max}$，$\min_{\|\bw\| = 1}\bw^\top\bC\bw = \lambda_{\min}$，分别在相应的特征向量处取到。这一变分刻画是 PCA 的基础， 还会把它作为球面上的优化问题重新讨论。 Matrix functions. For a function $f$ defined on the eigenvalues, $f(\bC) = \mathbf{E}f(\bLambda)\mathbf{E}^\top = \sum_i f(\lambda_i)\be_i\be_i^\top$. The result does not depend on the choice of eigenvectors, because $f(\bC) = p(\bC)$ for any polynomial $p$ with $p(\lambda_i) = f(\lambda_i)$ for all $i$. Examples are powers, $\exp(\bC)$, $\log\bC$ for $\bC \succ \bzero$, and square roots. Matrix functions commute with orthogonal similarity: $f(\bQ\bC\bQ^\top) = \bQ f(\bC)\bQ^\top$. 矩阵函数。 对定义在各特征值上的函数 $f$，令 $f(\bC) = \mathbf{E}f(\bLambda)\mathbf{E}^\top = \sum_i f(\lambda_i)\be_i\be_i^\top$。这个定义与特征向量的选取无关，因为对任何满足 $p(\lambda_i) = f(\lambda_i)$（对所有 $i$）的多项式 $p$，都有 $f(\bC) = p(\bC)$。例子有幂、$\exp(\bC)$、$\bC \succ \bzero$ 时的 $\log\bC$，以及平方根。矩阵函数与正交相似变换可交换：$f(\bQ\bC\bQ^\top) = \bQ f(\bC)\bQ^\top$。 Every positive semidefinite $\bC$ has a unique positive semidefinite square root, that is, a matrix $\bB \succeq \bzero$ with $\bB^2 = \bC$, namely $\bC^{1/2} = \mathbf{E}\bLambda^{1/2}\mathbf{E}^\top$. If $\bC \succ \bzero$, then $\bC^{-1/2} = (\bC^{1/2})^{-1} = \mathbf{E}\bLambda^{-1/2}\mathbf{E}^\top$ and $\bC^{-1/2}\bC\,\bC^{-1/2} = \bI$. 每个半正定矩阵 $\bC$ 都有唯一的半正定平方根，即满足 $\bB^2 = \bC$ 的矩阵 $\bB \succeq \bzero$，它就是 $\bC^{1/2} = \mathbf{E}\bLambda^{1/2}\mathbf{E}^\top$。若 $\bC \succ \bzero$，则 $\bC^{-1/2} = (\bC^{1/2})^{-1} = \mathbf{E}\bLambda^{-1/2}\mathbf{E}^\top$，且 $\bC^{-1/2}\bC\,\bC^{-1/2} = \bI$。 $\mathbf{E}\bLambda^{1/2}\mathbf{E}^\top$ is positive semidefinite and its square is $\mathbf{E}\bLambda\mathbf{E}^\top = \bC$. For uniqueness, let $\bB \succeq \bzero$ with $\bB^2 = \bC$. Then $\bB$ commutes with $\bC = \bB^2$, so it maps each eigenspace of $\bC$ into itself: if $\bC\bv = \lambda\bv$, then $\bC(\bB\bv) = \bB\bC\bv = \lambda\bB\bv$. Restricted to the eigenspace of $\lambda$, $\bB$ is symmetric and positive semidefinite with square $\lambda\bI$, so its eigenvalues are nonnegative square roots of $\lambda$, and it equals $\sqrt\lambda\,\bI$ there. Hence $\bB = \sum_i \sqrt{\lambda_i}\,\be_i\be_i^\top$. The statements about $\bC^{-1/2}$ follow from the eigendecomposition. $\mathbf{E}\bLambda^{1/2}\mathbf{E}^\top$ 是半正定的，且其平方为 $\mathbf{E}\bLambda\mathbf{E}^\top = \bC$。再证唯一性：设 $\bB \succeq \bzero$ 且 $\bB^2 = \bC$。则 $\bB$ 与 $\bC = \bB^2$ 可交换，所以 $\bB$ 把 $\bC$ 的每个特征子空间映到自身：若 $\bC\bv = \lambda\bv$，则 $\bC(\bB\bv) = \bB\bC\bv = \lambda\bB\bv$。把 $\bB$ 限制在特征值 $\lambda$ 的特征子空间上，它是对称半正定的，且平方为 $\lambda\bI$，所以它的特征值都是 $\lambda$ 的非负平方根，从而它在该子空间上等于 $\sqrt\lambda\,\bI$。因此 $\bB = \sum_i \sqrt{\lambda_i}\,\be_i\be_i^\top$。关于 $\bC^{-1/2}$ 的结论由特征分解直接得到。 Covariance factors, that is, matrices $\bB$ with $\bB\bB^\top = \bC$ such as the Cholesky factor, are not unique. If $\bC \succ \bzero$ and $\bB\bB^\top = \bB'\bB'^\top = \bC$, then $\bQ = \bB^{-1}\bB'$ satisfies $\bQ\bQ^\top = \bB^{-1}\bC\bB^{-\top} = \bI$, so $\bB' = \bB\bQ$ with $\bQ$ orthogonal, and every such $\bB\bQ$ works. Inverting gives the whitening matrices of . 协方差因子，即满足 $\bB\bB^\top = \bC$ 的矩阵 $\bB$（例如 Cholesky 因子），并不唯一。若 $\bC \succ \bzero$ 且 $\bB\bB^\top = \bB'\bB'^\top = \bC$，则 $\bQ = \bB^{-1}\bB'$ 满足 $\bQ\bQ^\top = \bB^{-1}\bC\bB^{-\top} = \bI$，所以 $\bB' = \bB\bQ$，$\bQ$ 正交；反之每个这样的 $\bB\bQ$ 都满足要求。取逆即得 中的白化矩阵。 A covariance factor satisfies $\bB\bB^\top=\bC$, whereas a matrix square root satisfies $\bB^2=\bC$. The symmetric positive semidefinite root satisfies both; a general Cholesky factor need not square to $\bC$. Do not replace $\bB^{-\top}$ by $\bB^{-1}$ unless symmetry is justified. 协方差因子满足 $\bB\bB^\top=\bC$，矩阵平方根满足的则是 $\bB^2=\bC$。对称半正定平方根同时满足两式，但一般的 Cholesky 因子并不满足平方等于 $\bC$。没有对称性依据时，不能把 $\bB^{-\top}$ 换为 $\bB^{-1}$。

sectionEn: The SVD and the polar decomposition
text: Every $\bW \in \R^{n \times m}$ has a singular value decomposition (SVD) $\bW = \mathbf{L}\bSigma\bR^\top$, with $\mathbf{L} \in O(n)$, $\bR \in O(m)$, and $\bSigma \in \R^{n \times m}$ zero except for the diagonal entries $\sigma_1 \ge \sigma_2 \ge \dots \ge 0$, the singular values (Golub & Van Loan, 2013). We call the factors $\mathbf{L}$ and $\bR$, for left and right, to keep $\bU$ and $\bV$ for the rotation and the whitening matrix of the main text. The nonzero $\sigma_i^2$ are the common nonzero eigenvalues of $\bW\bW^\top$ and $\bW^\top\bW$; the larger Gram matrix has additional zero eigenvalues. Their orthonormal eigenvector bases are the columns of $\mathbf{L}$ and $\bR$, respectively. A square $\bW$ is invertible exactly when all its singular values are positive. 每个 $\bW \in \R^{n \times m}$ 都有 奇异值分解 （SVD）$\bW = \mathbf{L}\bSigma\bR^\top$，其中 $\mathbf{L} \in O(n)$，$\bR \in O(m)$，$\bSigma \in \R^{n \times m}$ 除对角元 $\sigma_1 \ge \sigma_2 \ge \dots \ge 0$（即奇异值）外全为零（Golub & Van Loan, 2013）。我们把两个因子记作 $\mathbf{L}$ 与 $\bR$（取 left 与 right 之意），以便把 $\bU$ 与 $\bV$ 留给正文中的旋转与白化矩阵。非零的 $\sigma_i^2$ 是 $\bW\bW^\top$ 与 $\bW^\top\bW$ 共有的非零特征值；较大的 Gram 矩阵还含额外零特征值。两者的正交特征向量基分别是 $\mathbf{L}$ 与 $\bR$ 的各列。方阵 $\bW$ 可逆，当且仅当它的奇异值全为正。 Polar decomposition. An invertible square $\bW$ factors as 极分解。 可逆方阵 $\bW$ 可以分解为 $$\bW = (\bW\bW^\top)^{1/2}\,\bQ_{\bW}, \qquad \bQ_{\bW} = (\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\,\bW = \mathbf{L}\bR^\top,$$ where $(\bW\bW^\top)^{1/2} = \mathbf{L}\bSigma\mathbf{L}^\top$ is positive definite and $\bQ_{\bW}$ is orthogonal; indeed $(\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\bW = \mathbf{L}\bSigma^{-1}\mathbf{L}^\top\mathbf{L}\bSigma\bR^\top = \mathbf{L}\bR^\top$. This is the matrix analogue of writing a nonzero complex number as a modulus times a phase. The same orthogonal factor appears on the other side, $\bW = \bQ_{\bW}(\bW^\top\bW)^{1/2}$. A singular $\bW$ also has polar decompositions, but its orthogonal factor is not unique. 其中 $(\bW\bW^\top)^{1/2} = \mathbf{L}\bSigma\mathbf{L}^\top$ 正定，$\bQ_{\bW}$ 正交；事实上 $(\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\bW = \mathbf{L}\bSigma^{-1}\mathbf{L}^\top\mathbf{L}\bSigma\bR^\top = \mathbf{L}\bR^\top$。这相当于把非零复数写成模乘以相位的矩阵版本。同一个正交因子也出现在另一侧：$\bW = \bQ_{\bW}(\bW^\top\bW)^{1/2}$。奇异的 $\bW$ 也有极分解，但其正交因子不唯一。 Let $\bW \in \R^{n \times n}$ be invertible. Then $(\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\bW = \mathbf{L}\bR^\top$ is the unique orthogonal matrix closest to $\bW$ in Frobenius norm: $\|\bW - \bQ\|_F > \|\bW - (\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\bW\|_F$ for every other orthogonal $\bQ$. 设 $\bW \in \R^{n \times n}$ 可逆。则 $(\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\bW = \mathbf{L}\bR^\top$ 是在 Frobenius 范数下离 $\bW$ 最近的唯一正交矩阵：对其他任何正交矩阵 $\bQ$，$\|\bW - \bQ\|_F > \|\bW - (\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\bW\|_F$。 For orthogonal $\bQ$, $\|\bW - \bQ\|_F^2 = \|\bW\|_F^2 + n - 2\tr(\bQ^\top\bW)$, so we must maximize $\tr(\bQ^\top\bW) = \tr(\bQ^\top\mathbf{L}\bSigma\bR^\top) = \tr(\bM\bSigma)$ with $\bM = \bR^\top\bQ^\top\mathbf{L}$, which is orthogonal. Then $\tr(\bM\bSigma) = \sum_i m_{ii}\sigma_i \le \sum_i \sigma_i$, because each column of $\bM$ is a unit vector and so $|m_{ii}| \le 1$. Since every $\sigma_i > 0$, equality holds if and only if $m_{ii} = 1$ for all $i$; a unit column with $i$-th entry 1 is the $i$-th column of the identity, so this means $\bM = \bI$, that is, $\bQ = \mathbf{L}\bR^\top$. By , $\mathbf{L}\bR^\top = (\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\bW$. 对正交矩阵 $\bQ$，$\|\bW - \bQ\|_F^2 = \|\bW\|_F^2 + n - 2\tr(\bQ^\top\bW)$，所以问题化为最大化 $\tr(\bQ^\top\bW) = \tr(\bQ^\top\mathbf{L}\bSigma\bR^\top) = \tr(\bM\bSigma)$，其中 $\bM = \bR^\top\bQ^\top\mathbf{L}$ 是正交矩阵。于是 $\tr(\bM\bSigma) = \sum_i m_{ii}\sigma_i \le \sum_i \sigma_i$，因为 $\bM$ 的每一列都是单位向量，所以 $|m_{ii}| \le 1$。由于所有 $\sigma_i > 0$，等号成立当且仅当对所有 $i$ 都有 $m_{ii} = 1$；第 $i$ 个分量为 1 的单位列向量就是单位阵的第 $i$ 列，所以这意味着 $\bM = \bI$，即 $\bQ = \mathbf{L}\bR^\top$。由 ，$\mathbf{L}\bR^\top = (\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\bW$。 Uses in ICA. Symmetric FastICA orthogonalizes its current estimate by $\bW \leftarrow (\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\bW$ ( ), which by the proposition is the orthogonal matrix closest to $\bW$. It treats all rows alike: since matrix functions commute with orthogonal similarity, replacing $\bW$ by $\bPi\bW$ replaces the result by $\bPi(\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\bW$, whereas Gram–Schmidt orthogonalization depends on the order of the rows. For square invertible mixing and unit-variance sources, ZCA whitening produces the whitened mixing matrix $(\bA\bA^\top)^{-1/2}\bA$, the polar factor of $\bA$ ( ). Numerically, $\bQ_{\bW}$ is computed from the SVD, or by iterations such as Newton's iteration $\bX \leftarrow (\bX + \bX^{-\top})/2$ started at $\bX = \bW$ (Higham, 1986). Applied to $\bB\bA^\top$ in place of $\bW$, the same argument solves the orthogonal Procrustes problem $\min_{\bQ \in O(n)}\|\bQ\bA - \bB\|_F$. 在 ICA 中的应用。 对称 FastICA 用 $\bW \leftarrow (\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\bW$ 对当前估计作正交化（ ），由命题可知，这正是离 $\bW$ 最近的正交矩阵。它对各行一视同仁：由于矩阵函数与正交相似变换可交换，把 $\bW$ 换成 $\bPi\bW$，结果就变成 $\bPi(\bW\bW^\top)^{-1/2}\bW$；而 Gram–Schmidt 正交化的结果依赖于各行的次序。对于方阵可逆混合和单位方差源，ZCA 白化给出的白化混合矩阵 $(\bA\bA^\top)^{-1/2}\bA$ 正是 $\bA$ 的极因子（ ）。数值上，$\bQ_{\bW}$ 可由 SVD 求得，也可以用迭代法计算，例如从 $\bX = \bW$ 出发的 Newton 迭代 $\bX \leftarrow (\bX + \bX^{-\top})/2$（Higham, 1986）。把 $\bW$ 换成 $\bB\bA^\top$，同样的论证还可以解决正交 Procrustes 问题 $\min_{\bQ \in O(n)}\|\bQ\bA - \bB\|_F$。

Kronecker products. For $\bA \in \R^{p \times q}$ and $\bB \in \R^{r \times s}$, the Kronecker product $\bA \otimes \bB \in \R^{pr \times qs}$ is the block matrix whose $(i, j)$ block is $a_{ij}\bB$. It satisfies $(\bA \otimes \bB)(\bC \otimes \bD) = \bA\bC \otimes \bB\bD$ whenever the products exist, $(\bA \otimes \bB)^\top = \bA^\top \otimes \bB^\top$, and $(\bA \otimes \bB)^{-1} = \bA^{-1} \otimes \bB^{-1}$. For square $\bA$ ($p \times p$) and $\bB$ ($r \times r$), the eigenvalues of $\bA \otimes \bB$ are the products of an eigenvalue of $\bA$ and an eigenvalue of $\bB$, so $\tr(\bA \otimes \bB) = \tr\bA\,\tr\bB$ and $\det(\bA \otimes \bB) = (\det\bA)^r(\det\bB)^p$. By the first two rules, the Kronecker product of orthogonal matrices is orthogonal. Kronecker 积。 对 $\bA \in \R^{p \times q}$ 与 $\bB \in \R^{r \times s}$，Kronecker 积 $\bA \otimes \bB \in \R^{pr \times qs}$ 是第 $(i, j)$ 块为 $a_{ij}\bB$ 的分块矩阵。它满足：只要乘积有意义，就有 $(\bA \otimes \bB)(\bC \otimes \bD) = \bA\bC \otimes \bB\bD$；$(\bA \otimes \bB)^\top = \bA^\top \otimes \bB^\top$；$(\bA \otimes \bB)^{-1} = \bA^{-1} \otimes \bB^{-1}$。对方阵 $\bA$（$p \times p$）与 $\bB$（$r \times r$），$\bA \otimes \bB$ 的特征值是 $\bA$ 的一个特征值与 $\bB$ 的一个特征值之积，所以 $\tr(\bA \otimes \bB) = \tr\bA\,\tr\bB$，$\det(\bA \otimes \bB) = (\det\bA)^r(\det\bB)^p$。由前两条规则，正交矩阵的 Kronecker 积仍是正交矩阵。 The vec operator. $\vecop(\bX)$ stacks the columns of $\bX$ into one long vector. The key identity is vec 算子。 $\vecop(\bX)$ 把 $\bX$ 的各列依次叠成一个长向量。关键的恒等式是 $$\vecop(\bA\bX\bB) = (\bB^\top \otimes \bA)\,\vecop(\bX).$$ To see it, note that column $k$ of $\bA\bX\bB$ is $\sum_j b_{jk}\bA\bx_j$, where $\bx_j$ is column $j$ of $\bX$; this is block $k$ of $(\bB^\top \otimes \bA)\vecop(\bX)$, whose $(k, j)$ block is $b_{jk}\bA$. Special cases are $\vecop(\ba\bb^\top) = \bb \otimes \ba$ and $\tr(\bA^\top\bB) = \vecop(\bA)^\top\vecop(\bB)$. In NumPy, which stores arrays by rows, $\vecop(\bX)$ is X.reshape(-1, order="F") ; flattening by rows instead gives the identity with $\bA \otimes \bB^\top$ in place of $\bB^\top \otimes \bA$. 验证如下：$\bA\bX\bB$ 的第 $k$ 列为 $\sum_j b_{jk}\bA\bx_j$，其中 $\bx_j$ 是 $\bX$ 的第 $j$ 列；这正是 $(\bB^\top \otimes \bA)\vecop(\bX)$ 的第 $k$ 块，因为 $\bB^\top \otimes \bA$ 的第 $(k, j)$ 块为 $b_{jk}\bA$。特例有 $\vecop(\ba\bb^\top) = \bb \otimes \ba$ 与 $\tr(\bA^\top\bB) = \vecop(\bA)^\top\vecop(\bB)$。NumPy 按行存储数组，$\vecop(\bX)$ 对应 X.reshape(-1, order="F") ；若按行展平，恒等式中的 $\bB^\top \otimes \bA$ 要换成 $\bA \otimes \bB^\top$。 Tensors. An order-$k$ tensor is a $k$-way array $\mathcal{T} = (t_{i_1 \dots i_k})$. The outer product of vectors $\ba, \bb, \mathbf{c}, \mathbf{d}$ is the order-4 tensor $\ba \circ \bb \circ \mathbf{c} \circ \mathbf{d}$ with entries $a_ib_jc_kd_l$; tensors of this form have rank one. A tensor is symmetric if its entries are invariant under permutations of the indices. A CP (canonical polyadic) decomposition writes $\mathcal{T} = \sum_{r=1}^R \lambda_r\,\ba_r \circ \bb_r \circ \mathbf{c}_r \circ \mathbf{d}_r$, and the smallest such $R$ is the CP rank . Tensor rank behaves differently from matrix rank. It can exceed every dimension of the array, computing it is NP-hard in general (Hillar & Lim, 2013), and the CP decomposition is often essentially unique, whereas a low-rank matrix factorization is unique only up to an invertible linear transformation (Kolda & Bader, 2009). Uniqueness conditions, such as Kruskal's, are discussed in . 张量。 $k$ 阶张量是一个 $k$ 维数组 $\mathcal{T} = (t_{i_1 \dots i_k})$。向量 $\ba, \bb, \mathbf{c}, \mathbf{d}$ 的外积是四阶张量 $\ba \circ \bb \circ \mathbf{c} \circ \mathbf{d}$，其元素为 $a_ib_jc_kd_l$；这种形式的张量秩为一。若张量的元素在下标的任意置换下不变，则称它是 对称 的。CP（canonical polyadic）分解把张量写成 $\mathcal{T} = \sum_{r=1}^R \lambda_r\,\ba_r \circ \bb_r \circ \mathbf{c}_r \circ \mathbf{d}_r$，这样的 $R$ 的最小值称为 CP 秩 。张量秩与矩阵秩的性质很不一样：它可以超过数组的每一维，一般情形下计算它是 NP 难的（Hillar & Lim, 2013），而且 CP 分解常常在本质上唯一，而低秩矩阵分解只在相差一个可逆线性变换的意义下唯一（Kolda & Bader, 2009）。Kruskal 条件等唯一性条件见 。 Multilinear transformation. For a matrix $\bM$ with $n$ columns and an order-4 tensor $\mathcal{T}$ with all dimensions equal to $n$, define 多重线性变换。 对有 $n$ 列的矩阵 $\bM$ 与各维都等于 $n$ 的四阶张量 $\mathcal{T}$，定义 $$(\mathcal{T} \times_1 \bM \times_2 \bM \times_3 \bM \times_4 \bM)_{ijkl} = \sum_{p,q,r,t} m_{ip}\,m_{jq}\,m_{kr}\,m_{lt}\,t_{pqrt}.$$ It maps the rank-one tensor $\ba \circ \ba \circ \ba \circ \ba$ to $(\bM\ba) \circ (\bM\ba) \circ (\bM\ba) \circ (\bM\ba)$, and for orthogonal $\bM$ it preserves the Frobenius norm $\|\mathcal{T}\|_F^2 = \sum_{ijkl}t_{ijkl}^2$ ( ). The fourth-order cumulant tensor $\mathcal{K}_{\bx}$ of a random vector, with entries $\cum(x_i, x_j, x_k, x_l)$, is symmetric, and by multilinearity ( ) $\mathcal{K}_{\bM\bx} = \mathcal{K}_{\bx} \times_1 \bM \times_2 \bM \times_3 \bM \times_4 \bM$. For independent sources, $\mathcal{K}_{\bs}$ is diagonal, its only nonzero entries being $(\mathcal{K}_{\bs})_{pppp} = \kappa_p$. Hence, for $\bx = \bA\bs$, 它把秩一张量 $\ba \circ \ba \circ \ba \circ \ba$ 映为 $(\bM\ba) \circ (\bM\ba) \circ (\bM\ba) \circ (\bM\ba)$；当 $\bM$ 正交时，它保持 Frobenius 范数 $\|\mathcal{T}\|_F^2 = \sum_{ijkl}t_{ijkl}^2$ 不变（ ）。随机向量的四阶累积量张量 $\mathcal{K}_{\bx}$ 以 $\cum(x_i, x_j, x_k, x_l)$ 为元素，它是对称张量；由多重线性（ ），$\mathcal{K}_{\bM\bx} = \mathcal{K}_{\bx} \times_1 \bM \times_2 \bM \times_3 \bM \times_4 \bM$。对独立的源，$\mathcal{K}_{\bs}$ 是对角张量，唯一的非零元为 $(\mathcal{K}_{\bs})_{pppp} = \kappa_p$。因此对 $\bx = \bA\bs$， $$\mathcal{K}_{\bx} = \sum_{p=1}^n \kappa_p\,\ba_p \circ \ba_p \circ \ba_p \circ \ba_p,$$ a symmetric CP decomposition of rank at most $n$ whose factors are the columns of $\bA$; this is in tensor form. Arranging the entries as an $m^2 \times m^2$ matrix, with rows indexed by $(i, j)$ and columns by $(k, l)$, gives $\sum_p \kappa_p\,\vecop(\ba_p\ba_p^\top)\vecop(\ba_p\ba_p^\top)^\top$, a symmetric matrix of rank at most $n$. For whitened data the factors are orthogonal, which JADE exploits ( ); with more sources than sensors the tensor rank may exceed an individual mode dimension, but this is not guaranteed by the number of terms alone ( ). 这是一个秩至多为 $n$ 的对称 CP 分解，其因子就是 $\bA$ 的各列；它正是 的张量形式。把各元素排成 $m^2 \times m^2$ 的矩阵，行以 $(i, j)$ 为指标、列以 $(k, l)$ 为指标，得到 $\sum_p \kappa_p\,\vecop(\ba_p\ba_p^\top)\vecop(\ba_p\ba_p^\top)^\top$，这是秩至多为 $n$ 的对称矩阵。对白化后的数据，这些因子相互正交，JADE 正是利用了这一点（ ）；当源多于传感器时，张量秩可能超过单个模的维数，但仅凭分解项数并不能保证这一点（ ）。

A scalar objective can depend on every entry of a matrix. Its matrix gradient collects the corresponding partial derivatives in the same shape. Read the gradient as a direction of change before following the trace identities. 一个标量目标可以依赖矩阵的每个元素。矩阵梯度把各元素对应的偏导数按原来的形状排好。先把梯度理解成“变化方向”，再看后面的迹运算推导。 For a scalar function $f$ of a matrix $\bW \in \R^{n \times m}$, the gradient $\partial f/\partial\bW$ is the $n \times m$ matrix of partial derivatives $\partial f/\partial w_{ij}$. The most reliable way to compute it is through the differential: if $df = \tr(\bG^\top d\bW)$ for every direction $d\bW$, then $\partial f/\partial\bW = \bG$ (Magnus & Neudecker, 2019). The basic rules are 对矩阵 $\bW \in \R^{n \times m}$ 的标量函数 $f$，梯度 $\partial f/\partial\bW$ 是由偏导数 $\partial f/\partial w_{ij}$ 构成的 $n \times m$ 矩阵。最可靠的计算方法是通过微分：若对每个方向 $d\bW$ 都有 $df = \tr(\bG^\top d\bW)$，则 $\partial f/\partial\bW = \bG$（Magnus & Neudecker, 2019）。基本规则如下： $$\begin{aligned} d\,\tr(\bA\bW) &= \tr(\bA\,d\bW), & \frac{\partial\,\tr(\bA\bW)}{\partial\bW} &= \bA^\top, \\[6pt] d(\ba^\top\bW\bb) &= \tr(\bb\ba^\top d\bW), & \frac{\partial\,(\ba^\top\bW\bb)}{\partial\bW} &= \ba\bb^\top, \\[6pt] d\,\tr(\bW^\top\bM\bW) &= \tr\bigl(\bW^\top(\bM + \bM^\top)\,d\bW\bigr), & \frac{\partial\,\tr(\bW^\top\bM\bW)}{\partial\bW} &= (\bM + \bM^\top)\bW, \\[6pt] d(\bW^{-1}) &= -\bW^{-1}(d\bW)\,\bW^{-1}. \end{aligned}$$ The last rule follows by differentiating $\bW\bW^{-1} = \bI$. The determinant, which brings the Jacobian of $\by = \bW\bx$ into every likelihood and entropy of this book, has a particularly simple gradient. 最后一条由对 $\bW\bW^{-1} = \bI$ 求微分得到。行列式把变换 $\by = \bW\bx$ 的 Jacobi 因子带进了本书中的每个似然与熵，而它的梯度格外简单。 For invertible $\bW$, $d\log|\det\bW| = \tr(\bW^{-1}d\bW)$, hence $\partial\log|\det\bW|/\partial\bW = \bW^{-\top}$. 对可逆的 $\bW$，$d\log|\det\bW| = \tr(\bW^{-1}d\bW)$，因此 $\partial\log|\det\bW|/\partial\bW = \bW^{-\top}$。 $\det(\bW + d\bW) = \det\bW\,\det(\bI + \bW^{-1}d\bW)$, and $\det(\bI + \boldsymbol{\Delta}) = 1 + \tr\boldsymbol{\Delta} + O(\|\boldsymbol{\Delta}\|^2)$: in the expansion of the determinant, the product of the diagonal entries contributes $1 + \tr\boldsymbol{\Delta} + O(\|\boldsymbol{\Delta}\|^2)$, and every other term contains at least two off-diagonal entries of $\boldsymbol{\Delta}$. Hence $\log|\det(\bW + d\bW)| = \log|\det\bW| + \tr(\bW^{-1}d\bW) + O(\|d\bW\|^2)$. Writing $\tr(\bW^{-1}d\bW) = \tr\bigl((\bW^{-\top})^\top d\bW\bigr)$ identifies the gradient. $\det(\bW + d\bW) = \det\bW\,\det(\bI + \bW^{-1}d\bW)$，而 $\det(\bI + \boldsymbol{\Delta}) = 1 + \tr\boldsymbol{\Delta} + O(\|\boldsymbol{\Delta}\|^2)$：在行列式的展开式中，对角元之积贡献 $1 + \tr\boldsymbol{\Delta} + O(\|\boldsymbol{\Delta}\|^2)$，其余每一项都至少含有 $\boldsymbol{\Delta}$ 的两个非对角元。因此 $\log|\det(\bW + d\bW)| = \log|\det\bW| + \tr(\bW^{-1}d\bW) + O(\|d\bW\|^2)$。把 $\tr(\bW^{-1}d\bW)$ 写成 $\tr\bigl((\bW^{-\top})^\top d\bW\bigr)$，即得梯度。 Let $f(\bW) = \log|\det\bW| + \sum_i \E[\log p_i(\bw_i^\top\bx)]$, where $\bw_i^\top$ is row $i$ of $\bW$, $\by = \bW\bx$, and $\psi_i = -p_i'/p_i$ is the score function of source $i$. Then $df = \tr(\bW^{-1}d\bW) - \E\bigl[\sum_i \psi_i(y_i)\,d\bw_i^\top\bx\bigr] = \tr(\bW^{-1}d\bW) - \tr\bigl(\E[\bx\bpsi(\by)^\top]\,d\bW\bigr)$, so 设 $f(\bW) = \log|\det\bW| + \sum_i \E[\log p_i(\bw_i^\top\bx)]$，其中 $\bw_i^\top$ 是 $\bW$ 的第 $i$ 行，$\by = \bW\bx$，$\psi_i = -p_i'/p_i$ 是源 $i$ 的得分函数。则 $df = \tr(\bW^{-1}d\bW) - \E\bigl[\sum_i \psi_i(y_i)\,d\bw_i^\top\bx\bigr] = \tr(\bW^{-1}d\bW) - \tr\bigl(\E[\bx\bpsi(\by)^\top]\,d\bW\bigr)$，所以 $$\frac{\partial f}{\partial\bW} = \bW^{-\top} - \E\bigl[\bpsi(\by)\,\bx^\top\bigr], \qquad \frac{\partial f}{\partial\bW}\,\bW^\top\bW = \bigl(\bI - \E[\bpsi(\by)\,\by^\top]\bigr)\bW.$$ The second expression, the gradient multiplied on the right by the positive definite matrix $\bW^\top\bW$, is the relative or natural gradient of ; it is still an ascent direction, because $\langle\bG, \bG\bW^\top\bW\rangle = \|\bG\bW^\top\|_F^2 \ge 0$ for $\bG = \partial f/\partial\bW$. 第二个表达式，即右乘正定矩阵 $\bW^\top\bW$ 之后的梯度，就是 中的相对梯度（自然梯度）；它仍是上升方向，因为对 $\bG = \partial f/\partial\bW$ 有 $\langle\bG, \bG\bW^\top\bW\rangle = \|\bG\bW^\top\|_F^2 \ge 0$。 Formulas like these are easy to get wrong by a transpose, and easy to check. The script below verifies , by central differences, and against 20,000 random orthogonal matrices drawn uniformly from $O(4)$. 这类公式很容易在转置上出错，也很容易检验。下面的脚本验证 ，用中心差分验证 ，并用从 $O(4)$ 中均匀抽取的 20000 个随机正交矩阵检验 。 It prints True , a small finite-difference error (typically around 1e-8 to 1e-7 , with platform-dependent rounding), True , and the distances 2.886 from $\bW$ to its polar factor and 3.047 to the best of the random orthogonal matrices. 程序依次输出 True 、很小的有限差分误差（通常约为 1e-8 至 1e-7 ，末位受平台舍入影响）、 True ，以及 $\bW$ 到其极因子的距离 2.886 和到随机正交矩阵中最近者的距离 3.047 。

e j$），其中期望换成样本平均。它们的渐近协方差有标准的形式。 Let $ x(1), \dots,  x(T)$ be i.i.d., and let $\hat theta_T$ solve $ rac1T\sum_{t=1}^T \mathbf{h}( x(t),  theta) =  zero$, where $\E[\mathbf{h}( x,  theta_0)] =  zero$. Assume that $\hat theta_T 	o  theta_0$ in probability, that $\mathbf{h}$ is twice continuously differentiable in $ theta$ with first and second derivatives dominated near $ theta_0$ by an integrable function of $ x$, that $ H = \E[\partial\mathbf{h}( x,  theta_0)/\partial theta^	op]$ is invertible, and that $ B = \E[\mathbf{h}( x,  theta_0)\,\mathbf{h}( x,  theta_0)^	op]$ is finite. Then $\sqrt T(\hat theta_T -  theta_0) 	o \Ncal( zero,\  H^{-1} B H^{-	op})$. 设 $ x(1), \dots,  x(T)$ 独立同分布，$\hat theta_T$ 是方程 $ rac1T\sum_{t=1}^T \mathbf{h}( x(t),  theta) =  zero$ 的解，且 $\E[\mathbf{h}( x,  theta_0)] =  zero$。假设 $\hat theta_T$ 依概率收敛到 $ theta_0$；$\mathbf{h}$ 关于 $ theta$ 二阶连续可微，且其一阶与二阶导数在 $ theta_0$ 附近被某个关于 $ x$ 可积的函数控制；$ H = \E[\partial\mathbf{h}( x,  theta_0)/\partial theta^	op]$ 可逆；$ B = \E[\mathbf{h}( x,  theta_0)\,\mathbf{h}( x,  theta_0)^	op]$ 有限。则 $\sqrt T(\hat theta_T -  theta_0) 	o \Ncal( zero,\  H^{-1} B H^{-	op})$。 (Sketch.) A Taylor expansion of the estimating equations around $ theta_0$ gives $ zero =  rac1T\sum_t \mathbf{h}( x(t),  theta_0) + \hat H_T(\hat theta_T -  theta_0)$, where $\hat H_T$ is an average of derivatives evaluated at points between $\hat theta_T$ and $ theta_0$; by the law of large numbers and the domination condition, $\hat H_T 	o  H$ in probability. Hence $\sqrt T(\hat theta_T -  theta_0) = -\hat H_T^{-1}\,T^{-1/2}\sum_t \mathbf{h}( x(t),  theta_0)$ with probability tending to one, and the central limit theorem and Slutsky's lemma give the limit. Van der Vaart (1998, Chapter 5) gives the details and weaker conditions. （证明概要。）把估计方程在 $ theta_0$ 附近作 Taylor 展开，得 $ zero =  rac1T\sum_t \mathbf{h}( x(t),  theta_0) + \hat H_T(\hat theta_T -  theta_0)$，其中 $\hat H_T$ 是在 $\hat theta_T$ 与 $ theta_0$ 之间的点处取值的导数的平均；由大数定律与控制条件，$\hat H_T$ 依概率收敛到 $ H$。因此，在概率趋于一的事件上，$\sqrt T(\hat theta_T -  theta_0) = -\hat H_T^{-1}\,T^{-1/2}\sum_t \mathbf{h}( x(t),  theta_0)$，再由中心极限定理与 Slutsky 引理即得极限。细节以及更弱的条件见 van der Vaart（1998）第 5 章。 The covariance $ H^{-1} B H^{-	op}$ is called the sandwich . evaluates it for ICA estimators ( ), and works out the simplest case, the estimation of a location parameter. 协方差 $ H^{-1} B H^{-	op}$ 称为 三明治 （sandwich）协方差。 对 ICA 估计量计算了它（ ）， 则处理最简单的情形，即位置参数的估计。 Fisher information and the Cramér–Rao bound. For a family of densities $p( x;  theta)$, the Fisher information is $\mathcal{I}( theta) = \E igl[
abla_{ theta}\log p( x;  theta)\,
abla_{ theta}\log p( x;  theta)^	op igr]$, which equals $-\E[
abla^2_{ theta}\log p( x;  theta)]$ under regularity conditions. The Cramér–Rao bound states that, under regularity conditions, every unbiased estimator based on $T$ i.i.d. observations satisfies $\Cov(\hat theta) \succeq (T\,\mathcal{I}( theta))^{-1}$; the maximum-likelihood estimator is asymptotically normal with covariance $\mathcal{I}( theta)^{-1}/T$, so it attains the bound asymptotically (Lehmann & Casella, 1998; van der Vaart, 1998). In the sandwich formula, maximum likelihood takes $\mathbf{h}$ to be the score, so that $ H = -\mathcal{I}$, $ B = \mathcal{I}$ and $ H^{-1} B H^{-	op} = \mathcal{I}^{-1}$. For ICA, derives the bound for the gain matrix ( ). Fisher 信息与 Cramér–Rao 界。 对密度族 $p( x;  theta)$，Fisher 信息定义为 $\mathcal{I}( theta) = \E igl[
abla_{ theta}\log p( x;  theta)\,
abla_{ theta}\log p( x;  theta)^	op igr]$，在正则条件下它等于 $-\E[
abla^2_{ theta}\log p( x;  theta)]$。Cramér–Rao 界是说：在正则条件下，基于 $T$ 个独立同分布观测的任何无偏估计量都满足 $\Cov(\hat theta) \succeq (T\,\mathcal{I}( theta))^{-1}$；最大似然估计量渐近正态，协方差为 $\mathcal{I}( theta)^{-1}/T$，所以它渐近地达到这个界（Lehmann & Casella, 1998; van der Vaart, 1998）。在三明治公式中，最大似然取 $\mathbf{h}$ 为得分，于是 $ H = -\mathcal{I}$，$ B = \mathcal{I}$，$ H^{-1} B H^{-	op} = \mathcal{I}^{-1}$。对 ICA， 推导了增益矩阵的这个界（ ）。 For a location family $p(x - 	heta)$, the score with respect to $	heta$ is $-p'(x - 	heta)/p(x - 	heta) = \psi(x - 	heta)$, where $\psi = -p'/p$ is the score function in the book's notation, and the Fisher information is $\mathcal{J} = \E[\psi(s)^2]$. For the standard Gaussian, $\psi(u) = u$ and $\mathcal{J} = 1$; for the unit-variance Laplace law, $\psi(u) = \sqrt2\,\sign(u)$ and $\mathcal{J} = 2$. Among laws of a given variance, the Gaussian carries the least information. 对位置族 $p(x - 	heta)$，关于 $	heta$ 的得分为 $-p'(x - 	heta)/p(x - 	heta) = \psi(x - 	heta)$，其中 $\psi = -p'/p$ 即本书记号中的得分函数，Fisher 信息为 $\mathcal{J} = \E[\psi(s)^2]$。对标准高斯分布，$\psi(u) = u$，$\mathcal{J} = 1$；对单位方差的拉普拉斯分布，$\psi(u) = \sqrt2\,\sign(u)$，$\mathcal{J} = 2$。在方差给定的分布中，高斯分布携带的信息最少。 Let $s$ have zero mean, unit variance and a continuously differentiable density $p > 0$ with score $\psi = -p'/p$, $\mathcal{J} = \E[\psi(s)^2] < \infty$, and $u\,p(u) 	o 0$ as $|u| 	o \infty$. Then $\mathcal{J} \ge 1$, with equality if and only if $s \sim \Ncal(0, 1)$. 设 $s$ 均值为零、方差为一，具有连续可微的密度 $p > 0$，其得分为 $\psi = -p'/p$，$\mathcal{J} = \E[\psi(s)^2] < \infty$，并且当 $|u| 	o \infty$ 时 $u\,p(u) 	o 0$。则 $\mathcal{J} \ge 1$，等号成立当且仅当 $s \sim \Ncal(0, 1)$。 Integrating by parts, $\E[s\,\psi(s)] = -\int u\,p'(u)\,du =  igl[-u\,p(u) igr]_{-\infty}^{\infty} + \int p(u)\,du = 1$; the integral converges absolutely because $\E|s\,\psi(s)| \le (\E[s^2]\,\mathcal{J})^{1/2}$. By the Cauchy–Schwarz inequality, $1 = (\E[s\,\psi(s)])^2 \le \E[s^2]\,\E[\psi(s)^2] = \mathcal{J}$. Equality holds if and only if $\psi(s) = c\,s$ almost surely for a constant $c$; since $\psi$ is continuous and $p > 0$, this means $\psi(u) = cu$ for all $u$, so $(\log p)' = -cu$ and $p$ is a Gaussian density with variance $1/c$. Unit variance forces $c = 1$. 分部积分得 $\E[s\,\psi(s)] = -\int u\,p'(u)\,du =  igl[-u\,p(u) igr]_{-\infty}^{\infty} + \int p(u)\,du = 1$；由于 $\E|s\,\psi(s)| \le (\E[s^2]\,\mathcal{J})^{1/2}$，这个积分绝对收敛。由 Cauchy–Schwarz 不等式，$1 = (\E[s\,\psi(s)])^2 \le \E[s^2]\,\E[\psi(s)^2] = \mathcal{J}$。等号成立当且仅当存在常数 $c$ 使 $\psi(s) = c\,s$ 几乎必然成立；由于 $\psi$ 连续且 $p > 0$，这意味着对所有 $u$ 有 $\psi(u) = cu$，于是 $(\log p)' = -cu$，$p$ 是方差为 $1/c$ 的高斯密度。单位方差迫使 $c = 1$。 The same integration by parts applies to absolutely continuous densities such as the Laplace density, so the inequality holds for them too. Consequently, for two unit-variance sources $\mathcal{J}_i\mathcal{J}_j \ge 1$, with equality only when both are Gaussian, which is why the conditions $\mathcal{J}_i\mathcal{J}_j > 1$ in and fail only for pairs of Gaussian sources. 同样的分部积分也适用于拉普拉斯密度这样的绝对连续密度，所以不等式对它们同样成立。因此，对两个单位方差的源有 $\mathcal{J}_i\mathcal{J}_j \ge 1$，仅当二者都是高斯的时取等号；这就是为什么 与 中的条件 $\mathcal{J}_i\mathcal{J}_j > 1$ 只对一对高斯源才不成立。

A formula containing an inverse is not an instruction to construct that inverse. Solve a nonsingular square system with a linear solver; use QR or SVD for rectangular least squares. Forming normal equations squares the 2-norm condition number: for full-column-rank $\bA$, $\operatorname{cond}_2(\bA^\top\bA)=\operatorname{cond}_2(\bA)^2$. Mathematically equivalent formulas can behave very differently in floating-point arithmetic (Golub & Van Loan, 2013). 公式中出现逆矩阵，不代表程序必须显式求逆。可逆方阵方程应使用线性方程求解器；矩形最小二乘问题应使用 QR 或 SVD。构造正规方程会把 2-范数条件数平方：满列秩 $\bA$ 满足 $\operatorname{cond}_2(\bA^\top\bA)=\operatorname{cond}_2(\bA)^2$。数学上等价的公式，在浮点计算中可能有很不相同的表现（Golub & Van Loan, 2013）。 With thin SVD $\bA=\bL\diag(\sigma_i)\bR^\top$, the truncated pseudoinverse is $\bA_\tau^+=\sum_{\sigma_i>\tau}\sigma_i^{-1}\br_i\mathbf{l}_i^\top$. Its threshold selects the directions retained as identifiable. A machine-precision threshold addresses roundoff; it does not select the scientific model order or distinguish weak signal from noise. Report rank and threshold, and check sensitivity. Whitening amplifies a covariance eigen-direction by $\lambda_i^{-1/2}$, so a tiny eigenvalue calls for investigation, not silent clipping to an arbitrary positive constant. 设薄 SVD 为 $\bA=\bL\diag(\sigma_i)\bR^\top$，截断伪逆为 $\bA_\tau^+=\sum_{\sigma_i>\tau}\sigma_i^{-1}\br_i\mathbf{l}_i^\top$。阈值决定保留哪些方向作为可辨识方向。机器精度阈值处理的是舍入误差，不能替代科学上的模型阶数选择，也不能自动区分弱信号与噪声。应报告秩和阈值，并检查敏感性。白化会把协方差特征方向放大 $\lambda_i^{-1/2}$ 倍；极小特征值意味着需要调查，而不是默默用任意正数替换。 For samples in columns, center $\bX_c\in\R^{m\times T}$ and use its thin SVD directly. The following $1/T$-normalized PCA whitening avoids constructing the covariance Gram matrix and verifies the normalization. The threshold demonstrates numerical rank only; scientific model-order selection is discussed in . 对按列存放的样本，中心化得到 $\bX_c\in\R^{m\times T}$，然后直接使用薄 SVD。下面按 $1/T$ 归一化的 PCA 白化避免了构造协方差 Gram 矩阵，并验证归一化是否一致。这里的阈值只示范数值秩；科学上的模型阶数选择见 。

Dependent observations. For a stationary sequence of estimating functions $ h_t= h( x(t), theta_0)$, a suitable central limit theorem replaces the i.i.d. matrix $ B$ by the long-run covariance. Under conditions ensuring that limit theorem, consistent derivative estimation and convergence of the covariance sum, 相关观测。 对平稳估计函数序列 $ h_t= h( x(t), theta_0)$，适用的中心极限定理会把独立同分布情形的 $ B$ 替换为长期协方差。在满足极限定理、导数的一致估计及协方差级数收敛等条件时， $$ B_{\mathrm{LR}}=\sum_{k=-\infty}^{\infty}\Cov( h_0, h_k),\qquad \sqrt T(\hat theta_T- theta_0)\Rightarrow\Ncal( zero, H^{-1} B_{\mathrm{LR}} H^{-	op}).$$ Stationarity alone is insufficient: dependence and moment conditions must justify the limit theorem. Time points and spatially smoothed fMRI voxels are not automatically independent replications. HAC estimation or a suitable block bootstrap addresses dependence under its own assumptions; no single effective sample size generally corrects every component and statistic. Newey and West (1987) give a positive-semidefinite HAC construction. For a stationary AR(1) process of variance $\sigma_x^2$ and autocorrelation $ho^{|k|}$, $|ho|<1$, summing the geometric series gives $T\Var( ar x_T)	o\sigma_x^2(1+ho)/(1-ho)$. At $ho=0.8$, this is nine times the i.i.d. value. 仅有平稳性还不够，依赖结构和矩条件必须足以支持极限定理。时间点与经过空间平滑的 fMRI 体素都不能自动当作独立重复。HAC 估计或合适的分块自助法可在各自假设下处理相关性；通常不存在一个对所有成分和统计量都有效的统一有效样本量。Newey 与 West（1987）给出了保证半正定的 HAC 构造。对方差为 $\sigma_x^2$、自相关为 $ho^{|k|}$ 的平稳 AR(1) 过程（$|ho|<1$），对几何级数求和可得 $T\Var( ar x_T)	o\sigma_x^2(1+ho)/(1-ho)$；$ho=0.8$ 时，它是独立同分布值的九倍。 A zero first derivative. Squared off-diagonal gain errors, and ISR near perfect separation, live on this second-order scale. When resampling the complete fitted pipeline, repeat centering, dimension reduction, whitening and ICA inside each resample. Fixing an estimated whitening matrix gives conditional uncertainty that omits its sampling error. en: Start here: a beginner guide to ICA
zh: 从这里开始：ICA 新手指南
sectionEn: What are we trying to recover?
text: Imagine two microphones, each hearing a different blend of two voices. The recordings are visible; the original voices and their mixing weights are hidden. ICA tries to separate sources by exploiting a statistical assumption: the sources vary independently. It does not recognize voices by understanding speech. 想象两只麦克风，各自录到两个人声音的不同比例混合。录音是已知的，原始声音和混合比例却未知。ICA 利用一个统计假设——各个来源独立变化——尝试把它们分开；它不是先听懂语音，再辨认说话人。 For a first pass, keep three questions in view: What is observed? What assumption makes separation possible? How would we check the result? Real-room echoes and other departures from the simple model are separate issues, introduced in the chapters. 第一遍只抓住三个问题： 看到了什么？凭什么能分开？怎样检查分离结果？ 真实房间的回声等不满足简单模型的情况，会在后续章节单独说明。

en: Start here: a beginner guide to ICA
zh: 从这里开始：ICA 新手指南
sectionEn: A small example you can calculate by hand
text: 1. Mix. Suppose the source values at one instant are $s_1=2$ and $s_2=1$. One sensor adds them; another subtracts them. 1．混合。 设某一时刻的两个源值为 $s_1=2$、$s_2=1$。第一个传感器把它们相加，第二个传感器把它们相减。 $$x_1=s_1+s_2=3,\qquad x_2=s_1-s_2=1.$$ 2. Undo a known mix. Add the recordings and divide by two to recover the first source. Subtract them and divide by two to recover the second. 2．撤销已知混合。 把两路录音相加再除以 2，得到第一个源；相减再除以 2，得到第二个源。 $$s_1=\frac{x_1+x_2}{2}=2,\qquad s_2=\frac{x_1-x_2}{2}=1.$$ 3. See the blind part. These two arithmetic steps work because we were told the mixing rule. In ICA, that rule is unknown. We observe many pairs of measurements and use assumptions about the sources to estimate a separating rule. One pair of numbers cannot establish independence or solve a general blind separation problem. 3．看清“盲”在哪里。 上面能直接算回来，是因为题目告诉了混合规则。ICA 中这个规则未知；我们要观察许多组测量值，再利用源的假设估计分离规则。仅有一对数字，不能检验独立性，也不能解决一般的盲分离问题。 Your turn. Under the same known mixing rule, the recordings are $x_1=1$ and $x_2=5$. What are the two source values? 换你试试。 沿用同一个已知混合规则，若 $x_1=1$、$x_2=5$，两个源分别是多少？ Check the answer 查看答案 $s_1=(1+5)/2=3$, $s_2=(1-5)/2=-2$. Substitution gives $3+(-2)=1$ and $3-(-2)=5$. The negative sign is a valid signal value. $s_1=(1+5)/2=3$，$s_2=(1-5)/2=-2$。代回可得 $3+(-2)=1$、$3-(-2)=5$。信号出现负数完全正常。

en: Start here: a beginner guide to ICA
zh: 从这里开始：ICA 新手指南
sectionZh: 三遍阅读，不必一次攻完
text: Treat the appendix as a reference shelf. Open it when a symbol blocks the next step; you do not need to finish it before Chapter 1. Each chapter now starts with an unnumbered first-pass guide, a worked mini-example and two short checks. 把附录当工具架：某个符号挡住下一步时再去查，不必先读完附录才能进入第 1 章。每章开头都有不参与原有编号的导读、微型例子与两道短自测。 Pass 1 — understand the task. Read 1: the mixing model and ambiguities , 2: independence versus correlation , and 3: what whitening does . Stop when you can explain why whitening is useful but is not separation. 第一遍：知道问题是什么。 读 第 1 章的混合模型与不确定性 、 第 2 章的独立与不相关 、 第 3 章的白化 。能说清“白化有用，但白化不等于分离”，就可以继续。 Pass 2 — run and interpret an algorithm. Continue with 5: a non-Gaussianity measure , 8: FastICA , and 11: noise, dimension and reliability . Run the examples and explain what a stopping message does and does not prove. 第二遍：会运行，也会解释。 接着读 第 5 章的非高斯性度量 、 第 8 章的 FastICA 、 第 11 章的噪声、维数与可靠性 。运行示例，并解释“迭代停止”证明了什么、没有证明什么。 Pass 3 — choose a question. For why the model is identifiable , read 4 . For algorithm derivations , read 6 , 7 , and 9 . For uncertainty , read 10 . For new model classes , read 12 and 13 . For brain imaging , go from 11 to 14 and 15 . 第三遍：按问题深入。 想知道 为什么模型可辨识 ，读 第 4 章 ；想推导 算法 ，读 第 6 章 、 第 7 章 与 第 9 章 ；关心 不确定性 ，读 第 10 章 ；关心 新模型 ，读 第 12 章 与 第 13 章 ；做 脑影像 ，从第 11 章进入 第 14 章 和 第 15 章 。 A useful reading loop: read the question → predict the answer → follow one calculation → try the check → read the formal claim. A first-pass route postpones proofs; it does not remove the assumptions needed to use a result. 建议每次这样读： 先看问题 → 猜答案 → 跟算一步 → 做自测 → 再读正式结论。入门路线可以暂缓证明，但不能跳过使用结论所需的假设。

en: Start here: a beginner guide to ICA
zh: 从这里开始：ICA 新手指南
sectionEn: Read the symbols as a data flow
text: Lowercase bold letters are vectors: one observation across channels. Uppercase bold letters are matrices: many observations collected into a table, or a linear rule that transforms them. An index tells you which source, sensor or sample is being discussed. 粗体小写字母通常是向量：同一次观测在各通道上的值。粗体大写字母通常是矩阵：许多次观测拼成的数据表，或变换数据的线性规则。下标告诉你正在说哪个源、传感器或样本。 Core notation — keep this beside Chapter 1 核心符号：读第 1 章时可随时回查 Symbol 符号 Read it as 怎么读 $m,n,T$ number of sensors, sources, observations 传感器数、源数、观测次数 $\bX\in\R^{m\times T}$ observed data: m rows, T columns 观测数据：m 行、T 列 $\bS\in\R^{n\times T}$ unknown sources: one source per row 未知源：每行一个源 $\bA\in\R^{m\times n}$ mixing weights: source values → sensor values 混合权重：源值 → 传感器值 $\bW\in\R^{n\times m}$ estimated separating rule; y = Wx 估计的分离规则；y = Wx $\bZ$ centered, whitened data used by many algorithms 许多算法使用的中心化、白化后数据 $\bC_{\bx}$ covariance matrix: variances on its diagonal 协方差矩阵：对角线是各变量方差 $\bA^\top$ transpose: exchange rows and columns, not inversion 转置：交换行和列，不是求逆 $\bI$ identity matrix: leaves a vector unchanged 单位矩阵：乘上它后向量不变 $\E[f(s)]$ population average of f(s), when it exists f(s) 的总体平均，前提是该期望存在 $\frac1T\sum_{t=1}^T f(s(t))$ average computed from T observations 用 T 次观测计算出来的样本平均 $\hat\theta$ an estimate of an unknown quantity theta 未知量 theta 的估计值 Dimension check. With 3 sensors, 2 sources and 100 observations, X is 3×100, A is 3×2 and S is 2×100. In AS, the inner dimensions (2) agree; the result is 3×100. A separating matrix W has shape 2×3, so WX has two output rows. 先检查尺寸。 若有 3 个传感器、2 个源、100 次观测，则 X 为 3×100，A 为 3×2，S 为 2×100。计算 AS 时，中间两个维度都是 2，结果为 3×100。分离矩阵 W 为 2×3，因此 WX 有两行输出。 In the first chapters, columns are observations. In spatial fMRI ICA, columns can be voxels and rows can be time points: the word “sample” follows the model, not automatically the clock. Chapter 14 states that convention explicitly. 前几章把每列当一次观测。在 fMRI 空间 ICA 中，列可以是体素、行可以是时间点：“样本”跟随模型的定义，并不总指一个时间点。第 14 章会明确该约定。

en: Start here: a beginner guide to ICA
zh: 从这里开始：ICA 新手指南
sectionEn: Try it: zero correlation is not independence
sectionZh: 动手实验：不相关，仍可能没有分离
text: Each source independently takes −1 or +1 with equal probability. The four source pairs therefore each have probability 1/4. We rotate the pair by a fixed 30° to form the observed mixture. Move the proposed undo angle and watch the outputs. Point labels A–D follow the same source pair across all three plots. 两个源各自独立、等概率取 −1 或 +1，因此四种源组合的概率都为 1/4。我们把源向量固定旋转 30°，得到观测混合。调整你提出的“撤销角度”，观察输出；A–D 标记在三幅图中始终对应同一个源组合。 Proposed undo angle 试着撤销多少度 0° Keep the mixture 保持混合 Undo 30° 撤销 30° Try 75° 试试 75° Hidden sources (shown for teaching) 隐藏源（教学时显示） s₁ s₂ A B C D Observed mix: rotate 30° 观测混合：旋转 30° x₁ x₂ A B C D Output after your undo step 按你的角度撤销后的输出 y₁ y₂ A B C D Output covariance 输出之间的协方差 0.000 Excess kurtosis, each output 每路输出的超额峭度 −1.250 Still a mixture. Covariance alone does not reveal that. 仍然是混合；仅看协方差看不出来。 What to notice. Covariance stays zero at every angle. At 30°, the output matches the sources; at −60° or 120°, it matches after a swap and sign changes, which ICA allows. At 75°, one output is nonzero only when the other is zero: that is dependence even though their covariance is zero. 重点观察。 所有角度的协方差都保持零。撤销 30° 时输出就是源；撤销 −60° 或 120° 时，输出只是交换了顺序并翻转符号，ICA 同样认可。在 75° 时，一路输出非零，另一路就一定为零：这显然有依赖，尽管协方差为零。 The fourth-order statistic changes even when covariance does not. This is a preview of Chapter 5, not a rule that every non-Gaussian source has nonzero kurtosis. The plots enumerate an exact four-point probability model; they do not claim that four observations suffice for general ICA. The true mixing angle and sources are revealed here only for teaching. JavaScript enables the slider; the static plots and explanation still work without it. 协方差不变时，四阶统计量仍会变化。这是在预览第 5 章，不是在说所有非高斯源的峭度都非零。这里穷举的是一个精确的四点概率模型，不表示只要四次观测就能完成一般 ICA。真实混合角度与源只为教学而展示。启用 JavaScript 后可拖动滑块；未启用时仍可阅读静态图和解释。

en: Start here: a beginner guide to ICA
zh: 从这里开始：ICA 新手指南
sectionEn: A small glossary, with somewhere to go next
sectionZh: 术语速查：知道意思，再决定是否深挖
text: Source / component 源／成分 A hidden variable or process we want to separate. An estimated component is an output of a method, not automatically a true physical source. Read more → 希望分离的隐藏变量或过程。“估计成分”只是方法的输出，并不自动等于真实物理来源。 进一步阅读 → Mixing / unmixing 混合／解混 Mixing maps sources to measurements; unmixing maps measurements to estimated sources. “Blind” means the source values and mixing weights are not given. Read more → 混合把源变成测量值；解混把测量值变成源估计。“盲”指源值与混合权重事先未知。 进一步阅读 → Independence 独立 Knowing one variable does not change the probability distribution of the other. It concerns all statistical relationships, not only a straight-line trend. For several sources, the requirement is mutual independence, not merely independence of each pair. Read more → 知道一个变量的值，不会改变另一个变量的概率分布。它约束全部统计关系，而不只是一条直线趋势。源多于两个时，要求相互独立，不能只检查两两独立。 进一步阅读 → Covariance / correlation 协方差／相关系数 Covariance measures average co-movement around the means. Correlation divides it by the two standard deviations; it needs nonzero variances. Zero correlation is weaker than independence. Read more → 协方差衡量两个变量偏离各自均值时的共同变化。相关系数再除以双方标准差，需要方差非零。不相关比独立弱。 进一步阅读 → Centering / whitening 中心化／白化 Centering subtracts the mean. Whitening additionally changes scale and orientation so the chosen covariance convention becomes the identity; it does not finish ICA. Read more → 中心化减去均值；白化再改变尺度与方向，使选定约定下的协方差成为单位阵。白化不等于完成 ICA。 进一步阅读 → Gaussian / non-Gaussian 高斯／非高斯 Gaussian names a probability distribution, often drawn as a bell. Non-Gaussian means a different distribution; it does not mean “noise-free” or “useful signal.” Read more → 高斯是一类常画成钟形的概率分布；非高斯表示不是该分布，不代表“没有噪声”或“有用信号”。 进一步阅读 → Excess kurtosis / cumulant 超额峭度／累积量 For a zero-mean unit-variance variable, excess kurtosis is its fourth moment minus three. Cumulants organize higher-order dependence; zero kurtosis alone does not prove Gaussianity. Read more → 对零均值、单位方差变量，超额峭度是四阶矩减 3。累积量用来组织高阶依赖；峭度为零本身不能证明高斯性。 进一步阅读 → Contrast / objective 对比函数／目标函数 A score an algorithm optimizes to seek separation. A larger or smaller objective is meaningful only for that specified criterion and its assumptions. Read more → 算法为寻找分离而优化的评分。分数变大或变小，必须结合具体目标与假设解释。 进一步阅读 → Likelihood / score function 似然／得分函数 Likelihood rates observed data under a candidate density model. A score involves derivatives of log density; check the chapter’s sign convention. Read more → 似然评价某个候选密度模型对已观测数据的解释。得分函数涉及对数密度的导数；正负号请以该章约定为准。 进一步阅读 → Identifiability 可辨识性 Whether different model parameters can produce the same population distribution. It is a statement about the model, not a promise that an algorithm converges. Read more → 不同模型参数能否产生同一个总体分布。这是模型层面的性质，不是算法必然收敛的承诺。 进一步阅读 → Scale / sign / permutation ambiguity 尺度／符号／置换不确定性 Changing a source’s scale and compensating in its mixing weights leaves the data unchanged. Source order can also change. These are allowed ambiguities, not automatic failure. Read more → 改变源的尺度，再反向补偿混合权重，观测不变；源的排列也可以改变。这些允许的不确定性不应直接判为失败。 进一步阅读 → Rank / model order 秩／模型阶数 Rank counts independent linear directions. Model order is the chosen number of components. Numerical rank and scientifically appropriate model order need not coincide. Read more → 秩计算线性上独立的方向数。模型阶数是选取的成分数。数值秩不一定等于科学问题中合适的模型阶数。 进一步阅读 → Convergence / stability 收敛／稳定性 A stopping rule checks changes within a run. Stability compares repeated analyses. Neither alone proves that a recovered component is a true source. Read more → 停止准则检查单次运行的变化；稳定性比较重复分析。二者单独都不能证明恢复了真实源。 进一步阅读 → Standard deviation / standard error 标准差／标准误 Standard deviation describes variation of values. Standard error describes variation of an estimator across repeated data collection. Correlated observations require special care. Read more → 标准差描述数值本身的波动；标准误描述重复采集数据时估计量的波动。观测相关时尤其不能直接套独立样本公式。 进一步阅读 → Spatial ICA / time course 空间 ICA／时间过程 Spatial ICA seeks independent spatial maps while their time courses serve as mixing weights. Spatial overlap is not itself statistical dependence. Read more → 空间 ICA 寻找独立的空间图，而它们的时间过程充当混合权重。空间重叠本身不等于统计依赖。 进一步阅读 →

en: Start here: a beginner guide to ICA
zh: 从这里开始：ICA 新手指南
sectionZh: 正式公式前的三个小检查
text: Mean. The observations are 1 and 3. What is their mean, and what remains after centering? 均值。 观测为 1 和 3。均值是多少？减去均值后剩下什么？ Check the answer 查看答案 The mean is 2; centered observations are −1 and +1. Their mean is zero. Using the book’s /T convention, their variance is 1. 均值是 2；中心化后为 −1 和 +1，其均值为零。按本书的 /T 约定，方差为 1。 Dimensions. X has 4 rows and 200 columns. W has 3 rows and 4 columns. What is the shape of WX? 尺寸。 X 有 4 行、200 列，W 有 3 行、4 列。WX 的尺寸是什么？ Check the answer 查看答案 3×200. Each of 200 observation columns becomes a three-component output. This only checks the multiplication; it does not establish source recovery. 3×200。200 列观测各自被变成三成分输出。这只检查了矩阵乘法是否合法，不表示已经成功恢复源。 Independence. Two fair coins are tossed independently. What is the probability that both show heads? How does the answer change if the second always copies the first? 独立。 两枚公平硬币独立抛掷，同时正面的概率是多少？如果第二枚总是复制第一枚的结果呢？ Check the answer 查看答案 For independent coins it is (1/2)×(1/2)=1/4. For a perfect copy it is 1/2. Both individual coins are still fair, so checking marginal distributions alone misses the dependence. 独立时为 (1/2)×(1/2)=1/4；完全复制时为 1/2。两枚硬币各自仍然公平，因此只看各自的边缘分布会漏掉依赖关系。

en: Start here: a beginner guide to ICA
zh: 从这里开始：ICA 新手指南
sectionEn: Run your first example, then read its output
sectionZh: 运行第一个例子，并看懂输出
text: The browser experiment requires no installation. For the Python examples, use Python 3.12 and install the tested numerical dependencies. Download the Chapter 1 script and requirements.txt into the same new folder. Open a terminal in that folder. The commands below create an isolated environment; they do not require changing the system Python packages. 浏览器实验无需安装。运行 Python 示例则需要 Python 3.12 和已验证的数值依赖。把 第 1 章脚本 与 requirements.txt 下载到同一个新文件夹，并在该文件夹打开终端。下面的命令创建独立环境，无须修改系统 Python 包。 Windows PowerShell (Python launcher installed) Windows PowerShell（已安装 Python 启动器） macOS / Linux (python3 is Python 3.12) macOS / Linux（python3 指向 Python 3.12） Run the complete downloaded file, not only its final lines: later blocks can use variables defined earlier in the same chapter. A chapter’s printed-output block is something to compare against, not code to paste into Python. 运行完整下载文件，不要只复制最后几行：同章后面的代码可能使用前面定义的变量。正文中的“示例输出”用于对照，不是要粘贴运行的 Python 代码。 The first example prints a normalized gain matrix. A result near [[0.03, 1.00], [−1.00, 0.02]] means that the first output mostly matches the second source and the second output mostly matches the negative first source. The order and sign changes are allowed; the small unwanted entries measure residual mixing. The true sources and mixing matrix are known here because the data are synthetic. On real data you cannot normally compute this truth-based check. 第一个例子会打印归一化增益矩阵。若结果接近 [[0.03, 1.00], [−1.00, 0.02]]，表示第一路输出主要对应第二个源，第二路输出主要对应第一个源的负值。顺序交换和符号翻转是允许的，小的非目标项反映残余混合。这里之所以能对照真实源与混合矩阵，是因为数据由我们合成；真实数据通常不能直接计算这种依赖真值的检查。 Change one thing at a time: sample count, mixing weights or random seed. First predict what might change, then compare the output. Keep the original script so that an error is easy to reproduce. 一次只改一个量：样本数、混合权重或随机种子。先预测结果可能怎样变，再运行比较，并保留原脚本以便复现问题。

en: Start here: a beginner guide to ICA
zh: 从这里开始：ICA 新手指南
text: A symbol stops me 符号看不懂 Check the notation table , read its dimensions and say what the operation does in words before deriving anything. 先查 符号表 ，读出尺寸，再用一句话说明运算在做什么。 The proof feels too steep 证明跨度太大 Read the claim, its assumptions and the chapter’s mini-example first. Use the first-pass route to return to the proof after the idea is familiar. 先读结论、适用条件和该章微型例子，再按导读路线回到证明。 Python cannot find NumPy or SciPy 提示找不到 NumPy 或 SciPy Install requirements with the same environment executable used to run the script. If installation fails, read the first error line; a network or Python-version problem is not an ICA failure. 使用运行脚本的同一个环境解释器安装 requirements。安装失败先看第一条错误；网络或 Python 版本问题并不是 ICA 算法失败。 The file is not found 提示找不到文件 Check the terminal’s working folder and the actual filename. The script and requirements.txt should be in the folder where you ran the commands. 检查终端当前文件夹及实际文件名。脚本和 requirements.txt 应放在执行上述命令的文件夹里。 I get a rank or convergence error 提示秩不足或没有收敛 Read the error instead of replacing it with zero. Check data orientation, duplicate channels, retained dimension and sample count. Then consult the chapter’s diagnostics; changing seeds does not repair an invalid model. 不要把报错替换成零。先检查数据方向、重复通道、保留维数和样本数，再读该章诊断部分；换随机种子不能修复不成立的模型。 The components have different signs or order 成分符号或顺序不同 Use a one-to-one match and account for sign/scale ambiguities. Do not compare output row numbers as if their identities were fixed. 进行一一匹配，并考虑符号与尺度不确定性；不要默认输出行号就是固定的成分身份。 You are ready to continue when you can name the observed and hidden quantities, explain why zero correlation is not enough, and interpret a sign/permutation change. Continue to Chapter 1 → . 能做到这些就可以继续： 说出哪些量已知、哪些量隐藏，解释为什么不相关还不够，并正确理解符号／顺序变化。接着读 第 1 章 → 。
